xc_files.plain_code:
; Badger Smart Quad tutorial HUD v2.0 - client-side, informational only.
; Load on the HudController aliased "pilot-guide", NOT the flight computer.
; Arrows are projected from the cockpit's real 3D layout (from the blueprint)
; for the live HUD size and aspect ratio. They assume the seated first-person
; view centred on TERR (no head tracking). Calibration: see "Camera" below.
; The computer relay only supplies pilot subscription, never tutorial actions.

const $guide_steps = 15
const $guide_cps = 10

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Camera
; Seated eye position in craft coordinates (metres) and the vertical field
; of view in degrees. The view direction is the eye -> TERR button line.
; Fitted from an in-game screenshot (view centred on TERR): 13 cockpit points
; matched to within 2.4 px at 2560 x 1489 (UI scale 1.5).
const $cam_eye_x = 0
const $cam_eye_y = 2.876
const $cam_eye_z = -2.074
const $cam_vfov = 70
; TERR button on the centre NAV screen (pilot-screen, NAV page).
const $cam_look_x = 0
const $cam_look_y = 2.4188
const $cam_look_z = -2.9188

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Panels
; Three sets: compact (half size, the A- button), 1x, and 2x for 4K-class
; HUDs. The inactive sets are parked off-screen.
var $guide_window_0 = panel(top_left, 280, 270)
var $guide_window_1 = panel(top_left, 560, 540)
var $guide_window_2 = panel(top_left, 1120, 1080)
var $guide_icon_1 = panel(top_left, 32, 32)
var $guide_icon_2 = panel(top_left, 64, 64)
var $guide_arrow_a0 = panel(top_left, 160, 100)
var $guide_arrow_b0 = panel(top_left, 160, 100)
var $guide_arrow_c0 = panel(top_left, 160, 100)
var $guide_arrow_a1 = panel(top_left, 320, 200)
var $guide_arrow_b1 = panel(top_left, 320, 200)
var $guide_arrow_c1 = panel(top_left, 320, 200)
var $guide_arrow_a2 = panel(top_left, 640, 400)
var $guide_arrow_b2 = panel(top_left, 640, 400)
var $guide_arrow_c2 = panel(top_left, 640, 400)
var $guide_canvas = virtualscreen(1120, 1080)
var $guide_pointer = virtualscreen(640, 400)
var $guide_icon_canvas = virtualscreen(64, 64)

var $guide_background : number
var $guide_surface : number
var $guide_outline : number
var $guide_accent : number
var $guide_orange : number
var $guide_green : number
var $guide_white : number
var $guide_dim : number
var $guide_clear : number
var $guide_attention_ink : number
var $guide_sky : number
var $guide_ground : number
var $guide_pointer_attention = 0
var $guide_step = 0
var $guide_hidden = 0
var $guide_auto = 0
var $guide_show_arrows = 1
var $guide_page_started = 0
var $guide_last_key = -1
var $guide_last_width = -1
var $guide_last_height = -1
var $guide_last_fov = -1
var $guide_flash = 0
var $guide_key_group = 0
; Layout state.
var $gz = 1
var $guide_compact = 0
var $guide_auto_scale = 1
var $guide_compact_now = 0
; Dragging: click the title bar to pick the window up, click again to drop it.
; (The HUD has no press/release events, only clicks and the mouse position.)
var $guide_drag = 0
var $guide_drag_dx = 0
var $guide_drag_dy = 0
var $guide_drag_tick = 0
var $guide_drag_x0 = 0
var $guide_drag_y0 = 0
; Player-chosen window position as fractions of the screen; -1 = automatic.
var $guide_user_x = -1
var $guide_user_y = -1
var $guide_win_w = 560
var $guide_win_h = 540
var $guide_win_x = 0
var $guide_win_y = 0
var $guide_win_left = 0
var $guide_win_side_page = -1
; Camera basis.
var $cam_fx = 0
var $cam_fy = 0
var $cam_fz = -1
var $cam_rx = 1
var $cam_rz = 0
var $cam_ux = 0
var $cam_uy = 1
var $cam_uz = 0
var $cam_tx = 1
var $cam_ty = 1
var $guide_proj_x = 0
var $guide_proj_y = 0
var $guide_proj_front = 1
; Target scratch.
var $gt_x = 0
var $gt_y = 0
var $gt_z = 0
; Pointer plans for this page: tip on screen, label, side, lift.
array $gp_tip_x : number
array $gp_tip_y : number
array $gp_label : text
array $gp_side : number
array $gp_lift : number
; Dedicated cosmetic radio. This never sends craft commands or player tokens.
var $guide_radio = beacon("BADGER-GUIDE-UI-IN", "BADGER-GUIDE-UI-OUT")
var $guide_radio_last = ""
var $guide_radio_next = 0
var $guide_radio_sequence = 0
array $guide_titles : text
array $guide_line_a : text
array $guide_line_b : text
array $guide_line_c : text
array $guide_line_d : text
array $guide_line_e : text
array $guide_hint : text

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Drawing
; All coordinates are in 1x layout units and multiplied by $gz here.
; The game font only has integer sizes: 2 = body, 3 = titles (1x).

function @g_rect($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $ink : number, $fill : number)
	$guide_canvas.draw_rect($x1 * $gz, $y1 * $gz, $x2 * $gz, $y2 * $gz, $ink, $fill)
	if $gz > 1
		$guide_canvas.draw_rect($x1 * $gz + 1, $y1 * $gz + 1, $x2 * $gz - 1, $y2 * $gz - 1, $ink)

function @g_frame($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $ink : number)
	$guide_canvas.draw_rect($x1 * $gz, $y1 * $gz, $x2 * $gz, $y2 * $gz, $ink)
	if $gz > 1
		$guide_canvas.draw_rect($x1 * $gz + 1, $y1 * $gz + 1, $x2 * $gz - 1, $y2 * $gz - 1, $ink)

function @g_line($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $ink : number)
	; Two-pixel line at 1x (four at 2x): thin lines blur on a HUD.
	var $g_line_i_n = max(1, floor(2 * $gz))
	repeat $g_line_i_n ($g_line_i)
		var $g_line_o = $g_line_i - floor($g_line_i_n / 2)
		if abs($x2 - $x1) >= abs($y2 - $y1)
			$guide_canvas.draw_line($x1 * $gz, $y1 * $gz + $g_line_o, $x2 * $gz, $y2 * $gz + $g_line_o, $ink)
		else
			$guide_canvas.draw_line($x1 * $gz + $g_line_o, $y1 * $gz, $x2 * $gz + $g_line_o, $y2 * $gz, $ink)

function @g_text($gx : number, $gy : number, $gs : number, $gc : number, $gt : text)
	$guide_canvas.text_size(max(1, floor($gs * $gz + 0.5)))
	$guide_canvas.text_align(top_left)
	$guide_canvas.write($gx * $gz, $gy * $gz, $gc, $gt)

function @g_center($gx : number, $gy : number, $gs : number, $gc : number, $gt : text)
	$guide_canvas.text_size(max(1, floor($gs * $gz + 0.5)))
	; Native center alignment uses the screen origin, not a write-point anchor.
	; Compute the text origin explicitly from the live font metrics instead.
	$guide_canvas.text_align(top_left)
	var $g_center_w = size($gt) * $guide_canvas.char_w
	$guide_canvas.write($gx * $gz - $g_center_w / 2, $gy * $gz - $guide_canvas.char_h / 2, $gc, $gt)

function @g_right($gx : number, $gy : number, $gs : number, $gc : number, $gt : text)
	$guide_canvas.text_size(max(1, floor($gs * $gz + 0.5)))
	$guide_canvas.text_align(top_left)
	$guide_canvas.write($gx * $gz - size($gt) * $guide_canvas.char_w, $gy * $gz, $gc, $gt)

; Centred note, word-wrapped to two lines of at most 42 characters.
function @g_note($gy : number, $gc : number, $gt : text)
	if size($gt) <= 42
		@g_center(280, $gy, 2, $gc, $gt)
		return
	var $g_note_cut = 42
	while ($g_note_cut > 0) and (substring($gt, $g_note_cut, 1) != " ")
		$g_note_cut -= 1
	if $g_note_cut == 0
		$g_note_cut = 42
	@g_center(280, $gy - 11, 2, $gc, substring($gt, 0, $g_note_cut))
	@g_center(280, $gy + 11, 2, $gc, substring($gt, $g_note_cut + 1, size($gt) - $g_note_cut - 1))

function @g_box($gx : number, $gy : number, $gw : number, $gh : number, $label : text, $enabled : number)
	var $g_box_ink = $guide_dim
	if $enabled
		$g_box_ink = $guide_accent
	@g_rect($gx, $gy, $gx + $gw, $gy + $gh, $g_box_ink, $guide_surface)
	@g_center($gx + $gw / 2, $gy + $gh / 2, 2, $g_box_ink, $label)

; Thick arrow with an aligned head (1x units).
function @g_arrow($from_x : number, $from_y : number, $tip_x : number, $tip_y : number)
	var $g_arrow_dx = $tip_x - $from_x
	var $g_arrow_dy = $tip_y - $from_y
	var $g_arrow_len = sqrt($g_arrow_dx * $g_arrow_dx + $g_arrow_dy * $g_arrow_dy)
	if $g_arrow_len == 0
		return
	var $g_arrow_ux = $g_arrow_dx / $g_arrow_len
	var $g_arrow_uy = $g_arrow_dy / $g_arrow_len
	var $g_arrow_s_n = max(2, floor(5 * $gz))
	repeat $g_arrow_s_n ($g_arrow_s)
		var $g_arrow_o = ($g_arrow_s - ($g_arrow_s_n - 1) / 2) / $gz
		$guide_canvas.draw_line(($from_x - $g_arrow_o * $g_arrow_uy) * $gz, ($from_y + $g_arrow_o * $g_arrow_ux) * $gz, ($tip_x - 10 * $g_arrow_ux - $g_arrow_o * $g_arrow_uy) * $gz, ($tip_y - 10 * $g_arrow_uy + $g_arrow_o * $g_arrow_ux) * $gz, $guide_accent)
	var $g_arrow_bx = $tip_x - 16 * $g_arrow_ux
	var $g_arrow_by = $tip_y - 16 * $g_arrow_uy
	$guide_canvas.draw_triangle($tip_x * $gz, $tip_y * $gz, ($g_arrow_bx - 9 * $g_arrow_uy) * $gz, ($g_arrow_by + 9 * $g_arrow_ux) * $gz, ($g_arrow_bx + 9 * $g_arrow_uy) * $gz, ($g_arrow_by - 9 * $g_arrow_ux) * $gz, $guide_accent, $guide_accent)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- State
function @guide_remember()
	; Player-local preferences only: no craft storage, identity, token or commands.
	set("badger_guide_v1_page", $guide_step)
	set("badger_guide_v1_hidden", $guide_hidden)
	set("badger_guide_v1_arrows", $guide_show_arrows)
	set("badger_guide_v1_initialized", 1)
	set("badger_guide_v1_px", $guide_user_x)
	set("badger_guide_v1_py", $guide_user_y)
	if !$guide_auto_scale
		set("badger_guide_v1_compact", $guide_compact)

function @guide_move($next_page : number)
	$guide_step = clamp(floor($next_page), 0, $guide_steps - 1)
	$guide_page_started = tick
	$guide_last_key = -1
	@guide_remember()

function @guide_hide()
	$guide_hidden = 1
	$guide_auto = 0
	$guide_last_key = -1
	@guide_remember()

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Diagrams
; Diagram area: x 20..540, y 218..394 (1x).

function @guide_key($kx : number, $ky : number, $kw : number, $label : text, $active : number)
	var $key_ink = $guide_dim
	var $key_fill = $guide_surface
	if $active
		$key_ink = $guide_accent
		if $guide_flash
			$key_fill = $guide_green
	@g_rect($kx, $ky, $kx + $kw, $ky + 38, $key_ink, $key_fill)
	if $active and $guide_flash
		$key_ink = $guide_background
	@g_center($kx + $kw / 2, $ky + 19, 2, $key_ink, $label)

function @guide_keyboard()
	if $guide_step == 4
		@guide_key(232, 232, 52, "W", $guide_key_group == 0)
		@guide_key(172, 276, 52, "A", $guide_key_group == 1)
		@guide_key(232, 276, 52, "S", $guide_key_group == 0)
		@guide_key(292, 276, 52, "D", $guide_key_group == 1)
		@guide_key(92, 276, 52, "Q", $guide_key_group == 2)
		@guide_key(392, 276, 52, "E", $guide_key_group == 2)
		var $key_caption = "W / S : PITCH"
		var $key_tip = 258
		if $guide_key_group == 1
			$key_caption = "A / D : ROLL"
			$key_tip = 198
		elseif $guide_key_group == 2
			$key_caption = "Q / E : YAW"
			$key_tip = 418
		@g_arrow(280, 352, $key_tip, 318)
		@g_center(280, 372, 2, $guide_accent, $key_caption)
	else
		@guide_key(52, 248, 150, "L CTRL", !$guide_key_group)
		@guide_key(222, 248, 286, "SPACE", $guide_key_group)
		var $throttle_caption = "LESS THROTTLE / DESCEND"
		if $guide_key_group
			$throttle_caption = "MORE THROTTLE / CLIMB"
		@g_center(280, 318, 2, $guide_accent, $throttle_caption)
		@g_note(360, $guide_orange, "AP OFF ONLY - THESE DO NOT SET AP ALTITUDE")

function @guide_diagram()
	if ($guide_step == 4) or ($guide_step == 5)

		return
	@g_rect(20, 218, 540, 394, $guide_dim, $guide_surface)

	elseif $guide_step == 1

	elseif $guide_step == 6
		@g_line(110, 236, 110, 376, $guide_white)

		@g_text(168, 294, 2, $guide_accent, "AP  : COMMANDED COLLECTIVE")

	elseif $guide_step == 7
		@g_rect(44, 234, 274, 310, $guide_sky, $guide_sky)

		@g_line(124, 306, 168, 262, $guide_accent)

	elseif $guide_step == 9

		@g_box(160, 244, 112, 52, "DOME", 1)
		@g_box(284, 244, 112, 52, "NAV", 1)
		@g_box(408, 244, 112, 52, "FLOOD", 1)
		@g_note(350, $guide_orange, "NAV AND FLOOD ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE.")
	elseif $guide_step == 10
		@g_box(36, 244, 112, 52, "ROTORS", 1)

	elseif $guide_step == 11

		@g_box(334, 238, 170, 66, "AP MASTER", 1)

		@g_note(352, $guide_orange, "AP NEEDS STAB. AP OFF LEAVES STAB ON.")
	elseif $guide_step == 12

	elseif $guide_step == 13

	elseif $guide_step == 14
		@g_box(56, 238, 170, 66, "1. ROTORS", 1)
		@g_box(334, 238, 170, 66, "2. MASTER", 1)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Camera / projection
function @guide_camera()
	var $cam_dx = $cam_look_x - $cam_eye_x
	var $cam_dy = $cam_look_y - $cam_eye_y
	var $cam_dz = $cam_look_z - $cam_eye_z
	var $cam_n = sqrt($cam_dx * $cam_dx + $cam_dy * $cam_dy + $cam_dz * $cam_dz)
	$cam_fx = $cam_dx / $cam_n
	$cam_fy = $cam_dy / $cam_n
	$cam_fz = $cam_dz / $cam_n
	; right = forward x up(0,1,0); up = right x forward
	var $cam_rn = sqrt($cam_fz * $cam_fz + $cam_fx * $cam_fx)
	$cam_rx = -$cam_fz / $cam_rn
	$cam_rz = $cam_fx / $cam_rn
	$cam_ux = -$cam_rz * $cam_fy
	$cam_uy = $cam_rz * $cam_fx - $cam_rx * $cam_fz
	$cam_uz = $cam_rx * $cam_fy
	$cam_ty = tan($cam_vfov * pi / 360)
	$cam_tx = $cam_ty * screen_w / max(1, screen_h)
	; Use the player's own field of view when the HUD reports one (radians).
	; Above ~92 degrees it can only be a horizontal FOV; below, treat it as vertical.
	var $cam_fov = fov
	if ($cam_fov > 0.35) and ($cam_fov < 1.6)
		$cam_ty = tan($cam_fov / 2)
		$cam_tx = $cam_ty * screen_w / max(1, screen_h)
	elseif ($cam_fov >= 1.6) and ($cam_fov < 3)
		$cam_tx = tan($cam_fov / 2)
		$cam_ty = $cam_tx * screen_h / max(1, screen_w)

function @guide_project($px : number, $py : number, $pz : number)
	var $proj_dx = $px - $cam_eye_x
	var $proj_dy = $py - $cam_eye_y
	var $proj_dz = $pz - $cam_eye_z
	var $proj_cx = $proj_dx * $cam_rx + $proj_dz * $cam_rz
	var $proj_cy = $proj_dx * $cam_ux + $proj_dy * $cam_uy + $proj_dz * $cam_uz
	var $proj_cz = $proj_dx * $cam_fx + $proj_dy * $cam_fy + $proj_dz * $cam_fz
	$guide_proj_front = $proj_cz > 0.05
	$proj_cz = max($proj_cz, 0.05)
	$guide_proj_x = screen_w * (0.5 + $proj_cx / ($proj_cz * $cam_tx) / 2)
	$guide_proj_y = screen_h * (0.5 - $proj_cy / ($proj_cz * $cam_ty) / 2)

; Cockpit points (craft metres), computed from the blueprint dashboards:
; pilot-screen origin (-0.750, 2.003, -2.503), main-dash origin (0.750, 2.003, -2.503),
; both tilted 45 degrees back; tips sit on the top edge of each button or screen.
function @guide_target($target : number)
	if $target == 1
		; SYSTEMS strip PWR (pilot-screen 3)
		$gt_x = -0.6798
		$gt_y = 2.1206
		$gt_z = -2.6206
	elseif $target == 2
		; Attitude display (pilot-screen 0), top edge
		$gt_x = -0.4998
		$gt_y = 2.4930
		$gt_z = -2.9930
	elseif $target == 3
		; NAV display (pilot-screen 2), top edge
		$gt_x = 0.0002
		$gt_y = 2.4930
		$gt_z = -2.9930
	elseif $target == 4
		; LIGHTS panel (main-dash 1), top edge
		$gt_x = 0.8747
		$gt_y = 2.1228
		$gt_z = -2.6228
	elseif $target == 5
		; Systems display tabs (pilot-screen 1), top edge
		$gt_x = 0.5002
		$gt_y = 2.4930
		$gt_z = -2.9930
	elseif $target == 6
		; STAB (pilot-screen 3, FLIGHT group, lower row)
		$gt_x = -0.4364
		$gt_y = 2.0617
		$gt_z = -2.5617
	elseif $target == 7
		; AP MASTER (pilot-screen 3, AUTOPILOT group)
		$gt_x = -0.3131
		$gt_y = 2.1206
		$gt_z = -2.6206
	elseif $target == 8
		; AP MODE tab (pilot-screen 1)
		$gt_x = 0.4369
		$gt_y = 2.4942
		$gt_z = -2.9942
	elseif $target == 9
		; NAV START (pilot-screen 5)
		$gt_x = -0.1848
		$gt_y = 2.1206
		$gt_z = -2.6206
	elseif $target == 10
		; DOCK / LAND (pilot-screen 5, FUNCTION group)
		$gt_x = 0.0052
		$gt_y = 2.1206
		$gt_z = -2.6206
	else
		; ROTORS (pilot-screen 3, FLIGHT group, upper row)
		$gt_x = -0.4364
		$gt_y = 2.1206
		$gt_z = -2.6206

; Plan one pointer: project the target, keep the tip on screen and pick the
; label side (toward the screen centre) unless one is forced.
function @guide_plan($target : number, $label : text, $side : number, $lift : number)
	@guide_target($target)
	@guide_project($gt_x, $gt_y, $gt_z)
	var $plan_margin = 24 * $gz
	var $plan_label = $label
	var $plan_x = $guide_proj_x
	var $plan_y = $guide_proj_y
	if !$guide_proj_front
		$plan_y = screen_h - $plan_margin
	if $plan_x > screen_w - $plan_margin
		$plan_x = screen_w - $plan_margin
		$plan_label = $label & " >"
	elseif $plan_x < $plan_margin
		$plan_x = $plan_margin
		$plan_label = "< " & $label
	if $plan_y > screen_h - $plan_margin
		$plan_y = screen_h - $plan_margin
		$plan_label = $plan_label & " (LOOK DOWN)"
	; Leave room above the tip for the label box.
	$plan_y = max($plan_y, ($lift + 40) * $gz)
	var $plan_side = $side
	if $plan_side == 2
		$plan_side = -1
		if $plan_x < screen_w / 2
			$plan_side = 1
	$gp_tip_x.append($plan_x)
	$gp_tip_y.append($plan_y)
	$gp_label.append($plan_label)
	$gp_side.append($plan_side)
	$gp_lift.append($lift)

function @guide_page_targets()
	$gp_tip_x.clear()
	$gp_tip_y.clear()
	$gp_label.clear()
	$gp_side.clear()
	$gp_lift.clear()
	if $guide_step == 2
		@guide_plan(1, "PWR", 2, 90)
	elseif $guide_step == 7
		@guide_plan(2, "ATTITUDE DISPLAY", 2, 80)
	elseif $guide_step == 8
		@guide_plan(3, "NAV DISPLAY", 0, 80)
	elseif $guide_step == 9
		@guide_plan(4, "LIGHTS", 2, 90)
	elseif $guide_step == 10
		@guide_plan(5, "ROTORS / SYSTEMS", 2, 80)
	elseif $guide_step == 11
		@guide_plan(6, "STAB", -1, 70)
		@guide_plan(7, "AP MASTER", 1, 120)
	elseif $guide_step == 12
		@guide_plan(8, "AP MODE", 2, 80)
	elseif $guide_step == 13
		@guide_plan(9, "NAV START", -1, 90)
		@guide_plan(10, "DOCK / LAND", 1, 90)
	elseif $guide_step == 14
		@guide_plan(11, "1. ROTORS", -1, 90)
		@guide_plan(7, "2. AP MASTER", 1, 130)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Pointers
; Pointer panel (1x): 320 x 200. The tip is on the bottom row; the label box
; sits $lift above it, offset toward the side given (-1 left, 0 above, 1 right).
function @guide_pointer_draw($slot : number)
	var $pd_side = $gp_side.$slot
	var $pd_lift = $gp_lift.$slot
	var $pd_label = $gp_label.$slot
	var $pd_tip_x = 160
	var $pd_label_x = 160
	if $pd_side < 0
		$pd_tip_x = 300
		$pd_label_x = 300 - 150
	elseif $pd_side > 0
		$pd_tip_x = 20
		$pd_label_x = 20 + 150
	var $pd_tip_y = 196
	var $pd_box_bottom = $pd_tip_y - $pd_lift
	var $pd_ink = $guide_accent
	if $guide_pointer_attention
		$pd_ink = $guide_attention_ink
	$guide_pointer.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_pointer.text_size(max(1, floor(2 * $gz + 0.5)))
	$guide_pointer.text_align(top_left)
	var $pd_text_w = size($pd_label) * $guide_pointer.char_w / $gz
	var $pd_half = min(155, $pd_text_w / 2 + 10)
	var $pd_left = clamp($pd_label_x - $pd_half, 2, 318 - 2 * $pd_half)
	$guide_pointer.draw_rect($pd_left * $gz, ($pd_box_bottom - 30) * $gz, ($pd_left + 2 * $pd_half) * $gz, $pd_box_bottom * $gz, $pd_ink, $guide_background)
	$guide_pointer.write(($pd_left + $pd_half) * $gz - size($pd_label) * $guide_pointer.char_w / 2, ($pd_box_bottom - 15) * $gz - $guide_pointer.char_h / 2, $pd_ink, $pd_label)
	; Shaft from the label box to the tip, then an aligned head.
	var $pd_from_x = $pd_left + $pd_half
	var $pd_from_y = $pd_box_bottom + 2
	var $pd_dx = $pd_tip_x - $pd_from_x
	var $pd_dy = $pd_tip_y - $pd_from_y
	var $pd_len = sqrt($pd_dx * $pd_dx + $pd_dy * $pd_dy)
	var $pd_ux = $pd_dx / $pd_len
	var $pd_uy = $pd_dy / $pd_len
	var $pd_s_n = max(3, floor(7 * $gz))
	repeat $pd_s_n ($pd_s)
		var $pd_o = ($pd_s - ($pd_s_n - 1) / 2) / $gz
		$guide_pointer.draw_line(($pd_from_x - $pd_o * $pd_uy) * $gz, ($pd_from_y + $pd_o * $pd_ux) * $gz, ($pd_tip_x - 20 * $pd_ux - $pd_o * $pd_uy) * $gz, ($pd_tip_y - 20 * $pd_uy + $pd_o * $pd_ux) * $gz, $pd_ink)
	var $pd_bx = $pd_tip_x - 30 * $pd_ux
	var $pd_by = $pd_tip_y - 30 * $pd_uy
	$guide_pointer.draw_triangle($pd_tip_x * $gz, $pd_tip_y * $gz, ($pd_bx - 16 * $pd_uy) * $gz, ($pd_by + 16 * $pd_ux) * $gz, ($pd_bx + 16 * $pd_uy) * $gz, ($pd_by - 16 * $pd_ux) * $gz, $pd_ink, $pd_ink)
	var $pd_x = $gp_tip_x.$slot - $pd_tip_x * $gz
	var $pd_y = $gp_tip_y.$slot - $pd_tip_y * $gz
	if $gz < 1
		if $slot == 0
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_a0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 160, 100)
			$guide_arrow_a0.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		elseif $slot == 1
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_b0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 160, 100)
			$guide_arrow_b0.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		else
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_c0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 160, 100)
			$guide_arrow_c0.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
	elseif $gz == 1
		if $slot == 0
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_a1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 320, 200)
			$guide_arrow_a1.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		elseif $slot == 1
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_b1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 320, 200)
			$guide_arrow_b1.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		else
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_c1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 320, 200)
			$guide_arrow_c1.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
	else
		if $slot == 0
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_a2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 640, 400)
			$guide_arrow_a2.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		elseif $slot == 1
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_b2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 640, 400)
			$guide_arrow_b2.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)
		else
			screen_copy($guide_pointer, $guide_arrow_c2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 640, 400)
			$guide_arrow_c2.set_position($pd_x, $pd_y)

function @guide_pointers_blank()
	; Park unused arrow panels off-screen too: an empty panel can still take clicks.
	$guide_arrow_a0.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_a0.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_b0.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_b0.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_c0.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_c0.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_a1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_a1.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_b1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_b1.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_c1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_c1.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_a2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_a2.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_b2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_b2.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_arrow_c2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_arrow_c2.set_position(-5000, -5000)

function @guide_pointers()
	@guide_pointers_blank()
	if $guide_hidden or (!$guide_show_arrows)
		return
	var $pointer_slot_n = size($gp_tip_x)
	repeat $pointer_slot_n ($pointer_slot)
		@guide_pointer_draw($pointer_slot)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Layout
function @guide_window_move()
	var $place_w = $guide_win_w * $gz
	$guide_window_0.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_window_1.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_window_2.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_icon_1.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	$guide_icon_2.set_position(-5000, -5000)
	; Only one of window / re-open icon is ever on screen: an empty panel still
	; takes clicks, and the icon sits exactly over the window's X button.
	if !$guide_hidden
		if $gz < 1
			$guide_window_0.set_position($guide_win_x, $guide_win_y)
		elseif $gz == 1
			$guide_window_1.set_position($guide_win_x, $guide_win_y)
		else
			$guide_window_2.set_position($guide_win_x, $guide_win_y)
		return
	; The re-open icon is never smaller than 32 px.
	if $gz < 2
		$guide_icon_1.set_position($guide_win_x + $place_w - 32, $guide_win_y)
	else
		$guide_icon_2.set_position($guide_win_x + $place_w - 64, $guide_win_y)

function @guide_place_window()
	; Default: upper right, just under the corner Archean uses for its own info icon.
	; Pages whose arrows point under that spot move the window to the left.
	var $place_w = $guide_win_w * $gz
	var $place_h = $guide_win_h * $gz
	var $place_y = 56 * max(1, $gz)
	if screen_h < $place_y + $place_h + 8
		$place_y = max(8, screen_h - $place_h - 8)
	var $place_right = max(8, screen_w - $place_w - 18 * $gz)
	var $place_x = $place_right
	$guide_win_left = 0
	if $guide_user_x >= 0
		; Where the player dropped it, kept fully on screen.
		$place_x = clamp($guide_user_x * screen_w, 0, max(0, screen_w - $place_w))
		$place_y = clamp($guide_user_y * screen_h, 0, max(0, screen_h - $place_h))
	elseif $guide_show_arrows and (!$guide_hidden)
		var $place_hit = 0
		var $place_i_n = size($gp_tip_x)
		repeat $place_i_n ($place_i)
			var $place_tx = $gp_tip_x.$place_i
			var $place_ty = $gp_tip_y.$place_i
			; Tip and label box (the label sits up to 340 px to the side).
			if ($place_tx > $place_right - 40 * $gz) and ($place_ty > $place_y - 20 * $gz) and ($place_ty - ($gp_lift.$place_i + 40) * $gz < $place_y + $place_h)
				$place_hit = 1
		if $place_hit
			$place_x = 18 * $gz
			$guide_win_left = 1
	$guide_win_x = $place_x
	$guide_win_y = $place_y
	@guide_window_move()

function @guide_scale()
	; 4K-class HUDs get everything at double size; the font only scales in whole steps.
	; A- (compact) halves it. Tiny HUDs start compact unless the player chose a size.
	$gz = 1
	if (screen_h >= 1600) and (screen_w >= 2400)
		$gz = 2
	var $scale_compact = $guide_compact
	if $guide_auto_scale
		$scale_compact = screen_h < 640
	$guide_compact_now = $scale_compact
	if $scale_compact
		$gz = $gz / 2
	$guide_window_0.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_window_1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_window_2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_icon_1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_icon_2.blank($guide_clear)
	@guide_pointers_blank()
	$guide_last_key = -1

function @guide_layout()
	if (screen_w == $guide_last_width) and (screen_h == $guide_last_height) and (fov == $guide_last_fov)
		return
	$guide_last_width = screen_w
	$guide_last_height = screen_h
	$guide_last_fov = fov
	@guide_camera()
	@guide_scale()
	$guide_window_2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_icon_1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_icon_2.blank($guide_clear)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Render
function @guide_render()
	@guide_layout()
	$guide_flash = 0
	$guide_key_group = 0
	$guide_pointer_attention = 0
	var $arrow_elapsed = tick - $guide_page_started
	if (!$guide_hidden) and $guide_show_arrows and (($guide_step == 2) or ($guide_step >= 7))
		; Two 0.3-second attention pulses, then steady cyan; no endless flashing.
		$guide_pointer_attention = (($arrow_elapsed >= 0) and ($arrow_elapsed < 3)) or (($arrow_elapsed >= 6) and ($arrow_elapsed < 9))
	if (!$guide_hidden) and (($guide_step == 4) or ($guide_step == 5))
		$guide_flash = mod(floor(tick / 5), 2)
		$guide_key_group = mod(floor(tick / 20), 3)
		if $guide_step == 5
			$guide_key_group = mod(floor(tick / 20), 2)
	var $frame_key = $guide_step + $guide_hidden * 100 + $guide_auto * 200 + $guide_show_arrows * 400 + $guide_flash * 800 + $guide_key_group * 1600 + $guide_pointer_attention * 3200 + $guide_drag * 6400
	if $frame_key == $guide_last_key
		return
	$guide_last_key = $frame_key
	@guide_page_targets()
	@guide_place_window()
	@guide_pointers()
	if $guide_hidden
		$guide_window_0.blank($guide_clear)
		$guide_window_1.blank($guide_clear)
		$guide_window_2.blank($guide_clear)
		var $icon_z = max(1, $gz)
		var $icon_s = 32 * $icon_z
		$guide_icon_canvas.blank($guide_clear)
		$guide_icon_canvas.draw_rect(0, 0, $icon_s - 1, $icon_s - 1, $guide_accent, $guide_background)
		$guide_icon_canvas.draw_rect(1, 1, $icon_s - 2, $icon_s - 2, $guide_accent)
		$guide_icon_canvas.draw_rect(7 * $icon_z, 8 * $icon_z, 25 * $icon_z, 24 * $icon_z, $guide_accent)
		$guide_icon_canvas.draw_rect(7 * $icon_z, 12 * $icon_z, 25 * $icon_z, 13 * $icon_z, $guide_accent, $guide_accent)
		if $icon_z == 1
			screen_copy($guide_icon_canvas, $guide_icon_1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 32, 32)
		else
			screen_copy($guide_icon_canvas, $guide_icon_2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 64, 64)
		return
	$guide_icon_1.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_icon_2.blank($guide_clear)
	$guide_canvas.blank($guide_background)
	@g_frame(0, 0, 559, 539, $guide_outline)
	if $guide_drag
		@g_rect(1, 1, 558, 40, $guide_accent, $guide_accent)
		@g_text(16, 13, 2, $guide_background, "MOVING - CLICK TO DROP")
	else
		@g_rect(1, 1, 558, 40, $guide_surface, $guide_surface)
		@g_text(16, 13, 2, $guide_orange, "BADGER / PILOT GUIDE")
	@g_right(424, 13, 2, $guide_dim, text("{}/{}", $guide_step + 1, $guide_steps))
	var $size_caption = "A-"
	if $gz < 1
		$size_caption = "A+"
	@g_frame(440, 6, 504, 34, $guide_dim)
	@g_center(472, 20, 2, $guide_white, $size_caption)
	@g_frame(516, 6, 550, 34, $guide_dim)
	@g_line(526, 13, 540, 27, $guide_white)
	@g_line(540, 13, 526, 27, $guide_white)
	@g_text(20, 54, 3, $guide_white, $guide_titles.$guide_step)
	@g_text(20, 92, 2, $guide_white, $guide_line_a.$guide_step)
	@g_text(20, 116, 2, $guide_white, $guide_line_b.$guide_step)
	@g_text(20, 140, 2, $guide_white, $guide_line_c.$guide_step)
	@g_text(20, 164, 2, $guide_white, $guide_line_d.$guide_step)
	@g_text(20, 188, 2, $guide_white, $guide_line_e.$guide_step)
	@guide_diagram()
	@g_note(428, $guide_orange, $guide_hint.$guide_step)
	@g_box(20, 486, 110, 40, "BACK", $guide_step > 0)
	@g_box(140, 486, 110, 40, "AUTO", $guide_auto)
	@g_box(260, 486, 140, 40, "ARROWS", $guide_show_arrows)
	var $next_caption = "NEXT"
	if $guide_step == 0
		$next_caption = "START"
	elseif $guide_step == $guide_steps - 1
		$next_caption = "FINISH"
	@g_box(410, 486, 130, 40, $next_caption, 1)
	if $gz < 1
		screen_copy($guide_canvas, $guide_window_0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 280, 270)
	elseif $gz == 1
		screen_copy($guide_canvas, $guide_window_1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 560, 540)
	else
		screen_copy($guide_canvas, $guide_window_2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1120, 1080)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Input
function @guide_grab($grab_px : number, $grab_py : number)
	$guide_drag = 1
	$guide_drag_dx = $grab_px
	$guide_drag_dy = $grab_py
	$guide_drag_tick = tick
	$guide_drag_x0 = $guide_win_x
	$guide_drag_y0 = $guide_win_y
	; Follow the mouse smoothly while carried.
	set_cps(30)
	$guide_last_key = -1

function @guide_drop()
	$guide_drag = 0
	set_cps($guide_cps)
	if (tick - $guide_drag_tick <= 12) and (abs($guide_win_x - $guide_drag_x0) < 4) and (abs($guide_win_y - $guide_drag_y0) < 4)
		; Two quick clicks on the title bar without moving: back to automatic placement.
		$guide_user_x = -1
		$guide_user_y = -1
	else
		$guide_user_x = $guide_win_x / max(1, screen_w)
		$guide_user_y = $guide_win_y / max(1, screen_h)
	@guide_remember()
	$guide_last_key = -1

function @guide_drag_follow()
	if !$guide_drag
		return
	if mouse_look()
		; Mouse locked back to the view: leave the window where it is.
		@guide_drop()
		return
	var $follow_w = $guide_win_w * $gz
	var $follow_h = $guide_win_h * $gz
	$guide_win_x = clamp(mouse_x - $guide_drag_dx, 0, max(0, screen_w - $follow_w))
	$guide_win_y = clamp(mouse_y - $guide_drag_dy, 0, max(0, screen_h - $follow_h))
	@guide_window_move()

function @guide_click($click_px : number, $click_py : number)
	if $guide_hidden
		return
	if $guide_drag
		@guide_drop()
		return
	var $click_x = $click_px / $gz
	var $click_y = $click_py / $gz
	if ($click_y < 41) and ($click_x < 436)
		@guide_grab($click_px, $click_py)
		return
	if ($click_x >= 516) and ($click_x < 551) and ($click_y >= 6) and ($click_y < 35)
		@guide_hide()
		return
	if ($click_x >= 440) and ($click_x < 505) and ($click_y >= 6) and ($click_y < 35)
		; A- / A+: player-local text size, remembered like the other preferences.
		$guide_compact = !$guide_compact_now
		$guide_auto_scale = 0
		@guide_remember()
		@guide_scale()
		return
	if ($click_y < 486) or ($click_y >= 527)
		return
	if ($click_x >= 20) and ($click_x < 131)
		@guide_move($guide_step - 1)
	elseif ($click_x >= 140) and ($click_x < 251)
		$guide_auto = !$guide_auto
		$guide_page_started = tick
		$guide_last_key = -1
	elseif ($click_x >= 260) and ($click_x < 401)
		$guide_show_arrows = !$guide_show_arrows
		$guide_page_started = tick
		$guide_last_key = -1
		@guide_remember()
	elseif ($click_x >= 410) and ($click_x < 541)
		if $guide_step == $guide_steps - 1
			@guide_hide()
		else
			@guide_move($guide_step + 1)

function @guide_icon_click($icon_px : number, $icon_py : number)
	if $guide_hidden and ($icon_px >= 0) and ($icon_px < 32 * $gz) and ($icon_py >= 0) and ($icon_py < 32 * $gz)
		$guide_hidden = 0
		$guide_page_started = tick
		$guide_last_key = -1
		@guide_remember()

; ---------------------------------------------------------------- Radio
function @guide_radio_field($guide_radio_packet : text, $guide_radio_field : text) : text
	foreach $guide_radio_packet ($guide_radio_key, $guide_radio_value)
		if $guide_radio_key == $guide_radio_field
			return $guide_radio_value
	return ""

function @guide_radio_send()
	if (!$guide_radio.is_receiving) or ($guide_radio.distance < 0) or ($guide_radio.distance > 10)
		$guide_radio_last = ""
		return
	var $guide_server_packet = $guide_radio.data
	if (size($guide_server_packet) > 160) or (@guide_radio_field($guide_server_packet, "g") != "1")
		return
	var $guide_server_session = @guide_radio_field($guide_server_packet, "s")
	if ($guide_server_session == "") or (size($guide_server_session) > 48)
		return
	var $guide_radio_page = $guide_step
	var $guide_radio_flash = $guide_pointer_attention
	if $guide_hidden or (!$guide_show_arrows)
		$guide_radio_page = -1
		$guide_radio_flash = 0
	var $guide_radio_key = text("{},{},{}", $guide_server_session, $guide_radio_page, $guide_radio_flash)
	if ($guide_radio_key == $guide_radio_last) and (tick < $guide_radio_next)
		return
	$guide_radio_sequence += 1
	; Whitelisted page/flash only; sequence makes stale packets expire on the craft.
	$guide_radio.transmit(".g{1}.s{" & $guide_server_session & "}.p{" & text("{0}", $guide_radio_page) & "}.f{" & text("{0}", $guide_radio_flash) & "}.q{" & text("{0}", $guide_radio_sequence) & "}")
	$guide_radio_last = $guide_radio_key
	$guide_radio_next = tick + $guide_cps

function @guide_cycle()
	if $guide_auto and (!$guide_hidden) and (tick - $guide_page_started >= $guide_cps * 15)
		if $guide_step == $guide_steps - 1
			@guide_hide()
		else
			@guide_move($guide_step + 1)
	@guide_render()
	@guide_radio_send()

init
	set_resolution_scale(1)
	set_cps($guide_cps)
	$guide_background = color(8, 14, 22, 255)
	$guide_surface = color(24, 34, 45, 255)
	$guide_outline = color(66, 95, 115, 255)
	$guide_accent = color(35, 223, 235, 255)
	$guide_orange = color(255, 122, 50, 255)
	$guide_green = color(75, 235, 125, 255)

; Mechanical position requests (slots 0..4) remain change-only.
; Drill and rotor power commands (5..9) must be renewed, not latched.
; All OFF writers update the desired value too, preventing stale keepalive.
array $latched_io_values:number
var $latched_io_ready=0
function @latched_io($slot:number,$alias:text,$channel:number,$value:number)
	if !$latched_io_ready
		$latched_io_values.fill(10,999)
		$latched_io_ready=1
	if ($slot>=5) or ($latched_io_values.$slot!=$value)
		output_number($alias,$channel,$value)
		$latched_io_values.$slot=$value

; Flight control.

; Outer lateral-velocity integral. The existing proportional bank request and
; inner bank controller remain intact. All state is RAM, never saved trim.
var $lateral_velocity_trim=0

function @lateral_velocity_reset()
	$lateral_velocity_trim=0

function @lateral_velocity_correct($lv_owned:number,$lv_reset:number,$lv_normal:number,$lv_settled:number,$lv_error:number,$lv_speed:number,$lv_vertical:number,$lv_scale:number,$lv_dt:number) : number
	if (!$lv_owned) or $lv_reset
		@lateral_velocity_reset()
		return 0
	var $lv_step=clamp($lv_dt,0,0.1)
	if !$lv_normal
		; Release before protected low-speed/approach controllers take over.
		$lateral_velocity_trim+=clamp(-$lateral_velocity_trim,-$lv_step/180,$lv_step/180)
		return $lateral_velocity_trim
	if $lv_settled
		; Existing P gain is 1/denominator, in half-turns per m/s. With
		; lateral acceleration ~= g*pi*bank, tau=denominator/(g*pi).
		; Ti=4*tau makes the ideal outer PI critically damped. Floor Ti
		; at 10 s so low speed never makes the added loop aggressive.
		var $lv_denominator=6*abs($lv_speed)+abs($lv_vertical)+22
		var $lv_ti=max(10,4*$lv_denominator/(9.80665*pi))
		; Saturation blocks growth but always permits signed unwinding.
		if ($lv_scale>=0.999999) or ($lateral_velocity_trim*$lv_error<0)
			var $lv_delta=clamp($lv_error/($lv_denominator*$lv_ti),-0.1/180,0.1/180)*$lv_step
			$lateral_velocity_trim=clamp($lateral_velocity_trim+$lv_delta,-2/180,2/180)
	return $lateral_velocity_trim

; T5f authority governor: while the mixer, a motor or the yaw demand is at
; its limit, stop adding forward speed and ease off slightly. Speed comes back
; gently once there has been spare authority for 3 s. Display/speed only:
; no PID gains, limits or stored settings change.
var $authority_motor_saturated = 0
var $authority_yaw_saturated = 0
var $authority_cap = -1
var $authority_since = 0
var $authority_clear_at = 0
var $authority_limited = 0

function @authority_governor($ag_enabled : number, $ag_target : number, $ag_speed : number, $ag_saturated : number, $ag_dt : number) : number
	if !$ag_enabled
		$authority_cap = -1
		$authority_since = 0
		$authority_limited = 0
		return $ag_target
	var $ag_floor = 10 / $autopilot_ui_knots
	if $ag_saturated
		if $authority_since == 0
			$authority_since = time
		$authority_clear_at = time + 3
		if $authority_cap < 0
			; Freeze at the speed we have now (never above the request).
			$authority_cap = max(min($ag_target, $ag_speed + 0.5), $ag_floor)
		elseif (time - $authority_since) > 1
			; Still saturated after a second: back off a little, at most 2 m/s
			; below actual speed so the arrival brake never takes over.
			$authority_cap = max(max($authority_cap - 0.5 * $ag_dt, $ag_speed - 2), $ag_floor)
	else
		$authority_since = 0
		if ($authority_cap >= 0) and (time >= $authority_clear_at)
			$authority_cap += 0.5 * $ag_dt
			if $authority_cap >= $ag_target
				$authority_cap = -1
	if $authority_cap < 0
		$authority_limited = 0
		return $ag_target
	$authority_limited = $ag_target > $authority_cap + 0.25
	return min($ag_target, $authority_cap)

; Assisted blade allocation. Original blade limits and PID gains are unchanged.
; Allocate collective INSIDE the attitude envelope, not clip four corners after it.
var $rotor_allocation_active = 0
; T5w: steady yaw correction carried as a diagonal blade-pitch difference.
var $yaw_pitch_trim = 0
var $rotor_allocation_pitch = 0
var $rotor_allocation_roll = 0
var $rotor_allocation_scale = 1
var $rotor_allocation_lower = 0
var $rotor_allocation_upper = 32.8
var $rotor_allocation_collective = 0
var $rotor_allocation_limited = 0
var $rotor_allocation_fl = 0
var $rotor_allocation_fr = 0
var $rotor_allocation_rl = 0
var $rotor_allocation_rr = 0
var $rotor_allocation_climb_cap = 20
var $rotor_allocation_release_time = 0
; First-order RPM-squared effectiveness estimate, not another attitude PID.
; Positive coupling means the FL/RR diagonal responds more strongly.
var $rotor_allocation_rpm_coupling = 0

function @rotor_allocation_prepare($mx_active : number, $mx_pitch : number, $mx_roll : number, $mx_min : number, $mx_max : number)
	$rotor_allocation_active = $mx_active
	$rotor_allocation_pitch = -$mx_pitch
	$rotor_allocation_roll = -$mx_roll
	$rotor_allocation_rpm_coupling = 0
	; Use the existing same-frame measured RPM sample, never requested RPM.
	; Do not compensate stopped, reversed or severely mismatched pair members.
	if $mx_active and ($rotor_pair_sync_fl > 2.5) and ($rotor_pair_sync_rr > 2.5) and ($rotor_pair_sync_fr < -2.5) and ($rotor_pair_sync_rl < -2.5)
		var $mx_a = ($rotor_pair_sync_fl * $rotor_pair_sync_fl + $rotor_pair_sync_rr * $rotor_pair_sync_rr) / 2
		var $mx_b = ($rotor_pair_sync_fr * $rotor_pair_sync_fr + $rotor_pair_sync_rl * $rotor_pair_sync_rl) / 2
		var $mx_pair_error = max(abs($rotor_pair_sync_fl - $rotor_pair_sync_rr), abs($rotor_pair_sync_fr - $rotor_pair_sync_rl))
		if $mx_pair_error <= (20 / 60)
			$rotor_allocation_rpm_coupling = clamp(($mx_a - $mx_b) / ($mx_a + $mx_b), -0.35, 0.35)
	; Unequal diagonals produce pitch=P+e*R and roll=R+e*P.
	; Invert that coupling while preserving collective and both diagonal means.
	var $mx_e = $rotor_allocation_rpm_coupling
	var $mx_denominator = 1 - $mx_e * $mx_e
	$rotor_allocation_pitch = (-$mx_pitch + $mx_e * $mx_roll) / $mx_denominator
	$rotor_allocation_roll = (-$mx_roll + $mx_e * $mx_pitch) / $mx_denominator
	var $mx_span = max(($mx_max - $mx_min) / 2, 0)
	var $mx_reserve = abs($rotor_allocation_pitch) + abs($rotor_allocation_roll)
	$rotor_allocation_scale = min(1, $mx_span / max($mx_reserve, 0.000001))
	$rotor_allocation_pitch *= $rotor_allocation_scale
	$rotor_allocation_roll *= $rotor_allocation_scale
	; Derive BOTH limits from one centre/headroom pair. At full attitude
	; saturation, separately adding/subtracting the half-span inverted the
	; interval by floating-point roundoff and crashed the native clamp.
	var $mx_centre = ($mx_min + $mx_max) / 2
	var $mx_room = max($mx_span - min($mx_reserve, $mx_span), 0)
	; ECO's existing 0.01 collective floor still constrains integral authority.
	$rotor_allocation_lower = max(0.4, 40 * ($mx_centre - $mx_room))
	$rotor_allocation_upper = max($rotor_allocation_lower, 40 * ($mx_centre + $mx_room))
	if !$mx_active
		$rotor_allocation_limited = 0
		$rotor_allocation_climb_cap = 20
		$rotor_allocation_release_time = 0

function @rotor_allocation_can_integrate($mx_effort : number, $mx_error : number) : number
	return (($mx_effort > $rotor_allocation_lower) and ($mx_effort < $rotor_allocation_upper)) or (($mx_effort >= $rotor_allocation_upper) and ($mx_error < 0)) or (($mx_effort <= $rotor_allocation_lower) and ($mx_error > 0))

function @rotor_allocation_govern($mx_enabled : number, $mx_limit : number, $mx_speed_error : number, $mx_previous_effort : number, $mx_dt : number) : number
	; Shed climb demand only during a real high-clearance AP climb. LAND,
	; launch and altitude capture do not enter or chatter through this governor.
	if !$mx_enabled
		$rotor_allocation_climb_cap = $mx_limit
		$rotor_allocation_release_time = 0
		return $mx_limit
	var $mx_overload = $rotor_allocation_limited and ($mx_previous_effort >= ($rotor_allocation_upper - 0.4))
	if ($mx_speed_error < -2.5) or $mx_overload
		var $mx_shed = 1
		if $mx_speed_error < -2.5
			$mx_shed = 3
		$rotor_allocation_climb_cap = max(min($rotor_allocation_climb_cap, $mx_limit) - ($mx_shed * $mx_dt), 0)
		$rotor_allocation_release_time = time + 3
	elseif (time >= $rotor_allocation_release_time) and ($mx_speed_error >= -0.5) and ($mx_previous_effort < ($rotor_allocation_upper - 2))
		$rotor_allocation_climb_cap = min($rotor_allocation_climb_cap + (0.5 * $mx_dt), $mx_limit)
	return min($mx_limit, $rotor_allocation_climb_cap)

function @rotor_allocation_commit($mx_effort : number)
	var $mx_requested = clamp($mx_effort / 40, 0.01, 0.95)
	; Defensive ordering here too: no reversed interval can reach clamp().
	$rotor_allocation_collective = clamp($mx_requested, min($rotor_allocation_lower, $rotor_allocation_upper) / 40, max($rotor_allocation_lower, $rotor_allocation_upper) / 40)
	$rotor_allocation_limited = (abs($mx_requested - $rotor_allocation_collective) > 0.000001) or ($rotor_allocation_scale < 1)
	$rotor_allocation_fl = $rotor_allocation_collective + $rotor_allocation_pitch + $rotor_allocation_roll
	$rotor_allocation_fr = $rotor_allocation_collective + $rotor_allocation_pitch - $rotor_allocation_roll
	$rotor_allocation_rl = $rotor_allocation_collective - $rotor_allocation_pitch + $rotor_allocation_roll
	$rotor_allocation_rr = $rotor_allocation_collective - $rotor_allocation_pitch - $rotor_allocation_roll
	; T5w: diagonal yaw trim (FL/RR up, FR/RL down for a positive yaw command).
	if $yaw_pitch_trim != 0
		$rotor_allocation_fl = min($rotor_allocation_fl + $yaw_pitch_trim, 0.95)
		$rotor_allocation_rr = min($rotor_allocation_rr + $yaw_pitch_trim, 0.95)
		$rotor_allocation_fr = max($rotor_allocation_fr - $yaw_pitch_trim, 0.01)
		$rotor_allocation_rl = max($rotor_allocation_rl - $yaw_pitch_trim, 0.01)

; Smooth only the initial AP-to-DOCK pitch-reference transfer, not docking gains.
var $dock_pitch_previous = 0
var $dock_pitch_rate = 0
var $dock_pitch_owned = 0
var $dock_pitch_blending = 0
var $dock_pitch_ready = 0

; Only engagement / HOLD-to-ACTIVE transfers are shaped. Normal live control,
; emergency LAND/DOCK and existing gain/limit choices retain their authority.
var $ap_pitch_transfer_requested=0
var $ap_pitch_transfer_active=0
var $ap_pitch_transfer_previous=0
var $ap_pitch_transfer_rate=0
var $ap_pitch_transfer_was_enabled=0

function @ap_pitch_handoff($ah_enabled:number,$ah_begin:number,$ah_request:number,$ah_actual:number,$ah_min:number,$ah_max:number,$ah_dt:number) : number
	if !$ah_enabled
		$ap_pitch_transfer_was_enabled=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_active=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_requested=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_rate=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_previous=$ah_actual
		return $ah_request
	$ah_request=clamp($ah_request,$ah_min,$ah_max)
	$ap_pitch_transfer_previous=clamp($ap_pitch_transfer_previous,$ah_min,$ah_max)
	var $ah_start=$ah_begin or $ap_pitch_transfer_requested or (!$ap_pitch_transfer_was_enabled)
	$ap_pitch_transfer_was_enabled=1
	if $ah_start
		$ap_pitch_transfer_requested=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_active=1
		$ap_pitch_transfer_rate=0
		return $ap_pitch_transfer_previous
	if !$ap_pitch_transfer_active
		$ap_pitch_transfer_previous=$ah_request
		return $ah_request
	var $ah_dt_safe=clamp($ah_dt,0,0.1)
	var $ah_error=$ah_request-$ap_pitch_transfer_previous
	var $ah_accel=4/180
	var $ah_rate=min(3/180,sqrt(2*$ah_accel*abs($ah_error)))
	if $ah_error<0
		$ah_rate=-$ah_rate
	$ap_pitch_transfer_rate+=clamp($ah_rate-$ap_pitch_transfer_rate,-$ah_accel*$ah_dt_safe,$ah_accel*$ah_dt_safe)
	var $ah_move=$ap_pitch_transfer_rate*$ah_dt_safe
	if $ah_move*$ah_error>=0
		$ah_move=clamp($ah_move,-abs($ah_error),abs($ah_error))
	$ap_pitch_transfer_previous=clamp($ap_pitch_transfer_previous+$ah_move,$ah_min,$ah_max)
	if abs($ah_request-$ap_pitch_transfer_previous)<0.000001
		$ap_pitch_transfer_active=0
		$ap_pitch_transfer_rate=0
	return $ap_pitch_transfer_previous


function @dock_pitch_handoff($dh_available : number, $dh_dock : number, $dh_requested : number, $dh_min : number, $dh_max : number, $dh_dt : number) : number
	if (!$dh_available) or (!$dh_dock) or (!$dock_pitch_ready)
		$dock_pitch_previous = $dh_requested
		$dock_pitch_rate = 0
		$dock_pitch_blending = 0
		$dock_pitch_owned = $dh_dock and $dh_available
		$dock_pitch_ready = $dh_available
		return $dh_requested
	; Existing pitch bounds take precedence if they tighten during takeover.
	$dh_requested = clamp($dh_requested, $dh_min, $dh_max)
	$dock_pitch_previous = clamp($dock_pitch_previous, $dh_min, $dh_max)
	if !$dock_pitch_owned
		; Preserve the last applied NAV/AP reference on the capture frame.
		$dock_pitch_owned = 1
		$dock_pitch_blending = 1
		$dock_pitch_rate = 0
		return $dock_pitch_previous
	if !$dock_pitch_blending
		$dock_pitch_previous = $dh_requested
		return $dh_requested
	var $dh_step = clamp($dh_dt, 0, 0.1)
	var $dh_error = $dh_requested - $dock_pitch_previous
	; Normalized pitch: 1 = 180 degrees. Limit rate and its buildup.
	var $dh_accel = 24 / 180
	var $dh_desired_rate = min(12 / 180, sqrt(2 * $dh_accel * abs($dh_error)))
	if $dh_error < 0
		$dh_desired_rate = -$dh_desired_rate
	$dock_pitch_rate += clamp($dh_desired_rate - $dock_pitch_rate, -$dh_accel * $dh_step, $dh_accel * $dh_step)
	var $dh_move = $dock_pitch_rate * $dh_step
	if ($dh_move * $dh_error) >= 0
		$dh_move = clamp($dh_move, -abs($dh_error), abs($dh_error))
	$dock_pitch_previous = clamp($dock_pitch_previous + $dh_move, $dh_min, $dh_max)
	if abs($dh_requested - $dock_pitch_previous) < 0.000001
		$dock_pitch_previous = $dh_requested
		$dock_pitch_rate = 0
		$dock_pitch_blending = 0
	return $dock_pitch_previous

; AP flight pitch trim. Separate from the unchanged low-speed/hover PID memory.
; Bound the additional blade component; do not increase the requested pitch.
var $flight_pitch_trim = 0

function @flight_pitch_trim_update($pt_ready : number, $pt_reset : number, $pt_learn : number, $pt_error : number, $pt_scale : number, $pt_dt : number) : number
	if (!$pt_ready) or $pt_reset
		$flight_pitch_trim = 0
		return 0
	var $pt_step = clamp($pt_dt, 0, 0.1)
	if $pt_learn
		; Previous-frame attitude saturation blocks growth, not unwinding.
		if ($pt_scale >= 0.999999) or (($flight_pitch_trim * $pt_error) < 0)
			var $pt_change = clamp($pt_error * 0.4, -0.01, 0.01) * $pt_step
			$flight_pitch_trim = clamp($flight_pitch_trim + $pt_change, -0.10, 0.10)
	else
		; Release over at most five seconds into low speed/LAND/DOCK, not a step.
		$flight_pitch_trim -= clamp($flight_pitch_trim, -0.02 * $pt_step, 0.02 * $pt_step)
	return $flight_pitch_trim

; Manual thrust lever adjustment only. No PID state, gains, or AP requests.
; Seat Down/Up is channel 3 (default Left Ctrl / Space).
function @manual_throttle_step($current:number, $axis:number, $dt:number) : number
	if abs($axis) <= 0.02 or $dt <= 0
		return $current
	; Hold to move 20 percentage points per second; bound long/stalled frames.
	return clamp($current + clamp($axis, -1, 1) * 0.20 * min($dt, 0.1), -1, 1)

function @manual_throttle_input($current:number, $power:number, $ap:number, $blocked:number) : number
	; AP owns the lever even with STAB off. Preserve docking's zero handoff.
	if $ap or (!$power) or $blocked
		return $current
	if input_number("flight-seat", 0) <= 0
		return $current
	var $next = @manual_throttle_step($current, input_number("flight-seat", 3), delta_time)
	if $next != $current
		output_number("thrust", 0, $next)
	return $next

function @climb_speed_learning($clg_enabled : number, $clg_target : number, $clg_speed : number, $clg_dt : number) : number
	if (!$clg_enabled) or (!$climb_learn_ready) or ($clg_dt <= 0) or ($clg_dt > 0.2)
		$climb_learn_ready = $clg_enabled
		$climb_learn_previous_target = $clg_target
		$climb_learn_previous_speed = $clg_speed
		$climb_learn_acceleration = 0
		$climb_learn_settled = 0
		$climb_learn_weight = 0
		return 0
	var $clg_command_rate = abs($clg_target - $climb_learn_previous_target) / $clg_dt
	var $clg_acceleration = ($clg_speed - $climb_learn_previous_speed) / $clg_dt
	$climb_learn_previous_target = $clg_target
	$climb_learn_previous_speed = $clg_speed
	$climb_learn_acceleration = lerp($climb_learn_acceleration, $clg_acceleration, $clg_dt / (0.5 + $clg_dt))
	; Require a stable command and little actual acceleration for 1.5 seconds.
	; Raw acceleration also blocks a fresh transient before the filter catches up.
	if ($clg_command_rate > 0.025) or (abs($climb_learn_acceleration) > 0.05) or (abs($clg_acceleration) > 0.15)
		$climb_learn_settled = 0
		$climb_learn_weight = 0
	else
		$climb_learn_settled = min($climb_learn_settled + $clg_dt, 1.5)
		if $climb_learn_settled >= 1.5
			$climb_learn_weight = min($climb_learn_weight + $clg_dt / 2, 1)
	; Smoothstep enables growth without a step in either trim or its growth rate.
	return $climb_learn_weight * $climb_learn_weight * (3 - 2 * $climb_learn_weight)

function @pitch_limit_cap($pc_airspeed : number, $pc_cruise : number) : number
	var $pc_cap = (1 - clamp(((1 / 120) * $pc_airspeed), 0, 0.65)) * $flight_lower_pitch_limit
	; Authorized +5 degrees of AP cruise authority, blended over 100-150 knots.
	; Keep native normalized pitch units; lower-speed and non-cruise paths stay.
	if $pc_cruise
		$pc_cap += (5 / 180) * clamp(($pc_airspeed * $autopilot_ui_knots - 100) / 50, 0, 1)
	return $pc_cap

function @yaw_control_wrap($yaw_control_value:number) : number
	if $yaw_control_value > 180
		return $yaw_control_value - 360
	if $yaw_control_value < -180
		return $yaw_control_value + 360
	return $yaw_control_value

function @yaw_control_directed_error($yaw_control_target:number, $yaw_control_heading:number, $yaw_control_direction_value:number) : number
	var $yaw_control_delta = $yaw_control_target - $yaw_control_heading
	if ($yaw_control_direction_value > 0) and ($yaw_control_delta < 0)
		$yaw_control_delta += 360
	if ($yaw_control_direction_value < 0) and ($yaw_control_delta > 0)
		$yaw_control_delta -= 360
	return $yaw_control_delta

function @yaw_control_rate_limit($yaw_control_error_magnitude:number) : number

	return 10

function @heading_hold_pid($heading_pid_setpoint:number, $heading_pid_processvalue:number, $heading_pid_kp:number, $heading_pid_ki:number, $heading_pid_kd:number, $heading_pid_integral:number, $heading_pid_prev_error:number) : number

	if $controller_ownership_reset or (!$controller_ownership_ap_active)
		$heading_pid_integral = 0

	if $controller_ownership_engaging or $controller_ownership_ap_changed

	var $heading_pid_derivative = ($heading_pid_error - $heading_pid_prev_error) / $heading_pid_dt
	var $heading_pid_proportional = $heading_pid_kp * $heading_pid_error
	$heading_pid_integral += $heading_pid_error * $heading_pid_dt
	$heading_pid_prev_error = $heading_pid_error
	var $heading_pid_output = $heading_pid_proportional + $heading_pid_ki * $heading_pid_integral + $heading_pid_kd * $heading_pid_derivative

var $rpm_governor_limit = 15

function @rpm_governor_integrate($rg_i:number,$rg_error:number,$rg_pd:number,$rg_ki:number,$rg_direction:number,$rg_limit:number,$rg_trim:number,$rg_dt:number) : number
	if $rg_ki<=0
		return 0
	var $rg_bound=max($rg_limit,0.000001)
	; Work in positive motor-power effort for BOTH rotation directions.
	; Bound stored effort, not P/D: motor demand still retains immediate authority.
	var $rg_effort=clamp($rg_direction*$rg_i*$rg_ki,0,$rg_bound)
	var $rg_output=$rg_direction*$rg_pd+$rg_effort
	; Pair trim is applied after base clipping. Account for its final clipping too.
	var $rg_upper=$rg_bound*(1-max(clamp($rg_trim,-1,1),0))
	var $rg_lower=$rg_bound*max(-clamp($rg_trim,-1,1),0)
	var $rg_delta=$rg_direction*$rg_error*$rg_ki*clamp($rg_dt,0,0.1)
	if $rg_delta>0
		$rg_delta=min($rg_delta,max(0,$rg_upper-$rg_output))
	else
		$rg_delta=max($rg_delta,min(0,$rg_lower-$rg_output))
	$rg_effort=clamp($rg_effort+$rg_delta,0,$rg_bound)
	return $rg_direction*$rg_effort/$rg_ki

function @front_left_rpm_pid($front_left_rpm_pid_setpoint:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_processvalue:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_kp:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_ki:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_kd:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_integral:number, $front_left_rpm_pid_prev_error:number) : number
	var $front_left_rpm_pid_error = $front_left_rpm_pid_setpoint - $front_left_rpm_pid_processvalue
	if $controller_ownership_reset and (!$departure_rpm_control)
		$front_left_rpm_pid_integral = 0
		$front_left_rpm_pid_prev_error = $front_left_rpm_pid_error
		; Clear parked memory, not motor authority: allow rotor spin-up while locked.
		return $front_left_rpm_pid_kp * $front_left_rpm_pid_error
	if ($controller_ownership_engaging and (!$departure_rpm_handoff)) or $departure_rpm_start
		$front_left_rpm_pid_integral = 0
		$front_left_rpm_pid_prev_error = $front_left_rpm_pid_error
	var $front_left_rpm_pid_dt = delta_time
	var $front_left_rpm_pid_derivative = ($front_left_rpm_pid_error - $front_left_rpm_pid_prev_error) / $front_left_rpm_pid_dt
	var $front_left_rpm_pid_proportional = $front_left_rpm_pid_kp * $front_left_rpm_pid_error
	$front_left_rpm_pid_integral = @rpm_governor_integrate($front_left_rpm_pid_integral,$front_left_rpm_pid_error,$front_left_rpm_pid_proportional+$front_left_rpm_pid_kd*$front_left_rpm_pid_derivative,$front_left_rpm_pid_ki,1,$rpm_governor_limit,-$rotor_pair_sync_trim_a,$front_left_rpm_pid_dt)
	$front_left_rpm_pid_prev_error = $front_left_rpm_pid_error
	var $front_left_rpm_pid_output = $front_left_rpm_pid_proportional + $front_left_rpm_pid_ki * $front_left_rpm_pid_integral + $front_left_rpm_pid_kd * $front_left_rpm_pid_derivative

function @flight_forward_speed_pid($forward_speed_pid_setpoint:number, $forward_speed_pid_processvalue:number, $forward_speed_pid_kp:number, $forward_speed_pid_ki:number, $forward_speed_pid_kd:number, $forward_speed_pid_integral:number, $forward_speed_pid_prev_error:number) : number
	var $forward_speed_pid_error = $forward_speed_pid_setpoint - $forward_speed_pid_processvalue

		$forward_speed_pid_integral = 0
		$forward_speed_pid_prev_error = $forward_speed_pid_error
		return 0
	if $controller_ownership_engaging or $controller_ownership_ap_changed
		$forward_speed_pid_integral = 0
		$forward_speed_pid_prev_error = $forward_speed_pid_error
	var $forward_speed_pid_dt = delta_time
	var $forward_speed_pid_derivative = ($forward_speed_pid_error - $forward_speed_pid_prev_error) / $forward_speed_pid_dt

	if abs($forward_speed_pid_ki) > 0
		$forward_speed_pid_integral += $forward_speed_pid_error * $forward_speed_pid_dt
	else
		$forward_speed_pid_integral = 0
	$forward_speed_pid_prev_error = $forward_speed_pid_error
	var $forward_speed_pid_output = $forward_speed_pid_proportional + $forward_speed_pid_ki * $forward_speed_pid_integral + $forward_speed_pid_kd * $forward_speed_pid_derivative

function @pitch_attitude_pid($pitch_pid_setpoint:number, $pitch_pid_processvalue:number, $pitch_pid_kp:number, $pitch_pid_ki:number, $pitch_pid_kd:number, $pitch_pid_integral:number, $pitch_pid_prev_error:number) : number
	var $pitch_pid_error = $pitch_pid_setpoint - $pitch_pid_processvalue
	; Never accumulate an unused attitude command while controls are inactive.
	if $controller_ownership_reset or (!$attitude_ownership_active)
		$pitch_pid_integral = 0
		$pitch_pid_prev_error = $pitch_pid_error
		return 0
	; Clear stale I and seed D from THIS error on the ownership rising edge.
	if $controller_ownership_engaging or $attitude_ownership_engaging or $controller_ownership_ap_changed
		$pitch_pid_integral = 0
		$pitch_pid_prev_error = $pitch_pid_error
	var $pitch_pid_dt = delta_time
	var $pitch_pid_derivative = ($pitch_pid_error - $pitch_pid_prev_error) / $pitch_pid_dt
	var $pitch_pid_proportional = $pitch_pid_kp * $pitch_pid_error
	; Preserve active hover trim, but discard unused high-speed error.
	if abs($pitch_pid_ki) > 0
		$pitch_pid_integral += $pitch_pid_error * $pitch_pid_dt
	else
		$pitch_pid_integral = 0
	$pitch_pid_prev_error = $pitch_pid_error
	var $pitch_pid_output = $pitch_pid_proportional + $pitch_pid_ki * $pitch_pid_integral + $pitch_pid_kd * $pitch_pid_derivative
	return $pitch_pid_output
function @roll_attitude_pid($roll_pid_setpoint:number, $roll_pid_processvalue:number, $roll_pid_kp:number, $roll_pid_ki:number, $roll_pid_kd:number, $roll_pid_integral:number, $roll_pid_prev_error:number) : number
	var $roll_pid_error = $roll_pid_setpoint - $roll_pid_processvalue
	; Never accumulate an unused attitude command while controls are inactive.
	if $controller_ownership_reset or (!$attitude_ownership_active)
		$roll_pid_integral = 0
		$roll_pid_prev_error = $roll_pid_error
		return 0
	; Clear stale I and seed D from THIS error on the ownership rising edge.
	if $controller_ownership_engaging or $attitude_ownership_engaging
		$roll_pid_integral = 0

function @nav_beacon_project($nb_distance : number, $nb_x : number, $nb_y : number, $nb_z : number, $nb_bank : number, $nb_pitch : number, $nb_heading : number, $nb_alt : number, $nb_radius : number) : number

	var $nb_up = ($nb_x * sin($nb_bank) + $nb_y * cos($nb_bank)) * $nb_distance

	var $nb_level_forward = $nb_forward * cos($nb_pitch) + $nb_up * sin($nb_pitch)
	var $nb_level_up = $nb_up * cos($nb_pitch) - $nb_forward * sin($nb_pitch)
	$nav_beacon_horizontal = sqrt($nb_right * $nb_right + $nb_level_forward * $nb_level_forward)

	var $nb_z_now = input_number("beacon", 4)

		$nav_beacon_ready = @nav_beacon_project($nb_distance_now, $nb_x_now, $nb_y_now, $nb_z_now, @standby_nav(5) * pi, @standby_nav(4) * pi, @standby_nav(6), @standby_nav(2), @standby_nav(14))
		$nav_beacon_epoch = $nav_arrival_receive_after
		$nav_beacon_distance = $nb_distance_now
		$nav_beacon_x = $nb_x_now
		$nav_beacon_y = $nb_y_now
		$nav_beacon_z = $nb_z_now
	return $nav_beacon_ready

function @nav_arrival_elevation_update($ne_sample : number, $ne_dt : number)
	if !$nav_arrival_elevation_valid
		$nav_arrival_beacon_altitude = max($ne_sample, 0)
		$nav_arrival_elevation_valid = 1
	else
		; Repair a bad initial radio sample instead of holding it for the trip.
		; Two-second filtering rejects packet/attitude timing noise; the existing
		; arrival altitude slew and terrain floor still limit the flight request.
		$nav_arrival_beacon_altitude = lerp($nav_arrival_beacon_altitude, max($ne_sample, 0), clamp($ne_dt * 0.5, 0, 0.1))
; A climb is a command change/engagement, not a recurring altitude-hold error.
var $climb_limits_mission_ready = 0
var $climb_limits_mission_altitude = 0

function @climb_limits_update($cl_enabled : number, $cl_altitude_request : number, $cl_altitude : number)
	if !$cl_enabled
		$climb_limits_mission_ready = 0
		$climb_limits_climb_speed_cap = 0
		return
	if (!$climb_limits_mission_ready) or ($cl_altitude_request != $climb_limits_mission_altitude)
		$climb_limits_mission_altitude = $cl_altitude_request
		$climb_limits_mission_ready = 1
		$climb_limits_climb_speed_cap = ($cl_altitude_request - $cl_altitude) > 5
	elseif $climb_limits_climb_speed_cap and (($cl_altitude_request - $cl_altitude) <= 15.24)
		; Reaching the commanded altitude completes this climb once. Small later
		; undershoots cannot re-arm it without a new command or AP engagement.
		$climb_limits_climb_speed_cap = 0
	elseif $climb_limits_climb_speed_cap and $nav_arrival_active and $nav_arrival_valid and $cruise_limit_arrival_descent
		; NAV can supersede a selected climb with an arrival descent. Do not wait
		; for an altitude the planner is no longer asking the craft to reach.
		$climb_limits_climb_speed_cap = 0

function @nav_arrival_speed_limit($na_remaining : number) : number
	; v^2/(2a) + 4v stopping allowance, with conservative a=0.5m/s^2.
	; The four seconds cover the existing speed filter/control response.
	return min(max(sqrt(4 + max($na_remaining, 0)) - 2, 0), max($na_remaining, 0) * 0.2)

function @nav_arrival_profile_altitude($na_destination : number, $na_remaining : number, $na_speed : number, $na_descent : number, $na_cruise : number) : number
	; 70% of the selected descent rate leaves capture/rotor-authority margin.
	; Higher altitude, faster travel or a slower descent therefore starts sooner.
	return min($na_cruise, $na_destination + max($na_remaining - 5 * $na_speed, 0) / max($na_speed, 10) * $na_descent * 0.7)

; NAV mission policy. Distances are nautical miles, native state is metres/m/s.
; Only the pilot's preset and an accepted mode transition touch storage.
var $nav_plan_ready = 0
var $nav_plan_entry_speed = 0
var $nav_plan_height = 0
var $nav_plan_escape = 0
var $nav_plan_escape_latched = 0
var $nav_plan_escape_altitude = 0

; NAV obstacle recovery owns one absolute altitude, not the terrain contour.
; RAM only. LAND/DOCK, lost target, NAV OFF and launch release this owner.
var $nav_terrain_hold_active = 0
var $nav_terrain_hold_altitude = 0
var $nav_terrain_hold_clearance = 0
var $nav_plan_profile_altitude = 0
var $nav_plan_destination_altitude = 0

function @nav_terrain_recovery_reset()
	$nav_terrain_hold_active = 0
	$nav_terrain_hold_altitude = 0
	$nav_terrain_hold_clearance = 0

function @nav_terrain_recovery($nt_enabled : number, $nt_altitude : number, $nt_surface : number, $nt_clearance : number, $nt_requested : number, $nt_profile : number, $nt_destination : number, $nt_terminal : number) : number
	if !$nt_enabled
		@nav_terrain_recovery_reset()
		return 0
	var $nt_floor = $nt_surface + $nt_clearance
	; A stopped aircraft at the destination may finish the intentional vertical
	; arrival only when the measured surface permits its normal minimum altitude.
	var $nt_terminal_safe = $nt_terminal and ($nt_floor <= $nt_destination) and ($nt_profile >= $nt_floor)
	if $nav_terrain_hold_active
		; Rising terrain can raise the hold for safety. Falling terrain and a
		; speed-driven change of minimum clearance must never lower it mid-recovery.
		$nav_terrain_hold_clearance = max($nav_terrain_hold_clearance, $nt_clearance)
		$nav_terrain_hold_altitude = max($nav_terrain_hold_altitude, $nt_surface + $nav_terrain_hold_clearance + 152.4)
		var $nt_path_clearance = min($nt_requested, $nt_profile) - $nt_surface
		var $nt_recovered = ($nt_altitude >= $nav_terrain_hold_altitude - 3) and (($nt_altitude - $nt_surface) >= $nav_terrain_hold_clearance + 152.4)
		if $nt_terminal_safe or ($nt_recovered and ($nt_path_clearance >= $nav_terrain_hold_clearance + 152.4))
			@nav_terrain_recovery_reset()
			return 0
	elseif (!$nt_terminal_safe) and ($nt_requested < $nt_floor) and ($nt_profile < $nt_floor)
		; The filtered request AND unblocked glide path conflict with this ridge.
		; Do not misclassify an ordinary commanded climb as terrain recovery.
		$nav_terrain_hold_active = 1
		$nav_terrain_hold_clearance = $nt_clearance
		$nav_terrain_hold_altitude = max($nt_altitude, $nt_floor + 152.4)
	if $nav_terrain_hold_active
		return $nav_terrain_hold_altitude
	return 0

function @nav_plan_fraction($np_distance : number) : number
	return clamp(($np_distance / 1852 - 10) / 80, 0, 1)

function @nav_plan_speed_cap($np_clearance : number) : number
	; Conservative game policy, not a certified real-world flight envelope.
	return (100 + 80 * clamp(($np_clearance / 0.3048 - 2000) / 8000, 0, 1)) / $autopilot_ui_knots

; T5a: the cap above follows terrain under the aircraft, so at cruise it moved
; a knot or two with every ridge and valley. Smooth the clearance (20 s), follow
; a real terrain rise of more than 1,000 ft at once, and ignore cap reductions
; smaller than 3 knots so the speed request no longer twitches at cruise.
var $nav_cap_clearance = -1
var $nav_cap_applied = -1
function @nav_plan_speed_cap_smooth($np_clearance : number, $np_dt : number) : number
	if $nav_cap_clearance < 0
		$nav_cap_clearance = $np_clearance
	else
		$nav_cap_clearance += ($np_clearance - $nav_cap_clearance) * clamp($np_dt / 20, 0, 1)
	if $np_clearance < $nav_cap_clearance - 304.8
		$nav_cap_clearance = $np_clearance + 304.8
	var $np_cap = @nav_plan_speed_cap($nav_cap_clearance)
	if ($nav_cap_applied < 0) or ($np_cap > $nav_cap_applied) or ($np_cap < $nav_cap_applied - 3 / $autopilot_ui_knots)
		$nav_cap_applied = $np_cap
	return $nav_cap_applied

function @nav_plan_select_speed($np_speed : number)
	$speed_preview_active = 0
	$flight_counter4 = max($np_speed, 0)
	$flight_counter4_init = 1
	$pitch_mix_limit = $flight_counter4
	if $sqx_mynumber21__m != $flight_counter4
		$sqx_mynumber21 = $flight_counter4
		$sqx_mynumber21__m = $sqx_mynumber21

function @nav_plan_begin()
	@du_leave_manual()
	@autopilot_ui_boot()
	@nav_terrain_recovery_reset()
	$nav_plan_ready = 0
	$nav_plan_escape = 0
	$nav_plan_escape_latched = 0
	$nav_plan_escape_altitude = 0
	$nav_arrival_ready = 0
	$nav_arrival_elevation_valid = 0
	$nav_arrival_arrived = 0
	$nav_cap_clearance = -1
	$nav_cap_applied = -1
	; Replace ALL previous speed requests, including zero and reverse.
	$nav_plan_entry_speed = min($nav_cruise_speed__m, $sqx_ui46_speed__m)
	@nav_plan_select_speed($nav_plan_entry_speed)
	; Discard the previous manual altitude. Live mission altitude is RAM only.
	$flight_counter5 = 0
	$flight_counter5_init = 1
	$roll_mix_limit = 0
	if $sqx_mynumber20__m != 0
		$sqx_mynumber20 = 0
		$sqx_mynumber20__m = $sqx_mynumber20
	$autopilot_ui_alt_dirty = 1

function @nav_plan_initialize($np_alt : number, $np_agl : number)
	var $np_fraction = @nav_plan_fraction($nav_arrival_horizontal)
	$nav_plan_height = (2000 + 8000 * $np_fraction) * 0.3048
	; Use the higher endpoint's ground elevation, never a negative sea floor.
	; T5i: use the destination's elevation only when it can be trusted.
	var $np_dest = 0
	if $nav_arrival_known_elevation >= 0
		$np_dest = $nav_arrival_known_elevation
	elseif ($nav_arrival_horizontal < 20000) or $waypoint_navigation_active
		$np_dest = $nav_arrival_beacon_altitude
	var $np_ground = max(max($np_alt - $np_agl, 0), $np_dest)
	$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = max($np_alt, $np_ground + $nav_plan_height)
	; T5x: never plan less than 1,600 ft above the destination (using its best
	; elevation estimate even beyond 20 km, since it only raises the floor),
	; and fly at 20,000 ft for anything more than 20 statute miles away.
	var $np_target_elev = max($np_dest, $nav_arrival_beacon_altitude)
	if $nav_arrival_known_elevation >= 0
		$np_target_elev = $nav_arrival_known_elevation
	$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = max($nav_arrival_cruise_altitude, $np_target_elev + 487.68)
	if $nav_arrival_horizontal > 32186.9
		$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = max($nav_arrival_cruise_altitude, 6096)
	; A pilot edit made while waiting for a target still wins.
	if $sqx_mynumber20__m != 0
		$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20__m
	; T5z: speed is never reduced for distance. NAV flies the full cruise speed
	; (your NAV CRUISE SPEED, within the AP speed limit); only the safety
	; limits (terrain clearance, turns, arrival braking) slow it.
	var $np_speed = $nav_plan_entry_speed
	if !$speed_preview_active and ($sqx_mynumber21__m == $nav_plan_entry_speed)
		@nav_plan_select_speed($np_speed)
	$nav_arrival_selected_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20__m
	$nav_plan_ready = 1

function @nav_plan_terrain($np_alt : number, $np_clearance : number, $np_approach : number) : number
	; Re-arm only after clearing 1,100 ft; no 2,000-ft addition each tick.
	if $np_clearance > 335.28
		$nav_plan_escape_latched = 0
	if $nav_plan_escape
		if ($np_alt >= $nav_plan_escape_altitude - 3) or ($np_approach and ($np_clearance > 335.28))
			$nav_plan_escape = 0
	; An intentional terminal descent is exempt; LAND/DOCK never call this planner.
	if !$np_approach and ($np_clearance <= 304.8)
		if (!$nav_plan_escape_latched) or (!$nav_plan_escape and ($np_alt >= $nav_plan_escape_altitude - 3))
			$nav_plan_escape_altitude = max($nav_arrival_cruise_altitude, $np_alt + 609.6)
			$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = $nav_plan_escape_altitude
			$nav_plan_escape_latched = 1
			$nav_plan_escape = 1
	if $nav_plan_escape
		return $nav_plan_escape_altitude
	return 0


function @nav_arrival_update($na_enabled : number, $na_alt : number, $na_agl : number, $na_heading_error : number, $na_ground : number, $na_dt : number)
	$nav_arrival_active = $na_enabled
	$nav_arrival_valid = 0
	$cruise_limit_arrival_descent = 0
	if !$na_enabled
		$nav_arrival_ready = 0
		$nav_beacon_ready = 0
		$nav_arrival_elevation_valid = 0
		$nav_arrival_arrived = 0
		$nav_arrival_signal_lost = 0
		return
	var $na_step = clamp($na_dt, 0, 0.2)
	if !$nav_arrival_ready
		$nav_arrival_altitude = $na_alt
		$nav_arrival_target = $na_alt
		$nav_arrival_speed = max($flight_pitchs, 0)
		$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = max($na_alt, $sqx_mynumber20__m)
		$nav_arrival_selected_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20__m
		$nav_arrival_arrived = 0
		$nav_arrival_signal_lost = 0
		$nav_arrival_ready = 1
	if $nav_arrival_elevation_epoch != $nav_arrival_receive_after
		$nav_arrival_elevation_epoch = $nav_arrival_receive_after
		$nav_arrival_elevation_valid = 0
	if $nav_arrival_selected_altitude != $sqx_mynumber20__m
		; T5d: 0 means "no pilot altitude". It used to become the cruise
		; altitude, which put the glide path at destination minimums at any range.
		if $sqx_mynumber20__m > 0
			$nav_arrival_cruise_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20__m
		$nav_arrival_selected_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20__m
	; A retuned or lost beacon commands a stop/hover, never blind cruise/descent.
	var $na_receiving = input_number("beacon", 5)
	if $waypoint_navigation_active
		$na_receiving = $waypoint_navigation_valid
	if (!$na_receiving) or ((!$waypoint_navigation_active) and (time < $nav_arrival_receive_after))
		if !$nav_arrival_signal_lost
			$nav_arrival_altitude = $na_alt
			$nav_arrival_lost_at = time
		; T5a: a dropout or retune shorter than 2 s holds speed instead of
		; starting a stop (which used to trigger the full arrival brake).
		if (time - $nav_arrival_lost_at) >= 2
			$nav_arrival_speed = max($nav_arrival_speed - $na_step, 0)
		$nav_arrival_signal_lost = 1
		return
	var $na_distance = input_number("beacon", 1)
	if (!$waypoint_navigation_active) and (!@nav_beacon_refresh())
		$na_distance = 0
	if $waypoint_navigation_active
		$na_distance = max($waypoint_navigation_distance, 0.001)
	if $na_distance <= 0
		if !$nav_arrival_signal_lost
			$nav_arrival_altitude = $na_alt
			$nav_arrival_lost_at = time
		if (time - $nav_arrival_lost_at) >= 2
			$nav_arrival_speed = max($nav_arrival_speed - $na_step, 0)
		$nav_arrival_signal_lost = 1
		return
	$nav_arrival_valid = 1
	$nav_arrival_signal_lost = 0
	$nav_arrival_horizontal = $nav_beacon_horizontal
	if $waypoint_navigation_active
		$nav_arrival_horizontal = $waypoint_navigation_distance
		$nav_arrival_beacon_altitude = $waypoint_navigation_elevation
		$nav_arrival_elevation_valid = 1
	else
		@nav_arrival_elevation_update($nav_beacon_elevation, $na_dt)
		; T5h: beyond 2 km the angle-based estimate can be hundreds of metres
		; low; plan with the trusted elevation instead whenever it is higher.
		if ($nav_arrival_known_elevation >= 0) and ($nav_beacon_horizontal > 2000)
			$nav_arrival_beacon_altitude = max($nav_arrival_beacon_altitude, $nav_arrival_known_elevation)
	if !$nav_plan_ready
		@nav_plan_initialize($na_alt, $na_agl)
	; T5d: FIND ORE centring stops over the point instead of 20 m short.
	var $na_stop_radius = 20
	var $na_done_radius = 25
	if $mission_ore_centering and ($mission_mode==2) and ($mission_phase==3)
		$na_stop_radius = 0.5
		$na_done_radius = 1.5
	var $na_remaining = max($nav_arrival_horizontal - $na_stop_radius, 0)
	if ($nav_arrival_horizontal <= $na_done_radius) and (abs($na_ground) < 0.5)
		$nav_arrival_arrived = 1
	var $na_request = min(min(max(@flight_command_speed(), 0), $sqx_ui46_speed__m), @nav_arrival_speed_limit($na_remaining))
	$na_request = min($na_request, @nav_plan_speed_cap_smooth(min($na_alt, $na_agl), $na_dt))
	; Brake before large turns, then restore cruise speed as the bearing settles.
	$na_request *= clamp((90 - abs($na_heading_error)) / 60, 0, 1)
	; Do not accelerate through 100 knots until measured clearance is available.
	if ($na_alt - max($na_alt - $na_agl, 0)) < 320
		$na_request = min($na_request, 95 / $autopilot_ui_knots)
	if $nav_arrival_arrived
		$na_request = 0
	if ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==7)
		$na_request=min($na_request,3)
	; T5k: increases apply at once (the speed gap cap paces acceleration);
	; reductions keep the planned 1 m/s^2 so arrival stopping is unchanged.
	if $na_request > $nav_arrival_speed
		$nav_arrival_speed = $na_request
	else
		$nav_arrival_speed = max($nav_arrival_speed - $na_step, $na_request)
	var $na_clearance = $sqx_ui46_floor__m
	if $nav_arrival_fast_floor
		$na_clearance = max($na_clearance, 304.8)
	var $na_destination = $nav_arrival_beacon_altitude + $na_clearance
	; T5i: the radio-angle elevation is only trusted within 20 km (or when the
	; beacon reports it / it is remembered). Beyond that a few degrees of pitch
	; moved it by kilometres, and it used to drag the cruise target around.
	var $na_trusted = ($nav_arrival_horizontal < 20000) or ($nav_arrival_known_elevation >= 0) or $waypoint_navigation_active
	var $na_cruise = $nav_arrival_cruise_altitude
	if $na_trusted
		$na_cruise = max($na_cruise, $na_destination)
	; Plan the glide to a destination raised by 5% of the remaining distance
	; (unless its elevation is known). That margin covers a low long-range
	; estimate, shrinks smoothly to zero at arrival, and keeps the descent
	; rate under 20 m/s below about 230 kt. It can never exceed cruise.
	var $na_glide_destination = $na_destination
	if ($nav_arrival_known_elevation < 0) and (!$waypoint_navigation_active)
		$na_glide_destination += 0.05 * $na_remaining
	var $na_planning_speed = max(abs($na_ground), max($nav_arrival_speed, min(max(@flight_command_speed(), 0), $sqx_ui46_speed__m)))
	var $na_profile = @nav_arrival_profile_altitude($na_glide_destination, $na_remaining, $na_planning_speed, min($sqx_ui46_descent__m, 20), $na_cruise)
	; Preserve the unblocked glide path separately from every safety override.
	$nav_plan_profile_altitude = $na_profile
	$nav_plan_destination_altitude = $na_destination
	var $np_escape = @nav_plan_terrain($na_alt, min($na_alt, $na_agl), $na_profile < $na_cruise - 1)
	if $np_escape > 0
		$na_profile = max($na_profile, $np_escape)
	; T5d: en-route guard. Beyond 3 nm the glide path never goes below 1,000 ft
	; over the ground under the aircraft (a long-range beacon elevation error can
	; no longer pull the craft down to minimums miles out). Fades out 3 -> 2 nm.
	var $na_guard_fade = clamp(($na_remaining - 3704) / 1852, 0, 1)
	if $na_guard_fade > 0
		var $na_guard = min($na_cruise, max($na_alt - $na_agl, 0) + 304.8 * $na_guard_fade)
		$na_profile = max($na_profile, $na_guard)
	if ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==7)
		; Short clearance retreat, not a new 2000-ft cruise trip. Terrain wins.
		$na_profile=max($mission_escape_alt,max($np_escape,$na_alt-$na_agl+$sqx_ui46_floor__m))
	; Compare the actual arrival profile, NOT the slew-limited altitude request.
	; A lagging request during climb must not disable the climb-speed ceiling.
	$cruise_limit_arrival_descent = $na_profile < ($na_alt - 1)
	; Finish descent even if we reached the horizontal stop point while still high.
	; No LAND/DOCK command is issued and the anchor is never deployed by NAV.
	$nav_arrival_target = $na_profile
	$nav_arrival_altitude += clamp($na_profile - $nav_arrival_altitude, -min($sqx_ui46_descent__m, 20) * $na_step, $sqx_ui46_climb__m * $na_step)
; Coordinate guidance adapter only. Existing NAV arrival/terrain/PID logic owns flight.
function @waypoint_navigation_position() : number
	$waypoint_navigation_valid = 0
	if !$waypoint_navigation_active
		return 0
	var $gp_lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $gp_lon = @standby_nav(9)
	var $gp_radius = @standby_nav(14)
	if (@standby_nav_text(13) != $waypoint_navigation_body) or ($gp_radius <= 1000) or (abs($gp_lat) > 90) or (abs($gp_lon) > 180) or (abs($gp_radius - $waypoint_navigation_radius) > $waypoint_navigation_radius * 0.01)
		return 0
	var $gp_phi = $gp_lat * pi / 180
	var $gp_target = $waypoint_navigation_lat * pi / 180
	var $gp_delta = (mod($waypoint_navigation_lon - $gp_lon + 540, 360) - 180) * pi / 180
	var $gp_north = cos($gp_phi) * sin($gp_target) - sin($gp_phi) * cos($gp_target) * cos($gp_delta)
	var $gp_east = cos($gp_target) * sin($gp_delta)
	var $gp_norm = sqrt($gp_north * $gp_north + $gp_east * $gp_east)
	var $gp_dot = sin($gp_phi) * sin($gp_target) + cos($gp_phi) * cos($gp_target) * cos($gp_delta)
	$waypoint_navigation_distance = atan($gp_norm, $gp_dot) * $waypoint_navigation_radius
	$waypoint_navigation_heading = mod(@standby_nav(6) + 360, 360)
	if $gp_norm > 0.000000001
		$waypoint_navigation_heading = mod(atan($gp_east, $gp_north) * 180 / pi + 360, 360)
	$waypoint_navigation_relative = mod($waypoint_navigation_heading - @standby_nav(6) + 540, 360) - 180
	$waypoint_navigation_valid = 1
	return 1

function @waypoint_navigation_same($gp_site_lat : number, $gp_site_lon : number, $gp_site_body : text) : number
	return $waypoint_navigation_active and ($gp_site_lat == $waypoint_navigation_lat) and ($gp_site_lon == $waypoint_navigation_lon) and ($gp_site_body == $waypoint_navigation_body)

function @waypoint_navigation_start($gp_new_lat : number, $gp_new_lon : number, $gp_new_elevation : number, $gp_new_body : text, $gp_new_radius : number, $gp_new_name : text) : number
	@speed_preview_flush()
	@switches_boot()
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or (!$sqx_sw49_ap__m) or @switches_navigation_blocked() or $docking_active
		return 0
	if (abs($gp_new_lat) > 90) or (abs($gp_new_lon) > 180) or ($gp_new_body != @standby_nav_text(13)) or ($gp_new_radius <= 1000) or (abs(@standby_nav(14) - $gp_new_radius) > $gp_new_radius * 0.01) or ($gp_new_elevation < -100000) or ($gp_new_elevation > 100000)
		return 0
	$waypoint_navigation_lat = $gp_new_lat
	$waypoint_navigation_lon = $gp_new_lon
	$waypoint_navigation_elevation = max($gp_new_elevation, 0)
	$waypoint_navigation_radius = $gp_new_radius
	$waypoint_navigation_body = $gp_new_body
	$waypoint_navigation_name = substring($gp_new_name, 0, 32)
	$waypoint_navigation_active = 1
	if $sqx_ui46_nav__m != 1

	$departure_rpm_handoff=0

		$departure_stage=0

		$departure_spin_seconds=0
		$departure_rpm_control=1
		$departure_rpm_start=1

	var $dp_max_rpm=max(max(abs($rotor_pair_sync_fl),abs($rotor_pair_sync_fr)),max(abs($rotor_pair_sync_rl),abs($rotor_pair_sync_rr)))*60

			$departure_spin_since=-1

			$departure_ready_seconds=0

	var $dp_rl=input_number("rear-left-prop",1)
	var $dp_rr=input_number("rear-right-prop",1)
