; Terrain farther below than sea level means water, using the pilot's 0.1 m gap.
function @water_landing_update($sea : number, $terrain : number, $vertical : number, $horizontal : number, $dt : number)
	$water_landing_over_water = $terrain > ($sea + 0.1)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_land__m) or (!$sqx_sw49_power__m)
		$water_landing_settled_seconds = 0
		$water_landing_complete = 0
		return
	if $water_landing_complete
		return
	; Reuse the established LAND sensor-height gate. Require low horizontal
	; motion too; a low fly-by or a sinking craft cannot count as settled.
	var $settled = $water_landing_over_water and ($sea < 2.5) and (abs($vertical) < 0.25) and (abs($horizontal) < 0.5)
	if !$settled
		$water_landing_settled_seconds = 0
		return
	; No wall-clock credit for suspended/idle updates or a resumed saved VM.
	$water_landing_settled_seconds += min(max($dt, 0), 0.1)
	if $water_landing_settled_seconds > 0.75
		$water_landing_complete = 1

	$du_climb = clamp($du_edits.3,100,4000)/$autopilot_ui_fpm
	$flight_counter4 = $du_speed
	$flight_counter4_init = 1
	$pitch_mix_limit = $du_speed
	$flight_counter5 = $du_alt
	$flight_counter5_init = 1
	$roll_mix_limit = $du_alt
	$autopilot_ui_alt_dirty = 1
	$flight_counter3 = $du_heading
	$flight_counter3_init = 1
	$heading_preview_active = 0
	$speed_preview_active = 0
	$du_message = "ACTIVE / LIVE CHANGES"
	$du_message_until = time+3


; Braking-only P request in half-turn pitch units. No new accumulated trim.
; Existing arrival distance/speed profile is unchanged (no earlier stop offset).
function @arrival_brake_process($ground:number,$target:number) : number
	var $error=max($ground-$target,0)
	return min(0.3*$error/(8+abs($ground)*0.25+abs($target)*0.10),12/180)

var $arrival_brake_blending=0
var $arrival_brake_latched=0
var $arrival_brake_pitch=0
function @arrival_brake_blend($owner:number,$braking:number,$request:number,$observed:number,$dt:number) : number
	if !$owner
		$arrival_brake_blending=0
		return $request
	if $braking and (!$arrival_brake_blending)
		$arrival_brake_pitch=$observed
		$arrival_brake_blending=1
	if !$arrival_brake_blending
		return $request
	; Ease into braking; release twice as quickly as the speed error disappears.
	var $rate=6/180
	if $request>$arrival_brake_pitch
		$rate=12/180
	var $step=$rate*clamp($dt,0,0.1)
	$arrival_brake_pitch+=clamp($request-$arrival_brake_pitch,-$step,$step)
	if (!$braking) and (abs($arrival_brake_pitch-$request)<0.000001)
		$arrival_brake_blending=0
	return $arrival_brake_pitch

; Navigation display.

; TOP-RIGHT LCD: NAV, DOCK, ORE and independent GEO survey view.
; No flight/AP/beacon output calls. Clicks only change views or ore-scanner settings.
var $navigation_display_lcd = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $nav_pointer_pointer_cache = virtualscreen(24, 14)
var $nav_panels_heading_cache = virtualscreen(360, 360)
var $nav_bug_heading_filled = virtualscreen(360, 360)
; The rotationally invariant rim lives in the existing static backgrounds.
var $navigation_display_nav_cache = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $navigation_display_bg = color(8, 14, 22)
var $navigation_display_ready = 0
var $navigation_display_power = -1
var $navigation_display_range = 2
var $units_ranges_mode = 0
var $units_ranges_ready = 0

function @navigation_display_text($navigation_display_tx : number, $navigation_display_ty : number, $navigation_display_scale : number, $navigation_display_tc : number, $navigation_display_label : text)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_size($navigation_display_scale)
	$navigation_display_lcd.write($navigation_display_tx - size($navigation_display_label) * $navigation_display_lcd.char_w / 2, $navigation_display_ty - $navigation_display_lcd.char_h / 2, $navigation_display_tc, $navigation_display_label)

function @nav_headers_distance_label($nd_distance_m : number) : text
	; Only the NAV DIST header abbreviates feet; other Imperial labels stay put.
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m or (abs($nd_distance_m) >= 1852)
		return @fit_distance($nd_distance_m, 23)
	var $nd_distance_short = @format_distance($nd_distance_m, 0)
	return text("{} ft", substring($nd_distance_short, 0, size($nd_distance_short) - 2))

function @nav_headers_distance_header($nd_header_m : number)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_size(0.9)
	$navigation_display_lcd.write(1, 48 - $navigation_display_lcd.char_h / 2, cyan, text("DIST {}", @nav_headers_distance_label($nd_header_m)))

function @nav_headers_bearing_header($nd_header_bearing : number)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_size(0.9)
	var $nd_bearing_label = text("BRG {000}", mod(round($nd_header_bearing) + 360, 360))
	$navigation_display_lcd.write(298 - size($nd_bearing_label) * $navigation_display_lcd.char_w, 48 - $navigation_display_lcd.char_h / 2, cyan, $nd_bearing_label)

; Static map geometry, shared only by display painters.
var $rc_nav_rings = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $rc_full_rings = virtualscreen(300, 300)

; Twelve upright compass labels, rasterized once. No per-turn text formatting.

var $rc_nav_label_atlas = virtualscreen(576, 32)
var $rc_nav_dial_image = virtualscreen(300, 200)
var $rc_nav_dial_heading = -1
var $rc_nav_dial_builds = 0
var $rc_nav_label_writes = 0
var $rc_nav_label_copies = 0

; Dirty bounds accumulate until the physical LCD consumes this revision.

var $nn_track_x=150
var $nn_track_y=110
var $nn_ready=0
var $nn_header=""
var $nn_map=""
var $nn_map_frames=0
var $nn_header_frames=0
var $we_ready=0
var $we_cached_name=""
var $we_cached_notes=""
var $we_cached_notice=""
var $we_cached_field=-1
var $we_cached_shift=-1
var $we_keyboard_builds=0
var $wk_context=""
var $wk_value=""
var $wk_keyboard_builds=0


var $nr_full = 1
var $nr_mode = -1
var $nr_x1 = 300
var $nr_y1 = 300
var $nr_x2 = 0
var $nr_y2 = 0
var $nr_dock_ready = 0
var $nr_dock_context = ""
var $nr_heading = ""
var $nr_axes = ""
var $nr_height = ""
var $nr_status = ""

var $nr_py = 0

function @nr_dirty($x : number,$y : number,$w : number,$h : number)
	$nr_x1 = min($nr_x1,max(0,$x))
	$nr_y1 = min($nr_y1,max(0,$y))
	$nr_x2 = max($nr_x2,min(300,$x+$w))
	$nr_y2 = max($nr_y2,min(300,$y+$h))

function @nr_restore($x : number,$y : number,$w : number,$h : number)
	screen_copy($rc_dock_background,$navigation_display_lcd,$x,$y,$x,$y,$w,$h)
	@nr_dirty($x,$y,$w,$h)

function @nr_present($destination : screen,$force : number)
	if $force or $nr_full
		screen_copy($navigation_display_lcd,$destination,0,0,0,0,300,300)
	elseif ($nr_x2 > $nr_x1) and ($nr_y2 > $nr_y1)
		screen_copy($navigation_display_lcd,$destination,$nr_x1,$nr_y1,$nr_x1,$nr_y1,$nr_x2-$nr_x1,$nr_y2-$nr_y1)
	$nr_full = 0
	$nr_x1 = 300
	$nr_y1 = 300
	$nr_x2 = 0
	$nr_y2 = 0


function @rc_nav_dial_prepare()
	$rc_nav_label_atlas.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$rc_nav_label_atlas.text_align(top_left)
	$rc_nav_label_atlas.text_size(1.1)
	repeat 12 ($rc_dial_slot)
		var $rc_dial_label = text("{00}", $rc_dial_slot * 3)
		if $rc_dial_slot == 0
			$rc_dial_label = "N"
		elseif $rc_dial_slot == 3
			$rc_dial_label = "E"
		elseif $rc_dial_slot == 6
			$rc_dial_label = "S"
		elseif $rc_dial_slot == 9
			$rc_dial_label = "W"
		$rc_nav_label_atlas.write($rc_dial_slot * 48 + 24 - size($rc_dial_label) * $rc_nav_label_atlas.char_w / 2, 16 - $rc_nav_label_atlas.char_h / 2, white, $rc_dial_label)
		$rc_nav_label_writes += 1
	$rc_nav_dial_heading = -1

function @rc_nav_dial_draw($rc_dial_hdg : number)
	if $rc_dial_hdg != $rc_nav_dial_heading
		$rc_nav_dial_image.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
		; Sparse moving geometry: the rim is static; upright labels stay cached.
		; Clip pips at y=200; labels retain their original upper-arc positions.
		; One sin/cos pair, then a 5-degree recurrence. No angle quantization.
		var $ns_first = floor(($rc_dial_hdg - 80) / 5)
		var $ns_angle = ($ns_first * 5 - $rc_dial_hdg) * pi / 180
		var $ns_sin = sin($ns_angle)
		var $ns_cos = cos($ns_angle)
		repeat 33 ($ns_tick)
			var $ns_inner = 151
			if mod($ns_first + $ns_tick, 2) == 0
				$ns_inner = 147
			$rc_nav_dial_image.draw_line(150 + $ns_sin * $ns_inner, 240 - $ns_cos * $ns_inner, 150 + $ns_sin * 156, 240 - $ns_cos * 156, white)
			var $ns_next_sin = $ns_sin * 0.9961946980917455 + $ns_cos * 0.08715574274765817
			$ns_cos = $ns_cos * 0.9961946980917455 - $ns_sin * 0.08715574274765817
			$ns_sin = $ns_next_sin
		var $rc_dial_base = floor($rc_dial_hdg / 30)
		; These six candidates cover every label strictly inside +/-70 degrees.
		repeat 6 ($rc_dial_i)
			var $rc_dial_mark = $rc_dial_base + $rc_dial_i - 2
			var $rc_dial_relative = $rc_dial_mark * 30 - $rc_dial_hdg
			if abs($rc_dial_relative) < 70
				var $rc_dial_index = mod($rc_dial_mark + 24, 12)
				var $rc_dial_angle = $rc_dial_relative * pi / 180
				screen_copy($rc_nav_label_atlas, $rc_nav_dial_image, $rc_dial_index * 48, 0, 150 + sin($rc_dial_angle) * 135 - 24, 240 - cos($rc_dial_angle) * 135 - 16, 48, 32)
				$rc_nav_label_copies += 1
		$rc_nav_dial_heading = $rc_dial_hdg
		$rc_nav_dial_builds += 1
	screen_copy($rc_nav_dial_image, $navigation_display_lcd, 0, 80, 0, 80, 300, 120)

; The same live heading bug, with its 360x360 empty padding removed.
; Its local centre maps to the old centre at (180,26), 154 pixels above pivot.

var $ad_nav_bug_y = 0

function @ad_nav_bug_prepare()
	$ad_nav_bug_outline.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$ad_nav_bug_filled.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	screen_copy($nav_panels_heading_cache, $ad_nav_bug_outline, 160, 6, 0, 0, 40, 40)
	screen_copy($nav_bug_heading_filled, $ad_nav_bug_filled, 160, 6, 0, 0, 40, 40)
	$ad_nav_bug_key = ""

var $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_ready = 0
var $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_key = ""
var $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_0 = 0
var $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_1 = 0
function @ad_nav_bug_draw($ad_relative : number, $ad_controlling : number)
	var $ad_bug_key = $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_key
	if !$yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_ready or $ad_relative != $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_0 or $ad_controlling != $yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_1
		$ad_bug_key = text("{},{}", $ad_relative, $ad_controlling)
		$yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_key = $ad_bug_key
		$yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_ready = 1
		$yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_0 = $ad_relative
		$yr_ad_nav_bug_draw_1 = $ad_controlling
	if $ad_bug_key != $ad_nav_bug_key
		var $ad_bug_source = $ad_nav_bug_outline
		if $ad_controlling
			$ad_bug_source = $ad_nav_bug_filled
		$ad_nav_bug_rotated.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
		screen_copy($ad_bug_source, $ad_nav_bug_rotated, 0, 0, 0, 0, 40, 40, -1, $ad_relative, 1)
		var $ad_radians = $ad_relative * pi / 180
		$ad_nav_bug_x = 150 + sin($ad_radians) * 154 - 20
		$ad_nav_bug_y = 240 - cos($ad_radians) * 154 - 20
		$ad_nav_bug_key = $ad_bug_key
		$ad_nav_bug_builds += 1
	screen_copy($ad_nav_bug_rotated, $navigation_display_lcd, 0, 0, $ad_nav_bug_x, $ad_nav_bug_y, 40, 40)

function @navigation_display_prepare()
	@rc_nav_dial_prepare()
	$navigation_display_nav_cache.blank($navigation_display_bg)
	; Unknown space stays dark. Only scanner-confirmed water is painted blue.
	@ore_map_prepare_mask()
	screen_copy($ore_map_mask, $navigation_display_nav_cache, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	$navigation_display_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 48, gray)
	$navigation_display_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 96, gray)
	$navigation_display_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 144, gray)
	$navigation_display_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 156, white)

	$nav_bug_heading_filled.draw_triangle(165, 18, 165, 33, 180, 33, $nav_guidance_magenta, $nav_guidance_magenta)
	$nav_bug_heading_filled.draw_triangle(195, 18, 180, 33, 195, 33, $nav_guidance_magenta, $nav_guidance_magenta)
	$nav_bug_heading_filled.draw_line(165, 33, 195, 33, $nav_guidance_magenta)
	@ad_nav_bug_prepare()
	$rc_nav_rings.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$rc_nav_rings.draw_circle(150, 240, 48, gray)
	$rc_nav_rings.draw_circle(150, 240, 96, gray)
	$rc_nav_rings.draw_circle(150, 240, 144, gray)
	$rc_nav_rings.draw_circle(150, 240, 156, white)

	$rc_full_rings.draw_circle(150, 150, 36, gray)
	$rc_full_rings.draw_circle(150, 150, 72, gray)
	$rc_full_rings.draw_circle(150, 150, 108, gray)
	$rc_dock_background.blank($navigation_display_bg)
	$rc_dock_background.draw_line(50, 164, 250, 164, gray)
	$rc_dock_background.draw_line(150, 42, 150, 264, gray)
	$rc_dock_background.draw_circle(150, 164, 50, gray)
	$rc_dock_background.draw_circle(150, 164, 100, gray)
	$rc_dock_background.draw_rect(138, 152, 162, 176, white)
	$rc_nav_scene_key = ""
	$navigation_display_ready = 1

var $rc_navigation_display_chrome_image = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $rc_navigation_display_chrome_key = ""
var $rc_navigation_display_chrome_builds = 0
function @navigation_display_chrome_paint()
	; One cached warning banner; no per-frame text or polygon rendering.
	; Warning overlay is now drawn only on the physical centre screen.
	; Opaque headers/footers mask the map. Touch tabs never change flight modes.
	$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(0, 0, 300, 27, $navigation_display_bg, $navigation_display_bg)
	$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(0, 274, 300, 300, $navigation_display_bg, $navigation_display_bg)
	@navigation_display_text(30, 13, 1.1, white, "NAV")
	@navigation_display_text(90, 13, 1.1, white, "WAY")
	@navigation_display_text(150, 13, 1.1, white, "DOCK")
	@navigation_display_text(210, 13, 1.1, white, "ORE")
	var $geo_ink=white
	if @ore_ui_locked()
		$geo_ink=gray
	@navigation_display_text(270, 13, 1.1, $geo_ink, "GEO")
	var $wl_tab = $navigation_display_mode + 1

		$wl_tab = 0
	elseif $navigation_display_mode == 4
		$wl_tab = 1
	$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect($wl_tab * 60 + 1, 1, $wl_tab * 60 + 59, 25, cyan)
	@guide_service_border($navigation_display_lcd, 1, 1, 58, 24, 16)
	if $navigation_display_mode == 4
		@du_action($navigation_display_lcd,0,274,148,26,"ADD COORDS",0,green)
		@du_action($navigation_display_lcd,152,274,148,26,"SAVE HERE",2,green)
		return
	if $navigation_display_mode < 2
		@navigation_display_text(150, 287, 1, cyan, text("RANGE {}", @units_scale(@units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range), @fit_distance($navigation_display_range * 1852, 28))))
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(0, 274, 45, 300, cyan)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(255, 274, 300, 300, cyan)
		@navigation_display_text(22, 287, 1.5, red, "-")
		@navigation_display_text(278, 287, 1.5, green, "+")
	elseif $navigation_display_mode == 2
		var $navigation_display_state = "START"
		if $scan
			$navigation_display_state = "STOP"
		@navigation_display_text(32, 287, 1, white, $navigation_display_state)
		; Explicit ft/NM for every range selection; never ambiguous "miles".
		@navigation_display_text(105, 287, 0.9, cyan, @units_scale($max_distance, @format_distance($max_distance, 0)))
		@navigation_display_text(173, 287, 1, red, $ore1__m)
		@navigation_display_text(223, 287, 1, green, $ore2__m)
		@navigation_display_text(273, 287, 1, blue, $ore3__m)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line(65, 274, 65, 300, gray)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line(145, 274, 145, 300, gray)
	else
		var $geo_button = "START"
		if $geology_running
			$geo_button = "STOP"
		@navigation_display_text(30, 287, 0.9, white, $geo_button)
		@navigation_display_text(90, 287, 0.9, cyan, @units_scale($geology_range, text("{0} mi", $geology_range / 1852)))
		@navigation_display_text(150, 287, 0.65, cyan, @units_choice(text("FLT{0.00}mi", $geology_length / 1852), text("FLT{0.00}km", $geology_length / 1000)))
		@navigation_display_text(210, 287, 0.8, cyan, @geology_label($geology_filter))
		repeat 4 ($geo_sep)
			$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line(($geo_sep + 1) * 60, 274, ($geo_sep + 1) * 60, 300, gray)

function @navigation_display_chrome()
	var $rc_tile_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_mode, $navigation_display_range, $units_revision, $scan, $max_distance, $ore1__m, $ore2__m, $ore3__m, $geology_running, $geology_range, $geology_length, $geology_filter, $guide_service_revision)
	$rc_tile_key&=text("|{}",@ore_ui_locked())
	if $rc_tile_key != $rc_navigation_display_chrome_key
		var $rc_tile_target = $navigation_display_lcd
		$navigation_display_lcd = $rc_navigation_display_chrome_image
		$navigation_display_lcd.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
		@navigation_display_chrome_paint()
		$navigation_display_lcd = $rc_tile_target
		$rc_navigation_display_chrome_key = $rc_tile_key
		$rc_navigation_display_chrome_builds += 1
		$nr_full = 1
	screen_copy($rc_navigation_display_chrome_image, $navigation_display_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 28)
	screen_copy($rc_navigation_display_chrome_image, $navigation_display_lcd, 0, 274, 0, 274, 300, 26)

function @nav_guidance_heading() : number
	; Match the PFD: actual AP command while engaged, otherwise saved bearing.
	var $nav_guidance_bearing = @flight_command_heading()
	if $autopilot_ui_fd_enabled
		$nav_guidance_bearing = $systems_display_head
	; Use the same precision for actual and requested headings.
	return mod(round($nav_guidance_bearing * 10) / 10 + 720, 360)

function @nav_guidance_guidance($nav_guidance_hdg : number)
	var $nav_guidance_relative = mod(@nav_guidance_heading() - $nav_guidance_hdg + 540, 360) - 180
	var $nav_guidance_angle = $nav_guidance_relative * pi / 180
	var $nav_guidance_dx = sin($nav_guidance_angle)
	var $nav_guidance_dy = -cos($nav_guidance_angle)
	var $nav_guidance_radius = 144
	; Clip the actual bearing ray to the map, not to the compass edge.
	if abs($nav_guidance_dx) > 0.00001
		$nav_guidance_radius = min($nav_guidance_radius, 144 / abs($nav_guidance_dx))
	if $nav_guidance_dy > 0.00001
		$nav_guidance_radius = min($nav_guidance_radius, 20 / $nav_guidance_dy)
	; Dashed commanded-heading ray distinguishes it from the target vector.
	repeat 12 ($nav_guidance_segment)
		var $nav_guidance_r1 = $nav_guidance_segment * 12
		var $nav_guidance_r2 = min($nav_guidance_r1 + 8, $nav_guidance_radius)
		if $nav_guidance_r1 < $nav_guidance_radius
			$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line(150 + $nav_guidance_dx * $nav_guidance_r1, 240 + $nav_guidance_dy * $nav_guidance_r1, 150 + $nav_guidance_dx * $nav_guidance_r2, 240 + $nav_guidance_dy * $nav_guidance_r2, $nav_guidance_magenta)
	; Off-arc bugs park at the correct edge; the ray retains the real bearing.
	@ad_nav_bug_draw(clamp($nav_guidance_relative, -70, 70), @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling())


; Display-only ring captions. Rebuild for range/units changes, never for yaw.
var $map_ranges_atlas = virtualscreen(160, 16)
var $map_ranges_range = -1
var $map_ranges_units = -1
var $map_ranges_outer_width = 0
var $map_ranges_inner_width = 0
var $map_ranges_height = 0
var $map_ranges_builds = 0

function @map_ranges_prepare()
	if ($map_ranges_range == $navigation_display_range) and ($map_ranges_units == $units_revision)
		return
	$map_ranges_atlas.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	var $map_range_outer = @units_scale(@units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range) * 2 / 3, @format_distance($navigation_display_range * 1852 * 2 / 3, 0))
	var $map_range_inner = @units_scale(@units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range) / 3, @format_distance($navigation_display_range * 1852 / 3, 0))
	$map_ranges_atlas.text_size(0.7)
	$map_ranges_outer_width = size($map_range_outer) * $map_ranges_atlas.char_w
	$map_ranges_inner_width = size($map_range_inner) * $map_ranges_atlas.char_w
	$map_ranges_height = $map_ranges_atlas.char_h
	; Cached tiny plates keep marker leaders and the ring line out of the glyphs.

var $geology_px = 0
var $geology_py = 0
var $geology_visible = 0
var $geology_map_range = 0
var $geology_distance = 0

function @geology_project($geo_index : number, $geo_heading : number)
	$geology_visible = 0
	if ($geo_index < 0) or ($geo_index >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size)
		return
	var $geo_r = $sqx_geo18_find_radius.$geo_index
	if (@standby_nav_text(13) != $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_index) or ($geo_r <= 1000)
		return
	var $geo_now_lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $geo_now_lon = @standby_nav(9)
	if (abs($geo_now_lat) > 89) or (abs($geo_now_lon) > 180)
		return
	var $geo_n = @geology_north($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_index, $geo_now_lat, $geo_r)
	var $geo_e = @geology_east($sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_index, $geo_now_lon, $geo_now_lat, $geo_r)
	var $geo_h = $geo_heading * pi / 180
	var $geo_forward = $geo_n * cos($geo_h) + $geo_e * sin($geo_h)
	var $geo_right = $geo_e * cos($geo_h) - $geo_n * sin($geo_h)
	var $geo_scale = $geology_map_range
	if $geo_scale <= 0
		$geo_scale = $geology_range
	var $geo_center = 240
	var $geo_radius = 144
	if $navigation_display_mode == 3
		$geo_center = 150
		$geo_radius = 108
	$geology_px = 150 + $geo_right / $geo_scale * $geo_radius
	$geology_py = $geo_center - $geo_forward / $geo_scale * $geo_radius
	$geology_distance = sqrt($geo_n * $geo_n + $geo_e * $geo_e)
	; NAV arc overlay or full-circle ORE-style GEO view. No off-scale edge flags.
	$geology_visible = ($geology_distance <= $geo_scale) and ($geology_py <= 256) and ($geology_px >= 6) and ($geology_px <= 294)
	; NAV's header is not part of the map; GEO's full-circle view is unchanged.
	if ($navigation_display_mode == 0) and ($geology_py < 100)
		$geology_visible = 0

array $waypoint_label_y : number
array $waypoint_label_px : number

array $waypoint_label_name : text

	$waypoint_label_y.clear()

	$waypoint_label_kind.clear()

function @waypoint_label($px : number, $py : number, $ink : number, $name : text, $kind : number, $index : number)
	; All known beacon names remain present; bound the added discovery labels.
	if $kind and ($waypoint_label_x.size >= 128)
		return
	var $shown = substring($name, 0, 12)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_size(0.65)
	var $width = size($shown) * $navigation_display_lcd.char_w
	var $height = $navigation_display_lcd.char_h
	var $top = 109
	var $center = 240
	if $navigation_display_mode == 3
		$top = 60
		$center = 150
	var $x = clamp($px - $width / 2, 7, 293 - $width)
	var $y = clamp($py + 5, $top, 262 - $height)
	; Ownship exclusion zone, including its white wings and tail.
	if ($x < 169) and ($x + $width > 131) and ($y < $center + 16) and ($y + $height > $center - 18)
		$x = clamp($px + 20, 7, 293 - $width)
		if $px < 150
			$x = clamp($px - 20 - $width, 7, 293 - $width)
	; At most eight placement attempts; bounded work and no pixel scanning.
	repeat 8 ($attempt)
		var $overlap = @map_ranges_overlap($x, $y, $width, $height)
		foreach $waypoint_label_x ($i, $other)
			if ($x < $other + size($waypoint_label_name.$i) * $navigation_display_lcd.char_w + 4) and ($x + $width + 4 > $other) and (abs($y - $waypoint_label_y.$i) < $height + 3)
				$overlap = 1
		if !$overlap
			break
		$y = max($top, $y - $height - 4)
	$waypoint_label_x.append($x)
	$waypoint_label_y.append($y)
	$waypoint_label_px.append($px)
	$waypoint_label_py.append($py)
	$waypoint_label_ink.append($ink)
	$waypoint_label_name.append($shown)
	$waypoint_label_kind.append($kind)
	$waypoint_label_index.append($index)

function @waypoint_labels_draw()
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_size(0.65)
	$navigation_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	foreach $waypoint_label_x ($i, $x)
		var $y = $waypoint_label_y.$i
		var $name = $waypoint_label_name.$i
		var $ink = $waypoint_label_ink.$i
		var $width = size($name) * $navigation_display_lcd.char_w
		var $px = $waypoint_label_px.$i
		var $py = $waypoint_label_py.$i
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line($px, $py, clamp($px, $x, $x + $width), $y + $navigation_display_lcd.char_h / 2, $ink)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect($x - 2, $y - 1, $x + $width + 2, $y + $navigation_display_lcd.char_h + 1, $navigation_display_bg, $navigation_display_bg)
		$navigation_display_lcd.write($x, $y, $ink, $name)

function @waypoint_project($index : number, $way_heading : number, $range : number)
	$waypoint_visible = 0
	if ($index < 0) or ($index >= $sqx_way18_lat.size) or ($range <= 0)
		return
	if @standby_nav_text(13) != $sqx_way18_body.$index
		return
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	if (abs($lat) > 89) or (abs($lon) > 180)
		return
	var $north = @geology_north($sqx_way18_lat.$index, $lat, $sqx_way18_radius.$index)
	var $east = @geology_east($sqx_way18_lon.$index, $lon, $lat, $sqx_way18_radius.$index)
	var $h = $way_heading * pi / 180
	$waypoint_px = 150 + ($east * cos($h) - $north * sin($h)) / $range * 144
	$waypoint_py = 240 - ($north * cos($h) + $east * sin($h)) / $range * 144
	$waypoint_visible = (sqrt($north * $north + $east * $east) <= $range) and ($waypoint_px >= 6) and ($waypoint_px <= 294) and ($waypoint_py >= 100) and ($waypoint_py <= 256)

function @waypoint_markers($way_heading : number, $range : number)
	var $labels = 0
	foreach $sqx_way18_lat ($i, $lat)
		if @waypoint_navigation_same($lat, $sqx_way18_lon.$i, $sqx_way18_body.$i)
			continue
		@waypoint_project($i, $way_heading, $range)
		if !$waypoint_visible
			continue
		var $way_pip_ink = cyan
		if !$sqx_way18_way__m
			$way_pip_ink = $waypoint_records_dim_ink
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect($waypoint_px - 3, $waypoint_py - 3, $waypoint_px + 3, $waypoint_py + 3, $way_pip_ink)
		if ($labels < 24) and $sqx_way18_way__m
			@waypoint_label($waypoint_px, $waypoint_py, cyan, $sqx_way18_name.$i, 1, $i)
			$labels += 1

function @waypoint_records_height_known() : number
	var $site = $waypoint_focus
	if $geology_focus >= 0
		$site = $geology_focus
		if ($site >= $sqx_geo20_elevation.size) or ($site >= $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.size)
			return 0
		return $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.$site
	if ($site < 0) or ($site >= $sqx_way20_elevation.size) or ($site >= $sqx_way20_elevation_known.size)
		return 0
	return $sqx_way20_elevation_known.$site

function @waypoint_focus_locked() : number

			return @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geology_focus, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geology_focus, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geology_focus)

		return @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_way18_lat.$waypoint_focus, $sqx_way18_lon.$waypoint_focus, $sqx_way18_body.$waypoint_focus)
	return 0

function @waypoint_records_navigate()
	if !@waypoint_records_height_known()
		$waypoint_notice = "RECAPTURE / RESCAN ELEVATION FIRST"

	if !@waypoint_records_nav_ready()
		$waypoint_notice = "TURN NAV OFF FIRST"
		@nav_target_block(7, 7, "TURN NAV OFF FIRST")
		return
	var $site = $waypoint_focus
	var $accepted = 0
	if $geology_focus >= 0
		$site = $geology_focus
		var $site_name = $sqx_geo18_find_name.$site
		if $site_name == ""
			$site_name = @geology_label($sqx_geo18_find_kind.$site)
		$accepted = @nav_target_stage_point($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$site, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$site, $sqx_geo20_elevation.$site, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$site, $sqx_geo18_find_radius.$site, $site_name)
	else
		$accepted = @nav_target_stage_point($sqx_way18_lat.$site, $sqx_way18_lon.$site, $sqx_way20_elevation.$site, $sqx_way18_body.$site, $sqx_way18_radius.$site, $sqx_way18_name.$site)
	if !$accepted
		$waypoint_notice = "POSITION / BODY UNAVAILABLE"
		return
	$waypoint_focus = -1
	$geology_focus = -1
	; Selection stays on this page; only the bottom NAV engages flight.
	$navigation_display_key = ""
	$waypoint_notice = "TARGET SELECTED / PRESS NAV BELOW"
	if !$nav_target_kind
		$waypoint_notice = "TARGET CLEARED"
	$waypoint_revision += 1

	else

	else

			$sqx_way18_name.$i=$we_name
		if $sqx_way18_notes.$i!=$we_notes
			$sqx_way18_notes.$i=$we_notes
		if @nav_target_same($sqx_way18_lat.$i,$sqx_way18_lon.$i,$sqx_way18_body.$i)
			$nav_target_name=$we_name
			$nav_target_revision+=1

	$waypoint_notice=""
	$waypoint_revision+=1
	return 1

function @waypoint_detail_click($x : number, $y : number)
	if ($x>=262) and ($x<288) and ($y>=110) and ($y<138)
		$waypoint_focus=-1
		$geology_focus=-1
		$waypoint_delete_pending=0
		$geology_delete_pending=-1
		$waypoint_revision+=1
		return
	if @waypoint_focus_locked()
		$waypoint_notice="NAV TARGET LOCKED"
		@nav_target_block(7,7,"TURN NAV OFF FIRST")
		$waypoint_revision += 1
		return
	var $geo = ($geology_focus >= 0)
	var $pending = $waypoint_delete_pending
	if $geo
		$pending = ($geology_delete_pending == $geology_focus)
	var $left = ($x >= 24) and ($x < 142)
	var $right = ($x >= 158) and ($x < 276)
	if $pending
		if ($y >= 224) and ($y < 250)
			if $left
				$waypoint_delete_pending = 0
				$geology_delete_pending = -1
			elseif $right
				if $geo
					; Retain existing single-GEO-delete survey-stop behavior.
					if $geology_owned and $geology_selected
						@geology_quiet()
					$geology_running = 0
					@geology_delete($geology_focus)
				else
					@waypoint_delete($waypoint_focus)
	elseif ($y >= 227) and ($y < 250)
		if ($x >= 112) and ($x < 188)
			@waypoint_records_navigate()
		elseif ($x >= 24) and ($x < 100)
			@waypoint_edit(0)
		elseif ($x >= 200) and ($x < 276)
			if $geo
				$geology_delete_pending = $geology_focus
			else
				$waypoint_delete_pending = 1
	$waypoint_revision += 1

function @waypoint_insert($character : text)

function @waypoint_pick($x : number, $y : number, $range : number)
	var $closest = 144
	var $chosen = -1
	if $sqx_way18_way__m
		foreach $sqx_way18_lat ($i, $lat)
			@waypoint_project($i, @standby_nav(6), $range)
			var $distance = pow($x - $waypoint_px, 2) + pow($y - $waypoint_py, 2)
			if $waypoint_visible and ($distance < $closest)
				$closest = $distance
				$chosen = $i
	$waypoint_focus = $chosen
	$geology_focus = -1
	; Hit-test the same displayed GEO symbols, but never hidden layers.
	if $sqx_way18_geo__m
		$geology_map_range = $range
		foreach $sqx_geo18_find_kind ($i, $kind)
			if ($geology_filter != 0) and ($geology_filter != $kind)
				continue
			@geology_project($i, @standby_nav(6))
			var $distance = pow($x - $geology_px, 2) + pow($y - $geology_py, 2)
			if $geology_visible and ($distance < $closest)
				$closest = $distance
				$geology_focus = $i
				$waypoint_focus = -1
	; Labels are clickable too: near-center leader plates can be selected directly.
	foreach $waypoint_label_x ($i, $lx)
		var $kind = $waypoint_label_kind.$i
		if !$kind
			continue
		if (($kind == 1) and !$sqx_way18_way__m) or (($kind == 2) and !$sqx_way18_geo__m)
			continue
		var $ly = $waypoint_label_y.$i
		if ($x >= $lx - 2) and ($x < $lx + size($waypoint_label_name.$i) * 3.9 + 2) and ($y >= $ly - 1) and ($y < $ly + 8)
			$waypoint_focus = -1
			$geology_focus = -1
			if $kind == 1
				$waypoint_focus = $waypoint_label_index.$i
			else
				$geology_focus = $waypoint_label_index.$i
			break
	$waypoint_revision += 1

function @geology_markers($geo_heading : number, $geo_range : number)
	$geology_map_range = $geo_range
	var $labels = 0
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_kind ($geo_i, $geo_kind)
		if ($navigation_display_mode == 0) and @waypoint_navigation_same($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_i, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_i, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_i)
			continue
		if ($geology_filter != 0) and ($geology_filter != $geo_kind)
			continue
		@geology_project($geo_i, $geo_heading)
		if !$geology_visible
			continue
		var $geo_ink = yellow
		if ($geo_kind == 1) or ($geo_kind == 2)
			$geo_ink = green
		elseif $geo_kind == 7
			$geo_ink = orange
		if ($navigation_display_mode == 0) and (!$sqx_way18_geo__m)
			$geo_ink = $geology_records_dim_ink
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_circle($geology_px, $geology_py, 3, $geo_ink)
		if ($labels < 8) and (($navigation_display_mode != 0) or $sqx_way18_geo__m)
			var $name = $sqx_geo18_find_name.$geo_i
			if $name == ""
				$name = @geology_label($geo_kind)
			@waypoint_label($geology_px, $geology_py, $geo_ink, $name, 2, $geo_i)
			$labels += 1

; Small subdued snapshot diamonds/nameplates. NAV target draws above these.
function @saved_beacons_markers($bc_heading : number, $range : number)
	if ($range <= 0) or (!@saved_beacons_valid())
		return
	var $body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8) * pi / 180
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	if (abs($lat) > pi / 2) or (abs($lon) > 180) or ($body == "")
		return
	var $h = $bc_heading * pi / 180
	foreach $sqx_bc18_frequency ($index, $frequency)
		if !@bp_nav_shown($frequency)
			continue
		if @saved_beacons_hidden($frequency) or ($body != $sqx_bc18_body.$index) or ($sqx_bc18_radius.$index <= 1000)
			continue
		if (abs($sqx_bc18_lat.$index) > 90) or (abs($sqx_bc18_lon.$index) > 180)
			continue
		var $record = @saved_beacons_record($frequency)
		if $record < 0
			continue
		var $target = $sqx_bc18_lat.$index * pi / 180
		var $delta = (mod($sqx_bc18_lon.$index - $lon + 540, 360) - 180) * pi / 180
		var $north = cos($lat) * sin($target) - sin($lat) * cos($target) * cos($delta)
		var $east = cos($target) * sin($delta)
		var $norm = sqrt($north * $north + $east * $east)
		var $dot = sin($lat) * sin($target) + cos($lat) * cos($target) * cos($delta)
		var $distance = atan($norm, $dot) * $sqx_bc18_radius.$index
		; Saved entries outside the selected range are not edge-clamped.
		if $distance > $range
			continue
		if $norm > 0.000000001
			$north *= $distance / $norm
			$east *= $distance / $norm
		else
			$north = 0
			$east = 0
		var $forward = $north * cos($h) + $east * sin($h)
		var $right = $east * cos($h) - $north * sin($h)
		var $dx = $right / $range * 144
		var $dy = -$forward / $range * 144
		var $px = 150 + $dx
		var $py = 240 + $dy
		; Match custom waypoint bounds; no symbol, plate or leader off the map.
		if ($px < 6) or ($px > 294) or ($py < 100) or ($py > 256)
			continue
		var $ink = $saved_beacons_ink
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line($px, $py - 3, $px + 3, $py, $ink)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line($px + 3, $py, $px, $py + 3, $ink)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line($px, $py + 3, $px - 3, $py, $ink)
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_line($px - 3, $py, $px, $py - 3, $ink)
		var $name = substring($sqx_tg47_names.$record, 0, 12)
		if $name == ""
			$name = substring($frequency, 0, 12)
		if $sqx_way18_tar__m
			@waypoint_label($px, $py, $ink, $name, 0, $index)

function @ore_scanner_click($ox : number, $oy : number)
	if $ore_ui_active and ($mission_mode!=0) and ($oy<274)
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"CANCEL FIND ORE TO CHANGE SCAN")
		return
	if $oy >= 274
		if ($ox >= 75) and ($ox < 225)
			$ore_scanner_popup = 0
		return
	var $changed = 0
	if $ore_scanner_popup == 4
		repeat 4 ($oi)
			if ($ox >= 36) and ($ox < 264) and ($oy >= 76 + $oi * 42) and ($oy < 110 + $oi * 42)
				var $ore_range20 = @ore_scanner_range($oi)
				$changed = $max_distance != $ore_range20
				$max_distance = $ore_range20
				$ore_scanner_popup = 0
	else
		foreach $oreNames ($oi, $option)
			var $bx = 12 + mod($oi, 3) * 94
			var $by = 80 + floor($oi / 3) * 24
			if ($oi < 21) and ($ox >= $bx) and ($ox < $bx + 88) and ($oy >= $by) and ($oy < $by + 21)
				if $ore_ui_active and (($option=="off") or ($option=="land") or ($option=="sea"))
					return
				$changed = $option != @ore_scanner_selected()
				if $ore_scanner_popup == 1
					var $persist_next_204 : text
					$persist_next_204 = $option
					if $ore1__m != $persist_next_204
						$ore1 = $persist_next_204
						$ore1__m = $ore1
				elseif $ore_scanner_popup == 2
					var $persist_next_205 : text
					$persist_next_205 = $option
					if $ore2__m != $persist_next_205
						$ore2 = $persist_next_205
						$ore2__m = $ore2
				else
					var $persist_next_206 : text
					$persist_next_206 = $option
					if $ore3__m != $persist_next_206
						$ore3 = $persist_next_206
						$ore3__m = $ore3
				$ore_scanner_popup = 0
				break
	if $ore_ui_active and !$ore_scanner_popup and $ore_ui_pending
		$ore_ui_pending=0
		@mission_ore_click()
	elseif $changed
		@ore_scanner_reset_scan()

; All guidance, sensor, scanner, marker picking and detail reads stay live.
var $map_motion_ready = 0
var $map_motion_lat = 0
var $map_motion_lon = 0
var $map_motion_radius = 0
var $map_motion_body = ""
var $map_motion_range = 0
var $map_motion_revision = 0
var $map_motion_layers = -1

function @navigation_motion_key() : text
	; The detail view shows precise distance text, not only map pixels.
	if ($geology_focus >= 0) or ($waypoint_focus >= 0)
		return text("{0},{0},{}", round(@standby_nav(8) * 1000000), round(@standby_nav(9) * 1000000), @standby_nav_text(13))
	var $mm_layers = $terrain_enabled or $scan or ($sqx_geo18_find_kind.size > 0) or ($sqx_way18_name.size > 0)
	; A single selected base is hidden as a stored marker; live guidance draws it.
	if $sqx_bc18_frequency.size > 1
		$mm_layers = 1
	elseif $sqx_bc18_frequency.size == 1
		if !@saved_beacons_hidden($sqx_bc18_frequency.0)
			$mm_layers = 1
	if !$mm_layers
		$map_motion_ready = 0
		return "NO POSITION LAYER"
	var $mm_lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $mm_lon = @standby_nav(9)
	var $mm_radius = @standby_nav(14)
	var $mm_body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	var $mm_range = @units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range)
	var $mm_changed = (!$map_motion_ready) or ($mm_range != $map_motion_range) or ($mm_body != $map_motion_body) or ($mm_radius != $map_motion_radius)
	if !$mm_changed
		var $mm_north = abs($mm_lat - $map_motion_lat) * pi / 180 * $mm_radius
		var $mm_east = abs(mod($mm_lon - $map_motion_lon + 540, 360) - 180) * pi / 180 * $mm_radius * abs(cos(($mm_lat + $map_motion_lat) * pi / 360))
		$mm_changed = max($mm_north, $mm_east) >= max($mm_range / 576, 0.01)
	if $mm_changed
		$map_motion_lat = $mm_lat
		$map_motion_lon = $mm_lon
		$map_motion_radius = $mm_radius
		$map_motion_body = $mm_body
		$map_motion_range = $mm_range
		$map_motion_revision += 1
		$map_motion_ready = 1
	return text("{0},{}", $map_motion_revision, $mm_body)

	var $nr_frame_moved = $navigation_display_signal and (($nr_frame_px != $nr_px) or ($nr_frame_py != $nr_py))
	var $nr_frame_heading_dirty = $nr_frame_full or ($nr_frame_heading != $nr_heading)
	var $nr_frame_axes_dirty = $nr_frame_full or ($nr_frame_axes != $nr_axes)
	var $nr_frame_height_dirty = $nr_frame_full or ($nr_frame_height != $nr_height)
	var $nr_frame_status_dirty = $nr_frame_full or ($pad_status != $nr_status)
	if $nr_frame_moved
		; Restore whole text strips before repainting, including glyph edge pixels.
		$nr_frame_axes_dirty = $nr_frame_axes_dirty or (($nr_py+8 >= 225) and ($nr_py-7 < 245)) or (($nr_frame_py+8 >= 225) and ($nr_frame_py-7 < 245))
		$nr_frame_height_dirty = $nr_frame_height_dirty or (($nr_py+8 >= 245) and ($nr_py-7 < 267)) or (($nr_frame_py+8 >= 245) and ($nr_frame_py-7 < 267))
		$nr_frame_status_dirty = $nr_frame_status_dirty or (($nr_py-7 < 71) or ($nr_frame_py-7 < 71))
	if $navigation_display_signal and ($nr_frame_full or $nr_frame_moved or $nr_frame_axes_dirty or $nr_frame_height_dirty or $nr_frame_status_dirty)
		$nr_frame_axes_dirty = $nr_frame_axes_dirty or (($nr_frame_py+6 >= 225) and ($nr_frame_py-6 < 245))
		$nr_frame_height_dirty = $nr_frame_height_dirty or (($nr_frame_py+6 >= 245) and ($nr_frame_py-6 < 267))
		$nr_frame_status_dirty = $nr_frame_status_dirty or ($nr_frame_py-6 < 71)
	if $nr_frame_full

		$nr_full = 1
	else
		if $nr_frame_heading_dirty
			@nr_restore(0,28,300,19)
		if $nr_frame_axes_dirty
			@nr_restore(0,225,300,20)
		if $nr_frame_height_dirty
			@nr_restore(0,245,300,22)
		if $nr_frame_status_dirty
			@nr_restore(0,54,300,17)
		if $nr_frame_moved

			@nr_restore(floor($nr_frame_px)-7,floor($nr_frame_py)-7,15,15)
	if $navigation_display_signal
		; Small live circle stays a primitive: no resampling or visual change.
		if $nr_frame_full or $nr_frame_moved or $nr_frame_axes_dirty or $nr_frame_height_dirty or $nr_frame_status_dirty

		if $nr_frame_axes_dirty
			@navigation_display_text(150,235,min(0.85,288/max(size($nr_frame_axes)*6,1)),cyan,$nr_frame_axes)
		if $nr_frame_height_dirty
			@navigation_display_text(150,251,1,white,$nr_frame_height)
	elseif $nr_frame_full
		@navigation_display_text(150,80,1.3,orange,"NO DOCK SIGNAL")
	if $nr_frame_full
		@navigation_display_chrome()
	if $nr_frame_status_dirty and ($pad_status != "")
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(0,54,300,70,$navigation_display_bg,$navigation_display_bg)
		@navigation_display_text(150,62,min(1,288/max(size($pad_status)*6,1)),orange,$pad_status)
	if $nr_frame_full
		$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(46,274,254,300,$navigation_display_bg,$navigation_display_bg)
		@navigation_display_text(150,287,1,cyan,text("RANGE +/- {}",@units_scale(max(10,$navigation_display_range*10),@fit_distance(max(10,$navigation_display_range*10),22))))
	$nr_dock_ready = 1
	$nr_dock_context = $nr_frame_context
	$nr_heading = $nr_frame_heading
	$nr_axes = $nr_frame_axes
	$nr_height = $nr_frame_height
	$nr_status = $pad_status
	$nr_px = $nr_frame_px
	$nr_py = $nr_frame_py

; WAY is display mode 4; the established NAV/DOCK/ORE/GEO mode IDs stay intact.
; This view has no moving-map projection, beacon polling or per-tick storage writes.
var $wl_top = 0
; T4w: eight 26 px rows (the old hint line's space).
const $wl_rows = 8

function @wl_count() : number
	return $sqx_way18_lat.size + $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size

; RAM-only visible-row distances. No beacon reads or persistent writes.
array $wd_labels : text
array $wd_dirty : number
var $wd_changed = 0
var $wd_next = -1
var $wd_top = -1
var $wd_way_revision = -1
var $wd_geo_revision = -1
var $wd_units = -1
var $wd_lat = 999
var $wd_lon = 999
var $wd_body = ""
var $wd_radius = 0
var $wd_samples = 0
var $wd_calculations = 0

function @wd_meters($lat : number, $lon : number, $target_lat : number, $target_lon : number, $radius : number) : number
	var $phi = $lat * pi / 180
	var $other = $target_lat * pi / 180
	var $dphi = ($other - $phi) / 2
	var $dlon = (mod($target_lon - $lon + 540, 360) - 180) * pi / 360
	var $a = clamp(sin($dphi) ^ 2 + cos($phi) * cos($other) * sin($dlon) ^ 2, 0, 1)
	return 2 * atan(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a)) * $radius

function @wd_format($meters : number) : text
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		if $meters < 1000
			return text("{0} m", $meters)
		if $meters < 1000000
			return text("{0.0} km", $meters / 1000)
		return text("{0} km", $meters / 1000)
	if $meters < 185.2
		return text("{0} ft", $meters / 0.3048)
	if $meters < 1852000
		return text("{0.0} NM", $meters / 1852)
	return text("{0} NM", $meters / 1852)

function @wd_context_changed() : number
	return ($wd_top != $wl_top) or ($wd_way_revision != $waypoint_revision) or ($wd_geo_revision != $geology_revision) or ($wd_units != $sqx_u20_metric__m)

function @wd_position($lat : number, $lon : number, $body : text, $radius : number)
	if !@wd_context_changed()
		if ($lat == $wd_lat) and ($lon == $wd_lon) and ($body == $wd_body) and ($radius == $wd_radius)
			return
	while $wd_labels.size < $wl_rows
		$wd_labels.append("")
		$wd_dirty.append(0)
	$wd_top = $wl_top
	$wd_way_revision = $waypoint_revision
	$wd_geo_revision = $geology_revision
	$wd_units = $sqx_u20_metric__m
	$wd_lat = $lat
	$wd_lon = $lon
	$wd_body = $body
	$wd_radius = $radius
	var $valid = ($body != "") and ($radius > 1000) and (abs($lat) <= 90) and (abs($lon) <= 180)
	var $total = @wl_count()
	repeat $wl_rows ($row)
		var $slot = $wl_top + $row
		var $label = ""
		if $slot < $total
			$label = "--"
			if $valid
				var $target_lat = 0
				var $target_lon = 0
				var $target_radius = 0
				var $target_body = ""
				if $slot < $sqx_way18_lat.size
					$target_lat = $sqx_way18_lat.$slot
					$target_lon = $sqx_way18_lon.$slot
					$target_radius = $sqx_way18_radius.$slot
					$target_body = $sqx_way18_body.$slot
				else
					var $geo = $slot - $sqx_way18_lat.size
					$target_lat = $sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo
					$target_lon = $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo
					$target_radius = $sqx_geo18_find_radius.$geo
					$target_body = $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo
				if ($target_body == $body) and ($target_radius > 1000) and (abs($target_radius - $radius) <= $target_radius * 0.01) and (abs($target_lat) <= 90) and (abs($target_lon) <= 180)
					$label = @wd_format(@wd_meters($lat, $lon, $target_lat, $target_lon, $target_radius))
					$wd_calculations += 1
		if $label != $wd_labels.$row
			$wd_labels.$row = $label
			$wd_dirty.$row = 1
			$wd_changed = 1

function @wd_refresh($now : number)
	if $display_sleep or ($navigation_display_mode != 4) or $waypoint_editor or ($waypoint_focus >= 0) or ($geology_focus >= 0)
		return
	if !@sw_in_2()
		return
	if !@wd_context_changed()
		if $now < $wd_next
			return
	$wd_next = $now + 15
	$wd_samples += 1
	@wd_position(@standby_nav(8), @standby_nav(9), @standby_nav_text(13), @standby_nav(14))

function @wd_draw_row($row : number)

	var $y = 56 + $row * 26
	$navigation_display_lcd.draw_rect(222, $y + 1, 277, $y + 23, $navigation_display_bg, $navigation_display_bg)
	@navigation_display_text(249, $y + 12, min(0.75, 53 / max(size($wd_labels.$row) * 6, 1)), white, $wd_labels.$row)
	@nr_dirty(222, $y + 1, 55, 23)
	$wd_dirty.$row = 0

function @wd_draw_changes()
	var $count = min($wl_rows, max(@wl_count() - $wl_top, 0))
	repeat $count ($row)
		if $wd_dirty.$row

	$wd_changed = 0

function @wl_scroll($wl_step : number)

		@wd_draw_row($wl_row)

		$nn_ready=0
	if $waypoint_editor!=7
		$we_ready=0
	if !$waypoint_editor
		$wk_context=""
	@units_ranges_sync()
	@nav_panels_layout()
	if !@sw_in_2()
		$wd_next = -1
		$nr_full = 1
		$nr_dock_ready = 0
		@navigation_display_poweroff()
	else
		if !$navigation_display_ready
			@navigation_display_prepare()
		if $navigation_display_mode == 4
			@wl_update()
			return
		$navigation_display_capture = 1
		var $navigation_display_heading = mod(round(@standby_nav(6) * 10) / 10 + 360, 360)
		var $navigation_display_k = ""
		var $navigation_display_signal = 0
		var $navigation_display_dist = 0
		var $navigation_display_rel = 0
		var $navigation_display_track = 0
		var $navigation_display_gs = 0
		var $navigation_display_payload = ""
		var $navigation_display_right = 0
		var $navigation_display_forward = 0
		var $navigation_display_height = 0
		var $navigation_display_dock_heading = 0
		if $navigation_display_mode == 0
			$terrain_view_range = @units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range)
			@scanner_options_publish()
			if $terrain_enabled or $scan
				@ore_map_tick(@units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range))
			var $navigation_display_receiver = "beacon"
			if @sw_in_11() and (!input_number("ship-dock", 0))
				$navigation_display_receiver = "docking-beacon"
			$navigation_display_signal = input_number($navigation_display_receiver, 5) and ($sqx_ui46_nav__m or @sw_in_11())
			; Retune wait masks the previous receiver sample, not a stored fallback.
			if ($navigation_display_receiver == "beacon") and (time < $beacon_browser_nav_after)
				$navigation_display_signal = 0
			if $navigation_display_signal
				$navigation_display_dist = round(input_number($navigation_display_receiver, 1))
				; EXACT bearing sign used by the existing TAR heading selection.
				$navigation_display_rel = round(-@standby_nav(25) * 180 * 2) / 2
				$navigation_display_payload = substring(@beacon_display_name(input_text($navigation_display_receiver, 0)), 0, 12)
			if $waypoint_navigation_active
				$navigation_display_signal = @waypoint_navigation_position()
				$navigation_display_dist = $waypoint_navigation_distance
				$navigation_display_rel = $waypoint_navigation_relative
				$navigation_display_payload = substring($waypoint_navigation_name, 0, 12)
			$navigation_display_track = mod(@standby_nav(7) + 360, 360)
			$navigation_display_gs = round(@standby_nav(10) * 1.94384449)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_mode, $navigation_display_range, $navigation_display_heading, $navigation_display_track, $navigation_display_gs, $navigation_display_signal, $navigation_display_dist, $navigation_display_rel, $navigation_display_payload)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, @nav_guidance_heading(), $sqx_ui46_tar__m, @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling())
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $geology_revision, $geology_filter, $geology_focus, @navigation_motion_key(), 0, @standby_nav_text(13))
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $saved_beacons_revision, $beacon_last_main, $beacon_browser_last_view, @service_number("comms", 5) and (time >= $beacon_receive_after), $dock_selection_target, @sw_in_11())
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{}", $navigation_display_k, input_number("ship-dock", 0))
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $waypoint_navigation_active)
			var $ore_phase = -1
			if $scan
				$ore_phase = mod(floor(time * 2), 2)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $scan, $terrain_enabled, $terrain_sleep, $ore_map_revision, $navigation_display_ore_revision, $ore_phase)
		elseif $navigation_display_mode == 1
			$navigation_display_signal = input_number("docking-beacon", 5)
			if $navigation_display_signal
				$navigation_display_dist = input_number("docking-beacon", 1)
				var $navigation_display_raw_x = input_number("docking-beacon", 2) * $navigation_display_dist
				var $navigation_display_raw_y = input_number("docking-beacon", 3) * $navigation_display_dist
				var $navigation_display_raw_z = input_number("docking-beacon", 4) * $navigation_display_dist
				var $navigation_display_bank = @standby_nav(5) * pi
				var $navigation_display_pitch = @standby_nav(4) * pi
				var $navigation_display_up = $navigation_display_raw_x * sin($navigation_display_bank) + $navigation_display_raw_z * cos($navigation_display_bank)
				; Exact passed AD41 levelling math, READ ONLY.
				$navigation_display_right = round(($navigation_display_raw_x * cos($navigation_display_bank) - $navigation_display_raw_z * sin($navigation_display_bank)) * 10) / 10
				$navigation_display_forward = round(($navigation_display_raw_y * cos($navigation_display_pitch) + $navigation_display_up * sin($navigation_display_pitch)) * 10) / 10
				$navigation_display_height = round(($navigation_display_raw_y * sin($navigation_display_pitch) - $navigation_display_up * cos($navigation_display_pitch)) * 10) / 10
				$navigation_display_dock_heading = mod(round(input_number("docking-beacon", 0)) + 360, 360)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_mode, $navigation_display_range, $navigation_display_signal, $navigation_display_right, $navigation_display_forward, $navigation_display_height, $navigation_display_dock_heading)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $pad_status)
		elseif $navigation_display_mode == 2
			@scanner_options_publish()
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_mode, $scan, $resting, $scanner_options_published, $max_distance, $ore1__m, $ore2__m, $ore3__m, $scanArc)
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $ore_notices_revision, @ore_notices_phase())
		else
			$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_mode, $navigation_display_heading, round(@standby_nav(8) * 1000000), round(@standby_nav(9) * 1000000), @standby_nav_text(13), $geology_revision, $geology_status, $geology_focus)
		if ($navigation_display_mode==2) and $ore_ui_active
			$navigation_display_k=text("MISSION|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",$mission_mode,$mission_phase,$mission_status,$ore_ui_pending,$ore_ui_log_revision,$ore_scanner_popup,$nav_target_flash_message,time<$nav_target_flash_until)
		$navigation_display_k = text("{},{},{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $waypoint_revision, $units_revision, $ore_scanner_popup)
		if $ore_scanner_popup
			; Keep scanning, but do not redraw a static selector for new scan pixels.
			$navigation_display_k = text("SELECT,{},{},{},{},{},{}", $ore_scanner_popup, $units_revision, $ore1__m, $ore2__m, $ore3__m, $max_distance)
		$navigation_display_k = text("{},{}", $navigation_display_k, $guide_service_revision)
		$navigation_display_k &= text(",{},{},{}", $nav_target_revision, $sqx_ui46_nav__m, @waypoint_focus_locked())
		if ($navigation_display_power != 1) or ($navigation_display_k != $navigation_display_key)
			if ($nr_mode != $navigation_display_mode) or ($navigation_display_power != 1)
				$nr_full = 1
			$nr_mode = $navigation_display_mode
			if $waypoint_editor
				@waypoint_keyboard()
			elseif $navigation_display_mode == 0
				@navigation_display_nav_frame($navigation_display_heading, $navigation_display_track, $navigation_display_gs, $navigation_display_signal, $navigation_display_dist, $navigation_display_rel, $navigation_display_payload)
			elseif $navigation_display_mode == 1
				@navigation_display_dock_frame($navigation_display_signal, $navigation_display_dist, $navigation_display_right, $navigation_display_forward, $navigation_display_height, $navigation_display_dock_heading)
			elseif $navigation_display_mode == 2
				if !$ore_ui_active or $ore_scanner_popup
					$nr_full = 1
				@navigation_display_ore_frame()
			else
				$nr_full = 1
				@geology_frame($navigation_display_heading)
			$navigation_display_key = $navigation_display_k
			$navigation_display_power = 1
			$display_nd_revision += 1

; Repaint every NAV pixel on the next frame (tabs, header, map, footer),
; so a layer change can never leave stale rows behind.
function @nav_full_repaint()
	$nn_ready = 0
	$nr_full = 1
	$rc_nav_scene_key = ""
	$rc_navigation_display_chrome_key = ""

function @navigation_display_choose($navigation_display_x : number, $navigation_display_y : number)
	$nn_ready=0
	if @ore_ui_locked()
		if (($navigation_display_y<27) and ($navigation_display_x>=240)) or (($navigation_display_mode==0) and ($navigation_display_y>=58) and ($navigation_display_y<76) and ($navigation_display_x>=128) and ($navigation_display_x<172))
			@nav_target_block(17,17,"FIND ORE OWNS SCANNERS")
			return
	if ($navigation_display_mode==2) and $ore_ui_active and !$ore_scanner_popup and ($navigation_display_y>=27)
		@om_click($navigation_display_x,$navigation_display_y)
		return
	@units_ranges_sync()
	if ($navigation_display_power == 1) and ($navigation_display_x >= 0) and ($navigation_display_x < 300)
		; Modal first: keys, DELETE/CANCEL cannot fall through into map/tab controls.
		if $ore_scanner_popup
			@ore_scanner_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			$navigation_display_key = ""
			return
		if $waypoint_editor
			@waypoint_keyboard_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			$navigation_display_key = ""
			return
		if ($geology_focus >= 0) or ($waypoint_focus >= 0)
			@waypoint_detail_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			$navigation_display_key = ""
			return
		if ($navigation_display_mode == 4) and ($navigation_display_y >= 27)
			@wl_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			return
		if ($navigation_display_mode == 0) and ($navigation_display_x >= 128) and ($navigation_display_x < 172) and ($navigation_display_y >= 58) and ($navigation_display_y < 76)
			if $scan
				$scan = 0
				$resting = 0
				@ore_scanner_quiet()
				@terrain_scan_off()
			else
				if $terrain_enabled
					@terrain_scan_off()
				else
					@terrain_scan_start()
			$navigation_display_key = ""
			@nav_full_repaint()
			return
		if ($navigation_display_mode == 0) and @waypoint_control_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			$navigation_display_key = ""
			return
		if ($navigation_display_y >= 0) and ($navigation_display_y < 27)
			$waypoint_focus = -1
			$waypoint_delete_pending = 0
			$geology_focus = -1
			$geology_delete_pending = -1
			$geology_clear_pending = 0
			$wd_next = -1
			var $wl_tab = floor($navigation_display_x / 60)
			if $wl_tab == 0
				$navigation_display_mode = 0
			elseif $wl_tab == 1
				$navigation_display_mode = 4
			else
				$navigation_display_mode = $wl_tab - 1
			$geology_selected = ($navigation_display_mode == 3)
			$navigation_display_capture = 1
			$navigation_display_key = ""
		elseif ($navigation_display_y >= 274) and ($navigation_display_y < 300)
			if $navigation_display_mode == 0
				$geology_focus = -1
				$geology_delete_pending = -1
			if $navigation_display_mode == 3
				@geology_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
			elseif $navigation_display_mode < 2
				if $navigation_display_x < 45
					$navigation_display_range = clamp($navigation_display_range / 2, 0.5, 64)
				elseif $navigation_display_x >= 255
					$navigation_display_range = clamp($navigation_display_range * 2, 0.5, 64)
			else
				if $navigation_display_x < 65
					$scan = !$scan
					if $scan
						@ore_notices_rearm()
					else
						@ore_scanner_quiet()
				elseif $navigation_display_x < 145
					$ore_scanner_popup = 4
				elseif $navigation_display_x < 195
					$ore_scanner_popup = 1
				elseif $navigation_display_x < 245
					$ore_scanner_popup = 2
				else
					$ore_scanner_popup = 3
				if $navigation_display_x < 65
					@refresh_ore_screen()
					$resting = 0
			$navigation_display_key = ""
		elseif (($navigation_display_mode == 3) or ($navigation_display_mode == 0)) and ($navigation_display_y >= 27) and ($navigation_display_y < 274)
			if ($navigation_display_mode == 3) and $geology_clear_pending
				@geology_confirm_click($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y)
				$navigation_display_key = ""
				return
			var $geo_click_range = $geology_range
			if $navigation_display_mode == 0
				$geo_click_range = @units_nav_meters($navigation_display_range)
			if $navigation_display_mode == 0
				@waypoint_pick($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y, $geo_click_range)
			else
				@geology_pick($navigation_display_x, $navigation_display_y, $geo_click_range)
			$navigation_display_key = ""

function @navigation_display_scroll($navigation_wheel_delta : number)
	if ($navigation_wheel_delta == 0) or ($navigation_display_power != 1) or $display_sleep
		return
	; Do not zoom through an editor, selector or confirmation overlay.
	if $ore_scanner_popup or $waypoint_editor or ($geology_focus >= 0) or ($waypoint_focus >= 0) or $geology_clear_pending
		return
	if $navigation_display_mode == 4
		if $navigation_wheel_delta > 0
			@wl_scroll(-1)
		else
			@wl_scroll(1)
		return
	; NAV and DOCK use the same existing +/- range steps in any LCD position.
	if $navigation_display_mode >= 2
		return
	@units_ranges_sync()
	if $navigation_wheel_delta > 0
		$navigation_display_range = clamp($navigation_display_range / 2, 0.5, 64)
	else
		$navigation_display_range = clamp($navigation_display_range * 2, 0.5, 64)
	$navigation_display_key = ""

xc_files.plain_code:
; Pilot-only subscription relay for the tutorial HUD aliased "pilot-guide".
; "hud" belongs to the existing HUD Beacon. Never send subscription data there.
; Transient seat tokens are never saved, logged or broadcast to other players.
var $hud_subscription_last = -1

function @hud_subscription_release()
	output_number("pilot-guide", 0, 0)
	$hud_subscription_last = -1

function @hud_subscription_sample()
	; The uploaded VM confirms a non-boolean integer seat token below 2^53.
	; Preserve the native numeric value: do not turn it into text for forwarding.
	var $seat_token = input_number("flight-seat", 0)
	@lt_seat_observe($seat_token)
	if $seat_token == 1
		; A boolean occupancy signal is not a player identity.
		$seat_token = 0
	if $seat_token != 0
		output_number("pilot-guide", 0, $seat_token)
	elseif $seat_token != $hud_subscription_last
		output_number("pilot-guide", 0, 0)
	$hud_subscription_last = $seat_token
