xc_files.plain_code:
; Static target-selection artwork. NAV below the center LCD still engages flight.
; Two complete white tiles, tinted on copy for normal/selected/disabled states.
var $target_buttons_cache = virtualscreen(137, 24)
var $target_buttons_icon = virtualscreen(12, 14)
var $target_buttons_ready = 0

function @target_button_tile($tb_origin : number, $tb_width : number, $tb_height : number)
	$target_buttons_cache.draw_rect($tb_origin, 0, $tb_origin + $tb_width, $tb_height, white)
	$target_buttons_cache.text_size(0.8)
	$target_buttons_cache.text_align(top_left)
	var $tb_text_width = 6 * $target_buttons_cache.char_w
	var $tb_left = $tb_origin + ($tb_width - (12 + 4 + $tb_text_width)) / 2
	screen_copy($target_buttons_icon, $target_buttons_cache, 0, 0, $tb_left, ($tb_height - 14) / 2, 12, 14)
	$target_buttons_cache.write($tb_left + 16, ($tb_height - $target_buttons_cache.char_h) / 2, white, "SELECT")

function @target_buttons_prepare()
	if $target_buttons_ready
		return
	$target_buttons_icon.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	; Same notched NAV arrow as the main navigation control, fitted to this tile.
	$target_buttons_icon.draw_triangle(6, 1, 0.75, 12.5, 6, 9.5, white)
	$target_buttons_icon.draw_triangle(6, 1, 6, 9.5, 11.25, 12.5, white)
	$target_buttons_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	@target_button_tile(0, 59, 18)
	@target_button_tile(60, 76, 23)
	$target_buttons_ready = 1

function @target_button_draw($tb_screen : screen, $tb_x : number, $tb_y : number, $tb_wide : number, $tb_ink : number)
	@target_buttons_prepare()
	if $tb_wide
		screen_copy($target_buttons_cache, $tb_screen, 60, 0, $tb_x, $tb_y, 77, 24, $tb_ink)
	else
		screen_copy($target_buttons_cache, $tb_screen, 0, 0, $tb_x, $tb_y, 60, 19, $tb_ink)

xc_files.name: secure-radio.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Shared-key authenticated radio, version 2. No remote commands exist here.
; One bounded crypto engine; separate application queues and physical radio ownership.
storage var $sec_tx_counter : number
var $sec_tx_counter__m : number
storage var $sec_request_counter : number
var $sec_request_counter__m : number
storage var $sec_boot_counter : number
var $sec_boot_counter__m : number
; Last actual transmission, not enqueue/encryption-start time.
var $sec_last_sent_plain = ""
var $sec_last_sent_at = -1000
var $sec_expected_reply_from = ""
var $sec_role = ""
var $sec_identity = ""
var $sec_code = "!"
var $sec_ready = 0
var $sec_setup = 0
var $sec_prefix = ""
var $sec_notice = "SECURE RADIO STARTING"
var $sec_tx_plain = ""
var $sec_tx_kind = ""
var $sec_tx_to = ""
var $sec_tx_frequency = ""
var $sec_tx_pending = 0
var $sec_tx_off = 0
var $sec_drop_tx = 0
var $sec_header = ""
var $sec_task = ""
var $sec_public_plain = ""
var $sec_public_wire = ""
var $sec_public_next = 0
var $sec_rx_wire = ""
var $sec_rx_id = ""
var $sec_rx_peer = ""
var $sec_rx_sequence = 0
var $sec_rx_kind = ""
var $sec_rx_join = ""
var $sec_rx_reply = ""
var $sec_failed = ""
var $sec_failed_until = 0
array $sec_queue_wire : text
array $sec_queue_id : text
array $sec_queue_sequence : number
array $sec_peers : text
array $sec_high : number

function @sec_stop()
	if $sec_task == "tx"
		$cr_busy = 0
		$cr_done = 0
		$sec_task = ""
	$sec_tx_pending = 0
	$sec_tx_off = 0
	if $sec_role == "base"
		output_text("badger-link",1,"")
	else
		output_text("comms",1,"")

function @sec_config($sr_code : text, $sr_identity : text, $sr_role : text)
	if ($sec_code == $sr_code) and ($sec_identity == $sr_identity) and ($sec_role == $sr_role)
		return
	@sec_stop()
	$sec_last_sent_plain = ""
	$sec_last_sent_at = -1000
	$sec_code = $sr_code
	$sec_identity = $sr_identity
	$sec_role = $sr_role
	$sec_drop_tx = 0
	$sec_ready = 0
	$sec_setup = 0
	$sec_public_wire = ""
	$sec_public_plain = ""
	$sec_rx_join = ""
	$sec_rx_reply = ""
	$sec_failed = ""
	$sec_failed_until = 0
	$sec_queue_wire.clear()
	$sec_queue_id.clear()
	$sec_queue_sequence.clear()
	$cr_busy = 0
	$cr_done = 0
	$ch_busy = 0
	$sec_task = ""
	$sec_notice = "SET FLEET AUTH CODE"
	if ($sr_code == "") or !@fleet_text_valid($sr_code,0) or ($sr_identity == "")
		return
	var $sr_hex = @cr_to_hex("BADGER-KEY-v2:" & $sr_code)
	if $sr_hex == ""
		$sec_notice = "KEY NEEDS PRINTABLE TEXT"
		return
	@cr_boot()
	var $sr_started = @ch_begin($sr_hex)
	$sec_setup = 1
	$sec_notice = "PREPARING SECURE RADIO"

function @sec_aad($sr_header : text) : text
	return @cr_to_hex("BGR2" & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"kind")) & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"from")) & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"to")) & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"nonce")) & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"name")) & @sf_aad_field(@fleet_get($sr_header,"public")))

function @sec_peer_high($sr_id : text) : number
	foreach $sec_peers ($sr_i,$sr_peer)
		if $sr_peer == $sr_id
			return $sec_high.$sr_i
	return -1

function @sec_capture($sr_wire : text)
	if !$sec_ready or (size($sr_wire) > 8192) or ($sr_wire == "") or (($sr_wire == $sec_failed) and (time < $sec_failed_until))
		return
	if (@fleet_get($sr_wire,"schema") != "badger.secure") or (@fleet_num($sr_wire,"version") != 2)
		return
	var $sr_kind = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"kind")
	var $sr_to = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"to")
	if $sec_role == "base"
		if ($sr_kind != "join") or ($sr_to != "FLEET")
			return
	else
		if ($sr_kind != "reply") or ($sr_to != $sec_identity)
			return
	var $sr_id = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"from")
	; During docking, old unrelated bases may still answer broadcast joins.
	; Drop their envelopes before spending CPU on decryption. This is only a
	; routing filter; the selected sender still MUST pass its authenticated tag.
	if ($sec_role != "base") and ($sec_expected_reply_from != "") and ($sr_id != $sec_expected_reply_from)
		return
	var $sr_nonce = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"nonce")
	var $sr_tag = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"tag")
	var $sr_data = @fleet_get($sr_wire,"data")
	if (size($sr_id) < 1) or (size($sr_id) > 64) or contains($sr_id,"|") or (size($sr_nonce) != 24) or (size($sr_tag) != 32) or (size($sr_data) > 6144)
		return
	if !@cr_hex_valid($sr_nonce) or !@cr_hex_valid($sr_tag)
		return
	if @sec_aad($sr_wire) == ""
		return
	var $sr_sequence = @cr_le_word(substring($sr_nonce,16,8))
	var $sr_peer_key = $sr_id & "|" & substring($sr_nonce,0,16)
	if ($sr_sequence <= @sec_peer_high($sr_peer_key)) or (($sec_rx_peer == $sr_peer_key) and ($sec_rx_sequence >= $sr_sequence) and ($sec_task == "rx"))
		return
	foreach $sec_queue_id ($sr_i,$sr_existing)
		if $sr_existing == $sr_peer_key
			if $sr_sequence > $sec_queue_sequence.$sr_i
				$sec_queue_wire.$sr_i = $sr_wire
				$sec_queue_sequence.$sr_i = $sr_sequence
			return
	if $sec_queue_id.size >= 64
		return
	$sec_queue_id.append($sr_peer_key)
	$sec_queue_wire.append($sr_wire)
	$sec_queue_sequence.append($sr_sequence)

function @sec_take($sr_kind : text) : text
	var $sr_plain = ""
	if $sr_kind == "join"
		$sr_plain = $sec_rx_join
		$sec_rx_join = ""
	else
		$sr_plain = $sec_rx_reply
		$sec_rx_reply = ""
	return $sr_plain

function @sec_submit($sr_plain : text, $sr_kind : text, $sr_to : text, $sr_frequency : text) : number
	if !$sec_ready or $sec_tx_pending or (time < $sec_tx_off) or (size($sr_plain) > 3072) or !@fleet_text_valid($sr_frequency,0)
		return 0
	$sec_tx_plain = $sr_plain
	$sec_tx_kind = $sr_kind
	$sec_tx_to = $sr_to
	$sec_tx_frequency = $sr_frequency
	$sec_tx_pending = 1
	$sec_drop_tx = 0
	return 1

var $sec_tx_ram = -1
var $sec_request_ram = -1
function @sec_take_tx() : number
	if $sec_tx_ram < 0
		$sec_tx_ram = $sec_tx_counter__m
	if $sec_tx_ram >= $sec_tx_counter__m
		if $sec_tx_counter__m >= 4294967295
			return 0
		$sec_tx_counter = min($sec_tx_counter__m+64,4294967295)
		$sec_tx_counter__m = $sec_tx_counter
	$sec_tx_ram += 1
	return $sec_tx_ram

function @sec_take_request() : number
	if $sec_request_ram < 0
		$sec_request_ram = $sec_request_counter__m
	if $sec_request_ram >= $sec_request_counter__m
		$sec_request_counter += 64
		$sec_request_counter__m = $sec_request_counter
	$sec_request_ram += 1
	return $sec_request_ram

function @sec_start_tx($sr_plain : text, $sr_kind : text, $sr_to : text, $sr_task : text) : number
	if ($sec_tx_counter__m >= 4294967295) and (($sec_tx_ram < 0) or ($sec_tx_ram >= 4294967295))
		$sec_notice = "RADIO NONCE LIMIT / SERVICE HDD"
		return 0
	@sf_split($sr_plain,$sr_kind)
	var $sr_hex = @cr_to_hex($sf_private)
	if ($sr_hex == "") and ($sr_plain != "")
		$sec_notice = "TELEMETRY NEEDS PRINTABLE TEXT"
		return 0
	var $sr_sequence = @sec_take_tx()
	if $sr_sequence == 0
		$sec_notice = "RADIO NONCE LIMIT / SERVICE HDD"
		return 0
	$sec_header = ""
	$sec_header.schema = "badger.secure"
	$sec_header.version = 2
	$sec_header.kind = $sr_kind
	$sec_header.from = $sec_identity
	$sec_header.to = $sr_to
	$sec_header.nonce = $sec_prefix & @cr_word_hex($sr_sequence)
	$sec_header.public = $sf_public
	$sec_header.name = @fleet_get($sf_public,"name")
	var $sr_aad = @sec_aad($sec_header)
	if $sr_aad == ""
		$sec_notice = "TELEMETRY NEEDS PRINTABLE TEXT"
		return 0
	if !@cr_job($sr_hex,@fleet_get($sec_header,"nonce"),$sr_aad,1,"",$sr_task)
		return 0
	$sec_task = $sr_task
	return 1

function @sec_finish()
	if $sec_task == "rx"
		if $cr_good
			var $sr_plain = @sf_merge(@fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"public"),@cr_from_hex($cr_output))
			if $sr_plain != ""
				var $sr_found = -1
				foreach $sec_peers ($sr_i,$sr_peer)
					if $sr_peer == $sec_rx_peer
						$sr_found = $sr_i
				if $sr_found < 0 and ($sec_peers.size < 128)
					$sr_found = $sec_peers.size
					$sec_peers.append($sec_rx_peer)
					$sec_high.append(-1)
				if $sr_found >= 0 and ($sec_rx_sequence > $sec_high.$sr_found)
					$sec_high.$sr_found = $sec_rx_sequence
					if $sec_rx_kind == "join"
						; Bind the authenticated envelope to the enclosed craft identity.
						if @fleet_get($sr_plain,"id") == $sec_rx_id
							$sec_rx_join = $sr_plain
					else
						$sec_rx_reply = $sr_plain
				elseif $sr_found < 0
					$sec_notice = "REPLAY CACHE FULL / REBOOT"
		else
			$sec_failed = $sec_rx_wire
			$sec_failed_until = time + 10
		$sec_rx_wire = ""
	elseif $cr_good and !$sec_drop_tx
		if contains($sec_notice,"NEEDS")
			$sec_notice = "SECURE RADIO READY"
		var $sr_wire = $sec_header
		$sr_wire.data = $cr_cipher
		$sr_wire.tag = $cr_tag
		if $sec_task == "public"
			$sec_public_wire = $sr_wire
			$sec_public_next = time + 10
		else
			var $sr_alias = "comms"
			var $sr_hold = 0.3
			if $sec_role == "base"
				$sr_alias = "badger-link"
				$sr_hold = 1.8
			; Extend docking exchanges, not every registration on the shared inbox.
			; Thirty permanently transmitting joins would mask each other.
			if @fleet_get($sec_tx_plain,"pad") != ""
				if $sec_role == "base"
					$sr_hold = 3
			output_text($sr_alias,0,$sr_wire)
			output_text($sr_alias,1,$sec_tx_frequency)
			$sec_last_sent_plain = $sec_tx_plain
			$sec_last_sent_at = time
			$sec_tx_off = time + $sr_hold
			$sec_tx_pending = 0
	elseif $sec_task == "tx"
		$sec_tx_pending = 0
	$sec_task = ""
	$cr_done = 0

function @sec_slice()
	if $sec_setup
		@ch_step()
		if $ch_busy
			return
		if $sec_setup == 1
			var $sr_key_loaded = @cr_key_hex($ch_result)
			$sec_boot_counter += 1
			$sec_boot_counter__m = $sec_boot_counter
			; A fresh boot prefix also protects ordinary HDD replacements, where
			; the new drive's stored message counter may begin again at zero.
			var $sr_boot_context = "BADGER-ID-v2:" & $sec_identity & ":" & text("{0}",$sec_boot_counter__m) & ":" & text("{0}",random(1,999999999)) & ":" & text("{0}",random(1,999999999))
			var $sr_hash_started = @ch_begin(@cr_to_hex($sr_boot_context))
			$sec_setup = 2
		else
			$sec_prefix = substring($ch_result,0,16)
			$sec_setup = 0
			$sec_ready = 1
			$sec_notice = "SECURE RADIO READY"
		return
	if !$sec_ready
		return
	if $cr_busy
		@cr_step()
		if $cr_done
			@sec_finish()
		return
	if $sec_tx_pending
		if !@sec_start_tx($sec_tx_plain,$sec_tx_kind,$sec_tx_to,"tx")
			$sec_tx_pending = 0
		return
	if ($sec_queue_id.size > 0) and ($sec_rx_join == "") and ($sec_rx_reply == "")
		$sec_rx_wire = $sec_queue_wire.0
		$sec_rx_peer = $sec_queue_id.0
		$sec_rx_id = @fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"from")
		$sec_rx_sequence = $sec_queue_sequence.0
		$sec_rx_kind = @fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"kind")
		$sec_queue_wire.erase(0)
		$sec_queue_id.erase(0)
		$sec_queue_sequence.erase(0)
		if ($sec_role != "base") and ($sec_expected_reply_from != "") and ($sec_rx_id != $sec_expected_reply_from)
			$sec_rx_wire = ""
			return
		if @cr_job(@fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"data"),@fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"nonce"),@sec_aad($sec_rx_wire),0,@fleet_get($sec_rx_wire,"tag"),"rx")
			$sec_task = "rx"
		else
			$sec_failed = $sec_rx_wire
			$sec_failed_until = time + 10
		return
	if ($sec_role != "base") and ($sec_public_plain != "") and (time >= $sec_public_next)
		var $sr_started = @sec_start_tx($sec_public_plain,"telemetry","FLEET","public")
		if !$sr_started
			$sec_public_next = time + 5

function @sec_tick()
	if $sec_tx_off > 0 and time >= $sec_tx_off
		if $sec_role == "base"
			output_text("badger-link",1,"")
		else
			output_text("comms",1,"")
		$sec_tx_off = 0
	; Timeout cleanup above is always serviced. Skip slice budgeting only when
	; sec_slice would have no work; pending setup/crypto/traffic keeps its cadence.
	if !$sec_setup
		if !$sec_ready
			return
		if !$cr_busy and !$sec_tx_pending
			var $sr_rx_work = ($sec_queue_id.size > 0) and ($sec_rx_join == "") and ($sec_rx_reply == "")
			var $sr_public_work = ($sec_role != "base") and ($sec_public_plain != "") and (time >= $sec_public_next)
			if !$sr_rx_work and !$sr_public_work
				return
	var $sr_slices = 2
	if $sec_role == "base"
		$sr_slices = 8
	; Leave most of the current cycle to existing control/UI work. Expensive
	; packet setup gets a length-based allowance; busy CPUs defer, never spin.
	var $sr_stop_at = min(system_ipc * 0.5, ipc + system_ipc * 0.25)
	repeat $sr_slices ($sr_i)
		var $sr_need = 20000
		if !$cr_busy and !$sec_setup
			if $sec_tx_pending
				$sr_need = max($sr_need, 8000 + size($sec_tx_plain) * 30)
			elseif $sec_queue_wire.size > 0
				$sr_need = max($sr_need, 8000 + size($sec_queue_wire.0) * 20)
			elseif $sec_public_plain != "" and time >= $sec_public_next
				$sr_need = max($sr_need, 8000 + size($sec_public_plain) * 30)
		if (system_ipc > 0) and (ipc + $sr_need > $sr_stop_at)
			return
		@sec_slice()

; Event body dispatched after all module helpers.

xc_files.name: crypto-aead-sliced.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; One small work slice per call; no completed message is accepted before its tag.
var $cr_busy = 0
var $cr_done = 0
var $cr_good = 0
var $cr_encrypt = 0
var $cr_phase = 0
var $cr_offset = 0
var $cr_nonce_value = ""
var $cr_aad = ""
var $cr_input = ""
var $cr_cipher = ""
var $cr_output = ""
var $cr_tag_expected = ""
var $cr_tag = ""
var $cr_job_label = ""
var $cr_piece = ""
var $cr_piece_offset = 0

function @cr_hex_valid($ca_text : text) : number
	if mod(size($ca_text),2) != 0
		return 0
	var $ca_count = size($ca_text)
	repeat $ca_count ($ca_i)
		if find($cr_hex,substring($ca_text,$ca_i,1)) < 0
			return 0
	return 1

function @cr_job($ca_input : text, $ca_nonce : text, $ca_aad : text, $ca_encrypt : number, $ca_tag : text, $ca_label : text) : number
	if $cr_busy or ($cr_key.size != 8) or (size($ca_input) > 6144) or (size($ca_aad) > 4096) or (size($ca_nonce) != 24) or !@cr_hex_valid($ca_input) or !@cr_hex_valid($ca_aad) or !@cr_hex_valid($ca_nonce)
		return 0
	if !$ca_encrypt and ((size($ca_tag) != 32) or !@cr_hex_valid($ca_tag))
		return 0
	$cr_busy = 1
	$cr_done = 0
	$cr_good = 0
	$cr_encrypt = $ca_encrypt
	$cr_phase = 0
	$cr_offset = 0
	$cr_nonce_value = $ca_nonce
	$cr_aad = $ca_aad
	$cr_input = $ca_input
	$cr_tag_expected = $ca_tag
	$cr_job_label = $ca_label
	$cr_cipher = ""
	$cr_output = ""
	$cr_tag = ""
	return 1

function @cr_pad16($ca_hex : text) : text
	while mod(size($ca_hex),32) != 0
		$ca_hex &= "00"
	return $ca_hex

function @cr_step()
	if !$cr_busy
		return
	if $cr_phase == 0
		@cc_begin(0,$cr_nonce_value)
		$cr_phase = 10
	elseif $cr_phase == 10
		@cc_step()
		if !$cc_busy
			@cr_poly_begin(substring($cc_result,0,64))
			$cr_phase = 1
	elseif $cr_phase == 1
		if $cr_offset < size($cr_aad)
			@cr_poly_block(@cr_pad16(substring($cr_aad,$cr_offset,32)))
			$cr_offset += 32
		else
			$cr_phase = 2
			$cr_offset = 0
	elseif $cr_phase == 2
		if $cr_offset < size($cr_input)
			@cc_begin($cr_offset / 128 + 1,$cr_nonce_value)
			$cr_phase = 20
		else
			$cr_phase = 3
	elseif $cr_phase == 20
		@cc_step()
		if !$cc_busy
			$cr_phase = 21
	elseif $cr_phase == 21
		$cr_piece = substring($cr_input,$cr_offset,128)
		var $ca_xored = @cr_xor_hex($cr_piece,$cc_result)
		if $cr_encrypt
			$cr_cipher &= $ca_xored
			$cr_piece = $ca_xored
		else
			$cr_output &= $ca_xored
		$cr_piece = @cr_pad16($cr_piece)
		$cr_piece_offset = 0
		$cr_phase = 22
	elseif $cr_phase == 22
		@cr_poly_block(substring($cr_piece,$cr_piece_offset,32))
		$cr_piece_offset += 32
		if $cr_piece_offset >= size($cr_piece)
			$cr_offset += 128
			$cr_phase = 2
	else
		@cr_poly_block(@cr_word_hex(size($cr_aad) / 2) & "00000000" & @cr_word_hex(size($cr_input) / 2) & "00000000")
		$cr_tag = @cr_poly_finish()
		$cr_good = $cr_encrypt
		if !$cr_encrypt
			var $ca_mismatch = 0
			repeat 32 ($ca_i)
				$ca_mismatch += substring($cr_tag,$ca_i,1) != substring($cr_tag_expected,$ca_i,1)
			$cr_good = $ca_mismatch == 0
			if !$cr_good
				$cr_output = ""
		$cr_busy = 0
		$cr_done = 1

xc_files.name: ore-scanner.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Ore scanner.

; COLOR ORE SCANNER by Snjo, based on batcholi and Drya'd BMD's blueprints
; When moving this code into another computer, check main.xc for startup procedure, including runnin @oreinit()
; If you're adapting it to a smaller screen, adjust the buttonHeight and buttonwidth values to fit the UI on screen.

; OPTION SECTION, EDIT VALUES TO TASTE ----------------
; If there are ores missing in the config menu, add them in the init section at the bottom of the file

; REST MODE. Set this to 0 if there's no speed sensor and angular velocity senor attached
const $allowRestMode = 1

; STARTING ORE SELECTION, can be changed in the on-screen config menu
const $ore1Default = "Fe"
const $ore2Default = "land"
const $ore3Default = "sea"
var $resetStoredValue = 0 ; override to reset stored values, set to 1 to fix any bugged values

; Artificially boost the visibility of any ores, if you want to see trace amounts
; for examble, set Uranium's oreboost to 0.5, and a very low value will still be very visible

; Limit the brighness of an ore, for example dampen iron output since it's often overwhelming other ores
; 1 is normal, 0.1 is very faint.
; Values above 1 makes the color brighter, but it's better to use oreboost.
const $orenerf1 = 1 ; use values between 0-1
const $orenerf2 = 1 ; use values between 0-1
const $orenerf3 = 1 ; use values between 0-1

; Round cockpit presets: 1500 ft, 1 NM, 3 NM, 5 NM. Scanner IO stays metres.
const $mediumRange = 1852

; SCAN STEPS (AND TROUBLESHOOTING)
; Use this to limit power usage and server impact, but decrease the line density on screen.
; Max allowed is scan steps is 100, lower resolution screens use fewer lines.
; If you see circular stripes in the output near the center, reduce the $maxScanSteps value 
; or check that the scanner is connected directly to a battery. If power is routed through a junction,
; the scanner may run out of power before all scan steps are done per tick, and will output bad data.
; Sample count and pivot speed now come from the persistent scanner settings.
var $scanArc = 360 ; 1-360. change between full circle scan or narrow beam, which is faster to update the section you care about
var $scanDuration = 25 * 20; the amount of time in ticks (25*20 is 20s) to scan before going to sleep if there's no movement of the vehicle

; ATTACHED DEVICES, update if needed, You can replace port numbers with device names. (i.e. set $scanner_io to "ore_scanner")

const $shared_scan_width = 300
const $shared_scan_height = 300
const $scanner_io = "ore_scanner"	 ; COMPUTER PORT 1: ore scanner
const $pivot_io = "ore_pivot"	   ; COMPUTER PORT 2: robotic pivot
const $speed_io = "speed"	   ; COMPUTER PORT 3: speed sensor
const $angle_io = "angle"	   ; COMPUTER PORT 4: angular velocity sensor
const $terrain_io = "terrain_scanner"

var $scan = 0 ; 1 means the scanner is ON, change this to 0 if you always want to startin OFF mode after rebooting


; END OF OPTION SECTION ----------------
; VARIABLES ----------------

var $scanDurationCount = $scanDuration
array $oreNames:text
var $max_distance = $mediumRange ; gets changed by UI buttons


var $resting = 0 ; gets set to 1 when the vehicle isn't moving or rotating, overriden by $allowRestMode
var $angle = 0 ;current pivot angle
; Rest requires measured, valid sampled coverage, not just elapsed ticks.
var $ore_scanner_sweep_active = 0
var $ore_scanner_sweep_previous = 0
var $ore_scanner_sweep_travel = 0
var $ore_scanner_sweep_low = 0
var $ore_scanner_sweep_high = 0
var $ore_scanner_sweep_context = ""
var $ore_scanner_scan_context = ""
var $ore_scanner_context_red = ""
var $ore_scanner_context_green = ""
var $ore_scanner_context_blue = ""
var $ore_scanner_context_range = -1
var $ore_scanner_context_arc = -1
var $ore_scanner_context_steps = -1
var $ore_scanner_context_gain = -1
;var $oldAngle = 0 ; used by rest mode check
;var $extraScanRotation = 0 ;perform an extra full revolution after a change

; STORED VALUES ----------

storage var $ore1:text	;Red channel
var $ore1__m : text
storage var $ore2:text	;Green channel
var $ore2__m : text
storage var $ore3:text	;Blue channel
var $ore3__m : text

function @loadStoredValue($value:text,$default:text):text
	if $value == "" || $resetStoredValue
		print ("stored value is empty, setting in to ",$default)
		return $default
	else
		print ("stored value loaded",$value)
		return $value
		
function @loadStoredValues()
	var $persist_next_222 : text
	$persist_next_222 = @loadStoredValue($ore1__m,$ore1Default)
	if $ore1__m != $persist_next_222
		$ore1 = $persist_next_222
		$ore1__m = $ore1
	var $persist_next_223 : text
	$persist_next_223 = @loadStoredValue($ore2__m,$ore2Default)
	if $ore2__m != $persist_next_223
		$ore2 = $persist_next_223
		$ore2__m = $ore2
	var $persist_next_224 : text
	$persist_next_224 = @loadStoredValue($ore3__m,$ore3Default)
	if $ore3__m != $persist_next_224
		$ore3 = $persist_next_224
		$ore3__m = $ore3

; BUTTONS  ---------------
;const $ButtonHeight = 25 ;change this to fit your screen ;moved to higher up in the user option section

function @ore_scanner_palette()
	var $context_steps = @scanner_options_get(2)
	var $context_gain = @scanner_options_get(4)
	if ($ore_scanner_context_red == $ore1__m) and ($ore_scanner_context_green == $ore2__m) and ($ore_scanner_context_blue == $ore3__m) and ($ore_scanner_context_range == $max_distance) and ($ore_scanner_context_arc == $scanArc) and ($ore_scanner_context_steps == $context_steps) and ($ore_scanner_context_gain == $context_gain)
		return
	if ($ore_scanner_context_red != $ore1__m) or ($ore_scanner_context_green != $ore2__m) or ($ore_scanner_context_blue != $ore3__m)
		@ore_notices_rearm()
	$ore_scanner_context_red = $ore1__m
	$ore_scanner_context_green = $ore2__m
	$ore_scanner_context_blue = $ore3__m
	$ore_scanner_context_range = $max_distance
	$ore_scanner_context_arc = $scanArc
	$ore_scanner_context_steps = $context_steps
	$ore_scanner_context_gain = $context_gain
	; Only reformat on a setting change; reject old RED-curve cached colours.
	$ore_scanner_scan_context = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},RED-SQRT", $ore1__m, $ore2__m, $ore3__m, $max_distance, $scanArc, $context_steps, $context_gain)

function @ore_scanner_sweep_reset()
	$ore_scanner_sweep_active = 0
	$ore_scanner_sweep_travel = 0
	$ore_scanner_sweep_low = 0
	$ore_scanner_sweep_high = 0
	$ore_scanner_sweep_context = ""

function @ore_scanner_sweep_complete() : number
	if !$ore_scanner_sweep_active
		return 0
	if $scanArc >= 360
		; Three degrees beyond the starting ray closes the seam with a small overlap.
		return $ore_scanner_sweep_travel >= 2pi + 3 * pi / 180
	var $sweep_edge = $scanArc * pi / 360
	return ($ore_scanner_sweep_low <= -$sweep_edge) and ($ore_scanner_sweep_high >= $sweep_edge)

function @ore_scanner_sweep_sample()
	; Called after the valid ray has been painted, never for settling/stopped replies.
	var $sweep_context = $ore_scanner_scan_context
	var $sweep_signed = mod($angle + 3 * pi, 2pi) - pi
	if (!$ore_scanner_sweep_active) or ($sweep_context != $ore_scanner_sweep_context)
		@ore_scanner_sweep_reset()
		$ore_scanner_sweep_context = $sweep_context
		$ore_scanner_sweep_previous = $angle
		$ore_scanner_sweep_low = $sweep_signed
		$ore_scanner_sweep_high = $sweep_signed
		$ore_scanner_sweep_active = 1
		return
	var $sweep_delta = mod($angle - $ore_scanner_sweep_previous + 3 * pi, 2pi) - pi
	$ore_scanner_sweep_previous = $angle
	; Full-circle mode commands positive rotation. Reversals cannot add false laps.
	$ore_scanner_sweep_travel = max(0, $ore_scanner_sweep_travel + $sweep_delta)
	$ore_scanner_sweep_low = min($ore_scanner_sweep_low, $sweep_signed)
	$ore_scanner_sweep_high = max($ore_scanner_sweep_high, $sweep_signed)

function @refresh_ore_screen()
	@ore_scanner_sweep_reset()
	;$extraScanRotation = 1
	$scanDurationCount = $scanDuration
	;Transparent screen:

;UI BUTTONS etc --------------------

function @update_ore_rest_mode()
	;if $scanDurationCount <= 0 || $resting

	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or (!$scan)
		$resting = 0
		@refresh_ore_screen()
		return
	var $speed = input_number($speed_io,0)
	var $rot0 = abs(input_number($angle_io,0))
	var $rot1 = abs(input_number($angle_io,1))
	var $rot2 = abs(input_number($angle_io,2))
	var $rotating = $rot0 > 0.02 || $rot1 > 0.02 || $rot2 > 0.02
	var $standingStill = $speed < 0.1 && $rotating == 0
	if !$standingStill
		; Movement requires a fresh stationary sweep before sleeping again.
		$resting = 0
		@refresh_ore_screen()
		return
	if $resting and $allowRestMode
		return
	if $allowRestMode and ($scanDurationCount <= 0.1) and @ore_scanner_sweep_complete()
		$resting = 1
	else
		$resting = 0
	$scanDurationCount = max($scanDurationCount - 1, 0)

;TERRAIN AND ORE SCAN RETURN VALUES ---------------
var $terrain = 0
var $composite = ""
var $terrainScale = 0.0005 ; higher values go bright faster, less sensitive
var $seaScale = 0.0003 ; higher values goes to black quicker as the water is deeper, more sensitive
function @is_terrain_selected() : number
	return $ore1__m == "land" || $ore2__m == "land"  || $ore3__m == "land" || $ore1__m == "sea" || $ore2__m == "sea" || $ore3__m == "sea"
	
function @is_ore_selected() : number
	foreach $oreNames ($i,$o)
		if ($o == $ore1__m || $o == $ore2__m || $o == $ore3__m) && ($o != "off" && $o != "land" && $o != "sea")
			return 1
	return 0
	
function @getChannelStrength($channel:number,$resource:text,$nerf:number):number
	if $resource == "land"
		if $terrain > 0
			return clamp(($terrain*$terrainScale),0,1)
		else
			return 0
	if $resource == "sea"
		if $terrain < 0
			return clamp(1+($terrain*$seaScale*2),0,1)
		else
			return 0
	else
		return $composite.$resource

;TERRAIN AND ORE SCANNING  ---------------

var $rot = 0.05
var $scanner_options_previous_steps = 0
function @updatePivotAngle()
	var $rotSpeed = @scanner_options_get(1) / 100
	; Apply a new speed immediately, including while moving in the negative direction.
	$rot = $rotSpeed * sign($rot)
	if $rot == 0
		$rot = $rotSpeed
	var $chunk = 2pi / 360
	var $scanArcReal = $scanArc / 2
	if $scanArcReal < 360
		if $angle > $chunk*$scanArcReal  && $angle < $chunk * 180
			$rot = -$rotSpeed
			;print("go -",$scanArc,$angle,">",$chunk*$scanArc)
		elseif $angle < $chunk * (360-$scanArcReal) && $angle > $chunk * 180
			$rot = $rotSpeed
			;print("go +", (12-$scanArc),$angle,"<",$chunk * (360-$scanArc))
		else
			;$rot = $rotSpeed
			;print("huh?")
	else
		$rot = $rotSpeed
		;print("default rot")
	@mech_scanner_pivot($rot)

var $offsetY = 0
var $scanZoom = 1
var $ore_scanner_resuming = 1
array $ore_scanner_steps : number
array $ore_scanner_distances : number
var $ore_scanner_geometry_steps = -1
var $ore_scanner_geometry_zoom = -1
var $ore_scanner_geometry_range = -1
var $ore_scanner_flags_context = ""
var $ore_scanner_has_ore = 0
var $ore_scanner_has_terrain = 0
var $ore_scanner_ore_enabled = -1
var $ore_scanner_terrain_enabled = -1

function @ore_scanner_geometry($geometry_steps : number)
	if ($geometry_steps == $ore_scanner_geometry_steps) and ($scanZoom == $ore_scanner_geometry_zoom) and ($max_distance == $ore_scanner_geometry_range)
		return
	$ore_scanner_steps.clear()
	$ore_scanner_distances.clear()
	repeat $geometry_steps ($geometry_i)
		var $geometry_step = ($geometry_i + 1) / $geometry_steps * $scanZoom
		$ore_scanner_steps.append($geometry_step)
		$ore_scanner_distances.append($geometry_step * $max_distance)
	$ore_scanner_geometry_steps = $geometry_steps
	$ore_scanner_geometry_zoom = $scanZoom
	$ore_scanner_geometry_range = $max_distance

function @ore_scanner_red_level($red_linear : number) : number
	; Boost faint RED returns without changing GREEN/BLUE or whitening the map.
	; Zero remains zero; the original RED gain and 255 ceiling still apply.
	return sqrt(clamp($red_linear / 255, 0, 1)) * 255

function @perform_ore_scan()
	@navigation_display_scan_begin()
	@ore_scanner_palette()
	@ore_notices_begin($ore1__m, $max_distance, $scanArc)
	if $ore_scanner_resuming
		; A stopped scanner's zero-distance replies are not new map samples.
		$scanner_options_settle = time + max(0.08, delta_time * 2)
		$ore_notices_settle_until = $scanner_options_settle
		$ore_scanner_resuming = 0
	@ore_map_begin($max_distance, $angle)
	@updatePivotAngle()
	;output_number($pivot_io,0,$rotSpeed)
		
	;fade out to black, only works if above 0.5???
	var $half_width = $shared_scan_width/2
	var $half_height = $shared_scan_height/2
	if $scanArc > 180
		$offsetY = 0
		$scanZoom = 1
	else
		$offsetY = $half_height * 0.7
		$scanZoom = 1.3
		;print($offsetY)
	; var $steps = min(min($half_height, $maxScanSteps),100) ;steps above 100 will return bad values
	var $steps = min(min($half_height+$offsetY, @scanner_options_get(2)),100)
	if $scanner_options_previous_steps > $steps
		var $scanner_options_unused_count = $scanner_options_previous_steps - $steps
		repeat $scanner_options_unused_count ($unused)
			; Clear obsolete distances rather than leaving old far-away requests latched.
			output_number($scanner_io, $steps + $unused, 0)
			output_number($terrain_io, $steps + $unused, 0)
	$scanner_options_previous_steps = $steps
	var $scanner_options_red_gain = @scanner_options_get(4)
	@ore_scanner_geometry($steps)

	if $ore_scanner_flags_context != $ore_scanner_scan_context
		$ore_scanner_has_ore = @is_ore_selected()
		$ore_scanner_has_terrain = @is_terrain_selected()
		$ore_scanner_flags_context = $ore_scanner_scan_context
	var $shared_has_ore = $ore_scanner_has_ore
	; The same sweep samples land heights for NAV independently of ore RGB choices.
	var $shared_has_terrain = $ore_scanner_has_terrain or $ore_scanner_has_ore
	; Changing to terrain-only/ore-only must also stop the now-unused device.
	; Otherwise its old positive distances remain latched and keep it scanning.
	if (!$shared_has_ore) and ($ore_scanner_ore_enabled != 0)
		repeat $steps ($disable_i)
			output_number($scanner_io, $disable_i, 0)
	if (!$shared_has_terrain) and ($ore_scanner_terrain_enabled != 0)
		repeat $steps ($disable_i)
			output_number($terrain_io, $disable_i, 0)
	$ore_scanner_ore_enabled = $shared_has_ore
	$ore_scanner_terrain_enabled = $shared_has_terrain
	var $ore_notices_red_selected = $shared_has_ore and ($ore1__m != "off") and ($ore1__m != "land") and ($ore1__m != "sea")
	var $x = sin($angle)
	var $y = cos($angle)
	; T4v: land/sea channels resolved once per sweep; their strengths and the
	; RED curve, scan dot and notice guard are inlined below (same expressions).
	var $sc_k1 = 0
	if $ore1__m == "land"
		$sc_k1 = 1
	elseif $ore1__m == "sea"
		$sc_k1 = 2
	var $sc_k2 = 0
	if $ore2__m == "land"
		$sc_k2 = 1
	elseif $ore2__m == "sea"
		$sc_k2 = 2
	var $sc_k3 = 0
	if $ore3__m == "land"
		$sc_k3 = 1
	elseif $ore3__m == "sea"
		$sc_k3 = 2
	repeat $steps ($i)
		if $shared_has_ore
			$composite=input_text($scanner_io,$i)
		if $shared_has_terrain
			$terrain=input_number($terrain_io,$i)
			
		;boost ore numbers
						
		var $step = $ore_scanner_steps.$i
		var $distance = $ore_scanner_distances.$i
		if $shared_has_ore
			output_number($scanner_io,$i,$distance)
			;print("feed ore scanner")
		if $shared_has_terrain
			output_number($terrain_io,$i,$distance)
			;print("feed terrain scanner")

		if time >= $scanner_options_settle
			; Settling replies are not rendered; avoid parsing/color math for them.
			var $sc_s1 = 0
			if $sc_k1 == 1
				if $terrain > 0
					$sc_s1 = clamp(($terrain*$terrainScale),0,1)
			elseif $sc_k1 == 2
				if $terrain < 0
					$sc_s1 = clamp(1+($terrain*$seaScale*2),0,1)
			else
				$sc_s1 = @getChannelStrength(1,$ore1__m,$orenerf1)
			var $sc_s2 = 0
			if $sc_k2 == 1
				if $terrain > 0
					$sc_s2 = clamp(($terrain*$terrainScale),0,1)
			elseif $sc_k2 == 2
				if $terrain < 0
					$sc_s2 = clamp(1+($terrain*$seaScale*2),0,1)
			else
				$sc_s2 = @getChannelStrength(2,$ore2__m,$orenerf2)
			var $sc_s3 = 0
			if $sc_k3 == 1
				if $terrain > 0
					$sc_s3 = clamp(($terrain*$terrainScale),0,1)
			elseif $sc_k3 == 2
				if $terrain < 0
					$sc_s3 = clamp(1+($terrain*$seaScale*2),0,1)
			else
				$sc_s3 = @getChannelStrength(3,$ore3__m,$orenerf3)
			var $R = sqrt(clamp(clamp($sc_s1*255*$orenerf1*$scanner_options_red_gain,0,255) / 255, 0, 1)) * 255
			var $G = clamp($sc_s2*255*$orenerf2,0,255)
			var $B = clamp($sc_s3*255*$orenerf3,0,255)
			var $xx=(1-$x*$step)*$half_width
			var $yy=(1-$y*$step)*$half_height + $offsetY
			if $navigation_display_capture
				var $color=color($R,$G,$B,255)
				$navigation_display_ore_cache.draw_circle(150 + ($xx / $shared_scan_width - 0.5) * 246, 123 + ($yy / $shared_scan_height - 0.5) * 246, 1.5, $color, $color)
				$ore_scanner_has_pixels = 1
				$navigation_display_ore_revision += 1
			if $shared_has_terrain
				@ore_map_sample($distance, $terrain)
			if $ore_notices_red_selected
				if $ore_notices_power and (time >= $ore_notices_settle_until)
					@ore_notices_dot($xx, $yy, $shared_scan_width, $shared_scan_height, $composite.$ore1__m)
	if time >= $scanner_options_settle
		@ore_scanner_sweep_sample()
		
function @stopPivot()
	@ore_scanner_sweep_reset()
	@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
	$ore_scanner_resuming = 1
	$ore_map_request = 0
	$ore_map_reply = 0

function @ore_scanner_quiet()
	; Stop hardware demand too, not just the display/pivot.
	@stopPivot()
	$ore_scanner_ore_enabled = -1
	$ore_scanner_terrain_enabled = -1
	var $count = min($scanner_options_previous_steps, 100)
	repeat $count ($i)
		output_number($scanner_io, $i, 0)
		output_number($terrain_io, $i, 0)
	$scanner_options_previous_steps = 0
	
; Continuous terrain-only sweep. Same one-tick pipeline as the ore scanner.
; No per-cell aim/stop, linked queue, ore reads, ore pixels or ore notices.
array $terrain_pending_x : number
array $terrain_pending_y : number
var $terrain_request_count = 0
var $terrain_owner = 0
var $terrain_reply_wait = 0
var $terrain_plan_level = 0
var $terrain_plan_range = 0
var $terrain_plan_x = 0
var $terrain_plan_y = 0
var $terrain_plan_heading = 0
var $terrain_wake_after = 0
var $terrain_settle_until = 0
var $terrain_sweep_direction = 1
var $terrain_sweep_low = 0
var $terrain_sweep_high = 0
var $terrain_sweep_phase = 0
var $terrain_check_cursor = -1
var $terrain_check_missing = 0

function @terrain_scan_release()
	if $terrain_owner
		repeat 64 ($tr_channel)
			output_number($terrain_io, $tr_channel, 0)
		@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
	$terrain_owner = 0
	$terrain_request_count = 0
	$terrain_reply_wait = 0
	$terrain_plan_valid = 0
	$terrain_check_cursor = -1
	$terrain_sleep = 0

function @terrain_scan_off()
	@ts_flush()
	@terrain_scan_release()
	$terrain_enabled = 0

function @terrain_scan_start()
	; Clear old program requests ONCE, not every sweep or every tick.
	@ore_scanner_quiet()
	repeat 100 ($ts_channel)
		output_number($scanner_io, $ts_channel, 0)
		output_number($terrain_io, $ts_channel, 0)
	$terrain_enabled = 1
	$terrain_plan_valid = 0
	$terrain_sleep = 0

function @terrain_sweep_context($tp_range : number, $tp_heading : number)
	$terrain_plan_range = $tp_range
	$terrain_plan_level = @terrain_level($tp_range)
	var $tp_cell = @terrain_cell($terrain_plan_level)
	$terrain_plan_x = round($ore_map_now_e / $tp_cell)
	$terrain_plan_y = round($ore_map_now_n / $tp_cell)
	$terrain_plan_heading = $tp_heading
	$terrain_sweep_low = 0
	$terrain_sweep_high = 0
	$terrain_sweep_phase = 0
	$terrain_check_cursor = 0
	$terrain_check_missing = 0
	$terrain_plan_valid = 1
	$terrain_sleep = 0
	$terrain_settle_until = time + max(0.08, delta_time * 2)
	if !@terrain_covered($terrain_plan_level, $terrain_plan_x, $terrain_plan_y)
		@terrain_cache_put($terrain_plan_level, $terrain_plan_x, $terrain_plan_y, @standby_nav(2) - @standby_nav(3))

function @terrain_coverage_check()
	; Once on entry, then only after a full forward pass. NOT a target queue.
	var $tb_cell = @terrain_cell($terrain_plan_level)
	var $tb_rad = $terrain_plan_heading * pi / 180
	var $tb_sin = sin($tb_rad)
	var $tb_cos = cos($tb_rad)
	repeat 128 ($tb_i)
		var $tb_cursor = $terrain_check_cursor + $tb_i
		var $tb_x = $terrain_plan_x + mod($tb_cursor, 64) - 32
		var $tb_y = $terrain_plan_y + floor($tb_cursor / 64) - 32
		var $tb_e = ($tb_x - $terrain_plan_x) * $tb_cell
		var $tb_n = ($tb_y - $terrain_plan_y) * $tb_cell
		var $tb_dist2 = $tb_e * $tb_e + $tb_n * $tb_n
		if $tb_dist2 <= $terrain_plan_range * $terrain_plan_range
			var $tb_forward = $tb_n * $tb_cos + $tb_e * $tb_sin
			if ($tb_forward >= 0) or ($tb_forward * $tb_forward <= 0.06698729811 * $tb_dist2)
				if !@terrain_covered($terrain_plan_level, $tb_x, $tb_y)
					$terrain_check_missing += 1
	$terrain_check_cursor += 128
	if $terrain_check_cursor >= 4096
		$terrain_check_cursor = -1

function @terrain_scan_tick()
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or (!$terrain_enabled)
		@terrain_scan_release()
		return
	if $terrain_sleep and (time < $terrain_wake_after)
		return
	if device_type($terrain_io) != "TerrainScanner"
		@terrain_scan_release()
		return
	var $tt_range = min(max($terrain_view_range, 100), 29632)
	if (!$sqx_om20_valid__m) or (@standby_nav_text(13) != $sqx_om20_body__m)
		@terrain_scan_release()
		@ore_map_begin(min($tt_range, 1852), $angle)
		$ore_map_request = 0
		$ore_map_reply = 0
	if !@ore_map_position()
		@terrain_scan_release()
		return
	var $tt_heading = @standby_nav(6)
	var $tt_cell = @terrain_cell(@terrain_level($tt_range))
	var $tt_x = round($ore_map_now_e / $tt_cell)
	var $tt_y = round($ore_map_now_n / $tt_cell)
	var $tt_turn = abs(mod($tt_heading - $terrain_plan_heading + 540, 360) - 180)
	var $tt_moved = (abs($tt_x - $terrain_plan_x) > 0) or (abs($tt_y - $terrain_plan_y) > 0)
	if $terrain_sleep
		$terrain_wake_after = time + 0.25
		if ($tt_range == $terrain_plan_range) and (!$tt_moved) and ($tt_turn < 3) and $terrain_plan_valid
			return
	if (!$terrain_plan_valid) or ($tt_range != $terrain_plan_range) or ($tt_turn >= 30) or (abs($tt_x - $terrain_plan_x) > 2) or (abs($tt_y - $terrain_plan_y) > 2) or $terrain_sleep
		@terrain_scan_release()
		@terrain_sweep_context($tt_range, $tt_heading)
	; Consume the recorded preceding request BEFORE issuing this tick's batch.
	if $terrain_reply_wait
		foreach $terrain_pending_x ($tt_channel, $tt_px)
			@terrain_cache_put($terrain_plan_level, $tt_px, $terrain_pending_y.$tt_channel, input_number($terrain_io, $tt_channel))
		$terrain_reply_wait = 0
	if $terrain_check_cursor >= 0
		@terrain_coverage_check()
		if ($terrain_check_cursor < 0) and (!$terrain_check_missing)
			@terrain_scan_release()
			$terrain_plan_valid = 1
			$terrain_sleep = 1
			$terrain_wake_after = time + 0.25
			return
	var $tt_signed = mod($angle + 3 * pi, 2pi) - pi
	var $tt_edge = 105 * pi / 180
	if $tt_signed >= $tt_edge
		$terrain_sweep_direction = -1
	elseif $tt_signed <= -$tt_edge
		$terrain_sweep_direction = 1
	$terrain_sweep_low = min($terrain_sweep_low, $tt_signed)
	$terrain_sweep_high = max($terrain_sweep_high, $tt_signed)
	if ($terrain_check_cursor < 0) and ($terrain_sweep_low <= -$tt_edge) and ($terrain_sweep_high >= $tt_edge)
		$terrain_check_cursor = 0
		$terrain_check_missing = 0
		$terrain_sweep_low = $tt_signed
		$terrain_sweep_high = $tt_signed
		$terrain_sweep_phase = mod($terrain_sweep_phase + 1, 2)
	$terrain_owner = 1
	; Keep the ordinary 5% sweep speed; faster settings can jump whole cells.
	@mech_scanner_pivot($terrain_sweep_direction * min(@scanner_options_get(1) / 100, 0.05))
	var $tt_previous_count = $terrain_request_count
	$terrain_pending_x.clear()
	$terrain_pending_y.clear()
	if (time >= $terrain_settle_until) and (abs($tt_signed) <= $tt_edge + 0.025)
		var $tt_steps = min(64, max(4, ceil(2 * $tt_range / $tt_cell)))
		var $tt_step_distance = $tt_range / $tt_steps
		var $tt_bearing = $tt_heading * pi / 180 - $angle
		var $tt_sin = sin($tt_bearing)
		var $tt_cos = cos($tt_bearing)
		var $tt_last_key = 0
		repeat $tt_steps ($tt_radial)
			var $tt_distance = ($tt_radial + 1 - 0.5 * $terrain_sweep_phase) * $tt_step_distance
			if $tt_radial == $tt_steps - 1
				$tt_distance = $tt_range
			var $tt_sample_x = round(($ore_map_now_e + $tt_sin * $tt_distance) / $tt_cell)
			var $tt_sample_y = round(($ore_map_now_n + $tt_cos * $tt_distance) / $tt_cell)
			var $tt_key = @ore_map_key($tt_sample_x, $tt_sample_y)
			if $tt_key != $tt_last_key
				$tt_last_key = $tt_key
				if !@terrain_covered($terrain_plan_level, $tt_sample_x, $tt_sample_y)
					var $tt_channel = $terrain_pending_x.size
					$terrain_pending_x.append($tt_sample_x)
					$terrain_pending_y.append($tt_sample_y)
					output_number($terrain_io, $tt_channel, $tt_distance)
	$terrain_request_count = $terrain_pending_x.size
	if $tt_previous_count > $terrain_request_count
		var $tt_unused = $tt_previous_count - $terrain_request_count
		repeat $tt_unused ($tt_channel)
			output_number($terrain_io, $terrain_request_count + $tt_channel, 0)
	$terrain_reply_wait = $terrain_request_count > 0

function @initialize_ore_scanner()
	@scanner_options_boot()

	print("Scanning for ores: " & $ore1__m & ", " & $ore2__m & ", " &  $ore3__m)

function @flight_sol_boot()
	if !$sqx_sol_options__m
		if $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m != "4488"
			$sqx_sol_primary_frequency = "4488"
			$sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
		; Migrate the saved numeric legacy frequency without changing its storage type.
		var $persist_next_16 : text
		$persist_next_16 = text("{0}", $sqx_time31_frequency__m)
		if $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m != $persist_next_16
			$sqx_sol_legacy_frequency = $persist_next_16
			$sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
		if $sqx_sol_options__m != 1
			$sqx_sol_options = 1
			$sqx_sol_options__m = $sqx_sol_options

function @flight_sol_frequency_valid($frequency : text) : number
	return (size($frequency) > 0) and (size($frequency) <= 32)

function @flight_sol_wrap($angle : number) : number
	return mod(mod($angle, 2 * pi) + 2 * pi, 2 * pi)

function @flight_sol_number($packet : text, $key : text, $minimum : number, $maximum : number) : number
	if !contains($packet, text(".{}", $key) & "{")
		return 0
	var $value = $packet.$key
	if !isnumeric($value)
		return 0
	var $number = $value:number
	; Range comparisons reject nonfinite values without relying on an invented API.
	return ($number >= $minimum) and ($number <= $maximum)

function @flight_sol_height($offset : number) : number
	var $decl = $flight_sol_decl + $flight_sol_drift * $offset
	return sin($flight_sol_phi) * sin($decl) + cos($flight_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * cos($flight_sol_hour + $flight_sol_rate * $offset) - sin($flight_sol_horizon)

function @flight_sol_derivative($offset : number) : number
	var $decl = $flight_sol_decl + $flight_sol_drift * $offset
	var $hour = $flight_sol_hour + $flight_sol_rate * $offset
	return sin($flight_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * $flight_sol_drift - cos($flight_sol_phi) * sin($decl) * $flight_sol_drift * cos($hour) - cos($flight_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * sin($hour) * $flight_sol_rate

function @flight_sol_record($offset : number)
	if abs(@flight_sol_height($offset)) > 0.0000001
		return
	var $slope = @flight_sol_derivative($offset)
	; Tangencies are not Sunrise/Sunset crossings.
	if abs($slope) < 0.000000000001
		return
	if ($offset <= 0.01) and ($offset > $flight_sol_previous)
		$flight_sol_previous = min($offset, 0)
	if ($offset > 0.01) and ($offset < $flight_sol_next)
		$flight_sol_next = $offset
		$flight_sol_mode = 1
		if $slope > 0
			$flight_sol_mode = 2

function @flight_sol_bracket($left : number, $right : number, $stationary : number) : number
	var $fl = @flight_sol_height($left)
	var $fr = @flight_sol_height($right)
	if $stationary
		$fl = @flight_sol_derivative($left)
		$fr = @flight_sol_derivative($right)
	if $fl * $fr > 0
		return 1000000000
	repeat 28 ($iteration)
		var $middle = ($left + $right) / 2
		var $fm = @flight_sol_height($middle)
		if $stationary
			$fm = @flight_sol_derivative($middle)
		if $fl * $fm <= 0
			$right = $middle
		else
			$left = $middle
			$fl = $fm
	return ($left + $right) / 2

function @flight_sol_segment($left : number, $right : number)
	if @flight_sol_height($left) * @flight_sol_height($right) <= 0
		@flight_sol_record(@flight_sol_bracket($left, $right, 0))

function @flight_sol_solve()
	$flight_sol_solves += 1
	$flight_sol_previous = -1000000000
	$flight_sol_next = 1000000000
	$flight_sol_valid = 0
	$flight_sol_mode = 0
	$flight_sol_status = "NO LOCAL EVENT"
	; Xenon numeric equality has a 0.0000001 tolerance: solar drift is
	; smaller than that but significant over hours. Relational <= is exact.
	if abs($flight_sol_drift) <= 0
		; Constant-declination fast path: no search loop for stable solar models.
		var $denominator = cos($flight_sol_phi) * cos($flight_sol_decl)
		if abs($denominator) < 0.000000000001
			return
		var $crossing = (sin($flight_sol_horizon) - sin($flight_sol_phi) * sin($flight_sol_decl)) / $denominator
		if abs($crossing) >= 1
			return
		var $angle = acos($crossing)
		var $direction = sign($flight_sol_rate)
		var $rise = @flight_sol_wrap($direction * (-$direction * $angle - $flight_sol_hour)) / abs($flight_sol_rate)
		var $set = @flight_sol_wrap($direction * ($direction * $angle - $flight_sol_hour)) / abs($flight_sol_rate)
		if $rise <= 0.01
			@flight_sol_record(0)
			$rise += $flight_sol_cycle
		if $set <= 0.01
			@flight_sol_record(0)
			$set += $flight_sol_cycle
		@flight_sol_record($rise)
		@flight_sol_record($set)
		@flight_sol_record($rise - $flight_sol_cycle)
		@flight_sol_record($set - $flight_sol_cycle)
	else
		; Bound to one measured cycle each way AND physically valid declinations.
		; Split at derivative extrema so short daylight windows are not skipped.
		var $span = min($flight_sol_cycle, (pi / 2 - abs($flight_sol_decl)) / abs($flight_sol_drift))
		var $step = $span / 96
		repeat 192 ($index)
			var $left = -$span + $index * $step
			var $right = $left + $step
			var $dl = @flight_sol_derivative($left)
			var $dr = @flight_sol_derivative($right)
			if $dl * $dr < 0
				var $extreme = @flight_sol_bracket($left, $right, 1)
				@flight_sol_segment($left, $extreme)
				@flight_sol_segment($extreme, $right)
			else
				@flight_sol_segment($left, $right)
	if ($flight_sol_previous < -$flight_sol_cycle - 1) or ($flight_sol_next > $flight_sol_cycle + 1)
		return
	$flight_sol_elapsed = -$flight_sol_previous
	$flight_sol_period = $flight_sol_next - $flight_sol_previous
	if $flight_sol_period <= 0
		return
	$flight_sol_deadline = time + $flight_sol_next
	$flight_sol_phase = clamp($flight_sol_elapsed / $flight_sol_period, 0, 1) * 0.5
	if $flight_sol_mode == 2
		$flight_sol_phase += 0.5
	$flight_sol_valid = 1
	$flight_sol_status = "LOCAL"

function @flight_sol_validate_packet($packet : text) : number
	$flight_sol_reject = "INVALID MODEL FIELDS"
	if ($packet.protocol != "Solar4488V2") or (size($packet.serverid) == 0)
		return 0
	if (!contains($packet, ".celestial{")) or (!contains($packet, ".protocol{")) or (!contains($packet, ".serverid{"))
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "modelvalid", 1, 1)
		$flight_sol_reject = "SERVER MODEL NOT READY"
		if contains($packet,".modelstatus{")
			$flight_sol_reject = "SERVER: " & substring($packet.modelstatus,0,40)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "sampletime", 1, 1000000000000)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "sourcelatitude", -90, 90)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "sourcelongitude", -180, 180)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "longitudehouranglesign", -1, 1)
		return 0
	if abs($packet.longitudehouranglesign:number) != 1
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "solarhourangle", -pi, pi)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "solardeclination", -pi / 2, pi / 2)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "solarhouranglerate", -0.002, 0.002)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "solardeclinationrate", -0.0002, 0.0002)
		return 0
	if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "horizonaltitude", 0, 0)
		return 0
	; This version intentionally supports only the supplied geometric h0=0 model.
	var $body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	if (size($body) == 0) or (lower($body) != lower($packet.celestial))
		return 0
	var $latitude = @standby_nav(8)
	var $longitude = @standby_nav(9)
	if (!(($latitude >= -90) and ($latitude <= 90))) or (!(($longitude >= -180) and ($longitude <= 180)))
		return 0
	var $age = time - $packet.sampletime:number
	; Synchronized Unix clocks: no unmeasured future timestamp allowance.
	if $age < 0
		$flight_sol_reject = text("MODEL {0.000}s IN FUTURE",-$age)
		return 0
	if $age > 10
		$flight_sol_reject = text("STALE MODEL: {0.1}s OLD",$age)
		return 0
	var $rate = $packet.solarhouranglerate:number
	if (abs($rate) < 2 * pi / 5184000) or (abs($rate) > 2 * pi / 3600)
		return 0
	var $cycle = 2 * pi / abs($rate)
	if contains($packet, ".solarcycleseconds{")
		if !@flight_sol_number($packet, "solarcycleseconds", 3600, 5184000)
			return 0
		if abs($packet.solarcycleseconds:number - $cycle) > max(5, $cycle * 0.001)
			return 0
	var $drift = $packet.solardeclinationrate:number
	; Bound search complexity and reject a motion model outside tested support.
	if abs($drift) > abs($rate) * 0.1
		$flight_sol_reject = "DECLINATION RATE UNSUPPORTED"
		return 0
	var $decl = $packet.solardeclination:number + $drift * $age
	if abs($decl) >= pi / 2
		return 0
	var $identity = text("{}|{}", $packet.serverid, $packet.sessionid)
	if $identity != $flight_sol_identity
		$flight_sol_last_stamp = 0
		$flight_sol_identity = $identity
	if $packet.sampletime:number < $flight_sol_last_stamp
		$flight_sol_reject = "MODEL TIMESTAMP WENT BACKWARDS"
		return 0
	$flight_sol_last_stamp = $packet.sampletime:number
	$flight_sol_rate = $rate
	$flight_sol_cycle = $cycle
	$flight_sol_drift = $drift
	$flight_sol_decl = $decl
	$flight_sol_phi = $latitude * pi / 180
	$flight_sol_horizon = $packet.horizonaltitude:number
	$flight_sol_hour = @flight_sol_wrap($packet.solarhourangle:number + $rate * $age + $packet.longitudehouranglesign:number * ($longitude - $packet.sourcelongitude:number) * pi / 180 + pi) - pi
	@flight_sol_solve()
	return 1

function @flight_sol_packet($packet : text) : number
	var $fs_accepted = @flight_sol_validate_packet($packet)
	if $fs_accepted
		; Do not leave a default stale/error label on an accepted LOCAL model.
		$flight_sol_reject = ""
	else
		$flight_sol_last_rejection = $flight_sol_reject
		$flight_sol_last_rejection_at = time
		$flight_sol_last_rejection_age = -1
		if @flight_sol_number($packet,"sampletime",1,1000000000000)
			$flight_sol_last_rejection_age = time - $packet.sampletime:number
		if time >= $flight_sol_rejection_log_after
			print("Solar model rejected: " & $flight_sol_reject)
			$flight_sol_rejection_log_after = time + 10
	return $fs_accepted

function @flight_sol_tune($slot : number)
	$flight_sol_slot = $slot
	var $frequency = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m
	if $slot == 1
		$frequency = $flight_sol_fallback
	$flight_sol_seen = input_text("time-cycle", 0)
	$flight_sol_new_signal = 0
	$flight_sol_wait_until = time + 1
	$flight_sol_switch_at = time + 3
	output_text("time-cycle", 2, $frequency)
	$flight_sol_model = 0
	$flight_sol_valid = 0
	$flight_sol_identity = ""
	$flight_sol_last_stamp = 0
	$flight_sol_status = "WAITING"

function @flight_sol_start()
	$flight_sol_epoch_seen = $flight_sol_power_epoch
	$flight_sol_model = 0
	$flight_sol_valid = 0
	$flight_sol_line = ""
	$flight_sol_slot = -1
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m and $sqx_time31_enabled__m
		$flight_sol_fallback = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m
		$flight_sol_primary_tuned = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m
		@flight_sol_tune(0)

function @flight_sol_receive($enabled : number, $fallback : text) : number
	$flight_sol_model = 0
	$flight_sol_valid = 0
	if !$enabled
		return 0
	; No polling, parsing or frequency writes after both broadcasts are absent.
	if $flight_sol_slot == 2
		return 0
	if ($flight_sol_slot < 0) or ($flight_sol_fallback != $fallback) or ($flight_sol_primary_tuned != $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m)
		$flight_sol_fallback = $fallback
		$flight_sol_primary_tuned = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m
		@flight_sol_tune(0)
		return 0
	if $flight_sol_slot == 1
		if time < $flight_sol_wait_until
			return 0
		if input_number("time-cycle", 5)
			$flight_sol_switch_at = time + 3
		elseif time >= $flight_sol_switch_at
			$flight_sol_slot = 2
			$flight_sol_status = "NO SOLAR SERVER"
		return 0
	if time < $flight_sol_wait_until
		return 0
	if input_number("time-cycle", 5)
		; Reception is not model validity. Allow a short startup window; if the
		; model is unusable, retune legacy instead of rendering false local events.
		var $packet = input_text("time-cycle", 0)
		if $packet != $flight_sol_seen
			$flight_sol_new_signal = 1
		if $flight_sol_new_signal
			$flight_sol_model = @flight_sol_packet($packet)
	if $flight_sol_model
		$flight_sol_switch_at = time + 3
		return 1
	if time >= $flight_sol_switch_at
		if $fallback != $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m
			if input_number("time-cycle", 5) and !$flight_sol_fallback_reported
				print(text("Solar {} rejected: {}. Legacy fallback {} (server timing, not local).", $sqx_sol_primary_frequency__m, $flight_sol_reject, $fallback))
				$flight_sol_fallback_reported = 1
			@flight_sol_tune(1)
		else
			$flight_sol_slot = 2
			$flight_sol_status = "NO SOLAR SERVER"
	return 0

; REAL-TIME CLOCK BY CHIP PATTON. Gregorian calendar and stored UTC offset.
; V3.1: calendar is cached by day; formatted time changes only once per second.
storage var $timezone : number
var $timezone__m : number
storage var $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized : number
var $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_clock31_new_york : number
var $sqx_clock31_new_york__m : number
; 0 = timezone default, 12/24 = explicit display-format override.
storage var $sqx_clock31_format : number
var $sqx_clock31_format__m : number
var $clock_settings_year_begin = 0
var $clock_settings_year_end = 0
var $clock_settings_dst_begin = 0
var $clock_settings_dst_end = 0
array $daysInMonth : number
array $monthname : text
var $shared_clock_second = -1
var $shared_clock_day = -1
var $shared_clock_date = ""
var $shared_clock_time = ""
var $shared_clock_year = 1970
var $shared_clock_month = 0
var $shared_clock_dom = 1
var $shared_cycle_legacy = "!"
var $shared_clock_power = -1

function @isLeapYear($year : number) : number
	return (mod($year, 4) == 0 and mod($year, 100) != 0) or mod($year, 400) == 0

function @clock_settings_boot()
	if $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m
		return
	; New_York is the default; manual offsets remain independent of solar time.
	if $timezone__m != -5
		$timezone = -5
		$timezone__m = $timezone
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york__m != 1
		$sqx_clock31_new_york = 1
		$sqx_clock31_new_york__m = $sqx_clock31_new_york
	if $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m != 1
		$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized = 1
		$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m = $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized

function @clock_settings_timezone_set($offset : number, $new_york : number)
	var $persist_next_21 : number
	$persist_next_21 = clamp(round($offset * 4), -48, 56) / 4
	if $timezone__m != $persist_next_21
		$timezone = $persist_next_21
		$timezone__m = $timezone
	var $persist_next_22 : number
	$persist_next_22 = $new_york != 0
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york__m != $persist_next_22
		$sqx_clock31_new_york = $persist_next_22
		$sqx_clock31_new_york__m = $sqx_clock31_new_york
	if $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m != 1
		$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized = 1
		$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized__m = $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized
	$shared_clock_second = -1
	$shared_clock_day = -1

function @clock_settings_timezone_text($offset : number) : text
	var $minutes = abs(round($offset * 60))
	var $prefix = "UTC+"
	if $offset < 0
		$prefix = "UTC-"
	return text("{}{00}:{00}", $prefix, floor($minutes / 60), mod($minutes, 60))

function @clock_settings_year_day($year : number) : number
	var $prior = $year - 1
	return 365 * ($year - 1970) + floor($prior / 4) - 492 - floor($prior / 100) + 19 + floor($prior / 400) - 4

function @clock_settings_new_york_offset() : number
	if (time < $clock_settings_year_begin) or (time >= $clock_settings_year_end)
		; Rebuild only on a UTC-year change, not every screen update.
		var $year = 1970 + floor(time / 31556952)
		if time < @clock_settings_year_day($year) * 86400
			$year -= 1
		elseif time >= @clock_settings_year_day($year + 1) * 86400
			$year += 1
		var $first = @clock_settings_year_day($year)
		$clock_settings_year_begin = $first * 86400
		$clock_settings_year_end = @clock_settings_year_day($year + 1) * 86400
		var $march = $first + 59 + @isLeapYear($year)
		var $november = $first + 304 + @isLeapYear($year)
		; Current US rules: second March Sunday 07:00 UTC, first November Sunday 06:00 UTC.
		$clock_settings_dst_begin = ($march + 7 + mod(7 - mod($march + 4, 7), 7)) * 86400 + 25200
		$clock_settings_dst_end = ($november + mod(7 - mod($november + 4, 7), 7)) * 86400 + 21600
	return -5 + ((time >= $clock_settings_dst_begin) and (time < $clock_settings_dst_end))

function @clock_settings_offset() : number
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york__m
		return @clock_settings_new_york_offset()
	return $timezone__m

function @clock_settings_format_hours($choice : number) : number
	if ($choice == 12) or ($choice == 24)
		return $choice
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york__m
		return 12
	; An offset alone cannot identify a country's clock-format preference.
	return 24

function @clock_settings_format_set($choice : number)
	if $sqx_clock31_format__m != 0
		$sqx_clock31_format = 0
		$sqx_clock31_format__m = $sqx_clock31_format
	if ($choice == 12) or ($choice == 24)
		if $sqx_clock31_format__m != $choice
			$sqx_clock31_format = $choice
			$sqx_clock31_format__m = $sqx_clock31_format
	$shared_clock_second = -1

function @clock_settings_hms($hours : number, $minutes : number, $seconds : number) : text
	if @clock_settings_format_hours($sqx_clock31_format__m) == 12
		var $hour = mod($hours, 12)
		if $hour == 0
			$hour = 12
		var $suffix = "AM"
		if $hours >= 12
			$suffix = "PM"
		return text("{0}:{00}:{00} {}", $hour, $minutes, $seconds, $suffix)
	return text("{00}:{00}:{00}", $hours, $minutes, $seconds)

function @update_calendar_clock()
	@clock_settings_boot()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		if $shared_clock_power != 0
			output_text("systems-dashboard", 18, "")
			output_text("systems-dashboard", 19, "")
		$shared_clock_power = 0
		return
	if $shared_clock_power != 1
		$shared_clock_second = -1
		$shared_cycle_legacy = "!"
	$shared_clock_power = 1
	var $clockSecond = floor(time)
	if $clockSecond == $shared_clock_second
		return
	$shared_clock_second = $clockSecond
	var $currentTime = time + @clock_settings_offset() * 3600
	var $seconds = floor(mod($currentTime, 60))
	var $totalMinutes = floor($currentTime / 60)
	var $minutes = mod($totalMinutes, 60)
	var $totalHours = floor($totalMinutes / 60)
	var $hours = mod($totalHours, 24)
	var $totalDays = floor($currentTime / 86400)
	if $totalDays != $shared_clock_day
		$shared_clock_day = $totalDays
		$shared_clock_year = 1970
		var $daysRemaining = $totalDays
		repeat 1000 ($i)
			var $yearLength = 365
			if @isLeapYear($shared_clock_year)
				$yearLength = 366
			if $daysRemaining < $yearLength
				break
			$daysRemaining -= $yearLength
			$shared_clock_year += 1
		$daysInMonth.1 = 28
		if @isLeapYear($shared_clock_year)
			$daysInMonth.1 = 29
		$shared_clock_month = 0
		$shared_clock_dom = $daysRemaining + 1
		repeat 12 ($i)
			if $shared_clock_dom <= $daysInMonth.$i
				$shared_clock_month = $i
				break
			$shared_clock_dom -= $daysInMonth.$i
		$shared_clock_date = text("{0} {} '{00}", $shared_clock_dom, $monthname.$shared_clock_month, mod($shared_clock_year, 100))
	$shared_clock_time = @clock_settings_hms($hours, $minutes, $seconds)
	; Keep the two existing small LCDs working until the player removes them.
	output_text("systems-dashboard", 18, text("{} {}", $shared_clock_date, $shared_clock_time))
	var $cycle = "SOLAR OFF"
	if $sqx_time31_enabled__m
		; Do not send the new structured packet to the old small text LCD.
		$cycle = $flight_sol_line
	if $cycle != $shared_cycle_legacy
		output_text("systems-dashboard", 19, $cycle)
		$shared_cycle_legacy = $cycle

var $sqx_time31_night_seconds__m : number

function @sundial_hms($message : text) : number
	var $count = size($message)
	if $count < 8
		return -1
	var $hms = substring($message, $count - 8, 8)
	if (substring($hms, 2, 1) != ":") or (substring($hms, 5, 1) != ":")
		return -1
	var $hours = substring($hms, 0, 2)
	var $minutes = substring($hms, 3, 2)
	var $seconds = substring($hms, 6, 2)
	if (!isnumeric($hours)) or (!isnumeric($minutes)) or (!isnumeric($seconds))
		return -1
	if ($hours:number < 0) or ($minutes:number < 0) or ($minutes:number >= 60) or ($seconds:number < 0) or ($seconds:number >= 60)
		return -1
	return $hours:number * 3600 + $minutes:number * 60 + $seconds:number

function @sundial_boot()
	if !$sqx_time31_options__m
		if $sqx_time31_enabled__m != 1
			$sqx_time31_enabled = 1
			$sqx_time31_enabled__m = $sqx_time31_enabled
		if $sqx_time31_frequency__m != 8844
			$sqx_time31_frequency = 8844
			$sqx_time31_frequency__m = $sqx_time31_frequency
		if $sqx_time31_options__m != 1
			$sqx_time31_options = 1
			$sqx_time31_options__m = $sqx_time31_options
	if ($sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m != 12) and ($sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m != 24)
		if $sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m != 24
			$sqx_time31_cycle_hours = 24
			$sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
	@flight_sol_boot()

function @sundial_cycle_set($hours : number)
	var $selected = 24
	if $hours == 12
		$selected = 12
	if $selected == $sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m
		return
	if $sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m != $selected
		$sqx_time31_cycle_hours = $selected
		$sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
	if $sqx_time31_day_seconds__m != 0
		$sqx_time31_day_seconds = 0
		$sqx_time31_day_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_day_seconds
	if $sqx_time31_night_seconds__m != 0
		$sqx_time31_night_seconds = 0
		$sqx_time31_night_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_night_seconds
	$sundial_key = ""

function @sundial_receiver_set($enabled : number, $frequency : text)
	if !@flight_sol_frequency_valid($frequency)
		return
	if ($sqx_time31_enabled__m != ($enabled != 0)) or ($sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m != $frequency)
		$sundial_valid = 0
		$sundial_mode = 0
		$sundial_message = ""
		$sundial_changed_at = 0
		if $sqx_time31_day_seconds__m != 0
			$sqx_time31_day_seconds = 0
			$sqx_time31_day_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_day_seconds
		if $sqx_time31_night_seconds__m != 0
			$sqx_time31_night_seconds = 0
			$sqx_time31_night_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_night_seconds
		$sundial_key = ""
		if $flight_sol_slot != 2
			$flight_sol_slot = -1
		$flight_sol_line = "WAITING FOR SIGNAL"
	var $persist_next_35 : number
	$persist_next_35 = $enabled != 0
	if $sqx_time31_enabled__m != $persist_next_35
		$sqx_time31_enabled = $persist_next_35
		$sqx_time31_enabled__m = $sqx_time31_enabled
	if $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m != $frequency
		$sqx_sol_legacy_frequency = $frequency
		$sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
	if $sqx_time31_options__m != 1
		$sqx_time31_options = 1
		$sqx_time31_options__m = $sqx_time31_options

function @sundial_start()
	@sundial_boot()
	$sundial_valid = 0
	$sundial_mode = 0
	$sundial_message = ""
	$sundial_changed_at = 0
	$sundial_far = 0
	$sundial_key = ""
	; Explicitly tune the existing antenna at boot and each cockpit-power epoch.
	@flight_sol_start()

function @sundial_prepare()
	@sundial_boot()
	$sundial_frame.blank($shared_background)
	@draw_rounded_box($sundial_frame, 4, 2, 146, 164, 12, color(76, 93, 108))
	$sundial_frame.draw_rect(55, 0, 95, 12, $shared_background, $shared_background)
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_frame, 75, 6, 1.1, orange, "TIME")
	screen_copy($sundial_frame, $sundial_plain, 0, 0, 0, 0, 150, 168)
	$sundial_frame.draw_circle(75, 93, 45, color(106, 91, 59), color(24, 33, 44))
	$sundial_frame.draw_circle(75, 93, 43, color(221, 179, 86))
	$sundial_disk.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	; Cached two-colour face: dusk/dawn cross the fixed pointer at the top.
	repeat 83 ($column)
		var $x = $column - 41
		var $half = sqrt(max(41 * 41 - $x * $x, 0))
		var $sky = color(19, 29, 67)
		if $x >= 0
			$sky = color(39, 114, 168)
		$sundial_disk.draw_line(42 + $x, 42 - $half, 42 + $x, 42 + $half, $sky)
	$sundial_disk.draw_rect(61, 35, 75, 49, color(255, 204, 68), color(255, 204, 68))
	$sundial_disk.draw_line(68, 29, 68, 32, yellow)
	$sundial_disk.draw_line(68, 52, 68, 55, yellow)
	$sundial_disk.draw_line(55, 42, 58, 42, yellow)
	$sundial_disk.draw_line(78, 42, 81, 42, yellow)
	$sundial_disk.draw_circle(16, 42, 8, color(211, 224, 241), color(211, 224, 241))
	$sundial_disk.draw_circle(20, 39, 7, color(19, 29, 67), color(19, 29, 67))
	$sundial_disk.draw_rect(25, 21, 27, 23, white, white)
	$sundial_disk.draw_rect(9, 28, 11, 30, white, white)
	$sundial_disk.draw_rect(27, 62, 29, 64, white, white)
	$sundial_ready = 1

function @sundial_sample()
	$sundial_far = 0
	if @flight_sol_receive($sqx_time31_enabled__m, $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency__m)
		; V2 model may be usable even without a local crossing; never fake one
		; by substituting a distant server's legacy event in that case.
		return
	if !$sqx_time31_enabled__m
		$sundial_valid = 0
		$sundial_far = 0
		return
	if $flight_sol_slot != 1
		$sundial_valid = 0
		$sundial_mode = 0
		return
	if time < $flight_sol_wait_until
		return
	var $message = input_text("time-cycle", 0)
	if $message != $flight_sol_seen
		$flight_sol_new_signal = 1
	if !$flight_sol_new_signal
		$sundial_valid = ($sundial_changed_at > 0) and ((time - $sundial_changed_at) <= 8)
		return
	var $mode = 0
	if (size($message) == 16) and (substring($message, 0, 8) == "SUN SET ")
		$mode = 1
	elseif (size($message) == 17) and (substring($message, 0, 9) == "SUN RISE ")
		$mode = 2
	var $remaining = -1
	if $mode > 0
		$remaining = @sundial_hms($message)
	if (!input_number("time-cycle", 5)) or ($remaining < 0)
		$sundial_valid = 0
		$sundial_mode = 0
		$sundial_changed_at = 0
		return
	if $message != $sundial_message
		; Only learn when continuously receiving across an actual event.
		if ($sundial_mode > 0) and ($mode != $sundial_mode) and $sundial_valid and (abs(time - $sundial_deadline) <= 10) and ((time - $sundial_changed_at) <= 8)
			var $duration = $remaining + max(time - $sundial_deadline, 0)
			if $duration > 1
				if $mode == 1
					var $persist_next_38 : number
					$persist_next_38 = $duration
					if $sqx_time31_day_seconds__m != $persist_next_38
						$sqx_time31_day_seconds = $persist_next_38
						$sqx_time31_day_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_day_seconds
				else
					var $persist_next_39 : number
					$persist_next_39 = $duration
					if $sqx_time31_night_seconds__m != $persist_next_39
						$sqx_time31_night_seconds = $persist_next_39
						$sqx_time31_night_seconds__m = $sqx_time31_night_seconds
		$sundial_message = $message
		$sundial_changed_at = time
		$sundial_deadline = time + $remaining
		$sundial_mode = $mode
	$sundial_valid = (time - $sundial_changed_at) <= 8
	; Received beacon distance is metres. Warn only; never fabricate a local correction.
	$sundial_far = $sundial_valid and (input_number("time-cycle", 1) > 1609344)

function @sundial_update()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		if $sundial_key != "OFF"
			$sundial_lcd.draw_rect(0, 79, 150, 247, black, black)
			$sundial_key = "OFF"
		return
	if !$sundial_ready
		@sundial_prepare()
	if $flight_sol_epoch_seen != $flight_sol_power_epoch
		@sundial_start()
	@sundial_sample()
	var $remaining = max(ceil($sundial_deadline - time), 0)
	var $valid = $sundial_valid
	var $mode = $sundial_mode
	var $label = "WAITING FOR SIGNAL"
	var $countdown = "--:--:--"
	; A present but stuck legacy countdown is not a disabled receiver.
	; Keep the dial frame/status visible without fabricating an event time.
	var $stale = $sqx_time31_enabled__m and ($flight_sol_slot == 1) and input_number("time-cycle", 5) and (!$valid) and ($sundial_changed_at > 0) and (time - $sundial_changed_at > 8)
	if $stale
		$label = "STALE SERVER"
		if !$sundial_stale_reported
			print("Solar legacy countdown stopped changing; dial is SYNC, not a valid event prediction.")
			$sundial_stale_reported = 1
	var $duration = $sqx_time31_day_seconds__m
	var $phase = 0
	if $sundial_mode == 2
		$duration = $sqx_time31_night_seconds__m
		$phase = 0.5
	var $calibrated = $sundial_valid and ($duration > 1) and ($remaining <= $duration + 10)
	var $estimated = 0
	if $sundial_valid and (!$calibrated)
		; Known Earth rotation starts the dial immediately; half-cycle is approximate
		; until actual received transitions refine the local daylight/night length.
		$duration = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m * 1800
		$estimated = 1
	var $cycle_hours = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours__m
	var $source_label = "S"
	var $dial_source = "L"
	if $flight_sol_model
		$valid = $flight_sol_valid
		$mode = $flight_sol_mode
		$remaining = max(ceil($flight_sol_deadline - time), 0)
		$calibrated = $flight_sol_valid
		$estimated = 0
		$phase = $flight_sol_phase
		$cycle_hours = $flight_sol_cycle / 3600
		$source_label = "L"
		$dial_source = "D"
		if !$flight_sol_valid
			$label = $flight_sol_status
			$remaining = 0
	if $valid
		$label = "SUN SET"
		if $mode == 2
			$label = "SUN RISE"
		$countdown = text("{00}:{00}:{00}", floor($remaining / 3600), floor(mod($remaining, 3600) / 60), mod($remaining, 60))
	if (!$flight_sol_model) and ($calibrated or $estimated)
		$phase += clamp(1 - $remaining / $duration, 0, 1) * 0.5
	if !$sqx_time31_enabled__m
		$label = "SOLAR OFF"
	$flight_sol_line = ""
	if $valid and $sqx_time31_enabled__m
		$flight_sol_line = text("{} {} {}", $source_label, $label, $countdown)
	var $frame = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{0},{},{},{},{}", $shared_clock_date, $shared_clock_time, $label, $countdown, $calibrated, $mode, $phase * 360, $cycle_hours, $sqx_time31_enabled__m, $sundial_far, $source_label)
	if $frame == $sundial_key
		return
	if $sundial_key == "OFF"
		$sundial_lcd.draw_rect(0, 79, 150, 247, $shared_background, $shared_background)
	var $visible = $sqx_time31_enabled__m and ($valid or $flight_sol_model or $stale)
	if $visible
		screen_copy($sundial_frame, $sundial_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 79, 150, 168)
	else
		; Preserve civil clock/frame; no solar ring, pointer, SYNC or countdown
		; while disabled or both receive feeds are unavailable.
		screen_copy($sundial_plain, $sundial_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 79, 150, 168)
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 101, 0.9, gray, $shared_clock_date)
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 117, 1.4, white, $shared_clock_time)
	if !$visible
		$sundial_key = $frame
		return
	if !$sqx_time31_enabled__m
		@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 172, 1, gray, "SOLAR OFF")
	elseif $calibrated or $estimated
		screen_copy($sundial_disk, $sundial_lcd, 0, 0, 33, 130, 84, 84, -1, -$phase * 360)
	else
		; No made-up sun position before a full half-cycle has been observed.
		@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 164, 1.1, gray, "SYNC")
		@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 179, 0.65, gray, "SOLAR DIAL")
	if $sundial_far and $sqx_time31_enabled__m
		$sundial_lcd.draw_rect(46, 194, 104, 207, $shared_background, $shared_background)
		@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 201, 0.75, yellow, "FAR SERVER")
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 210, 0.7, white, $dial_source)
	$sundial_lcd.draw_triangle(71, 127, 79, 127, 75, 133, color(255, 204, 68), color(255, 204, 68))
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 223, 0.75, orange, $label)
	@draw_centered_text($sundial_lcd, 75, 235, 1.1, white, $countdown)
	$sundial_key = $frame

; Event body dispatched after all module helpers.

	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or (time >= $display_chime_until)
		return 0
	var $priority = 0
	repeat 7 ($i)
		var $bit = pow(2, $i)
		; A stopped rotor's RPM notice is normal during an avionics-only boot.
		if ($bit != 16) or $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
			$priority = $priority or (@warnings_active($bit) and @warnings_allowed($bit, 1))
	return !$priority

; Keyboard.

; Shared existing settings QWERTY layout and exact cockpit action-frame theme.
; Stateless helpers: separate editor buffers cannot overwrite settings or PIN.
function @access_action_frame($lcd : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $width : number, $height : number, $ink : number, $fill : number)
	$lcd.draw_rect($x + 2, $y + 2, $x + $width + 2, $y + $height + 2, black, black)
	$lcd.draw_rect($x, $y, $x + $width, $y + $height, $ink, $fill)
	$lcd.draw_rect($x + 1, $y + 1, $x + $width - 1, $y + $height - 1, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x + 3, $y + 3, $x + $width - 5, $y + 3, color(45, 53, 63))
	$lcd.draw_line($x + 3, $y + 3, $x + 3, $y + $height - 4, color(45, 53, 63))

function @keyboard_key($row : number, $column : number, $shift : number) : text
	var $keys = "1234567890"
	if $row == 1
		$keys = "qwertyuiop"
	elseif $row == 2
		$keys = "asdfghjkl"
	elseif $row == 3
		$keys = "zxcvbnm`"
	elseif $row == 4
		$keys = "-=[]\;',./"
	if $shift
		if $row == 0
			$keys = "!@#$%^&*()"
		elseif $row == 4
			$keys = "_+{}|:""<>?"
		elseif $row == 3
			$keys = "ZXCVBNM~"
		else
			$keys = upper($keys)
	if ($column >= size($keys)) or ($column < 0)
		return ""
	return substring($keys, $column, 1)
