; Mission requests reuse existing launch/NAV/DOCK controllers. No PID tuning.
function @mission_notice($message:text)
	if $standby_diagnostics and ($message!=$mission_status)
		if $sqx_mission_log.size>=24
			$sqx_mission_log.erase(0)
		$sqx_mission_log.append(text("{0.0}|{}|{}|{}",time,$mission_mode,$mission_phase,substring($message,0,120)))
	@ore_ui_log($message)
	$mission_status=$message
	$du_message=$message
	$du_message_until=time+6

; Mission safety helpers. No PID, integrator, rotor mixer or flight-rate changes.
function @mission_hover()
	$mission_internal=1
	if $sqx_ui46_nav__m
		@switches_action(7)
	$du_manual=1
	$du_hold=0
	$du_save_mask=0
	$du_speed=0
	$du_alt=@standby_nav(2)
	$du_heading=@standby_nav(6)
	$du_climb=$sqx_ui46_climb__m
	$mission_internal=0

; T4w: GO HOME pressed while NAV is flying keeps the present speed, heading
; and altitude while the HOME signal is checked (no stop-then-go). NAV then
; takes over from that speed; a cancel during the check slows down smoothly.
var $mission_carry = 0
function @mission_carry_begin()
	var $mc_speed = $nav_stop_speed
	$nav_stop_active = 0
	$nav_stop_deceleration = 0
	$du_manual=1
	$du_hold=0
	$du_save_mask=0
	$du_speed=$mc_speed
	$du_alt=@standby_nav(2)
	$du_heading=@standby_nav(6)
	$du_climb=$sqx_ui46_climb__m
	$flight_pitchs=$mc_speed
	$mission_carry=1

function @mission_carry_end($mc_stop : number)
	if !$mission_carry
		return
	$mission_carry=0
	if $mc_stop and $du_manual and (!$sqx_ui46_nav__m) and $sqx_sw49_ap__m and ($du_speed>0.01)
		; Same eased 1 m/s/s handback as switching NAV off.
		$nav_stop_speed = max($flight_pitchs, 0)
		$nav_stop_deceleration = 0
		$nav_stop_pitch_value = $nav_stop_observed_pitch
		$nav_stop_active = $nav_stop_speed > 0.01
		$du_speed = 0

function @mission_mine_stop()
	if $sqx_sw49_mine__m
		$sqx_sw49_mine=0
		$sqx_sw49_mine__m = $sqx_sw49_mine
	@latched_io(5,"mining-drill",0,0)

function @mission_mine_allowed() : number
	if ($mission_mode!=2) or ($mission_phase!=6)
		return $mission_mode==0
	var $mass=@mining_limit_mass()
	var $reserve=100*max(0.25,delta_time*3)+1
	return ($mass>0) and ($mass+$reserve<$mission_mine_cap)

function @mission_home_save_value($frequency:text,$label:text,$assume:number) : number
	if $mission_mode or (!@fleet_text_valid($frequency,0)) or ($frequency=="0000") or (size($frequency)>32)
		@mission_notice("CANCEL MISSION / CHECK FREQUENCY")
		return 0
	if !@beacon_valid()
		@mission_notice("BEACON STORAGE ERROR")
		return 0
	$sqx_home_main=$frequency
	$sqx_home_main__m = $sqx_home_main
	$sqx_home_name=$label
	$sqx_home_name__m = $sqx_home_name
	$sqx_home_assume=$assume
	$sqx_home_assume__m = $sqx_home_assume
	if $sqx_home_name__m==""
		$sqx_home_name="HOME"
		$sqx_home_name__m = $sqx_home_name
	$mission_home_ack=0
	@mission_notice("HOME SAVED")
	return 1

function @mission_home_record() : number
	if !@beacon_valid()
		return -1
	foreach $sqx_tg47_main ($i,$frequency)
		if $frequency==$sqx_home_main__m
			return $i
	if ($sqx_tg47_main.size>=128) or (!@fleet_text_valid($sqx_home_main__m,0))
		return -1
	; Add only an explicitly chosen manual HOME; never replace personal records.
	$sqx_tg47_names.append($sqx_home_name__m)
	$sqx_tg47_main.append($sqx_home_main__m)
	$sqx_tg47_land.append("")
	$sqx_tg47_commands.append(0)
	return $sqx_tg47_main.size-1

function @mission_home_warning() : number
	if !$sqx_home_assume__m
		return 1
	if time<$mission_home_ack
		return 1
	$mission_home_ack=time+15
	$mission_home_waiting=1
	@mission_notice("NOT A DOCK? THE QUAD WILL CRASH! PRESS AGAIN")
	return 0

function @mission_pad_blocked($packet:text) : number
	; Physical occupancy and a withdrawn/invalid pad always win.
	if @beacon_has($packet,"dockoccupied") and (@beacon_number($packet,"dockoccupied")!=0)
		return 1
	if @beacon_has($packet,"dockvalid") and (@beacon_number($packet,"dockvalid")!=1)
		return 1
	var $owner=@beacon_get($packet,"dockowner")
	if ($owner!="") and ($owner!=$fleet_id)
		return 1
	if @beacon_has($packet,"dockavailable") and (@beacon_number($packet,"dockavailable")!=1)
		; Available means UNRESERVED, not permission for the reservation owner.
		; Match our live request, not merely an unauthenticated owner string.
		; This only keeps HOME waiting: pad_grant_valid still gates approach.
		var $ours=$pad_active and ($fleet_id!="") and ($owner==$fleet_id) and (@beacon_number($packet,"dockreserved")==1) and ($pad_main==$sqx_home_main__m) and (@beacon_get($packet,"frequency")==$pad_main) and (@beacon_get($packet,"baseid")==$pad_id) and (@beacon_number($packet,"padepoch")==$pad_epoch) and (@beacon_get($packet,"landingfrequency")==$pad_land)
		return !$ours
	return 0

function @mission_escape_geometry($lat:number,$lon:number,$radius:number,$body:text,$distance:number,$bearing:number) : number
	if ($radius<=1000) or ($body=="") or (abs($lat)>=89) or ($distance<0)
		return 0
	; Beacon bearing is relative to heading; caller supplies absolute bearing.
	; Remain at least 150 yd away: never fly TOWARD a blocked pad if already out.
	var $travel=max(137.16-$distance,0)
	var $ms_angle=($bearing+180)*pi/180
	$mission_escape_lat=$lat+cos($ms_angle)*$travel/$radius*180/pi
	$mission_escape_lon=@geology_delta($lon+sin($ms_angle)*$travel/($radius*cos($lat*pi/180))*180/pi)
	$mission_escape_body=$body
	$mission_escape_radius=$radius
	return 1

function @mission_home_hold($reason:text)
	$mission_phase=8
	$mission_clearance_since=-1
	if $mission_home_retries<$mission_home_retry_limit
		$mission_home_retry_after=time+$mission_home_retry_delay
		@mission_notice(text("{} / RETRY {0}/{0} IN {0}S",$reason,$mission_home_retries+1,$mission_home_retry_limit,$mission_home_retry_delay))
	else
		$mission_home_retry_after=-1
		@mission_notice(text("HOME / {0} RETRIES FAILED / HOLDING OFF",$mission_home_retry_limit))


function @mission_retreat($reason:text)
	; Capture the live HOME beacon geometry before cancelling its guidance.
	var $valid=($beacon_last_main==$sqx_home_main__m) and (time>=$beacon_browser_nav_after) and @nav_beacon_refresh()
	var $distance=$nav_beacon_horizontal
	var $bearing=$nav_beacon_heading
	$mission_escape_alt=@standby_nav(2)
	$mission_escape_alt=max($mission_escape_alt,@standby_nav(2)-@standby_nav(3)+$sqx_ui46_floor__m)
	$mission_internal=1
	if $sqx_sw49_dock__m or $docking_active or $docking_acquiring
		@docking_abort(0,"HOME PAD UNAVAILABLE")
		@switches_output("main-dash",11,0)
		; Consume the completed DOCK->NAV handoff once. The ordinary DOCK-off
		; edge must not clear the newly issued retreat NAV on the next tick.
		$docking_was_dock_on=0
	@pad_release()
	$pad_legacy=0
	$mission_internal=0
	@mission_hover()
	$mission_home_retry_after=-1
	$mission_phase=8
	$mission_clearance_since=-1
	if $valid and @mission_escape_geometry(@standby_nav(8),@standby_nav(9),@standby_nav(14),@standby_nav_text(13),$distance,$bearing)
		if $distance<137.16
			$nav_target_kind=2
			$nav_target_name="HOME CLEARANCE HOLD"
			$nav_target_signal=""
			$nav_target_lat=$mission_escape_lat
			$nav_target_lon=$mission_escape_lon
			$nav_target_elevation=max(0,$mission_escape_alt-$sqx_ui46_floor__m)
			$nav_target_radius=$mission_escape_radius
			$nav_target_body=$mission_escape_body
			$nav_target_revision+=1
			$mission_internal=1
			@du_leave_manual()
			@switches_action(7)
			$mission_internal=0
			if $sqx_ui46_nav__m
				$mission_phase=7
	if $valid
		@mission_notice(text("{} / RETREAT 150 YD / HOLD",$reason))
	else
		@mission_notice("HOME POSITION LOST / HOLDING HERE")
	if $mission_phase==8
		@mission_home_hold($mission_status)


function @mission_best_sample($strength:number,$distance:number,$height:number)
	if ($strength<=0) or ($strength>1) or ($height!=$height) or ($height<0) or ($height>=100000)
		return
	; Highest sampled fraction wins. Equal richness uses the nearer location.
	if ($strength<$mission_best_strength) or (($strength==$mission_best_strength) and ($mission_best_strength>0) and ($distance>=$mission_best_distance))
		return
	$mission_best_strength=$strength
	$mission_best_distance=$distance
	$mission_best_bearing=$mission_ore_bearing
	$mission_best_lat=$mission_ore_lat
	$mission_best_lon=$mission_ore_lon
	$mission_best_height=$height

function @mission_ore_click()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	$navigation_display_mode=2
	$navigation_display_key=""
	$display_sleep=0
	$ore_scanner_popup=0
	$waypoint_editor=0
	$waypoint_focus=-1
	$geology_focus=-1
	$ore_ui_active=1
	if $mission_mode==1
		@nav_target_block(17,16,"CANCEL GO HOME FIRST")
		return
	if $mission_mode==2
		@mission_cancel("FIND ORE CANCELLED")
		return
	$ore_ui_log.clear()
	$ore_ui_log_revision+=1
	@terrain_scan_off()
	@ore_scanner_quiet()
	@geology_leave()
	$geology_selected=0
	$geology_running=0
	$scan=0
	if ($ore1__m=="off") or ($ore1__m=="land") or ($ore1__m=="sea") or ($ore1__m=="")
		$ore_ui_pending=1
		$geology_selected=0
		@mission_notice("PICK AN ORE TO BEGIN")
		return
	$ore_ui_pending=0
	if @mission_home_record()<0
		@nav_target_block(17,16,"SET HOME BEFORE FIND ORE")
		return
	if !@mission_home_warning()
		return
	if $batts<=0.50
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"CHARGE ABOVE 50% FIRST")
		return
	if (device_type("ore_scanner")!="OreScanner") or (device_type("terrain_scanner")!="TerrainScanner") or (device_type("ore_pivot")!="SmallPivot")
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"ORE / TERRAIN SCANNER REQUIRED")
		return
	if $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size>=256
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"GEO DATABASE FULL")

	var $ms_docked=input_number("ship-dock",0)
	var $ms_anchored=input_number("left-anchor",0)
	var $ms_parked=$ms_docked or $ms_anchored
	; Preserve a parked start even if a contact sample is momentarily absent.
	; An OFF rotor switch is never interpreted as an airborne hover request.
	if !$sqx_sw49_ap__m
		$ms_parked=$ms_parked or (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) or $sqx_sw49_dock__m or $sqx_sw49_land__m
		if !$ms_parked
			$ms_parked=(@standby_nav(3)<=3) and (abs(@standby_nav(1))<0.25) and (abs(@standby_nav(10))<0.5)
	if $departure_pending or $departure_request
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"FINISH DEPARTURE FIRST")
		return
	if (!$ms_parked) and (!$sqx_sw49_ap__m)
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"ENGAGE AP / HOLD STILL FIRST")
		return
	if $docking_active or $docking_acquiring or ($sqx_sw49_land__m and (!$ms_parked) and !$water_landing_complete)
		@nav_target_block(17,17,"FINISH APPROACH FIRST")
		return
	$mission_ore=$ore1__m
	$mission_ore_name=@mission_resource_name($ore1__m)
	; Full 5 NM cockpit range, regardless of the currently displayed range.
	$mission_ore_range=9260
	$mission_ore_ray=0
	$mission_ore_block=0
	$mission_ore_hit=0
	$mission_abort=0
	$mission_best_strength=0
	$mission_scan_origin=0
	$mission_home_trip=0
	$mission_home_waiting=0
	$mission_scan_parked=$ms_parked
	$mission_mode=2
	$mission_phase=4
	$mission_deadline=time+600
	; Scan-start cannot enable AP, start rotors or request lock release.
	; An already-airborne AP may hold position; a parked scan stays parked.
	if !$mission_scan_parked
		@mission_hover()
	@standby_touch()
	@mission_notice(text("FIND {} / HOLD STILL",$mission_ore_name))

function @mission_ore_store($distance:number,$height:number) : number
	if $mission_ore_hit or ($sqx_geo18_find_kind.size>=256)
		return 0
	var $ms_angle=$mission_ore_bearing*pi/180
	var $coslat=cos($mission_ore_lat*pi/180)
	if (abs($coslat)<0.01) or ($mission_ore_radius<=1000) or ($mission_ore_body=="") or ($height!=$height) or (abs($height)>=100000)
		return 0
	var $lat=$mission_ore_lat+cos($ms_angle)*$distance/$mission_ore_radius*180/pi
	var $lon=@geology_delta($mission_ore_lon+sin($ms_angle)*$distance/($mission_ore_radius*$coslat)*180/pi)
	$sqx_geo18_find_lat.append($lat)
	$sqx_geo18_find_lon.append($lon)
	$sqx_geo18_find_kind.append(8)
	$sqx_geo18_find_length.append(0)
	$sqx_geo18_find_variation.append(0)
	$sqx_geo18_find_body.append($mission_ore_body)
	$sqx_geo18_find_radius.append($mission_ore_radius)
	$sqx_geo18_find_name.append($mission_ore_name)
	$ore_ui_tag=text("ORE SCANNER: {} / BEST SAMPLED {0.0}% / 5 NM / MISSION {0.00}",$mission_ore_name,$mission_best_strength*100,time)
	$sqx_geo18_find_notes.append($ore_ui_tag)
	; Match the stored representation, including its numeric serialization precision.
	$ore_ui_lat=$sqx_geo18_find_lat.($sqx_geo18_find_lat.size-1)
	$ore_ui_lon=$sqx_geo18_find_lon.($sqx_geo18_find_lon.size-1)
	$ore_ui_body=$mission_ore_body
	$ore_ui_name=$mission_ore_name
	$ore_ui_owned=1
	$sqx_geo20_elevation.append($height)
	$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.append(1)
	$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.append(1)
	$geology_revision+=1
	$mission_ore_hit=1
	$nav_target_kind=2
	$nav_target_signal=""
	$nav_target_lat=$lat
	$nav_target_lon=$lon
	$nav_target_elevation=max($height,0)
	$nav_target_body=$mission_ore_body
	$nav_target_radius=$mission_ore_radius
	$nav_target_name=$mission_ore_name
	$nav_target_revision+=1
	$ore_notices_message=text("FOUND {}!",$mission_ore_name)
	$ore_notices_pending=1
	return 1

function @mission_ore_tick()
	if (!$mission_scan_parked) and !$sqx_sw49_ap__m and !input_number("ship-dock",0) and !input_number("left-anchor",0)
		@mission_cancel("SEARCH HOVER DISENGAGED")
		return
	if $batts<=0.50
		@mission_cancel("ORE SEARCH STOPPED / BATTERY RESERVE")
		return
	if time>$mission_deadline
		@mission_cancel("ORE SEARCH TIMED OUT")
		return
	if (abs(@standby_nav(10))>0.5) or (abs(@standby_nav(4)*180)>3) or (abs(@standby_nav(5)*180)>3)
		if $mission_ore_live
			@mission_ore_stop()
		$mission_status=text("FIND {} / HOLD STILL",$mission_ore_name)
		return
	var $lat=@standby_nav(8)
	var $lon=@standby_nav(9)
	var $radius=@standby_nav(14)
	var $body=@standby_nav_text(13)
	if (abs($lat)>89) or (abs($lon)>180) or ($radius<=1000) or ($body=="")
		@mission_cancel("ORE POSITION UNAVAILABLE")
		return
	if !$mission_scan_origin
		$mission_scan_lat=$lat
		$mission_scan_lon=$lon
		$mission_scan_origin=1
	elseif abs(@geology_north($lat,$mission_scan_lat,$radius))+abs(@geology_east($lon,$mission_scan_lon,$lat,$radius))>5
		@mission_cancel("ORE SEARCH MOVED / RESTART WHEN STILL")
		return
	var $bearing=mod(@standby_nav(6)-input_number("ore_pivot",0)*360+720,360)
	var $error=@geology_delta($bearing-$mission_ore_ray*5)
	if (abs($error)>0.3) or (abs(input_number("ore_pivot",1))>0.002)
		if $mission_ore_live
			@mission_ore_stop()
		@mech_scanner_pivot(clamp($error*0.01,-0.05,0.05))
		return
	@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
	if !$mission_ore_live
		$mission_ore_lat=$lat
		$mission_ore_lon=$lon
		$mission_ore_radius=$radius
		$mission_ore_body=$body
		$mission_ore_bearing=$bearing
		repeat 64 ($i)
			var $distance=($i+1)*$mission_ore_range/64
			output_number("ore_scanner",$i,$distance)
			output_number("terrain_scanner",$i,$distance)
		$mission_ore_live=1
		$mission_ore_wait=time+0.2
		return
	if time<$mission_ore_wait
		return
	var $north=@geology_north($lat,$mission_ore_lat,$radius)
	var $east=@geology_east($lon,$mission_ore_lon,$lat,$radius)
	if ($north*$north+$east*$east>4) or ($body!=$mission_ore_body)
		@mission_ore_stop()
		return
	repeat 64 ($i)
		var $packet=input_text("ore_scanner",$i)
		var $strength=$packet.$mission_ore
		if ($strength>0) and ($strength<=1)
			var $height=input_number("terrain_scanner",$i)
			var $distance=($i+1)*$mission_ore_range/64
			@mission_best_sample($strength,$distance,$height)
	@mission_ore_stop()
	$mission_ore_block+=1
	if $mission_ore_block>=1
		$mission_ore_block=0
		$mission_ore_ray+=1
		if $mission_ore_ray>=72
			if $mission_best_strength<=0
				@mission_cancel(text("NO {} IN SCAN RANGE",$mission_ore_name))
				return
			$mission_ore_lat=$mission_best_lat
			$mission_ore_lon=$mission_best_lon
			$mission_ore_bearing=$mission_best_bearing
			@mission_notice(text("FOUND {}!",$mission_ore_name))
			@mission_notice("CREATING WAYPOINT")
			if !@mission_ore_store($mission_best_distance,$mission_best_height)
				@mission_cancel("ORE POINT COULD NOT BE SAVED")
			elseif !@mission_launch()
				@mission_cancel("ORE SAVED / STARTUP BLOCKED")
			return
	$mission_status=text("FIND {} / {0}%",$mission_ore_name,min(100,$mission_ore_ray/72*100))

function @mission_remove_ore_waypoint()
	if !$ore_ui_owned
		return
	; Identify only this session's exact generated record, not an array position
	; that may have shifted after another waypoint was deleted.
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_kind ($i,$kind)
		if ($kind==8) and ($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$i==$ore_ui_lat) and ($sqx_geo18_find_lon.$i==$ore_ui_lon) and ($sqx_geo18_find_body.$i==$ore_ui_body)
			if $i<$sqx_geo18_find_notes.size
				if ($sqx_geo18_find_notes.$i==$ore_ui_tag) and ($sqx_geo18_find_name.$i==$ore_ui_name)
					$mission_internal=1
					var $removed=@geology_delete($i)
					$mission_internal=0
					if $removed
						@mission_notice("REMOVING WAYPOINT / COMPLETE")
					else
						@mission_notice("WAYPOINT RETAINED / STILL LOCKED")
					$ore_ui_owned=0
					return
	$ore_ui_owned=0
	@mission_notice("WAYPOINT RETAINED / RECORD CHANGED")

function @mission_tick()
	; Zero device IO, drawing or storage traffic while idle/OFF.

		return
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m

	if $mission_phase==4
		@mission_ore_tick()
		return
	if ($mission_mode==1) and ($btotchg<0.10) and (($mission_phase==7) or ($mission_phase==8) or (($mission_phase==1) and ($mission_home_retries>0)))
		@mission_home_low_battery()
		return
	if $mission_phase==1
		if time>$mission_deadline
			if $mission_home_retries>0
				@mission_home_hold("HOME SIGNAL UNAVAILABLE")
			else
				@mission_cancel("HOME SIGNAL UNAVAILABLE / NOT DEPARTING")
			return
		if ($beacon_last_main!=$sqx_home_main__m) or (time<$beacon_browser_nav_after) or (!input_number("beacon",5))
			return
		var $packet=input_text("beacon",0)
		if (@beacon_get($packet,"landingfrequency")=="") and !$sqx_home_assume__m
			$home_edit=$sqx_home_main__m
			$home_name_edit=$sqx_home_name__m
			$home_confirm=1
			$home_open_warning=1
			@mission_cancel("HOME DOCK UNVERIFIED / CONFIRM RISK")
			return
		if !@mission_launch()
			@mission_cancel("HOME STARTUP BLOCKED")
		return
	if $mission_phase==2
		if time>$mission_deadline
			@mission_cancel("DEPARTURE TIMED OUT")
			return
		if (!$sqx_sw49_ap__m) or (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m)
			@mission_cancel("MISSION DISENGAGED")
			return
		if input_number("ship-dock",0) or input_number("left-anchor",0) or $takeoff_active
			return
		if $mission_ground_launch and (@standby_nav(2)<$mission_launch_alt+15.24)
			return
		if !@mission_nav_start()
			@mission_cancel("NAV START BLOCKED")
		return
	; A completed LAND may turn MASTER off; that is expected only in phase 5/6.
	if $mission_retreat_pending and ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==3)
		$mission_retreat_pending=0
		@mission_retreat($docking_reason)
		return
	if ($mission_phase!=5) and ($mission_phase!=6) and (!$sqx_sw49_ap__m)
		if ($mission_mode==1) and input_number("ship-dock",0)
			@mission_cancel("HOME DOCKED")
		else
			@mission_cancel("MISSION DISENGAGED")
		return
	if $mission_phase==3
		if $mission_mode==1
			if input_number("ship-dock",0)
				@mission_cancel("HOME DOCKED")
				return
			if ($beacon_last_main==$sqx_home_main__m) and (time>=$beacon_browser_nav_after) and input_number("beacon",5)
				var $packet=input_text("beacon",0)
				if @nav_beacon_refresh() and ($nav_beacon_horizontal<=160)
					if @mission_pad_blocked($packet)
						@mission_retreat("PAD OCCUPIED / WITHDRAWN")
						return
					var $clear=($pad_legacy and @pad_legacy_guidance()) or @pad_grant_valid()
					if $clear
						$mission_clearance_since=-1
					elseif $mission_clearance_since<0
						$mission_clearance_since=time
					elseif time>=$mission_clearance_since+$mission_home_clearance_wait
						@mission_retreat("NO PAD CLEARANCE")
						return
				elseif $nav_arrival_signal_lost
					if $mission_clearance_since<0
						$mission_clearance_since=time
			elseif $mission_clearance_since<0
				$mission_clearance_since=time
			elseif time>=$mission_clearance_since+$mission_home_clearance_wait
				@mission_retreat("HOME SIGNAL LOST")
			return
		; No DOCK takeover for a geology point. LAND only after measured stop.
		; T5d: NAV stops about 20 m short. Hover there, then creep in at low
		; speed (heading held) until within about 1.5 m of the point, then LAND.
		if $nav_arrival_arrived and (abs(@standby_nav(10))<0.5) and (!$mission_ore_centering)
			$mission_ore_centering=1
			$mission_ore_center_until=time+90
			$nav_arrival_arrived=0
			@mission_notice("ORE ARRIVAL / CENTERING")
			return
		if $mission_ore_centering and (!$nav_arrival_arrived) and (time<$mission_ore_center_until)
			$mission_status=text("CENTERING / {0.0} M",$nav_arrival_horizontal)
			return
		if $mission_ore_centering and (abs(@standby_nav(10))<0.5)
			$mission_ore_centering=0
			@mission_hover()
			$mission_internal=1
			@switches_request_land()
			$mission_internal=0
			$mission_phase=5
			$mission_deadline=time+600
			@mission_notice("ORE ARRIVAL / LANDING")
		return
	if $mission_phase==5
		if $water_landing_complete
			@mission_cancel("WATER CONTACT / CANNOT MINE HERE")
			return
		if !$sqx_sw49_land__m or (time>$mission_deadline)
			@mission_cancel("ORE LANDING INTERRUPTED")
			return
		if !input_number("left-anchor",0)
			return
		@craft_weight_sample(1)
		if !$craft_weight_valid
			@mission_mining_return("MINING BLOCKED / MASS SENSOR")
			return
		@mining_limit_boot()
		$mission_mine_start=$craft_weight_mass
		$mission_mine_last=$craft_weight_mass
		$mission_mine_cap=@mining_limit_ceiling()
		$mission_mine_progress=time
		$mission_mine_started=0
		$mission_phase=6
		$mission_internal=1
		if !$sqx_sw49_mine__m
			@switches_mine_toggle()
		$mission_internal=0
		if !$sqx_sw49_mine__m
			@mission_mining_return("MINING START BLOCKED / " & $switches_notice)
			return
		; Anchor is confirmed above. No rotor-RPM or spin-down delay.
		if @mission_mine_allowed() and ($batts>0.50)
			@latched_io(5,"mining-drill",0,1)
		@mission_notice("MINING / STOP AT SET LIMIT")
		return
	if $mission_phase==6
		if !input_number("left-anchor",0)
			@mission_mine_stop()
			@mission_mining_return("ANCHOR LOST / MINING STOPPED")
			return
		var $mass=@mining_limit_mass()
		if $mass<=0
			@mission_mine_stop()
			@mission_mining_return("MASS SENSOR LOST / MINING STOPPED")
			return
		if $mass>$mission_mine_last+1
			$mission_mine_started=1
			$mission_mine_last=$mass
			$mission_mine_progress=time
		; No production is a fault: report it and request the normal return leg.
		if @mission_mine_allowed() and ($batts>0.50)
			if !$sqx_sw49_mine__m
				@mission_cancel("MINING STOPPED / REQUEST OFF")
				return
			if (!$mission_mine_started) and (time>$mission_mine_progress+30)
				@mission_mining_return("MINING FAILED / NO CARGO GAIN")
				return
		if !@mission_mine_allowed() or ($batts<=0.50) or (time>$mission_mine_progress+30)
			@mission_mine_stop()
			if !@mission_mine_allowed()
				@mission_notice("FULL / SAFE WEIGHT LIMIT")
			elseif $batts<=0.50
				@mission_notice("MINING STOPPED / BATTERY RESERVE")
			else
				@mission_notice("MINING FINISHED")
			@mission_remove_ore_waypoint()
			$mission_mode=0
			$mission_phase=0
			; Consent obtained before the ore trip covers its planned return leg.
			$mission_home_ack=time+15
			@mission_home_click()
			return
		$mission_status=text("MINING / {0} OF {0} KG TOTAL",$mass,$mission_mine_cap)
		return
	if $mission_phase==7
		if $nav_arrival_arrived
			@mission_hover()
			@mission_home_hold("HOME PAD UNAVAILABLE")
		elseif !$sqx_ui46_nav__m
			@mission_cancel("RETREAT INTERRUPTED")
		return
	if $mission_phase==8
		if ($mission_home_retry_after>=0) and (time>=$mission_home_retry_after)
			@mission_home_retry()

		$sqx_bc31_name__m = $sqx_bc31_name
	if $sqx_bc31_name_initialized__m != 1

xc_files.name: crypto-primitives.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; RFC 8439 primitives. Numeric intermediates stay below IEEE-754's exact integer limit.
; No device IO, flight state, key transmission, or actuator commands.
const $cr_hex = "0123456789abcdef"
const $cr_ascii = " !""#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~"
array $cr_xor4 : number
array $cr_key : number
array $cr_state : number
array $cr_original : number
array $cr_r : number
array $cr_s : number
array $cr_h : number
array $cr_t : number
var $cr_ok = 0

function @cr_boot()
	if $cr_xor4.size == 256
		return
	repeat 16 ($cr_a)
		repeat 16 ($cr_b)
			var $cr_v = 0
			repeat 4 ($cr_bit)
				var $cr_p = pow(2, $cr_bit)
				$cr_v += mod(floor($cr_a / $cr_p) + floor($cr_b / $cr_p), 2) * $cr_p
			$cr_xor4.append($cr_v)

function @cr_xor($cr_a : number, $cr_b : number) : number
	var $cr_i0 = mod($cr_a,16) * 16 + mod($cr_b,16)
	var $cr_i1 = mod(floor($cr_a / 16),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 16),16)
	var $cr_i2 = mod(floor($cr_a / 256),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 256),16)
	var $cr_i3 = mod(floor($cr_a / 4096),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 4096),16)
	var $cr_i4 = mod(floor($cr_a / 65536),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 65536),16)
	var $cr_i5 = mod(floor($cr_a / 1048576),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 1048576),16)
	var $cr_i6 = mod(floor($cr_a / 16777216),16) * 16 + mod(floor($cr_b / 16777216),16)
	var $cr_i7 = floor($cr_a / 268435456) * 16 + floor($cr_b / 268435456)
	return $cr_xor4.$cr_i0 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i1 * 16 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i2 * 256 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i3 * 4096 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i4 * 65536 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i5 * 1048576 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i6 * 16777216 + $cr_xor4.$cr_i7 * 268435456

function @cr_byte_xor($cr_a : number, $cr_b : number) : number
	var $cr_lo = mod($cr_a,16) * 16 + mod($cr_b,16)
	var $cr_hi = floor($cr_a / 16) * 16 + floor($cr_b / 16)
	return $cr_xor4.$cr_lo + $cr_xor4.$cr_hi * 16

function @cr_hex_byte($cr_n : number) : text
	return substring($cr_hex, floor($cr_n / 16), 1) & substring($cr_hex, mod($cr_n, 16), 1)

function @cr_hex_number($cr_text : text) : number
	; T4v: direct path for the common two-digit (one byte) case; same result.
	if size($cr_text) == 2
		var $cr_d1 = find($cr_hex, substring($cr_text, 0, 1))
		var $cr_d2 = find($cr_hex, substring($cr_text, 1, 1))
		if ($cr_d1 < 0) or ($cr_d2 < 0)
			return -1
		return $cr_d1 * 16 + $cr_d2
	var $cr_v = 0
	var $cr_count = size($cr_text)
	repeat $cr_count ($cr_i)
		var $cr_digit = find($cr_hex, substring($cr_text, $cr_i, 1))
		if $cr_digit < 0
			return -1
		$cr_v = $cr_v * 16 + $cr_digit
	return $cr_v

function @cr_le_word($cr_text : text) : number
	var $cr_v = 0
	var $cr_p = 1
	repeat 4 ($cr_i)
		$cr_v += @cr_hex_number(substring($cr_text, $cr_i * 2, 2)) * $cr_p
		$cr_p *= 256
	return $cr_v

function @cr_word_hex($cr_v : number) : text
	var $cr_result = ""
	repeat 4 ($cr_i)
		$cr_result &= @cr_hex_byte(mod($cr_v, 256))
		$cr_v = floor($cr_v / 256)
	return $cr_result

function @cr_to_hex($cr_text : text) : text
	var $cr_result = ""
	var $cr_count = size($cr_text)
	repeat $cr_count ($cr_i)
		var $cr_value = find($cr_ascii, substring($cr_text, $cr_i, 1))
		if $cr_value < 0
			return ""
		$cr_result &= @cr_hex_byte($cr_value + 32)
	return $cr_result

function @cr_from_hex($cr_text : text) : text
	var $cr_result = ""
	var $cr_count = size($cr_text) / 2
	repeat $cr_count ($cr_i)
		var $cr_value = @cr_hex_number(substring($cr_text, $cr_i * 2, 2))
		if ($cr_value < 32) or ($cr_value > 126)
			return ""
		$cr_result &= substring($cr_ascii, $cr_value - 32, 1)
	return $cr_result

function @cr_key_hex($cr_value : text) : number
	if size($cr_value) != 64
		return 0
	$cr_key.clear()
	repeat 8 ($cr_i)
		$cr_key.append(@cr_le_word(substring($cr_value, $cr_i * 8, 8)))
	return 1

function @cr_qr($cr_ai : number, $cr_bi : number, $cr_ci : number, $cr_di : number)
	var $cr_a = $cr_state.$cr_ai
	var $cr_b = $cr_state.$cr_bi
	var $cr_c = $cr_state.$cr_ci
	var $cr_d = $cr_state.$cr_di
	$cr_a = mod($cr_a + $cr_b, 4294967296)
	$cr_d = @cr_xor($cr_d, $cr_a)
	$cr_d = mod($cr_d, 65536) * 65536 + floor($cr_d / 65536)
	$cr_c = mod($cr_c + $cr_d, 4294967296)
	$cr_b = @cr_xor($cr_b, $cr_c)
	$cr_b = mod($cr_b, 1048576) * 4096 + floor($cr_b / 1048576)
	$cr_a = mod($cr_a + $cr_b, 4294967296)
	$cr_d = @cr_xor($cr_d, $cr_a)
	$cr_d = mod($cr_d, 16777216) * 256 + floor($cr_d / 16777216)
	$cr_c = mod($cr_c + $cr_d, 4294967296)
	$cr_b = @cr_xor($cr_b, $cr_c)
	$cr_b = mod($cr_b, 33554432) * 128 + floor($cr_b / 33554432)
	$cr_state.$cr_ai = $cr_a
	$cr_state.$cr_bi = $cr_b
	$cr_state.$cr_ci = $cr_c
	$cr_state.$cr_di = $cr_d

function @cr_chacha($cr_counter : number, $cr_nonce : text) : text
	$cr_state.clear()
	$cr_state.append(1634760805, 857760878, 2036477234, 1797285236)
	foreach $cr_key ($cr_i, $cr_v)
		$cr_state.append($cr_v)
	$cr_state.append($cr_counter)
	repeat 3 ($cr_i)
		$cr_state.append(@cr_le_word(substring($cr_nonce, $cr_i * 8, 8)))
	$cr_original.from($cr_state)
	repeat 10 ($cr_round)
		@cr_qr(0,4,8,12)
		@cr_qr(1,5,9,13)
		@cr_qr(2,6,10,14)
		@cr_qr(3,7,11,15)
		@cr_qr(0,5,10,15)
		@cr_qr(1,6,11,12)
		@cr_qr(2,7,8,13)
		@cr_qr(3,4,9,14)
	var $cr_result = ""
	repeat 16 ($cr_i)
		$cr_result &= @cr_word_hex(mod($cr_state.$cr_i + $cr_original.$cr_i, 4294967296))
	return $cr_result

function @cr_xor_hex($cr_left : text, $cr_right : text) : text
	var $cr_result = ""
	var $cr_count = size($cr_left) / 2
	repeat $cr_count ($cr_i)
		$cr_result &= @cr_hex_byte(@cr_byte_xor(@cr_hex_number(substring($cr_left, $cr_i * 2, 2)), @cr_hex_number(substring($cr_right, $cr_i * 2, 2))))
	return $cr_result

function @cr_poly_begin($cr_poly_key : text)
	$cr_h.fill(10, 0)
	$cr_r.fill(10, 0)
	$cr_s.clear()
	var $cr_acc = 0
	var $cr_bits = 0
	var $cr_limb = 0
	repeat 16 ($cr_i)
		var $cr_byte = @cr_hex_number(substring($cr_poly_key, $cr_i * 2, 2))
		if mod($cr_i,4) == 3
			$cr_byte = mod($cr_byte,16)
		if ($cr_i == 4) or ($cr_i == 8) or ($cr_i == 12)
			$cr_byte = floor($cr_byte / 4) * 4
		$cr_acc += $cr_byte * pow(2,$cr_bits)
		$cr_bits += 8
		if $cr_bits >= 13
			$cr_r.$cr_limb = mod($cr_acc,8192)
			$cr_acc = floor($cr_acc / 8192)
			$cr_bits -= 13
			$cr_limb += 1
		$cr_s.append(@cr_hex_number(substring($cr_poly_key,32 + $cr_i * 2,2)))
	$cr_r.$cr_limb = $cr_acc

function @cr_poly_block($cr_block : text)
	var $cr_count = size($cr_block) / 2
	var $cr_acc = 0
	var $cr_bits = 0
	var $cr_limb = 0
	repeat $cr_count ($cr_i)
		$cr_acc += @cr_hex_number(substring($cr_block,$cr_i * 2,2)) * pow(2,$cr_bits)
		$cr_bits += 8
		if $cr_bits >= 13
			$cr_h.$cr_limb += mod($cr_acc,8192)
			$cr_acc = floor($cr_acc / 8192)
			$cr_bits -= 13
			$cr_limb += 1
	$cr_h.$cr_limb += $cr_acc + pow(2,$cr_bits)
	; T4v: the 10x10 limb product, unrolled. Every term is an exact integer far
	; below 2^53, so the result is identical to the original loop.
	$cr_t.fill(10,0)
	$cr_t.0 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.6 * 5 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.5 * 5 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.4 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.3 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.2 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.1 * 5
	$cr_t.1 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.6 * 5 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.5 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.4 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.3 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.2 * 5
	$cr_t.2 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.6 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.5 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.4 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.3 * 5
	$cr_t.3 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.6 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.5 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.4 * 5
	$cr_t.4 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.4 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.6 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.5 * 5
	$cr_t.5 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.5 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.4 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.7 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.6 * 5
	$cr_t.6 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.6 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.5 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.4 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.8 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.7 * 5
	$cr_t.7 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.7 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.6 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.5 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.4 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.9 * 5 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.8 * 5
	$cr_t.8 = $cr_h.0 * $cr_r.8 + $cr_h.1 * $cr_r.7 + $cr_h.2 * $cr_r.6 + $cr_h.3 * $cr_r.5 + $cr_h.4 * $cr_r.4 + $cr_h.5 * $cr_r.3 + $cr_h.6 * $cr_r.2 + $cr_h.7 * $cr_r.1 + $cr_h.8 * $cr_r.0 + $cr_h.9 * $cr_r.9 * 5

; Settings.

function @access_cargo_prepare()
	; Exact existing paired-hatch sprites, translated without changing artwork.
	$access_cargo_icons.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$access_cargo_icons.draw_rect(4, 4, 26, 25, white)

	$access_cargo_icons.draw_line(51, 21, 44, 25, white)

function @access_text($lcd : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $font : number, $ink : number, $label : text)
	$lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$lcd.text_size($font)
	$lcd.write($x - size($label) * $lcd.char_w / 2, $y - $lcd.char_h / 2, $ink, $label)

function @access_icon($lcd : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $locked : number, $ink : number)
	$lcd.draw_rect($x - 8, $y, $x + 8, $y + 12, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x - 5, $y, $x - 5, $y - 6, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x - 5, $y - 6, $x + 5, $y - 6, $ink)
	if $locked
		$lcd.draw_line($x + 5, $y - 6, $x + 5, $y, $ink)
	else
		$lcd.draw_line($x + 5, $y - 6, $x + 5, $y - 3, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_circle($x, $y + 5, 1, $ink, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x, $y + 6, $x, $y + 9, $ink)

function @access_door_icon($lcd : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $ink : number)
	$lcd.draw_rect($x - 7, $y - 9, $x + 7, $y + 9, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x - 7, $y - 9, $x + 2, $y - 6, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_line($x + 2, $y - 6, $x + 2, $y + 8, $ink)
	$lcd.draw_circle($x, $y + 1, 1, $ink, $ink)

function @access_key($row : number, $col : number) : text
	if $row < 3
		return text("{0}", $row * 3 + $col + 1)
	if $col == 0
		return "CLR"
	if $col == 1
		return "0"
	return "DEL"

function @access_key_hit($x : number, $y : number) : text
	if ($x < 16) or ($x >= 284) or ($y < 104) or ($y >= 266)
		return ""
	var $col = floor(($x - 16) / 94)
	var $row = floor(($y - 104) / 42)
	if ($col > 2) or (mod($x - 16, 94) >= 80) or (mod($y - 104, 42) >= 34)
		return ""
	return @access_key($row, $col)

; Same shadow, double border and top highlight as cockpit action buttons.
function @access_keypad($lcd : screen, $title : text, $digits : text, $notice : text, $editing : number, $scale : number)
	@access_text($lcd, 150 * $scale, 43 * $scale, 1.6 * $scale, orange, $title)
	var $border = color(10, 180, 205)
	$lcd.draw_rect(16 * $scale, 59 * $scale, 284 * $scale, 88 * $scale, $border)
	var $shown = @access_mask($digits)
	if $editing
		$shown = $digits
	@access_text($lcd, 150 * $scale, 74 * $scale, 2 * $scale, white, $shown)
	@access_text($lcd, 150 * $scale, 96 * $scale, 1.2 * $scale, white, $notice)
	var $fill = color(18, 24, 32)
	repeat 4 ($row)
		repeat 3 ($col)
			var $x = 16 + $col * 94
			var $y = 104 + $row * 42
			@access_action_frame($lcd, $x * $scale, $y * $scale, 80 * $scale, 34 * $scale, $border, $fill)
			@access_text($lcd, ($x + 40) * $scale, ($y + 17) * $scale, 2 * $scale, white, @access_key($row, $col))
	@access_action_frame($lcd, 0, 274 * $scale, 148 * $scale, 25 * $scale, $border, $fill)
	@access_action_frame($lcd, 152 * $scale, 274 * $scale, 147 * $scale, 25 * $scale, color(45, 215, 75), $fill)
	var $save = "ENTER"
	if $editing
		$save = "SAVE"
	@access_text($lcd, 75 * $scale, 286 * $scale, 1.4 * $scale, white, "BACK")
	@access_text($lcd, 225 * $scale, 286 * $scale, 1.4 * $scale, color(45, 215, 75), $save)

function @access_door_open($side : number) : number
	; Include physical feedback: CLOSE remains available while a door is closing.
	if $side == 0
		if $_doors_pulse1__m
			return 1
		return $_doors_pulse1__m or (abs(input_number("left-door", 0)) > 0.003) or (abs(input_number("left-door-top", 0)) > 0.003)
	if $_doors_pulse2__m
		return 1
	return $_doors_pulse2__m or (abs(input_number("right-door", 0)) > 0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top", 0)) > 0.003)

function @access_outside_click($side : number, $x : number, $y : number)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or ($side < 0) or ($side > 1) or @du_doors_moving()
		return
	if !$sqx_lock14_locked__m
		if ($x>=0) and ($x<150) and ($y>=0) and ($y<150)
			if ($x>=53) and ($x<97) and ($y>=102) and ($y<146)
				@access_set(1)
			elseif ($x>=28) and ($x<122) and ($y>=4) and ($y<98)
				var $open = @access_door_open($side)
				; Rotor/coast lock prevents opening, never a closing request.
				if (!$open) and @maintenance_locked()
					return
				if $side == 0
					var $persist_next_226 : number
					$persist_next_226 = !$open
					if $_doors_pulse1__m != $persist_next_226
						$_doors_pulse1 = $persist_next_226
						$_doors_pulse1__m = $_doors_pulse1
				else
					var $persist_next_227 : number
					$persist_next_227 = !$open
					if $_doors_pulse2__m != $persist_next_227
						$_doors_pulse2 = $persist_next_227
						$_doors_pulse2__m = $_doors_pulse2
		return
	if time < $access_until
		return
	if $y >= 137
		if $x < 75
			$access_buffers.$side = ""
			$access_messages.$side = "ENTER PIN"
		else
			@access_enter($side)
		return
	var $key = @access_key_hit($x * 2, $y * 2)
	var $digits = $access_buffers.$side
	if $key == "CLR"
		$digits = ""
	elseif $key == "DEL"
		if size($digits) > 0
			$digits = substring($digits, 0, size($digits) - 1)
	elseif @access_digits($key) and (size($key) == 1) and (size($digits) < 8)
		$digits = text("{}{}", $digits, $key)
	$access_buffers.$side = $digits
	$access_messages.$side = "ENTER PIN"

function @access_outside($lcd:screen,$side:number)
	$lcd.blank($access_bg)
	var $moving=@du_doors_moving()
	if $sqx_lock14_locked__m and (!$moving)
		var $notice=$access_messages.$side
		if time<$access_until
			$notice=text("WAIT {0}s",ceil($access_until-time))
		@access_keypad($lcd,"LOCKED",$access_buffers.$side,$notice,0,0.5)
		return
	var $open=@access_door_open($side)
	var $ink=green
	var $label="OPEN"
	if $open
		$ink=red
		$label="CLOSE"
	if $moving
		$ink=gray
	@access_action_frame($lcd,28,4,94,94,$ink,color(18,24,32))
	@ni_draw($lcd,31,59,23,$ink)
	@access_text($lcd,75,77,1.1,$ink,$label)
	var $lockink=green
	if $moving
		$lockink=gray
	@access_action_frame($lcd,53,102,44,44,$lockink,color(18,24,32))
	@ni_draw($lcd,30,59,103,$lockink)
	@access_text($lcd,75,139,0.6,$lockink,"LOCK")

function @access_render()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		if $access_inside_key != "OFF"
			$access_inside.blank(black)
			$access_inside_key = "OFF"
		if $access_left_key != "OFF"
			$access_left.blank($access_bg)
			$access_left_key = "OFF"
		if $access_right_key != "OFF"
			$access_right.blank($access_bg)
			$access_right_key = "OFF"
		return
	if !$access_cargo_ready
		@access_cargo_prepare()
	var $interlock = @maintenance_locked()
	var $moving=@du_doors_moving()
	var $inside_key = text("{},{},{},{}", $sqx_lock14_locked__m, $_doors_pulse1__m, $_doors_pulse2__m, $maintenance_open)
	if $inside_key != $access_inside_key
		var $bg = color(8, 14, 22)
		$access_inside.blank($bg)
		@draw_rounded_box($access_inside, 4, 4, 146, 118, 12, color(76, 93, 108))
		$access_inside.draw_rect(51, 0, 99, 16, $bg, $bg)
		$access_inside.text_align(top_left)
		$access_inside.text_size(1.1)
		$access_inside.write(75 - size("DOORS") * $access_inside.char_w / 2, 4, orange, "DOORS")
		repeat 4 ($i)
			var $x = 10 + 68 * mod($i, 2)
			var $y = 20 + 50 * floor($i / 2)
			var $label = "LOCK"
			var $ink = color(45, 215, 75)
			var $fill = color(18, 24, 32)
			if $i == 0
				if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
					$label = "UNLOCK"
					$ink = color(120, 28, 36)
			elseif $i == 1
				$label = "< DOOR"
			elseif $i == 2
				$label = "MAINT"
			else
				$label = "DOOR >"
			var $active = (($i == 1) and $_doors_pulse1__m) or (($i == 2) and $maintenance_open) or (($i == 3) and $_doors_pulse2__m)
			if $i and ($ink != gray)
				$ink = color(45, 215, 75)
				if $active
					$ink = color(120, 28, 36)
			var $icon_ink = white
			if $ink == gray
				$icon_ink = gray
				$fill = color(14, 20, 27)
			@access_action_frame($access_inside, $x, $y, 62, 44, $ink, $fill)
			var $icon=31
			if $i==0
				$icon=30
			elseif $i==2
				$icon=32
			@ni_draw($access_inside,$icon,$x+15,$y+1,$icon_ink)
			@access_text($access_inside, $x + 31, $y + 37, 0.6, $ink, $label)
		$access_inside_key = $inside_key
	repeat 2 ($side)
		var $key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_lock14_locked__m, $access_buffers.$side, $access_messages.$side, max(ceil($access_until - time), 0), $interlock, @access_door_open($side))
		$key&=text("|{}",$moving)
		if $side == 0
			if $key != $access_left_key
				@access_outside($access_left, $side)
				$access_left_key = $key
		elseif $key != $access_right_key
			@access_outside($access_right, $side)
			$access_right_key = $key


function @interior_door_blank()
	$interior_door_left.blank(black)
	$interior_door_right.blank(black)
	$interior_door_left_key = -2
	$interior_door_right_key = -2

function @interior_door_draw($lcd:screen,$open:number,$blocked:number)
	var $w=$lcd.width
	var $h=$lcd.height
	var $ink=green
	var $label="CLOSED"
	if $open
		$ink=red
		$label="OPEN"
	if ($blocked and (!$open)) or @du_doors_moving()
		$ink=gray
	$lcd.blank($shared_background)
	@access_action_frame($lcd,4,4,$w-8,$h-8,$ink,color(18,24,32))
	@ni_draw($lcd,31,$w/2-16,$h/2-25,$ink)
	@access_text($lcd,$w/2,$h-18,0.8,$ink,$label)


function @interior_door_render()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		if ($interior_door_left_key != -2) or ($interior_door_right_key != -2)
			@interior_door_blank()
		return
	var $interior_blocked = @maintenance_locked()
	var $interior_left_open = @access_door_open(0)
	var $interior_right_open = @access_door_open(1)
	var $interior_left_state = $interior_left_open + 2 * $interior_blocked + 4*@du_doors_moving()
	var $interior_right_state = $interior_right_open + 2 * $interior_blocked + 4*@du_doors_moving()
	if $interior_left_state != $interior_door_left_key
		@interior_door_draw($interior_door_left, $interior_left_open, $interior_blocked)
		$interior_door_left_key = $interior_left_state
	if $interior_right_state != $interior_door_right_key
		@interior_door_draw($interior_door_right, $interior_right_open, $interior_blocked)
		$interior_door_right_key = $interior_right_state

function @interior_door_click($interior_side : number, $interior_width : number, $interior_height : number, $interior_px : number, $interior_py : number)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or ($interior_side < 0) or ($interior_side > 1) or @du_doors_moving()
		return
	if ($interior_px<4) or ($interior_px>=$interior_width-4) or ($interior_py<4) or ($interior_py>=$interior_height-4)
		return
	@doors_boot()
	var $interior_open = @access_door_open($interior_side)
	; Closing stays available during a closing transit or an opening interlock.
	if (!$interior_open) and @maintenance_locked()
		return
	if $interior_side == 0
		var $persist_next_228 : number
		$persist_next_228 = !$interior_open
		if $_doors_pulse1__m != $persist_next_228
			$_doors_pulse1 = $persist_next_228
			$_doors_pulse1__m = $_doors_pulse1
	else
		var $persist_next_229 : number
		$persist_next_229 = !$interior_open
		if $_doors_pulse2__m != $persist_next_229
			$_doors_pulse2 = $persist_next_229
			$_doors_pulse2__m = $_doors_pulse2
	@interior_door_render()

const $weight_editor_lb = 2.20462262185
var $weight_editor_edit = ""
var $weight_editor_exact_mass = 0
var $weight_editor_exact = 0

function @weight_editor_decimal($value : text) : number
	if (size($value) < 1) or (size($value) > 10)
		return 0
	var $length = size($value)
	var $points = 0
	var $digits = 0
	repeat $length ($i)
		var $c = substring($value, $i, 1)
		if $c == "."
			$points += 1
		elseif @access_digits($c)
			$digits += 1
		else
			return 0
	return ($points <= 1) and ($digits > 0)

function @weight_editor_recall()
	$weight_editor_exact_mass = $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m
	$weight_editor_exact = 1
	$weight_editor_edit = text("{0.0}", $weight_editor_exact_mass * @units_mass_factor($weight_editor_lb))
	$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("UNLADEN WT / lb / SAVE TO APPLY", "UNLADEN WT / kg / SAVE TO APPLY")

function @weight_editor_reset()
	if !@weight_editor_editable()
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "STOP ROTORS BEFORE RESET"
		return
	var $mass = @weight_editor_current()
	if !$mass
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "NO VALID CURRENT WEIGHT"
		return
	$weight_editor_exact_mass = $mass
	$weight_editor_exact = 1
	$weight_editor_edit = text("{0.0}", $mass * @units_mass_factor($weight_editor_lb))
	$autopilot_ui_notice = "CURRENT WT STAGED / PRESS SAVE"

function @weight_editor_key($key : text)
	if $key == ""
		return
	if $key == "CLR"
		$weight_editor_edit = ""
	elseif $key == "DEL"
		if size($weight_editor_edit) > 0
			$weight_editor_edit = substring($weight_editor_edit, 0, size($weight_editor_edit) - 1)
	elseif (size($key) == 1) and (($key == ".") or @access_digits($key)) and (size($weight_editor_edit) < 10)
		var $candidate = text("{}{}", $weight_editor_edit, $key)
		if !@weight_editor_decimal($candidate)
			return
		$weight_editor_edit = $candidate
	else
		return
	$weight_editor_exact = 0
	$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("MANUAL lb / PRESS SAVE", "MANUAL kg / PRESS SAVE")

function @weight_editor_save() : number
	if !@weight_editor_editable()
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "STOP ROTORS BEFORE SAVING"
		return 0
	var $mass = $weight_editor_exact_mass
	if !$weight_editor_exact
		if !@weight_editor_decimal($weight_editor_edit)
			$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("ENTER 1-50000 lb", "ENTER 0.454-22679.618 kg")
			return 0
		var $pounds = $weight_editor_edit:number
		var $valid = $pounds >= 1 and $pounds <= 50000
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m
			$valid = ($pounds >= 1 / $weight_editor_lb) and ($pounds <= 50000 / $weight_editor_lb)
		if !$valid
			$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("ENTER 1-50000 lb", "ENTER 0.454-22679.618 kg")
			return 0
		$mass = $pounds / @units_mass_factor($weight_editor_lb)
	if !@weight_editor_set($mass)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "INVALID WEIGHT"
		return 0
	$autopilot_ui_notice = "UNLADEN WEIGHT SAVED"
	return 1

function @weight_editor_key_label($index : number) : text
	if $index < 9
		return text("{0}", $index + 1)
	if $index == 9
		return "."
	if $index == 10
		return "0"
	return "DEL"

function @weight_editor_key_hit($x : number, $y : number) : text
	repeat 12 ($i)
		var $bx = 16 + mod($i, 3) * 94
		var $by = 156 + floor($i / 3) * 26
		if ($x >= $bx) and ($x < $bx + 80) and ($y >= $by) and ($y < $by + 22)
			return @weight_editor_key_label($i)
	return ""

function @weight_editor_button($lcd : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $width : number, $height : number, $label : text)
	@access_action_frame($lcd, $x, $y, $width, $height, cyan, color(18, 24, 32))
	@access_text($lcd, $x + $width / 2, $y + $height / 2, 0.8, white, $label)

function @weight_editor_draw($lcd : screen)
	@access_text($lcd, 150, 43, 1, orange, @units_choice("UNLADEN WEIGHT / lb", "UNLADEN WEIGHT / kg"))
	@access_text($lcd, 150, 61, 0.7, cyan, text("STORED {0.0} {}", $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m * @units_mass_factor($weight_editor_lb), @units_choice("lb", "kg")))
	var $current = @weight_editor_current()
	var $label = "CURRENT --"
	if $current
		$label = text("CURRENT {0.0} {}", $current * @units_mass_factor($weight_editor_lb), @units_choice("lb", "kg"))

; Separate mining ceiling draft: never edits the unladen-weight reference.
function @mining_limit_recall()
	@mining_limit_boot()
	$mining_limit_edit = text("{0}", $sqx_ml18_limit__m * $mining_limit_lb)
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		$mining_limit_edit = text("{0}", floor($sqx_ml18_limit__m))
		$units_mining_exact = 1
		$units_mining_mass = $sqx_ml18_limit__m
	$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("LOADED CRAFT lb / SAVE TO APPLY", "LOADED CRAFT kg / SAVE TO APPLY")

function @mining_limit_key($key : text)
	if ($key == "CLR") or ($key == "DEL") or @access_digits($key)
		$units_mining_exact = 0
	if $key == "CLR"
		$mining_limit_edit = ""
	elseif $key == "DEL"
		if size($mining_limit_edit) > 0
			$mining_limit_edit = substring($mining_limit_edit, 0, size($mining_limit_edit) - 1)
	elseif (size($key) == 1) and @access_digits($key) and (size($mining_limit_edit) < 6)
		$mining_limit_edit &= $key
	$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("MINING CEILING lb / PRESS SAVE", "MINING CEILING kg / PRESS SAVE")

function @mining_limit_save() : number
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		var $metric_mass = $mining_limit_edit:number
		if $units_mining_exact
			$metric_mass = $units_mining_mass
		if (!@access_digits($mining_limit_edit)) or ($metric_mass < 0) or ($metric_mass > $craft_weight_load_limit + 0.001)
			$autopilot_ui_notice = "ENTER 0-9071 kg"
			return 0
		var $persist_next_230 : number
		$persist_next_230 = $metric_mass
		if $sqx_ml18_limit__m != $persist_next_230
			$sqx_ml18_limit = $persist_next_230
			$sqx_ml18_limit__m = $sqx_ml18_limit
		if $sqx_ml18_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_ml18_initialized = 1
			$sqx_ml18_initialized__m = $sqx_ml18_initialized
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "MINING WEIGHT LIMIT SAVED"
		return 1
	if !@access_digits($mining_limit_edit)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("ENTER 0-20000 lb", "ENTER 0-9071 kg")
		return 0
	var $pounds = $mining_limit_edit:number
	if !($pounds >= 0 and $pounds <= 20000)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = @units_choice("ENTER 0-20000 lb", "ENTER 0-9071 kg")
		return 0
	var $persist_next_232 : number
	$persist_next_232 = min($pounds / $mining_limit_lb, $craft_weight_load_limit)
	if $sqx_ml18_limit__m != $persist_next_232
		$sqx_ml18_limit = $persist_next_232
		$sqx_ml18_limit__m = $sqx_ml18_limit
	if $sqx_ml18_initialized__m != 1
		$sqx_ml18_initialized = 1
		$sqx_ml18_initialized__m = $sqx_ml18_initialized
	$autopilot_ui_notice = "MINING WEIGHT LIMIT SAVED"
	return 1

	@access_text($lcd, 150, 43, 1, orange, @units_choice("MINING WEIGHT LIMIT / lb", "MINING WEIGHT LIMIT / kg"))

	@access_text($lcd, 150, 77, 0.7, gray, "CRAFT + CARGO + PILOT")

	@weight_editor_button($lcd, 150, 274, 149, 25, "SAVE")

function @rs_rects_init()

	$rs_pip_high.fill(4,-1)
	$rs_pip_hp.fill(4,-1)
	$rs_pip_hc.fill(4,-1)
	$rs_tip_x.fill(12,0)
	$rs_tip_y.fill(12,0)
	$rs_ux1.fill(12,999)
	$rs_uy1.fill(12,999)
	$rs_ux2.fill(12,-999)

; New needle tip for dial $rs_i (same expression as @systems_display_needle).
; With $rs_restore, the background is restored over the box holding the old
; and new needle (2 px margin) and that box joins the pending dirty area.
function @rs_needle($rs_i : number, $rs_cx : number, $rs_cy : number, $rs_fraction : number, $rs_restore : number)
	var $rs_angle = pi * (0.75 + clamp($rs_fraction, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	var $rs_ex = $rs_cx + cos($rs_angle) * 23
	var $rs_ey = $rs_cy + sin($rs_angle) * 23
	if $rs_restore
		var $rs_x1 = floor(min($rs_cx, min($rs_ex, $rs_tip_x.$rs_i))) - 2
		var $rs_y1 = floor(min($rs_cy, min($rs_ey, $rs_tip_y.$rs_i))) - 2
		var $rs_x2 = floor(max($rs_cx, max($rs_ex, $rs_tip_x.$rs_i))) + 3
		var $rs_y2 = floor(max($rs_cy, max($rs_ey, $rs_tip_y.$rs_i))) + 3
		screen_copy($systems_display_bg,$systems_display_lcd,$rs_x1,$rs_y1,$rs_x1,$rs_y1,$rs_x2-$rs_x1,$rs_y2-$rs_y1)
		$rs_ux1.$rs_i = min($rs_ux1.$rs_i, $rs_x1)
		$rs_uy1.$rs_i = min($rs_uy1.$rs_i, $rs_y1)
		$rs_ux2.$rs_i = max($rs_ux2.$rs_i, $rs_x2)
		$rs_uy2.$rs_i = max($rs_uy2.$rs_i, $rs_y2)
	$rs_tip_x.$rs_i = $rs_ex
	$rs_tip_y.$rs_i = $rs_ey

; Caption of dial $rs_i: restored (15 rows, full column) only when its text changes.
function @rs_caption($rs_i : number, $rs_x : number, $rs_ty : number, $rs_text : text, $rs_restore : number)
	if $rs_restore and ($rs_text != $rs_txt.$rs_i)
		screen_copy($systems_display_bg,$systems_display_lcd,$rs_x,$rs_ty-7,$rs_x,$rs_ty-7,75,15)
		$rs_tdirty.$rs_i = 1
	$rs_txt.$rs_i = $rs_text

function @rs_dirty_copy($rs_dst : screen, $rs_col : number, $rs_partial : number)
	repeat 3 ($rs_d)
		var $rs_i = $rs_col * 3 + $rs_d
		if $rs_ux2.$rs_i > $rs_ux1.$rs_i
			if $rs_partial
				screen_copy($systems_display_lcd,$rs_dst,$rs_ux1.$rs_i,$rs_uy1.$rs_i,$rs_ux1.$rs_i,$rs_uy1.$rs_i,$rs_ux2.$rs_i-$rs_ux1.$rs_i,$rs_uy2.$rs_i-$rs_uy1.$rs_i)
			$rs_ux1.$rs_i = 999
			$rs_uy1.$rs_i = 999
			$rs_ux2.$rs_i = -999
			$rs_uy2.$rs_i = -999
		if $rs_tdirty.$rs_i
			if $rs_partial
				var $rs_ty = 113 + $rs_d * 82
				screen_copy($systems_display_lcd,$rs_dst,$rs_col*75,$rs_ty,$rs_col*75,$rs_ty,75,15)
			$rs_tdirty.$rs_i = 0

var $rc_rotor_0 = virtualscreen(75, 300)

function @systems_display_gauges_paint($systems_display_gx : number, $systems_display_name : text, $systems_display_alias : text, $systems_display_pitch : number)
	var $systems_display_rpm = abs(input_number($systems_display_alias, 0)) * 60
	var $systems_display_thrust = input_number($systems_display_alias, 1)
	@systems_display_text($systems_display_gx, 34, 1.1, cyan, $systems_display_name)
	@systems_display_needle($systems_display_gx, 88, $systems_display_rpm / 3000, white)
	@systems_display_pip($systems_display_gx, 88, $systems_display_low / 3000, orange)
	@systems_display_pip($systems_display_gx, 88, $systems_display_high / 3000, red)
	@systems_display_text($systems_display_gx, 120, 1.05, white, text("{0}", $systems_display_rpm))
	@systems_display_needle($systems_display_gx, 170, abs($systems_display_pitch), white)
	@systems_display_pip($systems_display_gx, 170, 0.75, red)
	if ($systems_display_hover_pitch > 0) and (abs($systems_display_rpm - $systems_display_hover_rpm) < $systems_display_hover_rpm * 0.05) and (abs(@standby_nav(2) - $systems_display_hover_alt) < 30)
		@systems_display_pip($systems_display_gx, 170, $systems_display_hover_pitch, orange)
	@systems_display_text($systems_display_gx, 202, 1.05, white, text("{0}%", abs($systems_display_pitch) * 100))
	var $systems_display_thrust_colour = white
	; Thrust readback decides negative thrust; reverse-spinning rotors are normal.
	if $systems_display_thrust < 0
		$systems_display_thrust_colour = red
	; Display scale only: 0-50 kN, never a thrust/controller limit.
	@systems_display_needle($systems_display_gx, 252, abs($systems_display_thrust) / 50000, $systems_display_thrust_colour)
	@systems_display_text($systems_display_gx, 284, 0.95, $systems_display_thrust_colour, text("{0.0} KN", $systems_display_thrust / 1000))

function @systems_display_gauges($systems_display_gx : number, $systems_display_name : text, $systems_display_alias : text, $systems_display_pitch : number)
	var $rc_rotor_old = $rc_rotor_key_0
	if $systems_display_gx == 112.5
		$rc_rotor_old = $rc_rotor_key_1
	elseif $systems_display_gx == 187.5
		$rc_rotor_old = $rc_rotor_key_2
	elseif $systems_display_gx == 262.5
		$rc_rotor_old = $rc_rotor_key_3
	var $rc_rotor_key = text("{},{0},{0.00},{0},{0.00},{0},{0},{0},{},{}", $systems_display_name, abs(input_number($systems_display_alias, 0)) * 30, $systems_display_pitch, input_number($systems_display_alias, 1) / 100, $systems_display_hover_pitch, $systems_display_hover_rpm, $systems_display_low, $systems_display_high, sign(input_number($systems_display_alias, 1)), abs(@standby_nav(2) - $systems_display_hover_alt) < 30)
	if (!$rs_ready) or ($rc_rotor_key!=$rc_rotor_old)
		var $rs_col=floor($systems_display_gx/75)
		; T4v: when every pip is unchanged (exact values), only the needles and
		; numbers can differ from the painted column: restore just their
		; rectangles. The full paint below redraws everything (opaque, so the
		; unchanged pips and name repaint onto themselves).
		var $rs_rpm=abs(input_number($systems_display_alias, 0)) * 60
		var $rs_hc=($systems_display_hover_pitch > 0) and (abs($rs_rpm - $systems_display_hover_rpm) < $systems_display_hover_rpm * 0.05) and (abs(@standby_nav(2) - $systems_display_hover_alt) < 30)
		var $rs_partial=$rs_ready
		if $rs_partial
			$rs_partial=($rs_pip_low.$rs_col==$systems_display_low) and ($rs_pip_high.$rs_col==$systems_display_high) and ($rs_pip_hp.$rs_col==$systems_display_hover_pitch) and ($rs_pip_hc.$rs_col==$rs_hc)
		if !$rs_partial
			screen_copy($systems_display_bg,$systems_display_lcd,$rs_col*75,27,$rs_col*75,27,75,273)
			$rs_columns.$rs_col=1
		elseif $rs_columns.$rs_col==0
			$rs_columns.$rs_col=2
		var $rs_thrust=input_number($systems_display_alias, 1)
		var $rs_i=$rs_col*3
		@rs_needle($rs_i, $systems_display_gx, 88, $rs_rpm / 3000, $rs_partial)
		@rs_needle($rs_i+1, $systems_display_gx, 170, abs($systems_display_pitch), $rs_partial)
		@rs_needle($rs_i+2, $systems_display_gx, 252, abs($rs_thrust) / 50000, $rs_partial)
		var $rs_x=$rs_col*75
		@rs_caption($rs_i, $rs_x, 120, text("{0}", $rs_rpm), $rs_partial)
		@rs_caption($rs_i+1, $rs_x, 202, text("{0}%", abs($systems_display_pitch) * 100), $rs_partial)
		@rs_caption($rs_i+2, $rs_x, 284, text("{0.0} KN", $rs_thrust / 1000), $rs_partial)
		$rs_pip_low.$rs_col=$systems_display_low
		$rs_pip_high.$rs_col=$systems_display_high
		$rs_pip_hp.$rs_col=$systems_display_hover_pitch
		$rs_pip_hc.$rs_col=$rs_hc
		@systems_display_gauges_paint($systems_display_gx,$systems_display_name,$systems_display_alias,$systems_display_pitch)
		$rs_column_copies+=1
		$rc_rotor_builds += 1
		if $systems_display_gx == 37.5
			$rc_rotor_key_0 = $rc_rotor_key
		elseif $systems_display_gx == 112.5
			$rc_rotor_key_1 = $rc_rotor_key
		elseif $systems_display_gx == 187.5
			$rc_rotor_key_2 = $rc_rotor_key
		elseif $systems_display_gx == 262.5
			$rc_rotor_key_3 = $rc_rotor_key

function @systems_display_rotors()
	if !$rs_ready

	@systems_display_gauges(37.5, "FL", "front-left-prop", $systems_display_pfl)

	@systems_display_gauges(262.5, "RR", "rear-right-prop", $systems_display_prr)
	$rs_ready=1
	; Colored pips are self-contained; no large legend competes with the gauges.

; Reuses the rotor display's text/button drawing and cached rotor backgrounds.

function @autopilot_drafts_draft($index : number, $edit : number, $stored : number, $save : number) : number
	repeat 4 ($slot)
		if $sqx_ui33_drafts.size < 4
			$sqx_ui33_drafts.append(0)
		if $sqx_ui33_dirty.size < 4
			$sqx_ui33_dirty.append(0)
	if $save
		$sqx_ui33_drafts.$index = $edit
		$sqx_ui33_dirty.$index = abs($edit - $stored) > 0.000001
	if $sqx_ui33_dirty.$index
		return $sqx_ui33_drafts.$index
	return $stored

; One scrolling Settings list. Four rows are visible; chrome remains fixed.
function @access_setting_row($position : number) : number
	if $position==30
		return 30
	if $position == 4
		return 29
	var $ns_position = $position
	if $position > 4
		$ns_position -= 1
	if $ns_position >= 22
		return $ns_position
	if $ns_position == 0
		return 19
	if $ns_position == 1
		return 20
	if $ns_position == 2
		return 0
	if $ns_position == 3
		return 21
	return $ns_position - 3


function @access_setting_position($row : number) : number
	if $row==30
		return 30
	if $row == 29
		return 4
	if $row >= 22
		return $row + 1
	if $row == 19
		return 0
	if $row == 20
		return 1
	if $row == 0
		return 2
	if $row == 21
		return 3
	return $row + 4


; Native 300x300 MODE and replacement keypad. Render only dirty regions.
array $du_mode_regions : text
array $du_mode_x : number
array $du_mode_y : number
array $du_mode_w : number
array $du_mode_h : number
var $du_mode_full = 0
var $du_mode_dirty = 0

function @du_mode_prepare()
	if $du_mode_x.size
		return
	$du_mode_x.append(8,150,150,150,150,8,8,8,8)
	$du_mode_y.append(34,78,115,152,189,228,248,48,80)
	$du_mode_w.append(284,142,142,142,142,284,284,284,284)
	$du_mode_h.append(32,31,31,31,31,15,40,29,14)
	repeat 9 ($i)
		$du_mode_regions.append("!")

function @du_mode_mark($slot : number)
	if !mod(floor($du_mode_dirty/pow(2,$slot)),2)
		$du_mode_dirty += pow(2,$slot)

function @du_mode_field($slot:number,$value:text,$font:number,$ink:number)
	var $key = text("{}|{}",$value,$font)
	if $du_mode_regions.$slot == $key
		return
	$du_mode_regions.$slot = $key
	var $x=$du_mode_x.$slot
	var $y=$du_mode_y.$slot
	var $w=$du_mode_w.$slot
	var $h=$du_mode_h.$slot
	$systems_display_lcd.draw_rect($x,$y,$x+$w-1,$y+$h-1,$systems_display_ink,$systems_display_ink)
	@du_text($systems_display_lcd,$x+$w/2,$y+$h/2,$font,$ink,$value)
	@du_mode_mark($slot)

function @du_field_name($slot:number) : text
	if $slot == 0
		return "SPEED / KT"
	if $slot == 1
		return "ALTITUDE / FT"
	if $slot == 2
		return "HEADING"
	return "MAX CLIMB / FPM"

function @du_field_min($slot:number) : number
	if $slot == 0
		return -29
	if $slot == 3
		return 100
	return 0

function @du_field_max($slot:number) : number
	if $slot == 0
		return 300
	if $slot == 1
		return floor(12000*$autopilot_ui_feet)
	if $slot == 2
		return 359.9
	return 4000

function @du_field_text($slot:number,$value:number) : text
	if ($slot == 0) or ($slot == 2)
		return text("{0.1}",$value)
	return text("{0}",$value)

function @du_change($value:number)
	var $slot=$du_mode_selected
	$value=clamp($value,@du_field_min($slot),@du_field_max($slot))
	if ($slot == 1) or ($slot == 3)
		$value=round($value)
	if $du_edits.$slot == $value
		return
	$du_edits.$slot=$value
	@du_mark_manual($slot)
	if (!$du_hold) and (!$sqx_ui46_nav__m)
		@du_activate()

function @du_wheel($delta:number)
	if !$delta
		return
	if !$du_mode_ready
		@du_edit_recall()
	var $step=1
	if $du_mode_selected == 1
		$step=10
	if $du_mode_selected == 3
		$step=100
	var $next=$du_edits.$du_mode_selected
	if $du_keypad
		if isnumeric($du_digits)
			$next=$du_digits:number
	$next+=sign($delta)*$step
	if $du_mode_selected == 2
		$next=mod(mod($next,360)+360,360)
	$next=clamp($next,@du_field_min($du_mode_selected),@du_field_max($du_mode_selected))
	if $du_keypad
		$du_digits=@du_field_text($du_mode_selected,$next)
		$du_replace=1
		$du_error=""
	else
		@du_change($next)

function @du_key_input($key:text)
	if $key == "ENTER"
		if (!isnumeric($du_digits)) or ($du_digits == "")
			$du_error="ENTER A NUMBER"
			return
		var $next=$du_digits:number
		if !($next>=@du_field_min($du_mode_selected) and $next<=@du_field_max($du_mode_selected))
			$du_error="VALUE OUT OF RANGE"
			return
		if (($du_mode_selected == 1) or ($du_mode_selected == 3)) and ($next != round($next))
			$du_error="WHOLE NUMBERS ONLY"
			return
		@du_change($next)
		$du_keypad=0
		$du_mode_key="!"
		return
	if $key == "CANCEL"
		$du_keypad=0
		$du_mode_key="!"
		return
	if $key == "CLR"
		$du_digits=""
		$du_replace=0
	elseif $key == "BACK"
		$du_digits=substring($du_digits,0,max(size($du_digits)-1,0))
		$du_replace=0
	elseif $key == "-"
		if $du_mode_selected != 0
			return
		if $du_replace
			$du_digits="-"
		elseif substring($du_digits,0,1)=="-"
			$du_digits=substring($du_digits,1,size($du_digits)-1)
		else
			$du_digits="-" & $du_digits
		$du_replace=0
	elseif $key == "."
		if ($du_mode_selected == 1) or ($du_mode_selected == 3)
			return
		if $du_replace
			$du_digits="0"
		if !contains($du_digits,".")
			if ($du_digits=="") or ($du_digits=="-")
				$du_digits&="0"
			$du_digits&="."
		$du_replace=0
	elseif (size($key)==1) and isnumeric($key)
		if $du_replace
			$du_digits=""
		$du_replace=0
		if size($du_digits)<12
			$du_digits&=$key
	$du_error=""


function @settings_layout_scroll($settings_layout_delta : number)
	if ($systems_display_mode==2) and $settings_fields_editor and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected==30) and !$settings_editor_keypad and !$home_confirm
		$home_list_top=clamp($home_list_top-sign($settings_layout_delta),0,max(0,$home_choices.size-3))
		$systems_display_key=""
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode==1) and $sqx_sw49_power__m
		@du_wheel($settings_layout_delta)
		return
	; T5x: scroll changes NAV cruise speed while its editor is open.
	if ($systems_display_mode==2) and $settings_fields_editor and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected==29) and !$settings_editor_keypad
		var $ns_wheel_step = 1
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m
			$ns_wheel_step = $autopilot_ui_knots
		$nav_cruise_edit = clamp($nav_cruise_edit + sign($settings_layout_delta) * $ns_wheel_step, 20, 300)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if (!@sw_in_2()) or ($systems_display_mode != 2) or $settings_editor_keypad or $settings_fields_editor
		return
	; UP/DOWN moves the selection, never a value. Follow it only at list edges.
	var $position = clamp(@access_setting_position($autopilot_ui_settings_selected) - sign($settings_layout_delta), 0, 30)
	$autopilot_ui_settings_selected = @access_setting_row($position)
	if $position < $settings_layout_scroll_top
		$settings_layout_scroll_top = $position
	elseif $position >= $settings_layout_scroll_top + 5
		$settings_layout_scroll_top = $position - 4
	$settings_layout_scroll_top = clamp($settings_layout_scroll_top, 0, 26)
	$autopilot_ui_battery_page = $autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 4
	$systems_display_key = ""

function @home_choices_load()
	$home_choices.clear()
	$home_labels.clear()
	if @beacon_valid()
		foreach $sqx_tg47_main ($i,$frequency)
			$home_choices.append($frequency)
			$home_labels.append($sqx_tg47_names.$i)
	foreach $service_frequencies ($i,$frequency)
		var $label=@beacon_get($service_packets.$i,"name")
		if $label!=""
			var $duplicate=0
			foreach $home_choices ($j,$known)
				if $known==$frequency
					$duplicate=1
			if !$duplicate and ($home_choices.size<128)
				$home_choices.append($frequency)
				$home_labels.append($label)
	$home_list_top=0

	else
		@systems_display_text(150,58,0.7,cyan,text("HOME: {}",substring($sqx_home_name__m,0,32)))
		repeat 3 ($row)
			var $i=$home_list_top+$row

				@systems_display_button(8,$y,264,36,substring($home_labels.$i,0,35),$home_choices.$i==$sqx_home_main__m)

function @home_ui_click($x:number,$y:number)
	if $y>=274
		$home_confirm=0
		$settings_fields_editor=0
		return
	if $mission_mode
		@mission_notice("CANCEL MISSION BEFORE CHANGING HOME")
		return
	if $home_confirm
		if ($y>=224) and ($y<254)
			if $x>=156
				var $saved=@mission_home_save_value($home_edit,$home_name_edit,1)
			$home_confirm=0
		return
	if ($y>=75) and ($y<195)
		if $x>=276
			if $y<91
				$home_list_top=max(0,$home_list_top-1)
			elseif $y>=179
				$home_list_top=min(max(0,$home_choices.size-3),$home_list_top+1)
			else
				$home_list_top=clamp(round(($y-91)/88*max(0,$home_choices.size-3)),0,max(0,$home_choices.size-3))
		else
			var $i=$home_list_top+floor(($y-75)/40)
			if $i<$home_choices.size
				$home_edit=$home_choices.$i
				$home_name_edit=$home_labels.$i
				var $saved=@mission_home_save_value($home_edit,$home_name_edit,0)
	elseif ($y>=204) and ($y<234)
		$beacon_settings_buffer=$sqx_home_main__m
		$beacon_settings_cursor=size($beacon_settings_buffer)
		$beacon_settings_shift=0
		$settings_editor_keypad=1
	elseif ($y>=240) and ($y<266) and ($sqx_home_main__m!="")
		$home_edit=$sqx_home_main__m
		$home_name_edit=$sqx_home_name__m
		$home_confirm=1

function @autopilot_ui_adjust($autopilot_ui_direction : number)
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 29)
		var $ns_step = (1 + 9 * $systems_display_coarse)
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m
			$ns_step *= $autopilot_ui_knots
		$nav_cruise_edit = clamp($nav_cruise_edit + $autopilot_ui_direction * $ns_step, 20, 300)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and (($autopilot_ui_settings_selected >= 27) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected <= 28))
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 23)
		$units_edit = $autopilot_ui_direction > 0
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 22)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "USE MINING WEIGHT KEYPAD"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 21)
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m
			$cruise_limit_edit = clamp((round($cruise_limit_edit / $autopilot_ui_knots) + $autopilot_ui_direction * (1 + 9 * $systems_display_coarse)) * $autopilot_ui_knots, 20, 100)
			return
		$cruise_limit_edit = clamp(round($cruise_limit_edit) + $autopilot_ui_direction * (1 + 9 * $systems_display_coarse), 20, 100)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 20)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "USE WEIGHT KEYPAD"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 19)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "USE PIN KEYPAD"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and (($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 17) or ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 18) or ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 8) or ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 9) or (($autopilot_ui_settings_selected >= 27) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected <= 28)))
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "USE KEYBOARD TO EDIT"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected >= 12)
		@scanner_options_adjust($autopilot_ui_direction)
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 11)
		$settings_editor_edit_format = 12
		if $autopilot_ui_direction > 0
			$settings_editor_edit_format = 24
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 10)
		var $step = 0.25
		if $systems_display_coarse
			$step = 1
		if $settings_editor_edit_new_york
			$settings_editor_edit_timezone = @clock_settings_new_york_offset()
		$settings_editor_edit_new_york = 0
		$settings_editor_edit_timezone = clamp(round($settings_editor_edit_timezone * 4) / 4 + $autopilot_ui_direction * $step, -12, 14)
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 7)
		$settings_editor_edit_enabled = $autopilot_ui_direction > 0
		$autopilot_ui_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 6)
		$settings_editor_edit_solar = 12
		if $autopilot_ui_direction > 0
			$settings_editor_edit_solar = 24

function @command_editor_hold($command_editor_x : number, $command_editor_y : number)
	if ($systems_display_mode==2) and $settings_fields_editor and ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected==30)
		if ($command_editor_x>=276) and ($command_editor_y>=75) and ($command_editor_y<195)
			@home_ui_click($command_editor_x,$command_editor_y)
			$systems_display_key=""
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode==1)
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 3)
		$command_editor_hold_direction = 0
		return
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and (!$settings_fields_editor) and (!$settings_editor_keypad)
		var $arrow=($command_editor_y<57) or ($command_editor_y>=217)
		if $arrow and (time<$du_scroll_next)
			return
		@settings_scrollbar_touch($command_editor_x,$command_editor_y)
		$du_scroll_next=time+0.125
		return
	; Called ONLY by native click_hold: release cannot leave a timer running.
	; Never repeat APPLY, mission buttons, tab selection, or confirmation.
	if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and $settings_fields_editor and (($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 20) or ($autopilot_ui_settings_selected == 22))
		$command_editor_hold_direction = 0
		return
	if (!@sw_in_2()) or ($systems_display_mode < 1) or $autopilot_ui_more or $settings_editor_keypad or ($command_editor_x < 274) or ($command_editor_x >= 296)
		$command_editor_hold_direction = 0
		return
	var $command_editor_direction = 0
	if ($command_editor_y >= 109) and ($command_editor_y < 129)
		$command_editor_direction = 1
	elseif ($command_editor_y >= 133) and ($command_editor_y < 153)
		$command_editor_direction = -1
	if !$command_editor_direction
		$command_editor_hold_direction = 0
		return
	if ($command_editor_direction != $command_editor_hold_direction) or ((time - $command_editor_hold_seen) > 0.2)
		$command_editor_hold_direction = $command_editor_direction
		$command_editor_hold_started = time
		$command_editor_hold_next = time + 0.35
	$command_editor_hold_seen = time
	if time >= $command_editor_hold_next
		var $command_editor_multiplier = 1
		if (time - $command_editor_hold_started) >= 1.5
			$command_editor_multiplier = 5
		if ($systems_display_mode == 2) and (!$settings_fields_editor)
			@settings_layout_scroll($command_editor_direction)
		else
			@autopilot_ui_adjust($command_editor_direction * $command_editor_multiplier)
		$command_editor_hold_next = time + 0.125
		$systems_display_key = ""

function @wx_species_mass($name : text) : number
	var $key = lower($name)
	if $key == "n2"
		return 0.0280134
	if $key == "o2"
		return 0.0319988
	if $key == "ar"
		return 0.039948
	if $key == "co2"
		return 0.0440095
	if $key == "ch4"
		return 0.016043
	if $key == "h2o"
		return 0.01801528
	if $key == "h2"
		return 0.00201588
	if $key == "he"
		return 0.004002602
	if $key == "co"
		return 0.0280101
	if $key == "ne"
		return 0.0201797
	if $key == "kr"
		return 0.083798
	return 0

function @wx_composition($packet : text)
	if $packet == $wx_comp_seen
		return
	$wx_comp_seen = $packet
	$wx_parse_count += 1
	$wx_comp_ok = 0
	$wx_molar = 0
	$wx_h2o = -1
	if (size($packet) == 0) or (size($packet) > 2048)
		return
	var $total = 0
	var $weighted = 0
	var $water = -1
	var $count = 0
	foreach $packet ($name, $value)
		$count += 1
		if ($count > 16) or (!isnumeric($value))
			return
		var $fraction = $value:number
		if !($fraction >= 0 and $fraction <= 102)
			return
		var $mass = @wx_species_mass($name)
		if ($fraction > 0) and ($mass <= 0)
			return
		if lower($name) == "h2o"
			$water = $fraction
		$total += $fraction
		$weighted += $fraction * $mass
	; Accept only explicitly normalized fraction/percentage totals. Other
	; payload shapes stay unavailable rather than guessing a mass basis.
	if !(($total >= 0.98 and $total <= 1.02) or ($total >= 98 and $total <= 102))
		return
	if ($count == 0) or ($weighted <= 0)
		return
	$wx_molar = $weighted / $total
	if $water >= 0
		$wx_h2o = $water / $total
	$wx_comp_ok = 1

function @wx_solar($cycle_valid : number, $cycle_day : number, $sensor_valid : number, $watts : number)
	if $cycle_valid
		$wx_day = $cycle_day != 0
		$wx_day_source = "SOLAR CYCLE"
		$wx_dark_at = -1
		return
	if (!$sensor_valid) or (!($watts >= 0 and $watts < 10000000))
		$wx_day = -1
		$wx_dark_at = -1
		$wx_day_source = "NO SOLAR"
		return
	if $wx_day_source != "SENSOR EST"
		$wx_day = -1
		$wx_dark_at = -1
	$wx_day_source = "SENSOR EST"
	; Provisional commissioning thresholds; low light cannot prove night.
	if $watts >= 5
		$wx_day = 1
		$wx_dark_at = -1
	elseif $watts <= 1
		if $wx_dark_at < 0
			$wx_dark_at = time
		if time - $wx_dark_at >= 60
			$wx_day = 0
	else
		$wx_dark_at = -1

function @wx_calculate()
	$wx_pressure = 0
	$wx_rh = -1
	$wx_dew = -1000
	$wx_lift = -1
	$wx_status = "NO DATA"
	$wx_note = "CHECK SENSOR CONNECTIONS"
	if !$wx_temp_valid
		$wx_status = "NO TEMPERATURE"
		return
	if !($wx_rho > 0 and $wx_rho < 100)
		$wx_status = "NO AIR DATA"
		return
	if !$wx_comp_ok
		$wx_status = "CHECK COMPOSITION"
		$wx_note = "FORMAT NOT RECOGNIZED"
		return
	$wx_pressure = $wx_rho * 8.314462618 * $wx_temp / $wx_molar
	$wx_status = "AIR SAMPLE"
	$wx_note = "SKY / RAIN NOT MEASURED"
	var $c = $wx_temp - 273.15
	if ($wx_h2o < 0) or ($c < -40) or ($c > 50)
		return
	var $sat = 611.2 * pow(2.718281828459045, 17.67 * $c / ($c + 243.5))
	var $vapour = $wx_h2o * $wx_pressure
	; Cap the derived relative-humidity estimate, not the sensor sample.
	; Existing dew-point cap prevents a negative condensation height.
	$wx_rh = clamp(100 * $vapour / $sat, 0, 100)
	$wx_status = "UNSATURATED"
	$wx_note = "NO LOCAL SATURATION"
	if $wx_rh >= 80
		$wx_status = "HUMID AIR"
		$wx_note = "CONDENSATION RISK EST."
	if $wx_rh >= 98
		$wx_status = "SATURATED"
		$wx_note = "FOG / CLOUD POSSIBLE"
	if $vapour <= 0
		return
	var $vlog = log($vapour / 611.2, 2.718281828459045)
	var $dew = 243.5 * $vlog / (17.67 - $vlog)
	if ($dew < -80) or ($dew > 50)
		return
	$wx_dew = min($dew, $c)
	; Parcel condensation height only, not an observed cloud ceiling.
	$wx_lift = max(0, $c - $wx_dew) * 121.92

function @wx_service()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		$wx_at = -1
		$wx_observed_at = -1
		$wx_dark_at = -1
		return
	if time < $wx_at
		return
	$wx_at = time + 15
	$wx_observed_at = time
	$wx_samples += 1
	$wx_temp_valid = 0
	$wx_temp_est = 0
	$wx_rho = 0
	var $wx_sensor = device("pressure")
	if contains($wx_sensor.type, "DensitySensor") and (!$wx_sensor.broken:number) and ($wx_sensor.damage:number == 0)
		$wx_rho = input_number("pressure", 0)
		@wx_composition(input_text("pressure", 1))
		if isnumeric($wx_sensor.temp)
			$wx_temp = $wx_sensor.temp:number
			$wx_temp_valid = ($wx_temp >= 150) and ($wx_temp <= 500)
			$wx_temp_est = $wx_temp_valid
	else
		$wx_comp_ok = 0
		$wx_comp_seen = "!"
	; Optional true ambient thermometer is preferred when installed.
	var $wx_thermo = device("temperature")
	if contains($wx_thermo.type, "TemperatureSensor") and (!$wx_thermo.broken:number) and ($wx_thermo.damage:number == 0)
		var $wx_airtemp = input_number("temperature", 0)
		if ($wx_airtemp >= 150) and ($wx_airtemp <= 500)
			$wx_temp = $wx_airtemp
			$wx_temp_valid = 1
			$wx_temp_est = 0
	$wx_nav_valid = contains(device_type("nav"), "NavInstrument") and (@standby_nav_text(13) == "Earth")
	if $wx_nav_valid
		$wx_alt = @standby_nav(2)
		$wx_agl = @standby_nav(3)
	@wx_calculate()
	var $wx_cycle_valid = $flight_sol_model and $flight_sol_valid
	if $wx_cycle_valid
		@wx_solar(1, $flight_sol_mode == 1, 0, 0)
	else
		var $wx_solar_device = device("solar")
		var $wx_solar_valid = contains($wx_solar_device.type, "SolarSensor") and (!$wx_solar_device.broken:number) and ($wx_solar_device.damage:number == 0)
		var $wx_watts = -1
		if $wx_solar_valid
			$wx_watts = input_number("solar", 1)
		@wx_solar(0, 0, $wx_solar_valid, $wx_watts)
	var $wx_next = text("{}|{}|{}|{0.0}|{0.00}|{0.0}|{0}|{0.0}|{0}|{0}|{0}|{}|{}", $wx_temp_valid, $wx_temp_est, $wx_comp_ok, $wx_temp, $wx_rho, $wx_pressure / 100, $wx_rh, $wx_dew, $wx_lift, $wx_alt, $wx_agl, $wx_status, $wx_note)
	$wx_next &= text("|{}|{}|{}|{}", $wx_nav_valid, $wx_day, $wx_day_source, $wx_h2o)
	if $wx_next != $wx_key
		$wx_key = $wx_next
		$wx_revision += 1

function @wx_current() : number
	return ($wx_observed_at >= 0) and (time >= $wx_observed_at) and (time-$wx_observed_at <= 45)

function @wx_icon() : number
	if !@wx_current()
		return 3
	if (!$wx_temp_valid) or ($wx_pressure <= 0) or ($wx_status == "MODEL LIMIT")
		return 4
	if $wx_rh >= 80
		; Partly cloudy with the sun or moon when day/night is known.
		if $wx_day == 1
			return 5
		if $wx_day == 0
			return 6
		return 2
	if $wx_day >= 0
		return 1 - $wx_day
	return 3

; T4v: weather units follow the IMPERIAL / METRIC setting (temperature, dew
; point, pressure, density, condensation height). Kelvin input is unchanged.
function @wx_temp_value($wx_kelvin : number) : number
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		return $wx_kelvin - 273.15

function @du_mode_touch($x:number,$y:number)
	if $du_keypad and ($x>=274) and ($x<294) and ($y>=28) and ($y<48)
		@du_key_input("CANCEL")
		return
	if $du_keypad
		if ($y>=96) and ($y<232) and ($x>=8) and ($x<292) and (mod($x-8,97)<90) and (mod($y-96,35)<31)
			var $slot=floor(($x-8)/97)+floor(($y-96)/35)*3
			var $key=text("{0}",$slot+1)
			if $slot==9
				$key="-"
			elseif $slot==10
				$key="0"
			elseif $slot==11
				$key="."
			@du_key_input($key)
		elseif ($y>=237) and ($y<262)
			if ($x>=8) and ($x<147)
				@du_key_input("CLR")
			elseif ($x>=153) and ($x<292)
				@du_key_input("BACK")
		elseif ($y>=268) and ($y<294)
			if ($x>=8) and ($x<147)
				@du_key_input("CANCEL")
			elseif ($x>=153) and ($x<292)
				@du_key_input("ENTER")
		return
	if ($y>=34) and ($y<66) and ($x>=8) and ($x<292) and (mod($x-8,97)<90)
		var $mode=floor(($x-8)/97)
		if $mode == 0
			if !$sqx_ui46_nav__m
				@switches_action(7)
		elseif $mode == 1
			if $du_hold
				@du_activate()
			else
				@du_freeze(1)
		else
			@du_activate()
	elseif ($x>=150) and ($x<292) and ($y>=78) and ($y<220) and (mod($y-78,37)<31)
		$du_mode_selected=floor(($y-78)/37)
		$du_digits=@du_field_text($du_mode_selected,$du_edits.$du_mode_selected)
		$du_replace=1
		$du_error=""
		$du_keypad=1
		$du_mode_key="!"
