function @systems_display_choose($systems_display_x:number,$systems_display_y:number)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or ($systems_display_x<0) or ($systems_display_x>=300) or ($systems_display_y<0) or ($systems_display_y>=300)
		return
	; Menu dispatch precedes all editors, including the number pad.
	if $systems_display_y<27
		var $tab=floor($systems_display_x/75)
		var $next=$tab
		if $tab==2
			$next=3
		elseif $tab==3
			$next=2
		if $next==$systems_display_mode
			return
		if $systems_display_mode==1
			@du_manual_commit()
		$du_keypad=0
		$settings_editor_keypad=0
		$settings_fields_editor=0
		$command_editor_hold_direction=0
		$autopilot_ui_more=0
		$autopilot_ui_battery_page=0
		if $next==1
			@du_mode_open()
		else
			$systems_display_mode=$next
		$du_mode_key="!"
		$wx_page_key="!"
		$systems_display_key=""
		return
	if $systems_display_mode==1
		@du_mode_touch($systems_display_x,$systems_display_y)
		return
	if $systems_display_mode==3
		return
	@autopilot_ui_choose($systems_display_x,$systems_display_y)

function @access_inside_click($x : number, $y : number)
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	if ($x < 10) or ($x >= 140) or ($y < 20) or ($y >= 114) or (mod($x - 10, 68) >= 62) or (mod($y - 20, 50) >= 44)
		return
	var $slot = floor(($x - 10) / 68) + 2 * floor(($y - 20) / 50)
	if $slot == 0
		@access_set(!$sqx_lock14_locked__m)
	elseif $slot == 1
		if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
			@access_set(0)
		@doors_toggle(0)
	elseif $slot == 2
		@pilot_maintenance_toggle()
	else
		if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
			@access_set(0)
		@doors_toggle(1)

; Each interior panel owns only its adjacent door's existing requested state.
; No PIN or LOCK control is added; the craft's existing opening interlocks remain.	@access_render()
	@interior_door_render()



function @door_panels_step()
	; Observe the stop transition even after parked avionics go quiet.
	; Once coasting ends, quiet parked calls use RAM only and return.
	if $door_panel_was_rotors!=$sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		$door_panel_was_rotors=$sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		$door_panel_pending=1
	if (!$standby_visual_enabled) and (!$door_panel_pending)
		return
	var $moving=@du_doors_moving()
	@access_render()
	@interior_door_render()
	if (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) and (!$moving)
		$door_panel_pending=0
	elseif $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		; The next OFF edge will explicitly arm the coast observer again.
		$door_panel_pending=0

var $dev_gear_test = 0
var $dev_gear_auto = 0
var $dev_gear_last = -1
var $dev_front_down = 0
var $dev_front_last = -1

; Sole owner of the three pivot channels. Front-down has priority over both
; normal automatic retraction and the parked all-gear retract test.
function @dev_gear_apply($dev_gear_demand : number)
	$dev_gear_auto = $dev_gear_demand
	var $dev_gear_next = $dev_gear_demand
	if $dev_gear_test
		$dev_gear_next = 1
	if $dev_gear_next != $dev_gear_last
		output_number("back-gear-1-piv", 0, -$dev_gear_next * 0.25)
		output_number("back-gear-2-piv", 0, -$dev_gear_next * 0.25)
		$dev_gear_last = $dev_gear_next
	var $dev_front_next = $dev_gear_next
	if $dev_front_down
		$dev_front_next = 0
	if $dev_front_next != $dev_front_last
		output_number("front-gear-1-piv", 0, $dev_front_next * 0.30)
		$dev_front_last = $dev_front_next

function @dev_gear_toggle() : number
	if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		return 0
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return 0
	$dev_gear_test = !$dev_gear_test
	@dev_gear_apply($dev_gear_auto)
	return 1

function @dev_front_toggle() : number
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return 0
	$dev_front_down = !$dev_front_down
	@dev_gear_apply($dev_gear_auto)
	return 1

function @dev_gear_service()
	if (!$dev_gear_test) and (!$dev_front_down)
		return
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		$dev_gear_test = 0
		$dev_front_down = 0
		@dev_gear_apply($dev_gear_auto)
	elseif $dev_gear_test and $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		; Rotor start cancels only the parked retract test, not front-down.
		$dev_gear_test = 0
		@dev_gear_apply($dev_gear_auto)

; Late helpers may reference all existing modules; early update dispatches here.
function @standby_trace($st_event : text)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	@diagnostics_begin(1, time)
	@diagnostics_word("STANDBY")
	@diagnostics_word($st_event)
	@diagnostics_number($standby_mode)
	@diagnostics_number(input_number("left-anchor", 0))
	@diagnostics_number(input_number("ship-dock", 0))
	@diagnostics_number($sqx_sw49_power__m)
	@diagnostics_number($sqx_sw49_rotors__m)
	@diagnostics_finish()

function @standby_snapshot()
	repeat 29 ($st_i)
		$standby_nav_cache.$st_i = input_number("nav", $st_i)
	$standby_planet = input_text("nav", 13)

function @standby_charge()
	; Charging is intentionally the only periodic calculation while PWR is OFF.
	; Same battery bank and 99.999% stop threshold as the original monitor.
	if time < $standby_charge_at
		return
	$standby_charge_at = time + 1
	; Main-bank state feeds powered instrumentation, not OFF charging.
	; Keep the existing anchored/powered sampling path unchanged.
	if $standby_mode!=1
		var $st_soc = 0
		repeat 10 ($st_b)
			$st_soc += clamp(input_number(text("battery-{}", $st_b + 1), 2), 0, 1)
		$btotchg = $st_soc * 0.1
	; HV breaker supplies the LV battery converters, not just service loads.
	$standby_charge_feed = (input_number("battery-small-1", 2) < 0.99999) or (input_number("battery-small-2", 2) < 0.99999)
	; No charger relay in this direct-connected development craft.

function @standby_relays()
	var $st_service = @standby_io()
	if $st_service != $standby_service_last
		; lvbreaker1 is the computer/charging feed; never cut our own wake path.
		; Rotor relays remain under the original flight owner when live.
		output_number("lvbreaker2", 0, $st_service)
		$standby_service_last = $st_service
		@standby_trace("SERVICE")
	var $st_hv = $st_service or $standby_charge_feed
	if $st_hv != $standby_hv_last
		output_number("hvbreaker", 0, $st_hv)
		$standby_hv_last = $st_hv

function @standby_quiet_scanners()
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m and ($mission_mode==2) and ($mission_phase==4)
		return
	@terrain_scan_release()
	@ore_scanner_quiet()
	@geology_quiet()
	@stopPivot()

function @standby_stop_outputs()
	output_number("front-left-prop", 0, 0)
	output_number("front-right-prop", 0, 0)
	output_number("rear-left-prop", 0, 0)
	output_number("rear-right-prop", 0, 0)
	@latched_io(6,"front-left-prop-pwr",0,0)
	@latched_io(7,"front-right-prop-pwr",0,0)
	@latched_io(8,"rear-left-prop-pwr",0,0)
	@latched_io(9,"rear-right-prop-pwr",0,0)
	@latched_io(5,"mining-drill",0,0)
	output_number("speaker-1", 0, 0)
	output_number("speaker-2", 0, 0)

function @standby_enter($st_next : number)
	; Capture before removing sensor power; do not replace frozen values with 0.
	if $standby_mode == 0
		@standby_snapshot()
	$standby_mode = $st_next
	$standby_ui_until = time + 0.6
	$standby_io_until = 0
	$standby_job_until = 0
	$standby_job_seen = 0
	$standby_io_ready_at = time + 0.3
	$standby_charge_at = 0
	@controller_ownership_reset_hidden()
	@controller_ownership_reset_auxiliary()
	$controller_ownership_was_available = 0
	$controller_ownership_was_ap = 0
	$attitude_ownership_was_active = 0
	if $st_next == 1
		@switches_powerdown()
	else
		; Finish the touchdown latch before suspending the normal flight loop.
		if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m != 0
			$sqx_sw49_rotors = 0
			$sqx_sw49_rotors__m = $sqx_sw49_rotors
		if $sqx_sw49_stab__m != 0
			$sqx_sw49_stab = 0
			$sqx_sw49_stab__m = $sqx_sw49_stab
			$switches_boot_valid = 0
		if $sqx_sw49_ap__m != 0
			$sqx_sw49_ap = 0
			$sqx_sw49_ap__m = $sqx_sw49_ap
			$switches_boot_valid = 0
		if $sqx_ui46_nav__m != 0
			$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
			$sqx_ui46_nav__m = $sqx_ui46_nav
			$switches_boot_valid = 0
		$flight_landing_controls_released = 1
		@autopilot_requests_touchdown_defaults()
	@standby_stop_outputs()
	@standby_quiet_scanners()
	@standby_relays()
	@standby_trace("ENTER")

function @standby_step()
	; Stable cockpit OFF: input events still wake UI immediately; the power
	; switch is checked every tick. Do not poll anchor or rebuild live gates.
	if $standby_mode==1
		if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
			if time >= $standby_ui_until
				$standby_live_enabled=0
				$standby_work_enabled=0
				$standby_visual_enabled=0
				if time >= $standby_charge_at
					@standby_charge()
					@standby_relays()
				return
	var $st_anchor = input_number("left-anchor", 0)
	if !$sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		$standby_departure = 0
	var $st_next = 0
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		$st_next = 1
	elseif $st_anchor and (!$standby_departure) and (!$sqx_sw49_mine__m)
		$st_next = 2
	; A connected port does NOT prove the other build is terrain-anchored.
	; Unknown docks (including moving carriers) retain the live path.
	if $st_next != $standby_mode
		if $st_next == 0
			; An airborne program restart must not introduce a new actuator pause.
			$standby_warm_until = time
			if $standby_mode >= 1
				$standby_warm_until = time + 0.3
			$standby_mode = 0
			$standby_io_ready_at = $standby_warm_until
			$standby_ui_until = time + 1
			@standby_relays()
			@standby_trace("WAKE")
		else
			if $standby_mode == 1
				$standby_boot_until = time + 15
			@standby_enter($st_next)
	; Reuse the anchor sample; only read the dock when not already anchored.
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m
		var $st_secure=$st_anchor!=0
		if !$st_secure
			$st_secure=input_number("ship-dock",0)!=0
		@ui_secure_sample($st_secure)
	if $standby_mode == 2
		; Only an interaction can start a scan session. A stale saved RUN flag
		; cannot keep a parked craft awake forever. GEO has a five-minute ceiling.
		if (time < $standby_io_until) and (!$standby_job_seen)
			if $geology_selected and $geology_running
				$standby_job_seen = 1
			elseif (!$geology_selected) and $scan and (!$resting)
				$standby_job_seen = 2
			elseif (!$geology_selected) and (!$scan) and $terrain_enabled and (!$terrain_sleep)
				$standby_job_seen = 3
			if $standby_job_seen
				$standby_job_until = time + 300
		var $st_finished = 0
		if $standby_job_seen == 1
			$st_finished = (!$geology_running) or (!$geology_selected)
		elseif $standby_job_seen == 2
			$st_finished = (!$scan) or $resting or $geology_selected
		elseif $standby_job_seen == 3
			$st_finished = (!$terrain_enabled) or $terrain_sleep or $scan or $geology_selected
		if $standby_job_seen and ($st_finished or (time >= $standby_job_until))
			if $standby_job_seen == 1
				$geology_running = 0
			$standby_job_seen = 0
			$standby_job_until = 0
			$standby_io_until = 0
		if (!@standby_io()) and $standby_service_last
			@standby_quiet_scanners()
	if $standby_mode != 0
		@standby_charge()
	@standby_relays()
	; UI events set the visual gate immediately. Quiet OFF/anchor idle needs
	; no lifecycle call until the next interaction/power transition.
	if $standby_visual_enabled
		@visibility_tick()
	; Compute schedule gates once, not in every timer/observer callback.
	$standby_live_enabled = @standby_flight()
	$standby_work_enabled = @standby_work()
	$standby_visual_enabled = @standby_visual()

function @standby_init()
	$standby_nav_cache.fill(29, 0)
	@standby_snapshot()
	$standby_boot_until = time + 15
	@standby_step()


; Only this program owns these four door output channels. Output requests
; remain latched; OFF does not need to resend an identical target each poll.
var $standby_door_lower_left=999
var $standby_door_lower_right=999
var $standby_door_upper_left=999
var $standby_door_upper_right=999
function @standby_door_outputs()
	var $ll=$doormin*$_doors_pulse1__m
	var $lr=-$doormin*$_doors_pulse2__m
	var $ul=$doormax*$_doors_pulse1__m
	var $ur=-$doormax*$_doors_pulse2__m
	if ($ll!=$standby_door_lower_left)
		output_number("left-door",0,$ll)
		$standby_door_lower_left=$ll
	if ($lr!=$standby_door_lower_right)
		output_number("right-door",0,$lr)
		$standby_door_lower_right=$lr
	if ($ul!=$standby_door_upper_left)
		output_number("left-door-top",0,$ul)
		$standby_door_upper_left=$ul
	if ($ur!=$standby_door_upper_right)
		output_number("right-door-top",0,$ur)
		$standby_door_upper_right=$ur

; Hardware commands are not display invalidations. Renew active demands even
; with hidden screens / parked scheduling. OFF is issued by the existing owners.
function @hardware_commands_refresh()
	if $standby_service_last==1
		output_number("lvbreaker2",0,1)
	if $standby_hv_last==1
		output_number("hvbreaker",0,1)
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	if $latched_io_ready
		if $latched_io_values.6==1
			output_number("front-left-prop-pwr",0,1)
		if $latched_io_values.7==1
			output_number("front-right-prop-pwr",0,1)
		if $latched_io_values.8==1
			output_number("rear-left-prop-pwr",0,1)
		if $latched_io_values.9==1
			output_number("rear-right-prop-pwr",0,1)
	var $drilling=0
	if $sqx_sw49_mine__m and ($batts>0.50)
		if input_number("left-anchor",0) and (!input_number("ship-dock",0))
			$drilling=@mining_limit_weight_ok() and @mission_mine_allowed()
	@latched_io(5,"mining-drill",0,$drilling)

; Unknown/new/modded IDs still get a readable label, without guessing item identity.
function @cargo_names_fallback($cn_raw : text) : text
	var $cn_length = size($cn_raw)
	var $cn_start = 0
	repeat $cn_length ($cn_i)
		if substring($cn_raw, $cn_i, 1) == "."
			$cn_start = $cn_i + 1
	var $cn_leaf = substring($cn_raw, $cn_start, $cn_length - $cn_start)
	if $cn_leaf == ""
		return "Unknown Item"
	var $cn_result = ""
	var $cn_previous = ""
	$cn_length = size($cn_leaf)
	repeat $cn_length ($cn_i)
		var $cn_char = substring($cn_leaf, $cn_i, 1)
		var $cn_next = ""
		if ($cn_i + 1) < $cn_length
			$cn_next = substring($cn_leaf, $cn_i + 1, 1)
		if ($cn_char == "_") or ($cn_char == "-") or ($cn_char == " ")
			if ($cn_result != "") and ($cn_previous != " ")
				$cn_result &= " "
			$cn_previous = " "
		else
			var $cn_upper = ($cn_char == upper($cn_char)) and ($cn_char != lower($cn_char))
			var $cn_prev_lower = ($cn_previous == lower($cn_previous)) and ($cn_previous != upper($cn_previous))
			var $cn_next_lower = ($cn_next == lower($cn_next)) and ($cn_next != upper($cn_next))
			if $cn_upper and ($cn_result != "") and ($cn_previous != " ") and ($cn_prev_lower or isnumeric($cn_previous) or $cn_next_lower)
				$cn_result &= " "
			if ($cn_result == "") or ($cn_previous == " ")
				$cn_char = upper($cn_char)
			$cn_result &= $cn_char
			$cn_previous = $cn_char
	return $cn_result

function @cargo_names_name($cn_id : text) : text
	@cargo_names_boot()
	foreach $cargo_names_cache_ids ($cn_index, $cn_key)
		if $cn_key == $cn_id
			return $cargo_names_cache_labels.$cn_index
	var $cn_label = ""
	foreach $cargo_names_ids ($cn_index, $cn_key)
		if $cn_key == $cn_id
			$cn_label = $cargo_names_labels.$cn_index
			break
	if $cn_label == ""
		$cn_label = @cargo_names_fallback($cn_id)
	; Bounded session cache: changed quantities never repeat full catalog searches.
	if $cargo_names_cache_ids.size >= 64
		$cargo_names_cache_ids.clear()
		$cargo_names_cache_labels.clear()
	$cargo_names_cache_ids.append($cn_id)
	$cargo_names_cache_labels.append($cn_label)
	return $cn_label

function @mining_display_text($mining_display_x : number, $mining_display_y : number, $mining_display_size : number, $mining_display_colour : number, $mining_display_text : text)

function @mining_display_center_text($mining_display_cx : number, $mining_display_cy : number, $mining_display_font : number, $mining_display_colour : number, $mining_display_label : text)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_size($mining_display_font * $mining_display_scale)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	var $mining_display_fit = ($mining_display_lcd.width - 12) / max(size($mining_display_label) * $mining_display_lcd.char_w, 1)
	if $mining_display_fit < 1
		$mining_display_lcd.text_size($mining_display_font * $mining_display_scale * $mining_display_fit)
	$mining_display_lcd.write($mining_display_cx * $mining_display_scale - size($mining_display_label) * $mining_display_lcd.char_w / 2, $mining_display_cy * $mining_display_scale - $mining_display_lcd.char_h / 2, $mining_display_colour, $mining_display_label)

function @cargo_units_quantity($item : text, $count : number) : text
	if ($item == "Rock") or ($item == "ARCHEAN_celestial.Rock")
		return @units_choice(text("{0} lb", $count * 2.204622622), text("{0} kg", $count))
	; Ask the game for the item's actual units: ores are not all one-kg counts.
	var $unit = get_item_value_unit($item, $count)
	var $length = size($unit)
	if ($length >= 2) and (substring($unit, $length - 2, 2) == "kg")
		var $kg = substring($unit, 0, $length - 2)
		if isnumeric($kg)
			if $sqx_u20_metric__m
				return $unit
			return text("{0.0} lb", $kg:number * 2.204622622)
	return $unit

function @mining_display_row($m49_y : number, $m49_id : text, $m49_count : number)
	var $m49_label = @cargo_names_name($m49_id)
	var $m49_quantity = @cargo_units_quantity($m49_id, $m49_count)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_size(0.8 * $mining_display_scale)
	var $m49_count_x = 132 - size($m49_quantity) * $mining_display_lcd.char_w / $mining_display_scale
	var $m49_room = max($m49_count_x - 6 - 5, 1)
	var $m49_font = min(0.8, $m49_room / max(size($m49_label) * 6, 1))
	@mining_display_text(6, $m49_y, $m49_font, white, $m49_label)
	@mining_display_text($m49_count_x, $m49_y, 0.8, white, $m49_quantity)

function @mining_panel_status($ms_anchor:number,$ms_mass:number) : text
	if time<$mining_action_until
		if $mining_action_notice=="MINE LIMITED"
			if $ms_mass<=0
				return "MASS SENSOR"
			if !@mining_limit_weight_ok()
				return "WEIGHT LIMIT"
			if $batts<=0.50
				return "BATTERY LIMIT"
			return "MINE LIMITED"
		if ($mining_action_notice!="") and ($mining_action_notice!="MINE / LAND FIRST")
			return $mining_action_notice
	if $sqx_sw49_mine__m
		if $ms_anchor
			return "MINING"
		return "MINE / LAND FIRST"
	if $ms_anchor
		return "LANDED"
	return ""

; T4w: drill efficiency as a bar (native pixels): green, yellow at or below
; 50%, red at or below 15%; the percentage is printed inside the bar.
function @mining_eff_bar($eb_text : text, $eb_value : number)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_size(0.65 * $mining_display_scale)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$mining_display_lcd.write(158, 36, cyan, "EFF")
	var $eb_x1 = 158 + 3 * $mining_display_lcd.char_w + 6
	var $eb_x2 = 292
	$mining_display_lcd.draw_rect($eb_x1, 33, $eb_x2, 51, gray, color(18, 24, 32))
	if $eb_value >= 0
		var $eb_ink = green
		if $eb_value <= 0.15
			$eb_ink = red
		elseif $eb_value <= 0.5
			$eb_ink = yellow
		var $eb_w = round(($eb_x2 - $eb_x1 - 4) * clamp($eb_value, 0, 1))
		if $eb_w > 0
			$mining_display_lcd.draw_rect($eb_x1 + 2, 35, $eb_x1 + 2 + $eb_w, 49, $eb_ink, $eb_ink)
	$mining_display_lcd.text_size(0.6 * $mining_display_scale)
	var $eb_tx = ($eb_x1 + $eb_x2) / 2 - size($eb_text) * $mining_display_lcd.char_w / 2
	; Dark outline keeps the number readable over any fill colour.
	$mining_display_lcd.write($eb_tx - 1, 36, black, $eb_text)
	$mining_display_lcd.write($eb_tx + 1, 36, black, $eb_text)
	$mining_display_lcd.write($eb_tx, 35, black, $eb_text)
	$mining_display_lcd.write($eb_tx, 37, black, $eb_text)
	$mining_display_lcd.write($eb_tx, 36, white, $eb_text)

function @mining_display_render()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		if $mining_display_key != "OFF"
			$mining_display_lcd.blank(black)
			$mining_display_key = "OFF"
		return
	var $mining_display_cargo = ""
	var $cargo_large = 0
	var $mining_display_cargo_changed = 0
	if $mining_display_view
		$mining_display_cargo = input_text("cargo-container", 0)
		$cargo_large = size($mining_display_cargo) > 8192
		if $cargo_large
			$mining_display_cargo = ""
		$mining_display_cargo_changed = $mining_display_cargo != $shared_mining_cargo
		if $mining_display_cargo_changed
			$mining_display_rows = 0
			foreach $mining_display_cargo ($mining_display_name, $mining_display_quantity)
				if isnumeric($mining_display_quantity)
					if $mining_display_quantity:number > 0
						$mining_display_rows += 1
			$shared_mining_cargo = $mining_display_cargo
		$mining_display_page = clamp($mining_display_page, 0, max($mining_display_rows-4,0))
	var $drill = 0
	if !$mining_display_view
		$drill = device_type("mining-drill") == "MiningDrill"
	var $ore = ""
	var $rate = "--"
	var $eff = "--"
	var $eff_value = -1
	var $ore_large = 0
	if $drill
		$ore = input_text("mining-drill", 0)
		$ore_large = size($ore) > 2048
		if $ore_large
			$ore = ""
		var $mining_rate = input_number("mining-drill", 3)
		var $efficiency = input_number("mining-drill", 2)
		if ($mining_rate >= 0) and ($mining_rate < 1000000)
			$rate = text("{0.0} RK/s", $mining_rate)
		if ($efficiency >= 0) and ($efficiency <= 1)
			; Direct drill channel 2, with fractional percentage visible.
			$eff = text("{0.0}%", $efficiency * 100)
			$eff_value = $efficiency
	var $ore_changed = 0
	if !$mining_display_view
		$ore_changed = $ore != $mining_display_ore_cache
	if $ore_changed
		$mining_display_ore_rows = 0
		foreach $ore ($symbol, $fraction)
			if @mining_display_fraction($fraction) > 0
				$mining_display_ore_rows += 1
		$mining_display_ore_cache = $ore
	$mining_display_ore_page = clamp($mining_display_ore_page, 0, max($mining_display_ore_rows-8,0))
	var $mass = @mining_limit_mass()
	var $md_anchor=input_number("left-anchor",0)
	var $md_status=@mining_panel_status($md_anchor,$mass)
	; Never concatenate a potentially large inventory into a short frame-key text.
	var $mining_display_frame = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $mining_display_page, $mining_display_view, $mining_display_ore_page, $sqx_sw49_mine__m, $md_anchor, $md_status, $rate, $eff, $eff_value, $drill, $ore_large, $cargo_large)
	$mining_display_frame = text("{},{}", $mining_display_frame, $units_revision)
	if (!$mining_display_cargo_changed) and (!$ore_changed) and ($mining_display_frame == $mining_display_key)
		return
	var $full=($md_view!=$mining_display_view) or ($mining_display_key=="OFF")
	$md_view=$mining_display_view
	if $full
		$mining_display_lcd.blank($mining_display_ink)
	var $header=text("{}|{}|{}",$mining_display_view,$rate,$eff)
	if $full or ($header!=$md_header)
		$md_header=$header
		$mining_display_lcd.draw_rect(0,0,300,54,$mining_display_ink,$mining_display_ink)
		@mining_display_center_text(75, 9, 1.1, orange, "MINING")
		if !$mining_display_view
			@mining_display_center_text(42, 21, 0.65, cyan, text("RATE {}", $rate))
			@mining_eff_bar($eff, $eff_value)
		else
			@mining_display_center_text(75, 21, 0.65, cyan, "INVENTORY")
	if $full
		var $ore_ink = red
		var $cargo_ink = cyan
		if !$mining_display_view
			$ore_ink = cyan
			$cargo_ink = red
		@access_action_frame($mining_display_lcd, 8, 56, 138, 24, $ore_ink, color(18, 24, 32))
		@access_action_frame($mining_display_lcd, 154, 56, 138, 24, $cargo_ink, color(18, 24, 32))
		@mining_display_center_text(38.5, 34, 0.7, $ore_ink, "UNDER DRILL")
		@mining_display_center_text(111.5, 34, 0.7, $cargo_ink, "CARGO")
	var $listkey=text("{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",$mining_display_page,$mining_display_ore_page,$units_revision,$drill,$ore_large,$cargo_large)
	var $listdirty=$full or $mining_display_cargo_changed or $ore_changed or ($listkey!=$md_list)
	if $listdirty
		$md_list=$listkey
		$mining_display_lcd.draw_rect(0,84,299,233,$mining_display_ink,$mining_display_ink)
		var $index = 0
		if !$mining_display_view
			foreach $ore ($symbol, $fraction)
				var $value = @mining_display_fraction($fraction)
				if $value > 0
					if ($index >= $mining_display_ore_page) and ($index < $mining_display_ore_page+8)
						var $y = 45 + ($index-$mining_display_ore_page) * 9
						@mining_display_text(6, $y, 0.8, white, @mining_display_ore_name($symbol))
						@mining_display_text(105, $y, 0.8, cyan, text("{0.0}%", $value * 100))
					$index += 1
			if !$mining_display_ore_rows
				var $empty = "NO ORE DATA"
				if !$drill
					$empty = "NO DRILL LINK"
				elseif $ore_large
					$empty = "ORE DATA TOO LARGE"
				elseif $ore != ""
					$empty = "NO ORE DETECTED"
				@mining_display_center_text(75, 70, 0.8, gray, $empty)
		else
			foreach $mining_display_cargo ($mining_display_item, $mining_display_value)
				var $mining_display_count = 0
				if isnumeric($mining_display_value)
					$mining_display_count = $mining_display_value:number
				if $mining_display_count > 0
					if ($index >= $mining_display_page) and ($index < $mining_display_page+4)
						var $y = 45 + ($index-$mining_display_page) * 19
						@mining_display_row($y, $mining_display_item, $mining_display_count)
					$index += 1
			if !$mining_display_rows
				var $empty = "EMPTY"
				if $cargo_large
					$empty = "CARGO DATA TOO LARGE"
				@mining_display_center_text(75, 70, 0.8, gray, $empty)
		var $first=$mining_display_ore_page
		var $total=$mining_display_ore_rows
		var $visible=8
		if $mining_display_view
			$first=$mining_display_page
			$total=$mining_display_rows
			$visible=4
		@du_scroll($mining_display_lcd,276,86,146,$first,$total,$visible)
	var $footer=text("{}|{}|{}",$md_status,$sqx_sw49_mine__m,input_number("left-anchor",0))
	if $full or ($footer!=$md_footer)
		$md_footer=$footer
		$mining_display_lcd.draw_rect(0,234,299,299,$mining_display_ink,$mining_display_ink)
		var $mining_display_status=$md_status
		; T5i: keep the status text wholly inside the footer band (y 234+). It
		; used to start above 234, so when the status changed, the cleared footer
		; left the top pixels of the old text as a dashed line under the list.
		var $md_status_text = substring($mining_display_status, 0, 36)

function @msgs_add($label:text,$bit:number)
	if ($label=="") or ($label=="0")
		return
	foreach $msgs_texts ($mi,$mt)
		if $mt==$label
			return
	$msgs_texts.append($label)
	$msgs_bits.append($bit)

function @msgs_remember($label:text,$bit:number)
	foreach $msgs_history_texts ($mi,$mt)
		if $mt==$label
			return
	if $msgs_history_texts.size>=32
		$msgs_history_texts.erase(0)
		$msgs_history_bits.erase(0)
	$msgs_history_texts.append($label)
	$msgs_history_bits.append($bit)

function @msgs_ink($label:text,$bit:number) : number
	if $bit>0
		return red
	if $label=="AIRCRAFT SECURED"
		return green
	if $label=="MINIMUMS"
		return red
	return orange

function @msgs_recall($index:number) : number
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or ($index<0) or ($index>=$msgs_texts.size)
		return 0
	var $bit=$msgs_bits.$index
	var $label=$msgs_texts.$index
	$notice_recall_active=0
	if $bit>0
		if @warnings_active($bit) and (@warnings_message($bit)==$label)
			$standby_ui_until=max($standby_ui_until,time+0.6)
			return @warnings_recall($bit)
	$notice_recall_text=$label
	$notice_recall_ink=@msgs_ink($label,$bit)
	$notice_recall_active=1
	if $label=="AIRCRAFT SECURED"
		if $ui_secure_last==1
			$notice_recall_ink=green
			$ui_secure_pending=1
		else
			$notice_recall_text="PREVIOUS: AIRCRAFT SECURED"
	elseif $bit>0
		$notice_recall_text="PREVIOUS: "&$label
	$flight_status_last_drawn="__RECALL__"
	$standby_ui_until=max($standby_ui_until,time+0.6)
	return 1

function @msgs_sync()
	var $ore=($ore_notices_message!="") and ($ore_notices_pending or (time<$ore_notices_until))
	var $info=($du_message!="") and (time<$du_message_until)
	var $secure=$ui_secure_last==1
	var $key=text("{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",$warnings_active_bits,$rott,$craft_weight_message,$ore,$ore_notices_message,$info,$du_message,$secure,$seal_cockpit,$seal_fuselage)
	var $msg_minimums=time<$minimums_until
	$key&=text("|{}|{}|{}",$mission_mode,$mission_status,$msg_minimums)
	if $key==$msgs_key
		return
	$msgs_key=$key
	$msgs_texts.clear()
	$msgs_bits.clear()
	repeat 12 ($i)
		var $bit=pow(2,$i)
		if @warnings_active($bit)
			@msgs_add(@warnings_message($bit),$bit)
	if (!@warnings_active(8)) and ($craft_weight_message!="")
		@msgs_add($craft_weight_message,0)
	if $ore
		@msgs_add($ore_notices_message,-1)
	if $info
		@msgs_add($du_message,0)
	if $mission_mode and ($mission_status!="")
		@msgs_add($mission_status,0)
	if $secure
		@msgs_add("AIRCRAFT SECURED",0)
	if $msg_minimums
		@msgs_add("MINIMUMS",0)
	; Clearing acknowledges a continuous benign notice, not its next occurrence.
	var $cleared_count=$msgs_cleared_texts.size
	repeat $cleared_count ($ci)
		var $idx=$cleared_count-1-$ci
		var $found=0
		foreach $msgs_texts ($mi,$mt)
			if ($mt==$msgs_cleared_texts.$idx) and ($msgs_bits.$mi<=0)
				$found=1
		if !$found
			$msgs_cleared_texts.erase($idx)
	var $current_count=$msgs_texts.size
	repeat $current_count ($ci)
		var $idx=$current_count-1-$ci
		var $cleared=0
		if $msgs_bits.$idx<=0
			foreach $msgs_cleared_texts ($mi,$mt)
				if $mt==$msgs_texts.$idx
					$cleared=1
		if $cleared
			$msgs_texts.erase($idx)
			$msgs_bits.erase($idx)
	$msgs_pending_count=$msgs_texts.size
	$msgs_pending_alert=0
	foreach $msgs_texts ($mi,$mt)
		if ($msgs_bits.$mi>0) or ($mt!="AIRCRAFT SECURED")
			$msgs_pending_alert=1
	foreach $msgs_texts ($mi,$mt)
		@msgs_remember($mt,$msgs_bits.$mi)
	var $history_count=$msgs_history_texts.size
	repeat $history_count ($mi)
		var $mh=$msgs_history_texts.size-1-$mi
		@msgs_add($msgs_history_texts.$mh,$msgs_history_bits.$mh)
	$msgs_first=clamp($msgs_first,0,max($msgs_texts.size-5,0))
	$msgs_revision+=1

function @msgs_clear()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	@msgs_sync()
	var $count=$msgs_pending_count
	repeat $count ($mi)
		if $msgs_bits.$mi<=0
			$msgs_cleared_texts.append($msgs_texts.$mi)
	$msgs_history_texts.clear()
	$msgs_history_bits.clear()
	$ui_secure_pending=0
	$notice_recall_active=0
	$flight_status_last_drawn="__CLEAR__"
	$msgs_first=0
	$msgs_dragging=0
	$msgs_key="__CLEAR__"
	$msgs_button_last=-1

	@throttle_display_text(119,230,0.8,cyan,"CLEAR")
	if !$msgs_texts.size
		@throttle_display_text(75,112,0.8,green,"NO ACTIVE NOTICES")
	else
		repeat 5 ($row)
			var $index=$msgs_first+$row
			if $index>=$msgs_texts.size
				break
			var $y=40+$row*34
			var $ink=@msgs_ink($msgs_texts.$index,$msgs_bits.$index)
			if ($msgs_bits.$index>0) and ($index>=$msgs_pending_count)
				$ink=orange
			if ($msgs_bits.$index>0) and ($index<$msgs_pending_count)
				$ink=red
			$throttle_display_lcd.draw_line(8,$y+31,124,$y+31,color(45,57,68))
			$throttle_display_lcd.text_size(0.8)
			@du_wrap($msgs_texts.$index,max(1,floor(112/max($throttle_display_lcd.char_w,1))))
			var $lines=min(3,$du_wrap_lines.size)
			repeat $lines ($line)
				$throttle_display_lcd.write(9,$y+$line*9,$ink,$du_wrap_lines.$line)
			if $msgs_bits.$index==-1 and $ore_notices_pending
				; Same six-second seen lifetime as displaying the ORE notice.
				$ore_notices_pending=0
				$ore_notices_until=time+6
		@du_scroll($throttle_display_lcd,130,40,174,$msgs_first,$msgs_texts.size,5)
		@throttle_display_text(46,230,0.6,gray,text("{0}-{0} / {0}",$msgs_first+1,min($msgs_first+5,$msgs_texts.size),$msgs_texts.size))

function @msgs_scroll($delta:number)
	$msgs_dragging=0
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or ($throttle_display_view!=2) or $craft_weight_page
		return
	$msgs_first=clamp($msgs_first-sign($delta),0,max($msgs_texts.size-5,0))

function @throttle_display_prepare()
	$throttle_display_background.blank($throttle_display_ink)
	$throttle_display_background.text_align(top_left)
	$throttle_display_background.text_size(1.1)
	$throttle_display_background.write(48.6, 7, cyan, "THROTTLE")
	$throttle_display_background.draw_rect(4, 3, 28, 23, cyan)
	$throttle_display_background.write(12, 7, cyan, "<")
	$throttle_display_background.draw_rect(72, 45, 78, 200, gray, color(18, 24, 32))
	repeat 9 ($throttle_display_tick)
		var $throttle_display_y = 45 + $throttle_display_tick * 19.375
		var $throttle_display_half_width = 7
		if mod($throttle_display_tick, 2) == 0
			$throttle_display_half_width = 11
			var $throttle_display_number = text("{0}", 100 - $throttle_display_tick * 25)
			$throttle_display_background.text_size(0.8)
			$throttle_display_background.write(42 - size($throttle_display_number) * $throttle_display_background.char_w, $throttle_display_y - 3.2, white, $throttle_display_number)
		$throttle_display_background.draw_line(75 - $throttle_display_half_width, $throttle_display_y, 75 + $throttle_display_half_width, $throttle_display_y, gray)
	$throttle_display_ready = 1

function @throttle_display_alerts()
	$throttle_display_lcd.draw_rect(0,0,150,244,$throttle_display_ink,$throttle_display_ink)
	@draw_rounded_box($throttle_display_lcd,2,2,148,243,8,color(76,93,108))
	@throttle_display_text(75, 14, 1.1, cyan, "ALARMS")
	repeat 12 ($tile)
		var $x = 8 + mod($tile, 2) * 72
		var $y = 30 + floor($tile / 2) * 29
		var $lit = @warnings_active(pow(2, $tile))
		var $ink = color(75, 84, 94)
		var $fill = color(13, 20, 28)
		if $tile>=10
			var $seal_state=$seal_cockpit
			if $tile==11
				$seal_state=$seal_fuselage
			if $seal_state==1
				$ink=green
			elseif $seal_state==3
				$ink=orange
		if $lit
			$ink = red
			$fill = color(58, 9, 14)
		$throttle_display_lcd.draw_rect($x, $y, $x + 62, $y + 24, $ink, $fill)
		@throttle_display_text($x + 31, $y + 12, 1.1, $ink, @throttle_display_label($tile))
	@throttle_display_text(75, 212, 0.65, gray, "TAP TO RECALL")
	$throttle_display_lcd.draw_rect(8,222,72,242,cyan)
	@throttle_display_text(40,232,1,cyan,"THRUST")
	$msgs_button_last=-1
	@msgs_button()

function @throttle_display_click($x : number, $y : number)
	$msgs_dragging=0
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	if $craft_weight_page
		if ($x>=4) and ($x<=28) and ($y>=3) and ($y<=26)
			$craft_weight_page=0
			$throttle_display_key=""
		return
	if $y>=245
		$craft_weight_page=1
		@craft_weight_sample(1)
		$throttle_display_key=""
		return
	if $throttle_display_view==2
		if ($x>=4) and ($x<=28) and ($y>=3) and ($y<=23)
			$throttle_display_view=0
			$throttle_display_key=""
		elseif ($x>=94) and ($x<=144) and ($y>=219) and ($y<=240)
			@msgs_clear()
		elseif ($x>=130) and ($x<=146) and ($y>=40) and ($y<214)
			@msgs_scroll_touch($y)
		elseif ($x>=8) and ($x<=124) and ($y>=40) and ($y<210)
			@msgs_recall($msgs_first+floor(($y-40)/34))
		return
	if $throttle_display_view
		if ($x >= 4) and ($x <= 28) and ($y >= 3) and ($y <= 23)
			$throttle_display_view = 0
			$throttle_display_key = ""
		return
	if ($x>=78) and ($x<=142) and ($y>=222) and ($y<=242)
		$throttle_display_view=2
		$msgs_first=0
		$throttle_display_key=""
		return
	if ($x >= 8) and ($x <= 72) and ($y >= 222) and ($y <= 242)
		$throttle_display_view = 1
		$throttle_display_key = ""
		return
	var $col = floor(($x - 8) / 72)
	var $row = floor(($y - 30) / 29)
	if ($col < 0) or ($col > 1) or ($row < 0) or ($row > 5)
		return
	if ($x > 8 + $col * 72 + 62) or ($y > 30 + $row * 29 + 24)
		return
	@warnings_recall(pow(2, $row * 2 + $col))

var $ta_ready=0
var $ta_view=-1
var $ta_body=""
var $ta_weight=""
var $ta_body_builds=0
var $ta_weight_builds=0

function @ta_update()
	var $full=(!$ta_ready) or ($ta_view!=$throttle_display_view) or ($throttle_display_power!=1)
	var $body=text("{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",$warnings_active_bits,$warnings_dismissed,$seal_cockpit,$seal_fuselage,$units_revision)
	if $throttle_display_view==2
		$body=text("M|{}|{}|{}",$msgs_revision,$msgs_first,$units_revision)
	if $full or ($body!=$ta_body)
		if $throttle_display_view==2
			@msgs_render()
		else
			@throttle_display_alerts()
		$ta_body=$body
		$ta_body_builds+=1
	var $weight=text("{0}|{0}|{}|{}|{}|{}",$craft_weight_mass,$craft_weight_load,$craft_weight_valid,$craft_weight_overload,$units_revision,$craft_weight_load_limit)
	if $full or ($weight!=$ta_weight)
		@craft_weight_compact($throttle_display_lcd)
		$ta_weight=$weight
		$ta_weight_builds+=1
	if $throttle_display_view==0
		@msgs_button()
	$ta_ready=1
	$ta_view=$throttle_display_view
	$throttle_display_power=1
	$throttle_display_key=text("{}|{}",$body,$weight)


function @throttle_display_render()
	if !@sw_in_2()
		if $throttle_display_power != 0
			$throttle_display_lcd.blank(black)
		$ta_ready=0
		$throttle_display_power = 0
		$throttle_display_key = ""
		return
	if !$throttle_display_ready
		@throttle_display_prepare()
	@msgs_sync()
	@craft_weight_sample(0)
	if (!$craft_weight_page) and (($throttle_display_view==0) or ($throttle_display_view==2))
		@ta_update()
		return
	$ta_ready=0
	if ($throttle_display_view==2) and (!$craft_weight_page)
		var $mf=text("MSGS,{},{},{0}",$msgs_revision,$msgs_first,$craft_weight_mass)
		if ($throttle_display_power==1) and ($mf==$throttle_display_key)
			return
		@msgs_render()
		@craft_weight_compact($throttle_display_lcd)
		$throttle_display_power=1
		$throttle_display_key=$mf
		return
	; SET is the actual lever value; AP already mirrors its output into that lever.
	; AP is the existing signed collective command ($throt), not rotor RPM/power.
	var $throttle_display_setting = 0
	var $throttle_display_command = 0
	var $throttle_display_ap = 0
	var $throttle_display_actual_fpm = 0
	var $throttle_display_request_fpm = 0
	var $throttle_display_frame = ""
	if $throttle_display_view and (!$craft_weight_page)
		$throttle_display_setting = round(clamp(input_number("thrust", 0), -1, 1) * 100)
		$throttle_display_command = round(clamp($throt, -1, 1) * 100)
		$throttle_display_ap = @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling()
		$throttle_display_actual_fpm = round(@standby_nav(1) * 196.8503937 / 10) * 10
		$throttle_display_request_fpm = round($systems_display_vs * 196.8503937 / 10) * 10
		$throttle_display_frame = text("{},{},{},{},{}", $throttle_display_setting, $throttle_display_command, $throttle_display_ap, $throttle_display_actual_fpm, $throttle_display_request_fpm)
	if !$throttle_display_view
		$throttle_display_frame = text("ALRT,{},{},{},{}", $warnings_active_bits, $warnings_dismissed,$seal_cockpit,$seal_fuselage)
	$throttle_display_frame = text("{},{}", $throttle_display_view, $throttle_display_frame)
	$throttle_display_frame = text("{},{},{0},{0},{},{}", $throttle_display_frame, $craft_weight_page, $craft_weight_mass, $craft_weight_load, $craft_weight_valid, $craft_weight_overload)
	if $craft_weight_page
		$throttle_display_frame = text("{},{},{},{0.00},{0.00},{0.00},{}", $throttle_display_frame, $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m, (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) and @craft_weight_same_pose(), $craft_weight_x * 3.280839895, $craft_weight_y * 3.280839895, $craft_weight_z * 3.280839895, $sqx_sw49_rotors__m)
	$throttle_display_frame = text("{},{}", $throttle_display_frame, $units_revision)
	if (!$throttle_display_view) and (!$craft_weight_page)
		@msgs_button()
	if ($throttle_display_power == 1) and ($throttle_display_frame == $throttle_display_key)
		return
	if $craft_weight_page
		@craft_weight_details($throttle_display_lcd)
		$throttle_display_key = $throttle_display_frame
		$throttle_display_power = 1
		return
	if !$throttle_display_view
		@throttle_display_alerts()
		@craft_weight_compact($throttle_display_lcd)
		$throttle_display_key = $throttle_display_frame
		$throttle_display_power = 1
		return
	screen_copy($throttle_display_background, $throttle_display_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 150, 300)
	@throttle_display_text(42, 30, 0.95, white, text("SET {0}%", $throttle_display_setting))
	var $throttle_display_setting_y = 122.5 - $throttle_display_setting * 0.775
	$throttle_display_lcd.draw_triangle(60, $throttle_display_setting_y - 5, 71, $throttle_display_setting_y, 60, $throttle_display_setting_y + 5, white, white)
	if $throttle_display_ap
		@throttle_display_text(114, 30, 0.95, $throttle_display_magenta, text("AP {0}%", $throttle_display_command))
		var $throttle_display_command_y = 122.5 - $throttle_display_command * 0.775
		$throttle_display_lcd.draw_triangle(90, $throttle_display_command_y - 5, 79, $throttle_display_command_y, 90, $throttle_display_command_y + 5, $throttle_display_magenta, $throttle_display_magenta)
		@throttle_display_text(75, 216, 0.85, $throttle_display_magenta, @units_choice(text("CMD {0} FPM", $throttle_display_request_fpm), text("CMD {0.0} m/s", $throttle_display_request_fpm / 196.8503937)))
	else
		@throttle_display_text(114, 30, 0.95, gray, "AP --")
	@throttle_display_text(75, 235, 0.85, white, @units_choice(text("V/S {0} FPM", $throttle_display_actual_fpm), text("V/S {0.0} m/s", $throttle_display_actual_fpm / 196.8503937)))
	@craft_weight_compact($throttle_display_lcd)
	$throttle_display_key = $throttle_display_frame
	$throttle_display_power = 1

xc_files.name: diagnostics.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Diagnostics.

; Diagnostic-only bounded recorder. No device or flight-control writes.
; Every row is ASCII and <=192 bytes, built incrementally BEFORE concatenation.
; Both entry count and total text bytes are bounded BEFORE appending.
storage array $sqd_flight_log : text
storage array $sqx_ad41_log : text
storage var $sqx_lg13_version : number
var $sqx_lg13_version__m : number
const $diagnostics_row_limit = 192
const $diagnostics_flight_rows = 128
const $diagnostics_dock_rows = 64
const $diagnostics_flight_bytes = 24576
const $diagnostics_dock_bytes = 12288
var $diagnostics_ready = 0
var $diagnostics_flight_used = 0
var $diagnostics_dock_used = 0
var $diagnostics_kind = 0
var $diagnostics_stamp = ""
var $diagnostics_row = ""
var $diagnostics_field = 0
var $diagnostics_first = 0

function @diagnostics_boot()
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	if $diagnostics_ready
		return
	; Legacy CSV rows may exceed the new limits; never migrate settings here.
	if $sqx_lg13_version__m != 1
		$sqd_flight_log.clear()
		$sqx_ad41_log.clear()
		if $sqx_lg13_version__m != 1
			$sqx_lg13_version = 1
			$sqx_lg13_version__m = $sqx_lg13_version
	if $sqd_flight_log.size > $diagnostics_flight_rows
		$sqd_flight_log.clear()
	if $sqx_ad41_log.size > $diagnostics_dock_rows
		$sqx_ad41_log.clear()
	$diagnostics_flight_used = 0
	foreach $sqd_flight_log ($lg_i, $lg_row)
		if size($lg_row) > $diagnostics_row_limit
			$diagnostics_flight_used = $diagnostics_flight_bytes + 1
			break
		$diagnostics_flight_used += size($lg_row) + 1
	if $diagnostics_flight_used > $diagnostics_flight_bytes
		$sqd_flight_log.clear()
		$diagnostics_flight_used = 0
	$diagnostics_dock_used = 0
	foreach $sqx_ad41_log ($lg_i, $lg_row)
		if size($lg_row) > $diagnostics_row_limit
			$diagnostics_dock_used = $diagnostics_dock_bytes + 1
			break
		$diagnostics_dock_used += size($lg_row) + 1
	if $diagnostics_dock_used > $diagnostics_dock_bytes
		$sqx_ad41_log.clear()
		$diagnostics_dock_used = 0
	$diagnostics_ready = 1

function @diagnostics_numeric($lg_value : number) : text
	; Guard BEFORE formatting, not substring(text(...)) after an oversized result.
	if $lg_value != $lg_value
		return "NAN"
	if $lg_value > 9999999999
		return "OVR+"
	if $lg_value < -9999999999
		return "OVR-"
	return text("{}", $lg_value)

function @diagnostics_store($lg_line : text)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	var $lg_bytes = size($lg_line) + 1
	if ($lg_bytes > $diagnostics_row_limit + 1) or ($lg_bytes <= 1)
		return
	if $diagnostics_kind == 0
		while ($sqd_flight_log.size >= $diagnostics_flight_rows) or (($diagnostics_flight_used + $lg_bytes) > $diagnostics_flight_bytes)
			if $sqd_flight_log.size == 0
				$diagnostics_flight_used = 0
				break
			$diagnostics_flight_used -= size($sqd_flight_log.0) + 1
			$sqd_flight_log.erase(0)
		$sqd_flight_log.append($lg_line)
		$diagnostics_flight_used += $lg_bytes
	else
		while ($sqx_ad41_log.size >= $diagnostics_dock_rows) or (($diagnostics_dock_used + $lg_bytes) > $diagnostics_dock_bytes)
			if $sqx_ad41_log.size == 0
				$diagnostics_dock_used = 0
				break
			$diagnostics_dock_used -= size($sqx_ad41_log.0) + 1
			$sqx_ad41_log.erase(0)
		$sqx_ad41_log.append($lg_line)
		$diagnostics_dock_used += $lg_bytes

function @diagnostics_prefix() : text
	var $lg_tag = "F"
	if $diagnostics_kind == 1
		$lg_tag = "D"
	return text("{},{},{0}", $lg_tag, $diagnostics_stamp, $diagnostics_field)

function @diagnostics_begin($lg_kind : number, $lg_time : number)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	@diagnostics_boot()
	$diagnostics_kind = $lg_kind
	$diagnostics_stamp = @diagnostics_numeric($lg_time)
	$diagnostics_field = 0
	$diagnostics_first = 0
	$diagnostics_row = @diagnostics_prefix()

function @diagnostics_put($lg_token : text)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	; All tokens reaching here are already bounded ASCII (numeric <=18, word <=24).
	if size($lg_token) > 24
		return
	if size($diagnostics_row) + size($lg_token) + 1 > $diagnostics_row_limit
		@diagnostics_store($diagnostics_row)
		$diagnostics_first = $diagnostics_field
		$diagnostics_row = @diagnostics_prefix()
	$diagnostics_row &= "," & $lg_token
	$diagnostics_field += 1

function @diagnostics_number($lg_value : number)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	@diagnostics_put(@diagnostics_numeric($lg_value))

function @diagnostics_word($lg_value : text)
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	var $lg_token = ""
	var $lg_count = min(size($lg_value), 24)
	repeat $lg_count ($lg_char_i)
		var $lg_char = substring($lg_value, $lg_char_i, 1)
		if !contains("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_- .", $lg_char)
			$lg_char = "?"
		$lg_token &= $lg_char
	@diagnostics_put($lg_token)

function @diagnostics_finish()
	if !$standby_diagnostics
		return
	if $diagnostics_field > $diagnostics_first
		@diagnostics_store($diagnostics_row)
	$diagnostics_row = ""

; Session-only warning acknowledgements. Shared by display and the audio owners.
; Raw active bits remain lit after dismissal; only a cleared condition rearms it.
var $warnings_dismissed = 0
var $warnings_active_bits = 0
var $warnings_recall_bit = 0
var $warnings_recall_until = 0

; Read-only alarm observers. No attitude, rotor or AP command is changed.
var $pullup_alert_pull_active = 0
var $pullup_alert_recovery_seconds = 0
var $pullup_alert_previous_pitch = 0
var $pullup_alert_pitch_initialized = 0
var $pullup_alert_stall_seconds = 0
var $pullup_alert_stall_active = 0

function @pullup_alert_pull($enabled : number, $speed : number, $height : number, $vertical : number, $pitch : number, $dt : number)
	var $pitch_stable = 0
	if $pullup_alert_pitch_initialized and ($dt > 0.000001) and ($dt <= 0.1)
		; Nav pitch is positive nose-down, normalized to 180 degrees.
		$pitch_stable = (abs($pitch - $pullup_alert_previous_pitch) * 180 / $dt) <= 5
	$pullup_alert_previous_pitch = $pitch
	$pullup_alert_pitch_initialized = 1
	if !$enabled
		$pullup_alert_pull_active = 0
		$pullup_alert_recovery_seconds = 0
		$pullup_alert_pitch_initialized = 0
		return
	; Statute mph and feet converted once to native m/s and metres.
	; Small vertical sensor noise is not descent. Nose-up must not mask sinking.
	if (abs($speed) > 15.6464) and ($height < 15.24) and ($vertical < -0.1)
		$pullup_alert_pull_active = 1
		$pullup_alert_recovery_seconds = 0
	if abs($speed) < 11.176
		$pullup_alert_pull_active = 0
		$pullup_alert_recovery_seconds = 0
		return
	if ($height > 16.764) and ($vertical >= -0.1) and $pitch_stable
		$pullup_alert_recovery_seconds += clamp($dt, 0, 0.1)
		if $pullup_alert_recovery_seconds >= 1
			$pullup_alert_pull_active = 0
	else
		$pullup_alert_recovery_seconds = 0

function @pullup_alert_stall($enabled : number, $high_pitch : number, $vertical : number, $dt : number)
	if (!$enabled) or (!$high_pitch) or ($vertical >= -0.6)
		$pullup_alert_stall_seconds = 0
		$pullup_alert_stall_active = 0
		return
	$pullup_alert_stall_seconds = min($pullup_alert_stall_seconds + clamp($dt, 0, 0.1), 1)
	$pullup_alert_stall_active = $pullup_alert_stall_seconds >= 1

function @warnings_active($warning_bit : number) : number
	return mod(floor($warnings_active_bits / $warning_bit), 2)

function @warnings_allowed($warning_bit : number, $respect_ack : number) : number
	return (!$respect_ack) or (mod(floor($warnings_dismissed / $warning_bit), 2) == 0)

function @warnings_track($warning_bit : number, $warning_active : number)
	; T4v: @warnings_active inlined (same expression).
	if $warning_active
		if !mod(floor($warnings_active_bits / $warning_bit), 2)
			$warnings_active_bits += $warning_bit
	else
		$warnings_active_bits -= $warning_bit * mod(floor($warnings_active_bits / $warning_bit), 2)
		$warnings_dismissed -= $warning_bit * mod(floor($warnings_dismissed / $warning_bit), 2)
		if $warnings_recall_bit == $warning_bit
			$warnings_recall_bit = 0
			$warnings_recall_until = 0

xc_files.plain_code:
; Ore map.

; Display-only world grid. Reuses the ONE scanner pass; no actuator outputs.
; 64x64 toroidal cells: bounded lookup, bounded persistent storage, no hit search.
storage array $sqx_om20_keys : number
storage array $sqx_om20_colors : number
storage var $sqx_om20_valid : number
var $sqx_om20_valid__m : number
storage var $sqx_om20_lat : number
var $sqx_om20_lat__m : number
storage var $sqx_om20_lon : number
var $sqx_om20_lon__m : number
storage var $sqx_om20_radius : number
var $sqx_om20_radius__m : number
storage var $sqx_om20_body : text

function @ts_load()
	; from() supports storage/RAM conversion and copies, rather than aliases.
	$ts_keys.from($sqx_om20_keys)
	$ts_heights.from($sqx_om20_colors)
	$ts_far_keys.from($terrain_far_keys)
	$ts_far_heights.from($terrain_far_heights)
	$ts_flags.fill(12288,0)
	$ts_pending.clear()
	$ts_count = $sqx_om20_count__m
	$ts_far_count = $terrain_far_count__m
	$ts_due = 0
	$ts_ready = 1
	$ts_epoch = 1
	$ts_fine_dirty = 0
	$ts_far_dirty = 0

function @ts_mark($slot : number)
	if $ts_flags.$slot != $ts_epoch
		if !$ts_pending.size
			$ts_due = time+30
		$ts_flags.$slot = $ts_epoch
		$ts_pending.append($slot)
	if $slot < 4096
		$ts_fine_dirty = 1
	else
		$ts_far_dirty = 1

function @ts_flush()
	if !$ts_ready or !$ts_pending.size
		return
	; A bounded native snapshot avoids an interpreted loop over up to 12288 cells
	; on the save tick. Untouched layers and clean intervals make no assignments.
	if $ts_fine_dirty
		$sqx_om20_keys.from($ts_keys)
		$sqx_om20_colors.from($ts_heights)
	if $ts_far_dirty
		$terrain_far_keys.from($ts_far_keys)
		$terrain_far_heights.from($ts_far_heights)
	if $sqx_om20_count__m != $ts_count
		$sqx_om20_count = $ts_count
		$sqx_om20_count__m = $sqx_om20_count
	if $terrain_far_count__m != $ts_far_count
		$terrain_far_count = $ts_far_count
		$terrain_far_count__m = $terrain_far_count
	$ts_pending.clear()
	$ts_due = 0
	$ts_saves += 1
	$ts_epoch += 1
	$ts_fine_dirty = 0
	$ts_far_dirty = 0

function @ts_tick($running : number,$power : number)
	if $ts_pending.size
		if (time >= $ts_due) or !$running or !$power
			@ts_flush()

function @ore_map_prepare_mask()
	if $ore_map_mask_ready
		return
	$ore_map_mask.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	var $mask_ink = color(8, 14, 22)
	; Match the actual outer compass rim: centre (150,240), radius 156.
	; Filled spans use exclusive right/bottom bounds; include the final column.
	repeat 300 ($mask_y)
		var $mask_dy = $mask_y - 240
		if abs($mask_dy) > 156
			$ore_map_mask.draw_rect(0, $mask_y, 300, $mask_y + 1, $mask_ink, $mask_ink)
		else
			var $mask_half = sqrt(max(156 * 156 - $mask_dy * $mask_dy, 0))
			var $mask_left = ceil(150 - $mask_half) - 1
			var $mask_right = floor(150 + $mask_half) + 1
			if $mask_left >= 0
				$ore_map_mask.draw_rect(0, $mask_y, min($mask_left + 1, 300), $mask_y + 1, $mask_ink, $mask_ink)
			if $mask_right < 300
				$ore_map_mask.draw_rect(max($mask_right, 0), $mask_y, 300, $mask_y + 1, $mask_ink, $mask_ink)
	$ore_map_mask_ready = 1

function @terrain_cell($tc_level : number) : number
	if $tc_level == 1
		return 256
	if $tc_level == 2
		return 1024
	return $sqx_om20_cell__m

function @terrain_level($tl_range : number) : number
	if $tl_range <= $sqx_om20_cell__m * 28
		return 0
	if $tl_range <= 7168
		return 1
	return 2

function @terrain_key_at($tk_level : number, $tk_slot : number) : number
	if $tk_level == 0
		return $ts_keys.$tk_slot
	var $tk_offset = ($tk_level - 1) * 4096 + $tk_slot
	return $ts_far_keys.$tk_offset

function @terrain_height_at($th_level : number, $th_slot : number) : number
	if $th_level == 0
		return $ts_heights.$th_slot
	var $th_offset = ($th_level - 1) * 4096 + $th_slot
	return $ts_far_heights.$th_offset

function @terrain_water_at($tw_level : number, $tw_slot : number) : number
	if $tw_level == 0
		return $terrain_water_keys.$tw_slot
	var $tw_offset = ($tw_level - 1) * 4096 + $tw_slot
	return $terrain_far_water.$tw_offset

function @terrain_covered($cv_level : number, $cv_x : number, $cv_y : number) : number
	var $cv_slot = mod(mod($cv_y, 64) + 64, 64) * 64 + mod(mod($cv_x, 64) + 64, 64)
	var $cv_key = ($cv_y + 10000000) * 20000000 + $cv_x + 10000000
	return (@terrain_key_at($cv_level, $cv_slot) == $cv_key) or (@terrain_water_at($cv_level, $cv_slot) == $cv_key)

function @ore_map_boot()
	@ore_map_prepare_mask()
	$ore_map_view_ready = 0
	$ore_map_view_seen = 0
	$terrain_dirty_keys.clear()
	$terrain_dirty_levels.clear()
	$terrain_dirty_erases.clear()
	repeat 2048 ($dirty_slot)
		$terrain_dirty_keys.append(0)
		$terrain_dirty_levels.append(0)
		$terrain_dirty_erases.append(0)
	$terrain_dirty_head = 0
	$terrain_dirty_tail = 0
	$terrain_dirty_count = 0
	$terrain_publish_after = 0
	$terrain_restore_pending = 1
	$terrain_water_keys.clear()
	repeat 4096 ($water_slot)
		$terrain_water_keys.append(0)
	$terrain_water_count = 0
	$terrain_far_water.clear()
	repeat 8192 ($far_slot)
		$terrain_far_water.append(0)
	$terrain_far_water_count = 0
	$terrain_plan_valid = 0
	if ($terrain_far_keys.size != 8192) or ($terrain_far_heights.size != 8192)
		$terrain_far_keys.clear()
		$terrain_far_heights.clear()
		repeat 8192 ($far_slot)
			$terrain_far_keys.append(0)
			$terrain_far_heights.append(0)
		if $terrain_far_count__m != 0
			$terrain_far_count = 0
			$terrain_far_count__m = $terrain_far_count
	if ($terrain_cache_format__m != 1) or ($sqx_om20_keys.size != 4096) or ($sqx_om20_colors.size != 4096)
		$sqx_om20_keys.clear()
		$sqx_om20_colors.clear()
		repeat 4096 ($i)
			$sqx_om20_keys.append(0)
			$sqx_om20_colors.append(0)
		if $sqx_om20_valid__m != 0
			$sqx_om20_valid = 0
			$sqx_om20_valid__m = $sqx_om20_valid
		if $sqx_om20_count__m != 0
			$sqx_om20_count = 0
			$sqx_om20_count__m = $sqx_om20_count
		if $terrain_cache_format__m != 1
			$terrain_cache_format = 1
			$terrain_cache_format__m = $terrain_cache_format
	$ore_map_front.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$ore_map_back.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$ore_map_ready = 0
	$ore_map_build = -1
	$ore_map_request = 0
	$ore_map_reply = 0
	$ore_map_pose_ready = 0
	@ts_load()


function @ore_map_clear()
	@ore_map_boot()
	repeat 4096 ($i)
		$sqx_om20_keys.$i = 0
		$sqx_om20_colors.$i = 0
	if $sqx_om20_count__m != 0
		$sqx_om20_count = 0
		$sqx_om20_count__m = $sqx_om20_count
	repeat 8192 ($far_slot)
		$terrain_far_keys.$far_slot = 0
		$terrain_far_heights.$far_slot = 0
	if $terrain_far_count__m != 0
		$terrain_far_count = 0
		$terrain_far_count__m = $terrain_far_count
	$ore_map_revision += 1
	@ts_load()


function @ore_map_position() : number
	if (!$sqx_om20_valid__m) or ($sqx_om20_radius__m <= 1000) or ($sqx_om20_cell__m <= 0)
		return 0
	if @standby_nav_text(13) != $sqx_om20_body__m
		return 0
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	if (abs($lat) > 89) or (abs($lon) > 180)
		return 0
	if $ore_map_pose_ready and ($lat == $ore_map_pose_lat) and ($lon == $ore_map_pose_lon) and ($sqx_om20_lat__m == $ore_map_pose_base_lat) and ($sqx_om20_lon__m == $ore_map_pose_base_lon) and ($sqx_om20_radius__m == $ore_map_pose_radius)
		return 1
	$ore_map_now_n = ($lat - $sqx_om20_lat__m) * pi / 180 * $sqx_om20_radius__m
	$ore_map_now_e = (mod($lon - $sqx_om20_lon__m + 540, 360) - 180) * pi / 180 * $sqx_om20_radius__m * cos($sqx_om20_lat__m * pi / 180)
	$ore_map_pose_ready = 1
	$ore_map_pose_lat = $lat
	$ore_map_pose_lon = $lon
	$ore_map_pose_base_lat = $sqx_om20_lat__m
	$ore_map_pose_base_lon = $sqx_om20_lon__m
	$ore_map_pose_radius = $sqx_om20_radius__m
	return 1

function @ore_map_begin($range:number, $pivot:number)
	var $body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	var $radius = @standby_nav(14)
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	$ore_map_reply = 0
	if ($radius <= 1000) or ($body == "") or (abs($lat) > 89) or (abs($lon) > 180) or ($range <= 0)
		$ore_map_request = 0
		return
	if (!$sqx_om20_valid__m) or ($sqx_om20_context__m != "terrain heights") or ($body != $sqx_om20_body__m)
		@ore_map_clear()
		if $sqx_om20_lat__m != $lat
			$sqx_om20_lat = $lat
			$sqx_om20_lat__m = $sqx_om20_lat
		if $sqx_om20_lon__m != $lon
			$sqx_om20_lon = $lon
			$sqx_om20_lon__m = $sqx_om20_lon
		if $sqx_om20_radius__m != $radius
			$sqx_om20_radius = $radius
			$sqx_om20_radius__m = $sqx_om20_radius
		if $sqx_om20_body__m != $body
			$sqx_om20_body = $body
			$sqx_om20_body__m = $sqx_om20_body
		var $persist_next_217 : number
		$persist_next_217 = $range / 24
		if $sqx_om20_cell__m != $persist_next_217
			$sqx_om20_cell = $persist_next_217
			$sqx_om20_cell__m = $sqx_om20_cell
		if $sqx_om20_context__m != "terrain heights"
			$sqx_om20_context = "terrain heights"
			$sqx_om20_context__m = $sqx_om20_context
		if $sqx_om20_valid__m != 1
			$sqx_om20_valid = 1
			$sqx_om20_valid__m = $sqx_om20_valid
	if !@ore_map_position()
		$ore_map_request = 0
		return
	; Responses belong to the preceding request's location and installed bearing.
	$ore_map_reply = $ore_map_request
	$ore_map_reply_n = $ore_map_request_n
	$ore_map_reply_e = $ore_map_request_e
	$ore_map_reply_a = $ore_map_request_a
	$ore_map_reply_level = $ore_map_request_level
	$ore_map_request_n = $ore_map_now_n
	$ore_map_request_e = $ore_map_now_e
	$ore_map_request_a = @standby_nav(6) * pi / 180 - $pivot
	$ore_map_request_level = @terrain_level($range)
	$ore_map_request = 1

function @ore_map_key($x:number, $y:number) : number
	; Positive exact integer within double precision for this bounded local map.
	return ($y + 10000000) * 20000000 + $x + 10000000

function @ore_map_paint($canvas : screen, $x:number, $y:number, $height_m:number, $north:number, $east:number, $range:number, $paint_cell:number)
	if $range <= 0
		return
	if ($ore_map_paint_range != $range) or ($ore_map_paint_cell != $paint_cell)
		$ore_map_paint_range = $range
		$ore_map_paint_cell = $paint_cell
		$ore_map_paint_scale = 144 / $range
		$ore_map_paint_half = max(0.6, $paint_cell * $ore_map_paint_scale / 2)
	var $scale = $ore_map_paint_scale
	var $px = 256 + ($x * $paint_cell - $east) * $scale
	var $py = 256 - ($y * $paint_cell - $north) * $scale
	var $half = $ore_map_paint_half
	if ($px + $half >= 0) and ($px - $half < 512) and ($py + $half >= 0) and ($py - $half < 512)
		var $level = clamp($height_m * 0.0005, 0, 1)
		; Pre-mute land exactly as the former copy tint did. Opaque erasures
		; now match the NAV background instead of becoming a tinted dark seam.
		var $ink = color((26 + $level * 44) * 110 / 255, (64 + $level * 100) * 110 / 255, (34 + $level * 44) * 110 / 255)
		if $height_m == 0
			$ink = color(0, 0, 65)
		elseif $height_m < 0
			$ink = color(8, 14, 22)
		$canvas.draw_rect(max(0, floor($px - $half)), max(0, floor($py - $half)), min(512, ceil($px + $half)), min(512, ceil($py + $half)), $ink, $ink)

function @terrain_map_queue($dq_key : number, $dq_level : number, $dq_erase : number)
	if $dq_key <= 0
		return
	if $terrain_dirty_count >= 2048
		; Stored samples are authoritative: overflow falls back to a rebuild,
		; never drops recorded terrain or leaves a permanently stale image.
		$terrain_dirty_head = 0
		$terrain_dirty_tail = 0
		$terrain_dirty_count = 0
		$terrain_restore_pending = 1
	$terrain_dirty_keys.$terrain_dirty_tail = $dq_key
	$terrain_dirty_levels.$terrain_dirty_tail = $dq_level
	$terrain_dirty_erases.$terrain_dirty_tail = $dq_erase
	$terrain_dirty_tail = mod($terrain_dirty_tail + 1, 2048)
	$terrain_dirty_count += 1

function @ore_map_erase($erase_key : number, $erase_level : number)
	if $erase_key <= 0
		return
	if $terrain_enabled
		@terrain_map_queue($erase_key, $erase_level, 1)
		return
	var $erase_y = floor($erase_key / 20000000) - 10000000
	var $erase_x = mod($erase_key, 20000000) - 10000000
	if $ore_map_ready and ($ore_map_level >= $erase_level)
		@ore_map_paint($ore_map_front, $erase_x, $erase_y, -1, $ore_map_n, $ore_map_e, $ore_map_range, @terrain_cell($erase_level))
	if ($ore_map_build >= 0) and ($ore_map_next_level >= $erase_level)
		@ore_map_paint($ore_map_back, $erase_x, $erase_y, -1, $ore_map_next_n, $ore_map_next_e, $ore_map_next_range, @terrain_cell($erase_level))

function @terrain_cache_put($put_level : number, $put_x : number, $put_y : number, $put_height : number)
	if (abs($put_x) >= 9999999) or (abs($put_y) >= 9999999)
		return
	var $put_slot = mod(mod($put_y, 64) + 64, 64) * 64 + mod(mod($put_x, 64) + 64, 64)
	var $put_offset = max($put_level - 1, 0) * 4096 + $put_slot
	var $put_key = @ore_map_key($put_x, $put_y)
	var $put_old_land = @terrain_key_at($put_level, $put_slot)
	var $put_old_water = @terrain_water_at($put_level, $put_slot)
	var $put_value = max(round($put_height), 1)
	if $put_height <= 0
		if $put_old_water == $put_key
			return
		@ore_map_erase($put_old_water, $put_level)
		if $put_level == 0
			if !$put_old_water
				$terrain_water_count += 1
			$terrain_water_keys.$put_slot = $put_key
			if $put_old_land == $put_key
				$ts_keys.$put_slot = 0
				$ts_heights.$put_slot = 0
				var $persist_next_220 : number
				$persist_next_220 = max($ts_count - 1, 0)
				if $ts_count != $persist_next_220
					$ts_count = $persist_next_220
		else
			if !$put_old_water
				$terrain_far_water_count += 1
			$terrain_far_water.$put_offset = $put_key
			if $put_old_land == $put_key
				$ts_far_keys.$put_offset = 0
				$ts_far_heights.$put_offset = 0
				var $persist_next_221 : number
				$persist_next_221 = max($ts_far_count - 1, 0)
				if $ts_far_count != $persist_next_221
					$ts_far_count = $persist_next_221
		$put_value = 0
	else
		if ($put_old_land == $put_key) and (@terrain_height_at($put_level, $put_slot) == $put_value)
			return
		if $put_old_land != $put_key
			@ore_map_erase($put_old_land, $put_level)
		if $put_level == 0
			if !$put_old_land
				$ts_count += 1
			$ts_keys.$put_slot = $put_key
			$ts_heights.$put_slot = $put_value
			if $put_old_water == $put_key
				$terrain_water_keys.$put_slot = 0
				$terrain_water_count = max($terrain_water_count - 1, 0)
		else
			if !$put_old_land
				$ts_far_count += 1
			$ts_far_keys.$put_offset = $put_key
			$ts_far_heights.$put_offset = $put_value
			if $put_old_water == $put_key
				$terrain_far_water.$put_offset = 0
				$terrain_far_water_count = max($terrain_far_water_count - 1, 0)
	if ($put_height > 0) or ($put_old_land == $put_key)
		@ts_mark($put_level*4096+$put_slot)
	if $terrain_enabled
		@terrain_map_queue($put_key, $put_level, 0)
	else
		if $ore_map_ready and ($ore_map_level >= $put_level)
			@ore_map_paint($ore_map_front, $put_x, $put_y, $put_value, $ore_map_n, $ore_map_e, $ore_map_range, @terrain_cell($put_level))
		if ($ore_map_build >= 0) and ($ore_map_next_level >= $put_level)
			@ore_map_paint($ore_map_back, $put_x, $put_y, $put_value, $ore_map_next_n, $ore_map_next_e, $ore_map_next_range, @terrain_cell($put_level))
		$ore_map_revision += 1

function @terrain_map_publish()
	if (!$terrain_dirty_count) or (time < $terrain_publish_after) or ((!$ore_map_ready) and ($ore_map_build < 0))
		return
	var $pub_changed = 0
	repeat 128 ($pub_i)
		if $terrain_dirty_count > 0
			var $pub_key = $terrain_dirty_keys.$terrain_dirty_head
			var $pub_level = $terrain_dirty_levels.$terrain_dirty_head
			var $pub_erase = $terrain_dirty_erases.$terrain_dirty_head
			$terrain_dirty_head = mod($terrain_dirty_head + 1, 2048)
			$terrain_dirty_count -= 1
			var $pub_y = floor($pub_key / 20000000) - 10000000
			var $pub_x = mod($pub_key, 20000000) - 10000000
			var $pub_slot = mod(mod($pub_y, 64) + 64, 64) * 64 + mod(mod($pub_x, 64) + 64, 64)
			var $pub_land = @terrain_key_at($pub_level, $pub_slot) == $pub_key
			var $pub_water = @terrain_water_at($pub_level, $pub_slot) == $pub_key
			var $pub_height = -1
			if $pub_land
				$pub_height = @terrain_height_at($pub_level, $pub_slot)
			elseif $pub_water
				$pub_height = 0
			; Use CURRENT contents, never replay an old height over a newer one.
			if ((!$pub_erase) and ($pub_land or $pub_water)) or ($pub_erase and (!$pub_land) and (!$pub_water))
				if $ore_map_ready and ($ore_map_level >= $pub_level)
					@ore_map_paint($ore_map_front, $pub_x, $pub_y, $pub_height, $ore_map_n, $ore_map_e, $ore_map_range, @terrain_cell($pub_level))
				if ($ore_map_build >= 0) and ($ore_map_next_level >= $pub_level)
					@ore_map_paint($ore_map_back, $pub_x, $pub_y, $pub_height, $ore_map_next_n, $ore_map_next_e, $ore_map_next_range, @terrain_cell($pub_level))
				$pub_changed = 1
	$terrain_publish_after = time + 0.25
	if $pub_changed
		$ore_map_revision += 1

function @ore_map_sample($distance:number, $height_m:number)
	if (!$ore_map_reply) or ($sqx_om20_cell__m <= 0)
		return
	if (!$ore_map_trig_ready) or ($ore_map_trig_angle != $ore_map_reply_a)
		$ore_map_trig_angle = $ore_map_reply_a
		$ore_map_trig_sin = sin($ore_map_reply_a)
		$ore_map_trig_cos = cos($ore_map_reply_a)
		$ore_map_trig_ready = 1
	var $sample_cell = @terrain_cell($ore_map_reply_level)
	var $sample_x = round(($ore_map_reply_e + $ore_map_trig_sin * $distance) / $sample_cell)
	var $sample_y = round(($ore_map_reply_n + $ore_map_trig_cos * $distance) / $sample_cell)
	@terrain_cache_put($ore_map_reply_level, $sample_x, $sample_y, $height_m)

function @ore_map_tick($map_range:number)
	if ((!$ts_count) and (!$terrain_water_count) and (!$ts_far_count) and (!$terrain_far_water_count)) or !@ore_map_position() or ($map_range <= 0)
		return
	var $map_layers = 0
	if $ts_far_count or $terrain_far_water_count
		$map_layers = 2
	; Cold start can show new scan pixels immediately while saved layers rebuild.
	if !$ore_map_ready
		$ore_map_front.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
		$ore_map_n = $ore_map_now_n
		$ore_map_e = $ore_map_now_e
		$ore_map_range = $map_range
		$ore_map_level = $map_layers
		$ore_map_ready = 1
		$ore_map_revision += 1
	@terrain_map_publish()
	if $ore_map_build < 0
		if $terrain_restore_pending or ($ore_map_range != $map_range) or ($ore_map_level != $map_layers) or (abs($ore_map_now_n - $ore_map_n) > $map_range * 0.20) or (abs($ore_map_now_e - $ore_map_e) > $map_range * 0.20)
			$ore_map_next_n = $ore_map_now_n
			$ore_map_next_e = $ore_map_now_e
			$ore_map_next_range = $map_range
			$ore_map_next_level = $map_layers
			$ore_map_back.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
			$ore_map_build = 0
			$terrain_restore_pending = 0
			; Coarse background first, then every finer layer. Existing fine
			; records stay visible even before the new coarse layers are populated.
			$ore_map_build_total = ($ore_map_next_level + 1) * 8192
	if $ore_map_build < 0
		return
	; At most 512 cells per display tick, only after zoom/recenter/reboot.
	repeat 512 ($j)
		var $record = $ore_map_build + $j
		var $paint_level = $ore_map_next_level - floor($record / 8192)
		var $slot = mod($record, 8192)
		var $key = 0
		var $paint_height = 0
		if $slot < 4096
			$key = @terrain_key_at($paint_level, $slot)
			$paint_height = @terrain_height_at($paint_level, $slot)
		else
			var $water_slot = $slot - 4096
			$key = @terrain_water_at($paint_level, $water_slot)
		if $key > 0
			var $y = floor($key / 20000000) - 10000000
			var $x = mod($key, 20000000) - 10000000
			@ore_map_paint($ore_map_back, $x, $y, $paint_height, $ore_map_next_n, $ore_map_next_e, $ore_map_next_range, @terrain_cell($paint_level))
	$ore_map_build += 512
	if $ore_map_build == $ore_map_build_total
		; Swap handles; no full raster copy and no partial zoom frame.
		var $old = $ore_map_front
		$ore_map_front = $ore_map_back
		$ore_map_back = $old
		$ore_map_n = $ore_map_next_n
		$ore_map_e = $ore_map_next_e
		$ore_map_range = $ore_map_next_range
		$ore_map_level = $ore_map_next_level
		$ore_map_ready = 1
		$ore_map_build = -1
		$ore_map_revision += 1

function @ore_map_draw($canvas : screen, $map_heading:number, $range:number)
	; The caller copies NAV's normal dark background before scanned coverage.
	if (!$ore_map_ready) or ($ore_map_range != $range) or !@ore_map_position()
		return
	var $scale = 144 / $range
	var $sx = 40 + ($ore_map_now_e - $ore_map_e) * $scale
	var $sy = 40 - ($ore_map_now_n - $ore_map_n) * $scale
	var $view_pose_same = $ore_map_view_seen and ($ore_map_view_heading == $map_heading) and ($ore_map_view_sx == $sx) and ($ore_map_view_sy == $sy) and ($ore_map_view_range == $range)
	var $view_same = $view_pose_same and ($ore_map_view_revision == $ore_map_revision)
	; Only rows 84..273 can show terrain: the compass disc starts at row 84
	; (240 - 156) and NAV shows rows 56..273. Rows above 84 stay the base image.
	if $view_same and $ore_map_view_ready
		screen_copy($ore_map_view, $canvas, 0, 84, 0, 84, 300, 190)
		return
	; Ownship stays at (150,240). North-up data rotates with the compass.
	; Land is already muted; the same rotation preserves coverage as we turn.
	; Rotate only the disc that can be seen (316 x 316, was 432 x 432 drawn at
	; -66,24, which reached far outside the 300 x 300 canvas), into the scratch
	; canvas, then copy the visible band and trim it to the circle.
	; T5m: clear the scratch disc first. Unscanned map cells are transparent,
	; so without this every earlier frame showed through them as smeared,
	; ghosted terrain whenever the craft moved or turned.
	$ore_map_disc.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	screen_copy($ore_map_front, $ore_map_disc, $sx + 58, $sy + 58, 65, 65, 316, 316, white, -$map_heading, 1)
	screen_copy($ore_map_disc, $canvas, 73, 67, 0, 84, 300, 190)
	screen_copy($ore_map_mask, $canvas, 0, 84, 0, 84, 300, 190)
	; Only snapshot a repeated, stable frame: rapidly changing scans incur no
	; extra cache-copy work. Called before every pip, label, ring or control.
	if $view_pose_same
		screen_copy($canvas, $ore_map_view, 0, 84, 0, 84, 300, 190)
		$ore_map_view_ready = 1
	else
		$ore_map_view_ready = 0
	$ore_map_view_seen = 1
	$ore_map_view_revision = $ore_map_revision
	$ore_map_view_heading = $map_heading
	$ore_map_view_sx = $sx
	$ore_map_view_sy = $sy
	$ore_map_view_range = $range

; Observer only: receives the EXISTING scanner's coloured dots, never scans twice.
; Defined before OreScanner.xc so its optional observer calls are in scope.
var $navigation_display_capture = 0
var $navigation_display_ore_revision = 0
var $ore_scanner_has_pixels = 0
var $navigation_display_ore_cache = virtualscreen(300, 246)

; SCAN31: persistent options: image Hz, pivot %, radial samples, notices, RED gain.
storage array $sqx_scan31_options : number
var $scanner_options_image = virtualscreen(300, 246)
var $scanner_options_published = -1
var $scanner_options_next = 0
var $scanner_options_settle = 0

function @scanner_options_default($scan_index : number) : number
	if $scan_index == 0
		return 10
	elseif $scan_index == 1
		return 5
	elseif $scan_index == 2
		return 48
	return 1

function @scanner_options_min($scan_index : number) : number
	if $scan_index == 2
		return 4
	elseif $scan_index == 3
		return 0
	return 1

function @scanner_options_max($scan_index : number) : number
	if $scan_index == 0
		return 10
	elseif $scan_index == 1
		return 20
	elseif $scan_index == 3
		return 1
	return 100

function @scanner_options_get($scan_index : number) : number
	if $sqx_scan31_options.size == 5
		return clamp(round($sqx_scan31_options.$scan_index), @scanner_options_min($scan_index), @scanner_options_max($scan_index))
	return @scanner_options_default($scan_index)

function @scanner_options_boot()
	if $sqx_scan31_options.size == 5
		return
	if $sqx_scan31_options.size > 5
		$sqx_scan31_options.clear()
	repeat 5 ($scan_index)
		if $sqx_scan31_options.size <= $scan_index
			$sqx_scan31_options.append(@scanner_options_default($scan_index))
		$sqx_scan31_options.$scan_index = clamp(round($sqx_scan31_options.$scan_index), @scanner_options_min($scan_index), @scanner_options_max($scan_index))

function @scanner_options_set($scan_index : number, $scan_value : number)
	@scanner_options_boot()
	var $scan_bounded = clamp(round($scan_value), @scanner_options_min($scan_index), @scanner_options_max($scan_index))
	if $sqx_scan31_options.$scan_index == $scan_bounded
		return
	$sqx_scan31_options.$scan_index = $scan_bounded
	if ($scan_index == 2) or ($scan_index == 4)
		; New sample positions/colours must not mix with the previous accumulated map.
		$navigation_display_ore_cache.blank($shared_background)
		$ore_scanner_has_pixels = 0
		$navigation_display_ore_revision += 1
		$scanner_options_published = -1
		; Hardware replies describe the PREVIOUS tick's requested sample distances.
		$scanner_options_settle = time + 0.08
	elseif $scan_index == 0
		$scanner_options_next = 0
		$scanner_options_published = -1

function @scanner_options_publish()
	; At the original 10Hz LCD rate, use the live cache: no extra image copy.
	if @scanner_options_get(0) == 10
		$scanner_options_published = $navigation_display_ore_revision
		return
	if ($scanner_options_published != $navigation_display_ore_revision) and (($scanner_options_published < 0) or (time >= $scanner_options_next))
		screen_copy($navigation_display_ore_cache, $scanner_options_image, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 246)
		$scanner_options_published = $navigation_display_ore_revision
		$scanner_options_next = time + 1 / @scanner_options_get(0)

; Bounded, session-local sample markers, NOT GPS targets or beacon frequencies.
; These relative map coordinates must not survive a scanner context change/reboot.
array $ore_notices_x : number
array $ore_notices_y : number
array $ore_notices_strength : number
array $ore_notices_time : number
var $ore_notices_context = ""
var $ore_notices_name = ""
var $ore_notices_message = ""
var $ore_notices_until = 0
var $ore_notices_first = 1
var $ore_notices_pending = 0
var $ore_notices_power = 0
var $ore_notices_next = 0
var $ore_notices_pip_x = 0
var $ore_notices_pip_y = 0
var $ore_notices_pip_until = 0
var $ore_notices_revision = 0
var $ore_notices_settle_until = 0
var $ore_notices_context_resource = ""
var $ore_notices_context_range = -1
var $ore_notices_context_arc = -1

function @ore_notices_rearm()
	$ore_notices_first = 1
	$ore_notices_pending = 0
	$ore_notices_until = 0
	$ore_notices_message = ""
	$ore_notices_context = ""
	$ore_notices_revision += 1

function @ore_notices_begin($resource : text, $range : number, $arc : number)
	$ore_notices_power = @sw_in_2()
	if ($ore_notices_context != "") and ($ore_notices_context_resource == $resource) and ($ore_notices_context_range == $range) and ($ore_notices_context_arc == $arc)
		return
	$ore_notices_context_resource = $resource
	$ore_notices_context_range = $range
	$ore_notices_context_arc = $arc
	var $context = text("{},{},{}", $resource, $range, $arc)
	if $context != $ore_notices_context
		; Explicit selection/start callbacks own rearming, not rest/zoom changes.
		$ore_notices_x.clear()
		$ore_notices_y.clear()
		$ore_notices_strength.clear()
		$ore_notices_time.clear()
		$ore_notices_next = 0
		$ore_notices_pip_until = 0
		; Scanner packets lag their requested ranges by one server tick.
		$ore_notices_settle_until = time + 0.08
		$ore_notices_context = $context
		$ore_notices_name = $resource
		if $resource == "Au"
			$ore_notices_name = "Gold"
		elseif $resource == "Ag"
			$ore_notices_name = "Silver"
		elseif $resource == "U"
			$ore_notices_name = "Uranium"
		elseif $resource == "Fe"
			$ore_notices_name = "Iron"
		elseif $resource == "Cu"
			$ore_notices_name = "Copper"
		$ore_notices_revision += 1

function @ore_notices_dot($x : number, $y : number, $width : number, $height : number, $strength : number)
	; Detect RAW composition, before RGB rounding can hide a tiny positive trace.
	if (!$ore_notices_power) or (time < $ore_notices_settle_until) or ($strength <= 0) or ($strength > 1)
		return
	; Bright deposits already show normally. Keep the first hit and trace hits <=1%.
	if (!$ore_notices_first) and ($strength > 0.01)
		return
	var $px = round(150 + ($x / $width - 0.5) * 246)
	var $py = round(150 + ($y / $height - 0.5) * 246)
	if ($px < 2) or ($px > 297) or ($py < 28) or ($py > 272)
		return
	foreach $ore_notices_x ($index, $old_x)
		if (abs($px - $old_x) < 8) and (abs($py - $ore_notices_y.$index) < 8)
			return
	if $ore_notices_x.size < 16
		$ore_notices_x.append($px)
		$ore_notices_y.append($py)
		$ore_notices_strength.append($strength)
		$ore_notices_time.append(time)
	else
		$ore_notices_x.$ore_notices_next = $px
		$ore_notices_y.$ore_notices_next = $py
		$ore_notices_strength.$ore_notices_next = $strength
		$ore_notices_time.$ore_notices_next = time
		$ore_notices_next = mod($ore_notices_next + 1, 16)
	$ore_notices_pip_x = $px
	$ore_notices_pip_y = $py
	$ore_notices_pip_until = time + 6
	$ore_notices_revision += 1
	if @scanner_options_get(3) and $ore_notices_first
		$ore_notices_message = text("{} was found!", $ore_notices_name)
		; Keep the first discovery pending until the ORE tab actually draws it.
		$ore_notices_pending = 1
	$ore_notices_first = 0

function @ore_notices_phase() : number
	if $ore_notices_pending or (time < $ore_notices_until)
		if time < $ore_notices_pip_until
			return 2 + mod(floor(time * 4), 2)
		return 4
	if time < $ore_notices_pip_until
		return mod(floor(time * 4), 2)
	return -1

function @ore_notices_draw($canvas : screen)
	var $notice_phase = @ore_notices_phase()
	if ($notice_phase == 0) or ($notice_phase == 2)
		$canvas.draw_circle($ore_notices_pip_x, $ore_notices_pip_y, 2, red, red)
	if !@scanner_options_get(3)
		return
	if $ore_notices_pending
		$ore_notices_pending = 0
		$ore_notices_until = time + 6
	if time < $ore_notices_until
		$canvas.draw_rect(10, 47, 290, 66, orange, $shared_background)
		$canvas.text_align(top_left)
		$canvas.text_size(1)
		$canvas.write(150 - size($ore_notices_message) * $canvas.char_w / 2, 56.5 - $canvas.char_h / 2, orange, $ore_notices_message)

function @navigation_display_scan_begin()
	; Capture follows power, not the tab being viewed.
	$navigation_display_capture = @sw_in_2()
	; Retain every sampled pixel; scan steps must not fade the accumulated map.

function @navigation_display_scan_dot($navigation_display_ox : number, $navigation_display_oy : number, $navigation_display_ow : number, $navigation_display_oh : number, $navigation_display_oc : number)
	if $navigation_display_capture
		; Exact original scan orientation and zoom, scaled to a 216px map.
		$navigation_display_ore_cache.draw_circle(150 + ($navigation_display_ox / $navigation_display_ow - 0.5) * 246, 123 + ($navigation_display_oy / $navigation_display_oh - 0.5) * 246, 1.5, $navigation_display_oc, $navigation_display_oc)
		$ore_scanner_has_pixels = 1
		$navigation_display_ore_revision += 1
