; Waypoints.

; Bounded, additive waypoint storage. GPS NAV copies a verified record explicitly.
storage var $sqx_way18_initialized : number
var $sqx_way18_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_way18_geo : number
var $sqx_way18_geo__m : number
storage var $sqx_way18_tar : number
var $sqx_way18_tar__m : number
storage var $sqx_way18_way : number
var $sqx_way18_way__m : number
storage array $sqx_way18_lat : number
storage array $sqx_way18_lon : number
storage array $sqx_way18_radius : number
storage array $sqx_way18_body : text
storage array $sqx_way18_name : text
storage array $sqx_way18_notes : text
storage array $sqx_way20_elevation : number
storage array $sqx_way20_elevation_known : number
var $waypoint_revision = 0
var $waypoint_records_dim_ink : number
var $geology_records_dim_ink : number
var $waypoint_focus = -1
var $waypoint_delete_pending = 0
; 0 closed; 1 new waypoint name; 2 existing name; 3 existing notes.
var $waypoint_editor = 0
var $waypoint_edit_geo = 0
var $waypoint_edit_index = -1
var $waypoint_buffer = ""
var $waypoint_cursor = 0
var $waypoint_shift = 0
var $waypoint_notice = ""
var $waypoint_draft_lat = 0
var $waypoint_draft_lon = 0
var $waypoint_draft_radius = 0
var $waypoint_draft_body = ""
var $waypoint_records_draft_elevation = 0

function @waypoint_boot()
	$waypoint_records_dim_ink = color(45, 78, 87)
	$geology_records_dim_ink = color(89, 85, 53)
	if !$sqx_way18_initialized__m
		if $sqx_way18_geo__m != 1
			$sqx_way18_geo = 1
			$sqx_way18_geo__m = $sqx_way18_geo
		if $sqx_way18_tar__m != 1
			$sqx_way18_tar = 1
			$sqx_way18_tar__m = $sqx_way18_tar
		if $sqx_way18_way__m != 1
			$sqx_way18_way = 1
			$sqx_way18_way__m = $sqx_way18_way
		if $sqx_way18_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_way18_initialized = 1
			$sqx_way18_initialized__m = $sqx_way18_initialized
	; Preserve intentional OFF values, not truthy-default replacement.
	var $persist_next_266 : number
	$persist_next_266 = ($sqx_way18_geo__m != 0)
	if $sqx_way18_geo__m != $persist_next_266
		$sqx_way18_geo = $persist_next_266
		$sqx_way18_geo__m = $sqx_way18_geo
	var $persist_next_267 : number
	$persist_next_267 = ($sqx_way18_tar__m != 0)
	if $sqx_way18_tar__m != $persist_next_267
		$sqx_way18_tar = $persist_next_267
		$sqx_way18_tar__m = $sqx_way18_tar
	var $persist_next_268 : number
	$persist_next_268 = ($sqx_way18_way__m != 0)
	if $sqx_way18_way__m != $persist_next_268
		$sqx_way18_way = $persist_next_268
		$sqx_way18_way__m = $sqx_way18_way
	array $lat : number
	array $lon : number
	array $radius : number
	array $body : text
	array $name : text
	array $notes : text
	array $way_elevation : number
	array $way_known : number
	$lat.clear()
	$lon.clear()
	$radius.clear()
	$body.clear()
	$name.clear()
	$notes.clear()
	$way_elevation.clear()
	$way_known.clear()
	var $count = min(128, min($sqx_way18_lat.size, min($sqx_way18_lon.size, min($sqx_way18_radius.size, min($sqx_way18_body.size, min($sqx_way18_name.size, $sqx_way18_notes.size))))))
	repeat $count ($i)
		if (abs($sqx_way18_lat.$i) > 90) or (abs($sqx_way18_lon.$i) > 180) or ($sqx_way18_radius.$i <= 1000) or ($sqx_way18_body.$i == "") or ($sqx_way18_name.$i == "")
			continue
		$lat.append($sqx_way18_lat.$i)
		$lon.append($sqx_way18_lon.$i)
		$radius.append($sqx_way18_radius.$i)
		$body.append(substring($sqx_way18_body.$i, 0, 32))
		$name.append(substring($sqx_way18_name.$i, 0, 32))
		$notes.append(substring($sqx_way18_notes.$i, 0, 160))
		var $way_height = 0
		var $way_has_height = 0
		if ($i < $sqx_way20_elevation.size) and ($i < $sqx_way20_elevation_known.size)
			$way_height = $sqx_way20_elevation.$i
			$way_has_height = $sqx_way20_elevation_known.$i and (abs($way_height) < 100000)
		$way_elevation.append($way_height)
		$way_known.append($way_has_height)
	$sqx_way18_lat.clear()
	$sqx_way18_lon.clear()
	$sqx_way18_radius.clear()
	$sqx_way18_body.clear()
	$sqx_way18_name.clear()
	$sqx_way18_notes.clear()
	$sqx_way20_elevation.clear()
	$sqx_way20_elevation_known.clear()
	foreach $lat ($i, $value)
		$sqx_way18_lat.append($value)
		$sqx_way18_lon.append($lon.$i)
		$sqx_way18_radius.append($radius.$i)
		$sqx_way18_body.append($body.$i)
		$sqx_way18_name.append($name.$i)
		$sqx_way18_notes.append($notes.$i)
		$sqx_way20_elevation.append($way_elevation.$i)
		$sqx_way20_elevation_known.append($way_known.$i)
	; Fresh donor GEO seed is restored after GEO boot: annotate missing slots only.
	repeat 256 ($slot)
		if $sqx_geo18_find_name.size >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size
			break
		$sqx_geo18_find_name.append("")
	repeat 256 ($slot)
		if $sqx_geo18_find_notes.size >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size
			break
		$sqx_geo18_find_notes.append("")
	repeat 256 ($slot)
		if $sqx_geo20_elevation.size >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size
			break
		$sqx_geo20_elevation.append(0)
	repeat 256 ($slot)
		if $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.size >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size
			break
		$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.append(0)
	repeat 256 ($slot)
		if $sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.size >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size
			break
		$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.append(0)
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_kind ($entry, $kind)
		; Compact only the exact old generated title; preserve custom names/notes.
		if $sqx_geo18_find_name.$entry == text("{} / SAMPLED CANDIDATE", @geology_label($kind))
			$sqx_geo18_find_name.$entry = @geology_label($kind)
		if !$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.$entry
			; One-time additive migration; user-cleared notes remain empty thereafter.
			if $sqx_geo18_find_name.$entry == ""
				$sqx_geo18_find_name.$entry = @geology_label($kind)
			if $sqx_geo18_find_notes.$entry == ""
				$sqx_geo18_find_notes.$entry = "INFERRED FROM ELEVATIONS / CHECK SITE"
			$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.$entry = 1
	$waypoint_focus = -1
	$waypoint_delete_pending = 0
	$waypoint_editor = 0
	$waypoint_revision += 1

function @waypoint_capture() : number
	$waypoint_notice = ""
	if $sqx_way18_lat.size >= 128
		$waypoint_notice = "WAYPOINT STORAGE FULL (128)"
		return 0
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	var $radius = @standby_nav(14)
	var $body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	if (abs($lat) > 90) or (abs($lon) > 180) or ($radius <= 1000) or ($body == "") or (size($body) > 32)
		$waypoint_notice = "POSITION UNAVAILABLE"
		return 0
	; Snapshot now, NOT at SAVE: craft may move while the keyboard is open.
	$waypoint_draft_lat = $lat
	$waypoint_draft_lon = $lon
	$waypoint_draft_radius = $radius
	$waypoint_draft_body = $body
	$waypoint_records_draft_elevation = max(@standby_nav(2) - @standby_nav(3), 0)
	$waypoint_buffer = ""
	$waypoint_cursor = 0
	$waypoint_shift = 0
	$waypoint_editor = 1
	$waypoint_focus = -1
	$geology_focus = -1
	$waypoint_revision += 1
	return 1

function @waypoint_has_name($name : text) : number
	var $length = size($name)
	repeat $length ($i)
		if substring($name, $i, 1) != " "
			return 1
	return 0

function @waypoint_save() : number
	if !$waypoint_editor
		return 0
	if ($waypoint_editor != 3) and !@waypoint_has_name($waypoint_buffer)
		$waypoint_notice = "ENTER A NAME"
		return 0
	var $index = $waypoint_edit_index
	if $waypoint_editor == 1
		if $sqx_way18_lat.size >= 128
			$waypoint_notice = "WAYPOINT STORAGE FULL (128)"
			return 0
		$sqx_way18_lat.append($waypoint_draft_lat)
		$sqx_way18_lon.append($waypoint_draft_lon)
		$sqx_way18_radius.append($waypoint_draft_radius)
		$sqx_way18_body.append($waypoint_draft_body)
		$sqx_way18_name.append(substring($waypoint_buffer, 0, 32))
		$sqx_way18_notes.append("")
		$sqx_way20_elevation.append($waypoint_records_draft_elevation)
		$sqx_way20_elevation_known.append(1)
		$waypoint_focus = $sqx_way18_lat.size - 1
	elseif $waypoint_edit_geo
		if ($index < 0) or ($index >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size)
			$waypoint_notice = "ENTRY NO LONGER EXISTS"
			return 0
		if @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$index, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$index, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$index)
			$waypoint_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
			return 0
		if @nav_target_same($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$index, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$index, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$index)
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
		if $waypoint_editor == 2
			$sqx_geo18_find_name.$index = substring($waypoint_buffer, 0, 32)
		else
			$sqx_geo18_find_notes.$index = substring($waypoint_buffer, 0, 160)
		$geology_revision += 1
	else
		if ($index < 0) or ($index >= $sqx_way18_lat.size)
			$waypoint_notice = "ENTRY NO LONGER EXISTS"
			return 0
		if @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_way18_lat.$index, $sqx_way18_lon.$index, $sqx_way18_body.$index)
			$waypoint_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
			return 0
		if @nav_target_same($sqx_way18_lat.$index, $sqx_way18_lon.$index, $sqx_way18_body.$index)
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
		if $waypoint_editor == 2
			$sqx_way18_name.$index = substring($waypoint_buffer, 0, 32)
		else
			$sqx_way18_notes.$index = substring($waypoint_buffer, 0, 160)
	$waypoint_editor = 0
	$waypoint_notice = ""
	$waypoint_buffer = ""
	$waypoint_revision += 1
	return 1

function @waypoint_delete($index : number) : number
	if ($index < 0) or ($index >= $sqx_way18_lat.size) or ($index != floor($index))
		return 0
	if @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_way18_lat.$index, $sqx_way18_lon.$index, $sqx_way18_body.$index)
		$waypoint_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
		return 0
	if @nav_target_same($sqx_way18_lat.$index, $sqx_way18_lon.$index, $sqx_way18_body.$index)
		var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
	$sqx_way18_lat.erase($index)
	$sqx_way18_lon.erase($index)
	$sqx_way18_radius.erase($index)
	$sqx_way18_body.erase($index)
	$sqx_way18_name.erase($index)
	$sqx_way18_notes.erase($index)
	if $index < $sqx_way20_elevation.size
		$sqx_way20_elevation.erase($index)
	if $index < $sqx_way20_elevation_known.size
		$sqx_way20_elevation_known.erase($index)
	$waypoint_focus = -1
	$waypoint_delete_pending = 0
	$waypoint_revision += 1
	return 1

xc_files.name: nav-target-state.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Session-only target selection. Selecting never arms NAV or changes AP requests.
; 0 none, 1 main beacon, 2 waypoint/GEO coordinates. No persistent writes.
var $nav_target_kind = 0
var $nav_target_signal = ""
var $nav_target_name = ""
var $nav_target_lat = 0
var $nav_target_lon = 0
var $nav_target_elevation = 0
var $nav_target_body = ""
var $nav_target_radius = 0
var $nav_target_revision = 0
var $nav_target_beacon_pending = 0
var $nav_target_flash_button = -1
var $nav_target_flash_blocker = -1
var $nav_target_flash_until = 0
var $nav_target_flash_message = ""

function @nav_target_block($nt_button : number, $nt_blocker : number, $nt_message : text)
	$nav_target_flash_button = $nt_button
	$nav_target_flash_blocker = $nt_blocker
	$nav_target_flash_message = $nt_message
	$nav_target_flash_until = time + 2.4

function @nav_target_clear() : number
	if @mission_locked()
		@nav_target_block(12,16,"CANCEL MISSION FIRST")
		return 0
	if $sqx_ui46_nav__m
		@nav_target_block(12, 7, "TURN NAV OFF FIRST")
		return 0
	if $nav_target_kind
		$nav_target_kind = 0
		$nav_target_signal = ""
		$nav_target_name = ""
		$nav_target_beacon_pending = 0
		$nav_target_revision += 1
	return 1

function @nav_target_same($nt_lat : number, $nt_lon : number, $nt_body : text) : number
	return ($nav_target_kind == 2) and ($nt_lat == $nav_target_lat) and ($nt_lon == $nav_target_lon) and ($nt_body == $nav_target_body)

function @nav_target_record_locked($nt_lat : number, $nt_lon : number, $nt_body : text) : number
	return $sqx_ui46_nav__m and $waypoint_navigation_active and ($nt_lat == $waypoint_navigation_lat) and ($nt_lon == $waypoint_navigation_lon) and ($nt_body == $waypoint_navigation_body)

function @nav_target_stage_point($nt_lat : number, $nt_lon : number, $nt_height : number, $nt_body : text, $nt_radius : number, $nt_name : text) : number
	if @mission_locked()
		@nav_target_block(12,16,"CANCEL MISSION FIRST")
		return 0
	if $sqx_ui46_nav__m
		@nav_target_block(7, 7, "TURN NAV OFF FIRST")
		return 0
	if @nav_target_same($nt_lat, $nt_lon, $nt_body)
		return @nav_target_clear()
	if (abs($nt_lat) > 90) or (abs($nt_lon) > 180) or ($nt_radius <= 1000) or ($nt_body == "") or ($nt_height < 0) or ($nt_height >= 100000)
		return 0
	$nav_target_kind = 2
	$nav_target_signal = ""
	$nav_target_lat = $nt_lat
	$nav_target_lon = $nt_lon
	$nav_target_elevation = $nt_height
	$nav_target_body = $nt_body
	$nav_target_radius = $nt_radius
	$nav_target_name = $nt_name
	$nav_target_revision += 1
	return 1

function @nav_target_stage_beacon($nt_signal : text, $nt_name : text) : number
	if @mission_locked()
		@nav_target_block(12,16,"CANCEL MISSION FIRST")
		return 0
	if $sqx_ui46_nav__m
		@nav_target_block(7, 7, "TURN NAV OFF FIRST")
		return 0
	if ($nav_target_kind == 1) and ($nav_target_signal == $nt_signal)
		return @nav_target_clear()
	if $nt_signal == ""
		return 0
	$nav_target_kind = 1
	$nav_target_signal = $nt_signal
	$nav_target_name = $nt_name
	$nav_target_revision += 1
	return 1

var $fleet_slot = 0

var $fleet_join_off = 0

var $fleet_last_publish = -1000

var $fleet_pilot_name = ""

var $service_browser_seen = -1000
var $service_browser_packet = ""
var $service_browser_distance = 0
var $service_browser_x = 0
var $service_browser_y = 0
var $service_browser_z = 0
var $service_scan_index = 0
array $service_frequencies : text
array $service_packets : text
array $service_seen : number

function @fleet_get($fr_packet : text, $fr_key : text) : text
	foreach $fr_packet ($fr_k, $fr_v)
		if $fr_k == $fr_key
			return $fr_v
	return ""

function @fleet_num($fr_packet : text, $fr_key : text) : number
	var $fr_value = @fleet_get($fr_packet, $fr_key)
	if isnumeric($fr_value)
		return $fr_value:number
	return 0

function @fleet_text_valid($fr_value : text, $fr_empty : number) : number
	if (size($fr_value) > 32) or ((!$fr_empty) and (size($fr_value) == 0))
		return 0
	; Keep configuration values out of the nested text-object grammar.
	return replace(replace($fr_value, "{", ""), "}", "") == $fr_value

function @fleet_mask($fr_value : text) : text
	if $fr_value == ""
		return "DISABLED"
	return "********"

function @service_number($fr_alias : text, $fr_channel : number) : number
	if $fr_alias != "comms"
		return input_number($fr_alias, $fr_channel)
	if (time - $service_browser_seen > 4) or ($service_browser_frequency == "")
		return 0
	if $fr_channel == 5
		return 1
	if $fr_channel == 1
		return $service_browser_distance
	if $fr_channel == 2
		return $service_browser_x
	if $fr_channel == 3
		return $service_browser_y
	if $fr_channel == 4
		return $service_browser_z
	return 0

function @service_text($fr_alias : text, $fr_channel : number) : text
	if $fr_alias != "comms"
		return input_text($fr_alias, $fr_channel)
	if @service_number("comms", 5)
		return $service_browser_packet
	return ""

function @service_request($fr_frequency : text)
	if $service_browser_frequency != $fr_frequency
		$service_browser_frequency = $fr_frequency
		$service_browser_packet = ""
		$service_browser_seen = -1000

function @service_capture()
	if !input_number("comms", 5)
		return
	var $fr_data = input_text("comms", 0)
	if size($fr_data) > 2048
		return
	if $fleet_rx_frequency == $service_browser_frequency
		$service_browser_packet = $fr_data
		$service_browser_seen = time
		$service_browser_distance = input_number("comms", 1)
		$service_browser_x = input_number("comms", 2)
		$service_browser_y = input_number("comms", 3)
		$service_browser_z = input_number("comms", 4)
	var $fr_found = -1
	foreach $service_frequencies ($fr_i, $fr_f)
		if $fr_f == $fleet_rx_frequency
			$fr_found = $fr_i
	if $fr_found < 0
		if $service_frequencies.size >= 32
			$service_frequencies.erase(0)
			$service_packets.erase(0)
			$service_seen.erase(0)
		$service_frequencies.append($fleet_rx_frequency)
		$service_packets.append($fr_data)
		$service_seen.append(time)
	else
		$service_packets.$fr_found = $fr_data
		$service_seen.$fr_found = time

xc_files.plain_code:
; Displays.

; One owner for the three large physical LCDs and their routed touch events.
var $display_left = screen("pilot-screen", 0)
var $display_center = screen("pilot-screen", 2)
var $display_right = screen("pilot-screen", 1)
var $display_controls = screen("systems-dashboard", 0)
var $display_boot_canvas = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $display_left_context = ""
var $display_center_context = ""
var $display_right_context = ""
var $display_left_key = ""
var $display_center_key = ""
var $display_right_key = ""
var $display_controls_key = ""
var $display_power_seen = 0
var $display_power_epoch_seen = -1
var $display_boot_at = 0
var $display_boot_done = 0
var $display_chime_started = 0
var $display_pressed = -1
var $display_press_until = 0

function @display_blank()
	$display_left.blank(black)
	$display_center.blank(black)
	$display_right.blank(black)
	$display_left_context = ""
	$display_center_context = ""
	$display_right_context = ""
	$display_left_key = ""
	$display_center_key = ""
	$display_right_key = ""

function @display_copy($destination : screen, $content : number)
	if $content == 0
		screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd, $destination, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	elseif $content == 1
		screen_copy($navigation_display_lcd, $destination, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	else
		screen_copy($systems_display_lcd, $destination, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)

function @display_revision($content : number) : number
	if $content == 0
		return $display_pfd_revision
	if $content == 1
		return $display_nd_revision
	return $display_rx_revision

function @display_startup($destination : screen)
	screen_copy($brand_frame, $destination, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)

function @display_sleep_image($ds_lcd : screen)
	if $brand_ready
		screen_copy($brand_logo,$ds_lcd,0,0,0,0,300,300,$brand_sleep_tint)
	else
		$ds_lcd.blank(black)
		@access_text($ds_lcd,150,140,1.8,orange,"BADGER")
		@access_text($ds_lcd,150,165,0.8,$brand_dim,"PREPARING ARTWORK")

function @display_overlay() : number
	return $sqx_sw49_power__m and ($flight_status_last_drawn != "") and ($flight_status_last_drawn != "0")

; Routine parked warnings remain visible as an overlay, not a splash cancel.
; Stall / pull-up urgency still bypasses branding, as do the flight guards.
function @brand_priority_warning() : number
	return @display_overlay() and ($ore_notices_notice_ink == red) and (($warnings_current_bit == 1) or ($warnings_current_bit == 4))

function @display_refresh_instruments()
	@attitude_display_update()
	@navigation_display_update()
	@systems_display_update()

function @display_compose()
	@display_boot()
	var $power = $sqx_sw49_power__m != 0
	if ($power != $display_power_seen) or ($display_power_epoch_seen != $flight_sol_power_epoch)
		$display_power_seen = $power
		$display_power_epoch_seen = $flight_sol_power_epoch
		$display_sleep = 0
		$display_boot_at = time
		@brand_restart()
		$display_boot_done = 0
		$display_chime_started = 0
		$display_chime_until = 0
		$display_chime_pulse = 0
		@display_blank()
		if $power
			; Power-on re-presents every warning that is still active (acks do not survive a power cycle).
			$warnings_dismissed = 0
			$flight_status_last_drawn = "__INIT__"
	$brand_sleep_requested = $power and $display_sleep
	if !$power
		$brand_building = 0
		return
	if $display_sleep
		@brand_seed()
		$brand_building = !$brand_ready
	elseif $display_boot_done
		$brand_building = 0
	var $warning = @display_overlay()
	if !$display_boot_done and !$display_sleep
		var $br_complete = @brand_tick()
		; Expected ROTORS/OFF, door and advisory banners must not erase startup.
		var $br_warning = @brand_priority_warning()
		if $br_complete or $br_warning
			; Prepare one fresh frame before replacing BIOS, not a blank cache.
			@display_refresh_instruments()
			$display_boot_done = 1
			$brand_building = 0
			if $br_warning
				print("Badger startup skipped: URGENT FLIGHT WARNING")
			if $br_warning or !@brand_safe_to_show()
				$display_chime_pulse = 0
				$display_chime_until = 0
		else
			@brand_render()
			; Play the existing melody WITH the logo/BIOS, once per power epoch.
			; Routine parked ROTORS banners must not suppress the trigger.
			if !$display_chime_started and ($brand_phase > 0)
				$display_chime_started = 1
				$display_chime_pulse = 1
				$display_chime_until = time + 2.5
	repeat 3 ($slot)
		var $content = $sqx_dp14_order.$slot
		var $key = text("{},{},{},{},{}", $content, @display_revision($content), $display_epoch, $display_sleep, $display_boot_done)
		if $display_sleep
			; Sleeping artwork is static: ignore hidden-page sensor revisions.
			$key = text("SLEEP,{},{}",$display_epoch,$brand_ready)
		if !$display_boot_done
			$key = text("{},{}", $key, $brand_frame_key)
		if $slot == 1
			$key = text("{},{},{},{}", $key, $flight_status_last_drawn, $ore_notices_notice_ink, $warning)
		var $context = text("{},{},{},{},{}",$content,$display_epoch,$display_sleep,$display_boot_done,$display_power_epoch_seen)
		if $slot == 1
			$context = text("{},{},{},{}",$context,$flight_status_last_drawn,$ore_notices_notice_ink,$warning)
		var $old_context = $display_left_context
		var $lcd = $display_left
		var $old = $display_left_key
		if $slot == 1
			$lcd = $display_center
			$old = $display_center_key
			$old_context = $display_center_context
		elseif $slot == 2
			$lcd = $display_right
			$old = $display_right_key
			$old_context = $display_right_context
		if $key == $old
			continue
		if $display_sleep
			@display_sleep_image($lcd)
		elseif !$display_boot_done
			@display_startup($lcd)
		else
			if $content == 0
				@ar_present($lcd,$context != $old_context)
			elseif $content == 1
				@nr_present($lcd,$context != $old_context)
			elseif $systems_display_mode==0
				@rs_present($lcd,$context!=$old_context)
			elseif $systems_display_mode==2
				@se_present($lcd,$context!=$old_context)
			elseif $systems_display_mode==1
				@du_mode_present($lcd,$context!=$old_context)
			elseif $systems_display_mode == 3
				@wx_present($lcd,$context != $old_context)
			else
				@display_copy($lcd, $content)
		; Safety overlay stays on the physical middle LCD, including sleep/boot.
		if ($slot == 1) and $warning
			screen_copy($dashboard, $lcd, 0, 0, 25, 133, 250, 30)
			if $flight_status_last_drawn=="AIRCRAFT SECURED"
				@ui_secure_presented()
		if $slot == 0
			$display_left_key = $key
			$display_left_context = $context
		elseif $slot == 1
			$display_center_key = $key
			$display_center_context = $context
		else
			$display_right_key = $key
			$display_right_context = $context

function @display_controls_draw()
	@wx_tile_draw()
	var $key = text("{},{},{},{},{}", $display_sleep, $display_epoch, $display_pressed, time < $display_press_until, $sqx_sw49_power__m)
	if $key == $display_controls_key
		return
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		$display_controls.draw_rect(0, 0, 150, 78, black, black)
		$display_controls.draw_rect(0, 258, 150, 300, black, black)
		$display_controls_key = $key
		return
	var $bg = color(8, 14, 22)
	$display_controls.draw_rect(0, 0, 150, 78, $bg, $bg)
	@draw_rounded_box($display_controls, 3, 8, 147, 72, 8, color(76, 93, 108))
	$display_controls.draw_rect(48, 2, 102, 15, $bg, $bg)
	@access_text($display_controls, 75, 8, 0.9, orange, "DISPLAYS")
	repeat 3 ($i)
		var $x = 6 + 47 * $i
		var $y = 20
		var $ink = color(10, 180, 205)
		var $fill = color(18, 24, 32)
		if ($display_pressed == $i) and (time < $display_press_until)
			$fill = color(30, 40, 52)
		if $i == 2
			if $display_sleep
				$ink = color(45, 215, 75)
		@access_action_frame($display_controls, $x, $y, 44, 44, $ink, $fill)
		var $label = "SWAP"
		if $i < 2
			$display_controls.draw_rect($x + 7, $y + 5, $x + 22, $y + 18, white)
			$display_controls.draw_rect($x + 20, $y + 13, $x + 35, $y + 26, white, $fill)
			@access_text($display_controls, $x + 14.5, $y + 11.5, 0.7, white, text("{0}", $i + 1))
			@access_text($display_controls, $x + 27.5, $y + 19.5, 0.7, white, text("{0}", $i + 2))
		else
			$label = "SLEEP"
			if $display_sleep
				$label = "WAKE"
			$display_controls.draw_circle($x + 22, $y + 17, 10, white, white)
			$display_controls.draw_circle($x + 27, $y + 13, 9, $fill, $fill)
		@access_text($display_controls, $x + 22, $y + 37, 0.6, $ink, $label)
	$display_controls_key = $key

function @display_control_click($x : number, $y : number)
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	if ($x >= 3) and ($x < 148) and ($y >= 249) and ($y < 300)
		@wx_open()
		@display_compose()
		return
	var $action = -1
	if ($y >= 20) and ($y < 64) and ($x >= 6) and ($x < 144) and (mod($x - 6, 47) < 44)
		$action = floor(($x - 6) / 47)
	if $action < 0
		return
	$display_pressed = $action
	$display_press_until = time + 0.18
	if $action == 2
		$display_sleep = !$display_sleep
		if !$display_sleep
			@display_refresh_instruments()
		; Explicit Sleep/WAKE replaces, rather than restarts, startup branding.
		$display_boot_done = 1
		$brand_building = 0
	else
		@display_swap($action, $action + 1)
	@display_compose()
	@display_controls_draw()

function @display_touch($slot : number, $x : number, $y : number, $kind : number)
	@display_boot()
	if ($slot < 0) or ($slot > 2) or ($slot != floor($slot)) or (!$sqx_sw49_power__m)
		return
	; Consume warning clicks before ANY underlying page action, even in sleep.
	; A tap during startup only skips the splash; it never acknowledges a warning.
	if ($kind == 0) and ($slot == 1) and $display_boot_done and @display_overlay() and ($x >= 25) and ($x < 275) and ($y >= 133) and ($y < 163)
		@warnings_acknowledge()
		@display_compose()
		return
	if $display_sleep
		if $kind == 0
			$display_sleep = 0
			@display_refresh_instruments()
			$display_boot_done = 1
			$brand_sleep_requested = 0
			$brand_building = 0
			@display_compose()
			@display_controls_draw()
		return
	if !$display_boot_done
		if $kind == 0
			$display_boot_done = 1
			$brand_building = 0
			@display_compose()
		return
	var $content = $sqx_dp14_order.$slot
	if $kind == 0
		if $content == 0
			@attitude_display_choose($x, $y)
		elseif $content == 1
			@navigation_display_choose($x, $y)
		else
			@systems_display_choose($x, $y)
	elseif ($kind == 1) and ($content == 2)
		@command_editor_hold($x, $y)
	elseif ($kind == 2) and ($content == 2)
		@settings_layout_scroll($x)
	elseif ($kind == 2) and ($content == 1)
		@navigation_display_scroll($x)

xc_files.name: beacon-display.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Beacon display.

var $beacon_lcd = screen("screen", 0)
var $beacon_bg = color(8, 14, 22)
var $beacon_display_key = ""
var $beacon_display_packet = ""
var $beacon_display_power = -1
var $beacon_hold_last = 0
var $beacon_hold_next = 0
var $beacon_hold_direction = 0
var $beacon_border = color(65, 87, 105)
var $beacon_card = color(16, 28, 40)
var $beacon_resource_kind = 0
var $beacon_resource_signal = ""
var $beacon_nav_badge_phase = -1

function @beacon_text($beacon_tx : number, $beacon_ty : number, $beacon_size : number, $beacon_tc : number, $beacon_label : text)
	$beacon_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$beacon_lcd.text_size($beacon_size)
	$beacon_lcd.write($beacon_tx - size($beacon_label) * $beacon_lcd.char_w / 2, $beacon_ty - $beacon_lcd.char_h / 2, $beacon_tc, $beacon_label)

; Large saved-record identity, fitted to the panel without changing stored names.
function @beacon_name_text($y : number, $ink : number, $name : text)
	$name = substring($name, 0, 44)
	$beacon_lcd.text_size(1)
	var $scale = min(3, 282 / max(size($name) * $beacon_lcd.char_w, 1))
	@beacon_text(150, $y, $scale, $ink, $name)


function @beacon_draw_meter($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $label : text, $reading : text, $value : number, $ok : number, $ink : number, $caption : text)
	$beacon_lcd.draw_rect($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + 68, $beacon_border, $beacon_card)
	@beacon_text($x + $w / 2, $y + 12, 0.85, cyan, $label)
	@beacon_text($x + $w / 2, $y + 33, 1.4, $ink, $reading)
	if $caption != ""
		@beacon_text($x + $w / 2, $y + 44, 0.65, gray, $caption)
	var $step = ($w - 16) / 16
	repeat 16 ($segment)
		var $sx = $x + 8 + $segment * $step
		var $fill = $beacon_border
		if $ok and ($segment < ceil($value * 16))
			$fill = $ink
		$beacon_lcd.draw_rect($sx, $y + 51, $sx + $step - 2, $y + 60, $fill, $fill)

; Battery/fuel cards retain their existing fraction/low-level color behavior.
function @beacon_meter($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $label : text, $field : text, $valid : text)
	var $ok = @beacon_available($beacon_packet, $field, $valid)
	var $value = clamp(@beacon_number($beacon_packet, $field), 0, 1)
	var $ink = gray
	var $reading = "NO DATA"
	if $ok
		$ink = green
		if $value < 0.2
			$ink = red
		elseif $value < 0.5
			$ink = yellow
		$reading = text("{0}%", $value * 100)
	@beacon_draw_meter($x, $y, $w, $label, $reading, $value, $ok, $ink, "")

function @beacon_power_text($beacon_kw : number) : text
	if $beacon_kw >= 1000
		return text("{0.0} MW", $beacon_kw / 1000)
	return text("{0.0} kW", $beacon_kw)

function @beacon_solar_meter()
	var $beacon_generation = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "solargenerationkw")
	var $beacon_capacity = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "solarcapacitykw")
	var $beacon_generation_ok = @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "solargenerationkw", "solarvalid") and ($beacon_generation >= 0)
	var $beacon_capacity_ok = @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "solarcapacitykw", "solarvalid") and ($beacon_capacity > 0)
	var $beacon_solar_reading = "NO DATA"
	var $beacon_solar_caption = ""
	var $beacon_solar_fraction = 0
	var $beacon_solar_ink = gray
	if $beacon_generation_ok
		$beacon_solar_reading = @beacon_power_text($beacon_generation)
		; Nighttime zero is valid, not a fuel/low-battery alarm.
		$beacon_solar_ink = cyan
		$beacon_solar_caption = "CAPACITY UNKNOWN"
		if $beacon_capacity_ok
			$beacon_solar_fraction = clamp($beacon_generation / $beacon_capacity, 0, 1)
			$beacon_solar_caption = text("OF {}", @beacon_power_text($beacon_capacity))
	@beacon_draw_meter(154, 104, 140, "SOLAR GENERATION", $beacon_solar_reading, $beacon_solar_fraction, $beacon_generation_ok and $beacon_capacity_ok, $beacon_solar_ink, $beacon_solar_caption)

function @beacon_resource_card()
	if $beacon_resource_signal != $beacon_browser_last_view
		$beacon_resource_signal = $beacon_browser_last_view
		$beacon_resource_kind = 0
	; Remember only the card type during signal loss, never its stale readings.
	if $beacon_packet != ""
		$beacon_resource_kind = 0
		if @beacon_has($beacon_packet, "fuel")
			$beacon_resource_kind = 0
		elseif @beacon_has($beacon_packet, "oil")
			$beacon_resource_kind = 1
		elseif @beacon_has($beacon_packet, "solargenerationkw") or @beacon_has($beacon_packet, "solarcapacitykw")
			$beacon_resource_kind = 2
	if $beacon_resource_kind == 2
		@beacon_solar_meter()
	elseif $beacon_resource_kind == 1
		@beacon_meter(154, 104, 140, "OIL RESERVE", "oil", "oilvalid")
	else
		@beacon_meter(154, 104, 140, "FUEL RESERVE", "fuel", "fuelvalid")

function @beacon_detail($y : number, $label : text, $value : text, $ok : number)
	$beacon_lcd.draw_line(10, $y + 15, 290, $y + 15, $beacon_border)
	@beacon_text(77, $y, 0.8, cyan, $label)
	var $ink = white
	if !$ok
		$value = "NO DATA"
		$ink = gray
	@beacon_text(220, $y, 0.85, $ink, substring($value, 0, 25))

function @beacon_state($field : text) : text
	if !@beacon_available($beacon_packet, $field, "")
		return "NO DATA"
	if @beacon_number($beacon_packet, $field)
		return "ON"
	return "OFF"

function @beacon_pad_progress() : text
	if ($sqx_tg47_selected__m < 0) or ($sqx_tg47_selected__m >= $sqx_tg47_main.size)
		return "STATUS / NOT LANDING CLEARANCE"

		if input_number("ship-dock",0)

		if ($pad_main == $bp_main) and ($pad_status != "")

		return "FOUND DOCKING PORT"

	return "STATUS / NOT LANDING CLEARANCE"

function @bp_security_sample()
	if $bp_auth_seen != $fleet_auth_code__m
		$bp_auth_seen = $fleet_auth_code__m
		$bp_secure_frequencies.clear()
		$bp_secure_times.clear()
		$bp_ack_seen = $fleet_last_ack
	; Only a successfully authenticated/decrypted fleet reply can set this cache.
	if ($fleet_last_ack != $bp_ack_seen) and ($fleet_last_ack > -1000) and $sec_ready
		$bp_ack_seen = $fleet_last_ack
		var $bp_frequency = @beacon_get($fleet_base_packet, "frequency")
		if $bp_frequency != ""
			var $bp_slot = -1
			foreach $bp_secure_frequencies ($bp_i, $bp_f)
				if $bp_f == $bp_frequency
					$bp_slot = $bp_i
			if $bp_slot < 0
				if $bp_secure_frequencies.size >= 32
					$bp_secure_frequencies.erase(0)
					$bp_secure_times.erase(0)
				$bp_slot = $bp_secure_frequencies.size
				$bp_secure_frequencies.append($bp_frequency)
				$bp_secure_times.append($fleet_last_ack)
			else
				$bp_secure_times.$bp_slot = $fleet_last_ack
	$bp_security = 0
	if !$beacon_structured
		return
	$bp_security = 1
	if !$sec_ready or ($fleet_auth_code__m == "")
		return
	foreach $bp_secure_frequencies ($bp_i, $bp_f)
		if ($bp_f == $beacon_browser_last_view) and (time - $bp_secure_times.$bp_i < 60)
			$bp_security = 2

function @bp_alert() : text
	var $bp_message = @beacon_get($beacon_packet, "buildingerror")

function @bp_battery_time() : text
	if @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "batterytimefullseconds", "batterytimevalid")
		var $bp_seconds = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "batterytimefullseconds")
		if $bp_seconds >= 0
			return text("TTF {0}:{00}", floor($bp_seconds / 3600), floor(mod($bp_seconds / 60, 60)))
	if @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "batterytimeemptyseconds", "batterytimevalid")
		var $bp_seconds = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "batterytimeemptyseconds")
		if $bp_seconds >= 0
			return text("TTE {0}:{00}", floor($bp_seconds / 3600), floor(mod($bp_seconds / 60, 60)))
	return ""

function @bp_generation_sample($bp_kind : number)
	; Diesel percentage is RUNNING / INSTALLED, never electrical kW/load.
	if $bp_kind == 1
		$bp_generation_ok = 0
		$bp_generation_bar = 0
		$bp_generation_ratio = 0
		$bp_generation_reading = "--"
		if !@beacon_available($beacon_packet, "generators", "generatorvalid")
			return
		if !@beacon_available($beacon_packet, "generatortotal", "generatorvalid")
			return
		if @beacon_has($beacon_packet, "generatoronline")
			if !@beacon_available($beacon_packet, "generatoronline", "")
				return
			if @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "generatoronline") != 1
				return
		var $bp_running = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "generators")
		var $bp_installed = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, "generatortotal")
		if ($bp_running < 0) or ($bp_installed <= 0) or ($bp_running > $bp_installed)
			return
		if (floor($bp_running) != $bp_running) or (floor($bp_installed) != $bp_installed)
			return
		$bp_generation_ratio = $bp_running / $bp_installed
		$bp_generation_reading = text("{0}%", $bp_generation_ratio * 100)
		$bp_generation_ok = 1
		$bp_generation_bar = 1
		return

	var $bp_power = "solargenerationkw"
	var $bp_capacity = "solarcapacitykw"
	var $bp_valid = "solarvalid"
	var $bp_fraction = "solarfraction"
	if $bp_kind == 2
		$bp_power = "nuclearpowerkw"
		$bp_capacity = "nuclearcapacitykw"
		$bp_valid = "nuclearvalid"
		$bp_fraction = "nuclearfraction"
	$bp_generation_ok = @beacon_has($beacon_packet, $bp_power) or @beacon_has($beacon_packet, $bp_fraction)
	$bp_generation_bar = 0
	$bp_generation_ratio = 0
	$bp_generation_reading = "--"
	if @beacon_available($beacon_packet, $bp_fraction, $bp_valid)
		var $bp_fraction_value = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, $bp_fraction)
		if ($bp_fraction_value >= 0) and ($bp_fraction_value <= 1)
			$bp_generation_ratio = $bp_fraction_value
			$bp_generation_bar = 1
	elseif @beacon_available($beacon_packet, $bp_power, $bp_valid)
		$bp_generation_value = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, $bp_power)
		if $bp_generation_value >= 0
			$bp_generation_reading = text("{0}kW", $bp_generation_value)
			if @beacon_available($beacon_packet, $bp_capacity, $bp_valid)
				var $bp_max = @beacon_number($beacon_packet, $bp_capacity)
				if $bp_max > 0
					$bp_generation_ratio = clamp($bp_generation_value / $bp_max, 0, 1)
					$bp_generation_bar = 1
	if $bp_generation_bar
		$bp_generation_reading = text("{0}%", $bp_generation_ratio * 100)
	; Unknown percentages do not get a row, icon, placeholder bar or value.
	$bp_generation_ok = $bp_generation_bar

function @bp_resources_sample()
	$bp_fuel_field = ""
	if @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "fuel", "fuelvalid")
		if (@beacon_number($beacon_packet, "fuel") >= 0) and (@beacon_number($beacon_packet, "fuel") <= 1)
			$bp_fuel_field = "fuel"
	elseif @beacon_available($beacon_packet, "oil", "oilvalid")
		if (@beacon_number($beacon_packet, "oil") >= 0) and (@beacon_number($beacon_packet, "oil") <= 1)
			$bp_fuel_field = "oil"
	$bp_generation_count = 0
	repeat 3 ($bp_kind)
		@bp_generation_sample($bp_kind)
		$bp_generation_count += $bp_generation_ok

function @bp_sources_key() : text
	; Parse resource inputs once, then ignore unrelated sequence/GPS changes.
	var $bp_inputs = ""
	var $bp_fields = ",solargenerationkw,solarcapacitykw,solarvalid,solarfraction,generators,generatortotal,generatorvalid,generatoronline,nuclearpowerkw,nuclearcapacitykw,nuclearvalid,nuclearfraction,batterytimefullseconds,batterytimeemptyseconds,batterytimevalid,"
	foreach $beacon_packet ($bp_key, $bp_value)
		if contains($bp_fields, "," & $bp_key & ",")
			$bp_inputs.$bp_key = $bp_value
	if $bp_inputs != $bp_resource_signature
		$bp_resource_signature = $bp_inputs
		$bp_resource_time = @bp_battery_time()
		$bp_resource_visual = ""
		repeat 3 ($bp_kind)
			@bp_generation_sample($bp_kind)
			$bp_resource_visual &= text("{}:{};", $bp_kind, $bp_generation_ok)
			if $bp_generation_ok
				$bp_resource_visual &= text("{},{0};", $bp_generation_reading, ceil($bp_generation_ratio * 16))
	return $bp_resource_visual

function @bp_generation_card($bp_y : number, $bp_height : number)

	var $bp_row = 0
	repeat 3 ($bp_kind)
		@bp_generation_sample($bp_kind)
		if !$bp_generation_ok
			continue
		var $bp_cy = $bp_y + 22 + ($bp_height - 28) * ($bp_row + 0.5) / max($bp_generation_count, 1)
		screen_copy($bp_icons, $beacon_lcd, $bp_kind * 20 + 3, 3, 11, $bp_cy - 7, 14, 14)
		repeat 16 ($bp_segment)

				$bp_ink = green
			$beacon_lcd.draw_rect(35 + $bp_segment * 4.7, $bp_cy - 3, 38 + $bp_segment * 4.7, $bp_cy + 3, $bp_ink, $bp_ink)

function @beacon_frame()

function @beacon_touch($beacon_x : number, $beacon_y : number)
	@beacon_boot()
	if $beacon_editing
		if $beacon_y >= 274
			if $beacon_x < 150
				@beacon_back()
			else
				@beacon_save()
		elseif !@beacon_locked() or $beacon_new
			var $beacon_field_bottom = 202
			if $beacon_edit_array
				$beacon_field_bottom = 106
			if ($beacon_y >= 58) and ($beacon_y < $beacon_field_bottom)
				$beacon_focus = floor(($beacon_y - 58) / 48) + 1
				$beacon_notice = "CLEAR KEYBOARD / ENTER NEW VALUE"
			elseif ($beacon_y >= 202) and ($beacon_y < 230) and !$beacon_edit_array
				$beacon_draft_commands = !$beacon_draft_commands
		return
	if $beacon_delete
		if $beacon_y >= 274
			if $beacon_x < 150
				$beacon_delete = 0
			else
				@beacon_remove_last()
		return
	; Footer navigation/add is available even on the AP-owned record.
	if $beacon_y >= 274
		if $beacon_x < 75
			@beacon_move(-1)
		elseif $beacon_x < 150
			@beacon_move(1)
		elseif $beacon_x < 225
			@beacon_add()
		elseif ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0) and !@beacon_locked()
			$beacon_delete = 1
			$beacon_focus = 0
			$beacon_wait_name = 0
		return
	if ($beacon_y >= 220) and ($beacon_y < 239) and ($beacon_x >= 170)
		if $beacon_x >= 235
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
		elseif $sqx_tg47_main.size > 0
			var $nt_staged = @nav_target_stage_beacon($sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_names.$sqx_tg47_selected__m)
		$beacon_display_key = ""
		return
	if ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0) and ($beacon_y >= 220) and ($beacon_y < 239)
		if ($beacon_x >= 82) and ($beacon_x < 165)
			@bp_nav_toggle($sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m)
		elseif $beacon_structured and ($beacon_x >= 6) and ($beacon_x < 79)
			$beacon_info = mod($beacon_info + 1, 3)
		else
			return
		$beacon_display_key = ""
		return
	if @beacon_locked()
		if @beacon_nav_locked()
			$beacon_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
		else
			$beacon_notice = "DOCK OWNS TARGET"
		return
	if ($beacon_y >= 1) and ($beacon_y < 24) and ($beacon_x >= 226)
		@beacon_edit()

function @beacon_display_off()
	if $beacon_display_power != 0
		$beacon_lcd.blank(black)
	$beacon_display_power = 0
	$beacon_display_key = ""
	$beacon_focus = 0
	$beacon_display_packet = ""
	$beacon_nav_badge_phase = -1

; Packet freshness/authentication remains owned by the radio backend.
; A changing sequence, token or private field is not a visible card change.
var $beacon_view_signature = "!"
var $beacon_view_page = -1

function @beacon_visible_changed() : number
	var $bv_view = ""
	if $beacon_packet != ""
		$bv_view.present = 1
	var $bv_fields = ",name,buildingerror,alert,error,fault,"
	if $beacon_info == 0
		$bv_fields &= "batteries,batteryvalid,fuel,fuelvalid,oil,oilvalid,solargenerationkw,solarcapacitykw,solarvalid,solarfraction,generatorpowerkw,generatorcapacitykw,generatorvalid,generatorfraction,generators,nuclearpowerkw,nuclearcapacitykw,nuclearvalid,nuclearfraction,batterytimefullseconds,batterytimeemptyseconds,batterytimevalid,dockoccupied,dockvalid,landingheading,"
	elseif $beacon_info == 1
		$bv_fields &= "batterymain,batterybank1,batterybank2,batteryvalid,generators,refineries,"
	else
		$bv_fields &= "landingfrequency,chargingenabled,planet,latitude,longitude,navvalid,"
	if $beacon_info == 0
		; Quantize to the actual visible percentage/bar/availability, not raw kW.
		$bv_fields = ",name,buildingerror,alert,error,fault,batteries,batteryvalid,fuel,fuelvalid,oil,oilvalid,dockoccupied,dockvalid,landingheading,"
		$bv_view.sources = @bp_sources_key()
		$bv_view.batterytime = $bp_resource_time
	foreach $beacon_packet ($bv_key, $bv_value)
		if contains($bv_fields, "," & $bv_key & ",")
			var $rc_bv_value = $bv_value
			if contains(",batteries,fuel,oil,batterymain,batterybank1,batterybank2,", "," & $bv_key & ",")
				if isnumeric($bv_value)
					var $rc_bv_ratio = clamp($bv_value:number, 0, 1)
					$rc_bv_value = text("{0}", $rc_bv_ratio * 100)
					if $beacon_info == 0
						$rc_bv_value = text("{},{0},{},{}", $rc_bv_value, ceil($rc_bv_ratio * 16), $rc_bv_ratio < 0.2, $rc_bv_ratio < 0.5)
			if $bv_key == "landingheading"
				if isnumeric($bv_value)
					$rc_bv_value = text("{0}", mod(floor(mod($bv_value:number + 360, 360) + 0.5), 360))
			$bv_view.$bv_key = $rc_bv_value
	var $bv_changed = ($bv_view != $beacon_view_signature) or ($beacon_view_page != $beacon_info)
	$beacon_view_signature = $bv_view
	$beacon_view_page = $beacon_info
	return $bv_changed


function @beacon_display()
	@beacon_boot()

	; Keep the full packet separate from the small UI key: native text is 4096 bytes.
	@beacon_nav_latch()

	@bp_security_sample()
	var $packet_changed = 0
	if ($beacon_packet != $beacon_display_packet) or ($beacon_view_page != $beacon_info)
		$packet_changed = @beacon_visible_changed()
		$beacon_display_packet = $beacon_packet
	var $beacon_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_main.size, $beacon_delete, $beacon_focus, $beacon_notice, @beacon_locked(), $beacon_editing, $beacon_new, $beacon_info, $beacon_draft_name, $beacon_draft_main, $beacon_draft_land)
	$beacon_key = text("{},{},{},{}", $beacon_key, $beacon_draft_commands, $beacon_edit_array, $beacon_structured)

	$beacon_key = text("{},{},{}", $beacon_key, input_number("ship-dock", 0), $dock_selection_busy)

		$beacon_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{}", $beacon_key, $sqx_tg47_names.$sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_land.$sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_commands.$sqx_tg47_selected__m, @service_number("comms", 5) and (time >= $beacon_receive_after))
	$beacon_key &= text(",{},{},{}", $nav_target_revision, $sqx_ui46_nav__m, $nav_target_kind)
	if $packet_changed or ($beacon_key != $beacon_display_key) or ($beacon_display_power != 1)
		@beacon_frame()

		$beacon_display_packet = $beacon_packet
		$beacon_display_power = 1
	if @beacon_records_ap_record_locked() and !$beacon_editing and ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0)
		@beacon_nav_badge()

function @beacon_click($beacon_cx : number, $beacon_cy : number)
	if @sw_in_2() and ($beacon_cx >= 0) and ($beacon_cx < 300) and ($beacon_cy >= 0) and ($beacon_cy < 300)

function @beacon_hold($beacon_hx : number, $beacon_hy : number)
	; Repeat only PREV/NEXT. ADD and DELETE/confirmation never repeat.
	if (!@sw_in_2()) or ($beacon_hy < 274) or ($beacon_hy >= 300) or ($beacon_hx < 0) or ($beacon_hx >= 150) or $beacon_delete or $beacon_editing
		$beacon_hold_direction = 0
		return
	var $beacon_direction = -1
	if $beacon_hx >= 75
		$beacon_direction = 1
	if ($beacon_direction != $beacon_hold_direction) or ((time - $beacon_hold_last) > 0.2)
		$beacon_hold_direction = $beacon_direction
		$beacon_hold_next = time + 0.35
	$beacon_hold_last = time
	if time >= $beacon_hold_next
		@beacon_move($beacon_direction)
		$beacon_hold_next = time + 0.125

function @beacon_display_scroll($beacon_wheel_delta : number)
	if (!@sw_in_2()) or ($beacon_wheel_delta == 0) or $beacon_editing or $beacon_delete
		return
	; Reuse PREV/NEXT browsing: existing tune/target ownership stays in charge.
	$beacon_hold_direction = 0
	@beacon_move(-sign($beacon_wheel_delta))
	$beacon_display_key = ""

; Shared helpers.

; Shared, stateless presentation/input helpers. No flight/PID state here.
var $shared_background : number

; DISTANCE31 BEGIN helpers
; Presentation only: all sensors, scanner ranges and control math stay in metres.
; Long-form "miles" means nautical miles (1852m), never statute miles.
function @flight_dock_distance13($dock_display_m : number, $dock_display_signed : number) : number
	; Display-only dock datum: 3.6 feet = 1.09728 metres. Never feeds guidance.
	var $dock_display_distance = $dock_display_m - 1.09728
	if $dock_display_signed
		return $dock_display_distance
	return max($dock_display_distance, 0)

function @format_distance($distance_m : number, $distance_long : number) : text
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		return @units_distance($distance_m)
	var $distance_abs = abs($distance_m)
	var $distance_sign = ""
	if $distance_m < 0
		$distance_sign = "-"
	; Choose units before rounding: a distance below 1 NM always stays in feet.
	if $distance_abs >= 1852
		var $distance_miles = round($distance_abs / 1852)
		if !$distance_long
			return text("{}{0}NM", $distance_sign, $distance_miles)
		var $distance_mile_unit = "miles"
		if $distance_miles == 1
			$distance_mile_unit = "mile"
		return text("{}{0} {}", $distance_sign, $distance_miles, $distance_mile_unit)
	var $distance_feet = round($distance_abs / 0.3048)
	var $distance_ft = text("{0}", $distance_feet)
	; Retain sub-foot precision close to the dock without cluttering long ranges.
	if ($distance_abs < 30.48) and ($distance_feet != round($distance_abs / 0.3048 * 10) / 10)
		$distance_ft = text("{0.0}", $distance_abs / 0.3048)
	if $distance_abs < 0.01524
		$distance_sign = ""
	if !$distance_long
		return text("{}{}ft", $distance_sign, $distance_ft)
	var $distance_ft_unit = "feet"
	if $distance_ft == "1"
		$distance_ft_unit = "foot"
	return text("{}{} {}", $distance_sign, $distance_ft, $distance_ft_unit)

function @fit_distance($distance_m : number, $distance_chars : number) : text
	var $distance_label = @format_distance($distance_m, 1)
	if size($distance_label) > $distance_chars
		$distance_label = @format_distance($distance_m, 0)
	return $distance_label
; DISTANCE31 END helpers

function @shared_ap_axis_locked($ap : number, $air : number, $ground : number) : number
	return $ap and (max(abs($air), abs($ground)) * 1.94384449 >= 15)

function @shared_speed_key($axis : number, $locked : number, $approach : number, $direction : number) : number
	return $locked and (!$approach) and ($axis * $direction > 0.5)

function @draw_centered_text($canvas : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $scale : number, $ink : number, $label : text)
	$canvas.text_align(top_left)
	$canvas.text_size($scale)
	$canvas.write($x - size($label) * $canvas.char_w / 2, $y - $canvas.char_h / 2, $ink, $label)

; Only used while preparing cached panel frames, never in the flight loop.
function @draw_rounded_box($canvas : screen, $left : number, $top : number, $right : number, $bottom : number, $radius : number, $ink : number)
	$canvas.draw_line($left + $radius, $top, $right - $radius, $top, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($left + $radius, $bottom, $right - $radius, $bottom, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($left, $top + $radius, $left, $bottom - $radius, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($right, $top + $radius, $right, $bottom - $radius, $ink)
	repeat 4 ($corner)
		var $cx = $right - $radius
		var $cy = $bottom - $radius
		if ($corner == 1) or ($corner == 2)
			$cx = $left + $radius
		if $corner >= 2
			$cy = $top + $radius
		repeat 6 ($segment)
			var $a = ($corner * 6 + $segment) * pi / 12
			var $b = $a + pi / 12
			$canvas.draw_line($cx + cos($a) * $radius, $cy + sin($a) * $radius, $cx + cos($b) * $radius, $cy + sin($b) * $radius, $ink)

; TAKEOFF31 HELPERS BEGIN
; Transient guidance ownership only. No stored target or PID state is changed.
var $takeoff_active = 0
var $takeoff_engaging = 0
var $takeoff_was_ready = 0
var $takeoff_grounded = 0
var $takeoff_origin = 0
var $takeoff_heading = 0

function @takeoff_capture($to_anchor : number, $to_dock : number, $to_alt : number, $to_agl : number, $to_ground : number, $to_vs : number, $to_heading : number)
	$takeoff_grounded = $to_anchor or $to_dock or (($to_agl >= 0) and ($to_agl <= 3) and (abs($to_ground) < 2) and (abs($to_vs) < 0.5))
	if $takeoff_grounded
		$takeoff_origin = $to_alt
		$takeoff_heading = $to_heading

function @takeoff_update($to_ready : number, $to_approach : number, $to_anchor : number, $to_dock : number, $to_alt : number)
	var $to_was_active = $takeoff_active
	if (!$to_ready) or $to_approach
		$takeoff_active = 0
	elseif (!$takeoff_was_ready) and $takeoff_grounded
		$takeoff_active = 1
	$takeoff_was_ready = $to_ready
	; Height gained from the launch point, not terrain AGL: elevated docks work too.
	if $takeoff_active and (!$to_anchor) and (!$to_dock) and ($to_alt >= ($takeoff_origin + 15.24))
		$takeoff_active = 0
	$takeoff_engaging = $takeoff_active and (!$to_was_active)
; TAKEOFF31 HELPERS END

; YAWBIAS31 HELPERS BEGIN
; Bounded cruise compensation retained through heading capture.
; RAM only. Heading/rate PID gains and rotor governors are unchanged.
var $yaw_trim_bias = 0
var $yaw_trim_settled = 0
var $yaw_trim_stable_seconds = 0
var $yaw_trim_capture_heading = 0
var $yaw_trim_was_ready = 0

function @yaw_trim_reset()
	$yaw_trim_bias = 0
	$yaw_trim_settled = 0
	$yaw_trim_stable_seconds = 0
	$yaw_trim_capture_heading = 0
	$yaw_trim_was_ready = 0

function @yaw_trim_trim($yb_ready : number, $yb_approach : number, $yb_forward : number, $yb_error : number, $yb_rate : number, $yb_rate_error : number, $yb_raw : number, $yb_dt : number, $yb_heading : number) : number
	if (!$yb_ready) or $yb_approach or (abs($yb_forward) < 10)
		@yaw_trim_reset()
		return 0
	var $yb_step = min(max($yb_dt, 0), 0.1)
	if !$yaw_trim_was_ready
		$yaw_trim_capture_heading = $yb_heading
		$yaw_trim_was_ready = 1
	var $yb_heading_change = (($yb_heading - $yaw_trim_capture_heading + 540) % 360) - 180
	; Release the capture immediately for a new bearing or real yaw motion.
	; Wider exit thresholds prevent noisy readings from toggling every frame.
	if (abs($yb_heading_change) > 0.5) or (abs($yb_error) > 1) or (abs($yb_rate) > 0.15)
		$yaw_trim_settled = 0
		$yaw_trim_stable_seconds = 0
		$yaw_trim_capture_heading = $yb_heading
	if !$yaw_trim_settled
		if (abs($yb_error) <= 0.5) and (abs($yb_rate) <= 0.08)
			$yaw_trim_stable_seconds += $yb_step
		else
			$yaw_trim_stable_seconds = 0
			$yaw_trim_capture_heading = $yb_heading
		if $yaw_trim_stable_seconds >= 0.6
			$yaw_trim_settled = 1
			$yaw_trim_capture_heading = $yb_heading
	; T4e: once heading AND yaw rate are captured, release retained bias.
	; Do not erase the live rate controller or abruptly synchronize RPM commands.
	; Existing capture exit guards resume correction if heading/rate depart.
	if $yaw_trim_settled
		$yaw_trim_bias-=sign($yaw_trim_bias)*min(abs($yaw_trim_bias),0.02*$yb_step)
		return $yaw_trim_bias
	; While outside capture, retain bounded learning and saturation protection.
	var $yb_combined = $yb_raw + $yaw_trim_bias
	if (abs($yb_error) < 5) and (abs($yb_rate) < 0.25) and ((abs($yb_combined) < 0.95) or (($yb_combined * $yb_rate_error) < 0))
		$yaw_trim_bias = clamp($yaw_trim_bias + $yb_rate_error * min(max($yb_dt, 0), 0.1) * 0.006, -0.35, 0.35)
	return $yaw_trim_bias
; YAWBIAS31 HELPERS END

; Selection/permission only. No PID, rotor, or actuator changes.
var $pad_reply_sequence = 0
array $pad_request_sequences : number
array $pad_request_times : number
array $pad_request_transmitted : number
var $pad_active = 0
var $pad_releasing = 0
var $pad_release_until = 0
var $pad_id = ""
var $pad_epoch = 0
var $pad_main = ""
var $pad_land = ""
var $pad_inbox = ""
var $pad_session = 0
var $pad_sequence = 0
var $pad_sent_at = -1000
var $pad_valid_until = 0
var $pad_status = ""
var $pad_candidate_packet = ""
var $pad_selected_packet = ""
var $pad_auth_at_request = ""
var $pad_fleet_inbox_at_request = ""

function @pad_grant_valid() : number
	return $pad_active and ($pad_valid_until > time) and ($pad_auth_at_request == $fleet_auth_code__m) and ($pad_fleet_inbox_at_request == $fleet_inbox__m) and ($fleet_auth_code__m != "") and $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m and (device_type("comms") == "Beacon")

function @pad_release()
	if $pad_active
		$pad_active = 0
		$pad_releasing = 1
		$pad_release_until = time + 20
		$fleet_join_next = time
	$pad_valid_until = 0
	$sec_expected_reply_from = ""

; A legacy compatibility path is NOT a reservation grant or an authenticated link.
; Once a channel advertises reservations, never downgrade it in this boot session.
var $pad_legacy = 0
var $pad_legacy_main = ""
var $pad_legacy_land = ""
array $pad_reservation_mains : text

function @pad_requires_reservation($pl_packet : text, $pl_main : text) : number
	foreach $pad_reservation_mains ($pl_i, $pl_known)
		if $pl_known == $pl_main
			return 1
	foreach $pl_packet ($pl_key, $pl_value)
		if ($pl_key == "reservationversion") or ($pl_key == "padepoch") or ($pl_key == "dockreserved") or ($pl_key == "dockowner")
			if $pad_reservation_mains.size < 128
				$pad_reservation_mains.append($pl_main)
			return 1
	; Saturated capability memory fails closed until reboot, rather than evicting.
	return $pad_reservation_mains.size >= 128

function @pad_legacy_ok($pl_packet : text, $pl_main : text, $pl_land : text) : number
	if @pad_requires_reservation($pl_packet, $pl_main) or ($pl_packet == "") or !@fleet_text_valid($pl_main, 0) or !@fleet_text_valid($pl_land, 0) or ($pl_land == "0000")
		return 0
	var $pl_structured = 0
	foreach $pl_packet ($pl_key, $pl_value)
		$pl_structured = 1
		if ($pl_key == "frequency") and ($pl_value != $pl_main)
			return 0
		if ($pl_key == "dockvalid") or ($pl_key == "dockavailable")
			if !isnumeric($pl_value)
				return 0
			if $pl_value:number != 1
				return 0
		if $pl_key == "dockoccupied"
			if !isnumeric($pl_value)
				return 0
			if $pl_value:number != 0
				return 0
	if ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==3) and $sqx_home_assume__m and ($pl_main==$sqx_home_main__m) and ($pl_land==$sqx_home_main__m) and (@fleet_get($pl_packet,"landingfrequency")=="")
		return 1
	if $pl_structured and (@fleet_get($pl_packet, "landingfrequency") != $pl_land)
		return 0
	return 1

function @pad_legacy_guidance() : number
	var $pl_payload = input_text("docking-beacon", 0)
	var $pl_heading = input_number("docking-beacon", 0)
	var $pl_distance = input_number("docking-beacon", 1)
	return input_number("docking-beacon", 5) and isnumeric($pl_payload) and ($pl_heading >= 0) and ($pl_heading <= 360) and ($pl_distance > 0) and ($pl_distance < 1000) and ($dock_selection_frequency == $pad_legacy_land)

function @pad_legacy_begin($pl_main : text, $pl_land : text)
	@pad_release()
	$pad_legacy = 1
	$pad_legacy_main = $pl_main
	$pad_legacy_land = $pl_land
	$pad_status = "LEGACY PAD / UNRESERVED"

function @pad_legacy_abort()
	$pad_legacy = 0
	$mission_internal=1
	@switches_action(9)
	$mission_internal=0
	$dock_selection_ready = 0
	$pad_status = "LEGACY PAD SIGNAL LOST / BUSY"
	$beacon_notice = $pad_status
	$switches_notice = $pad_status

function @pad_legacy_guard()
	if !$pad_legacy
		return
	if input_number("ship-dock", 0) or !$sqx_sw49_dock__m or !$sqx_sw49_power__m or !$sqx_sw49_ap__m or !$sqx_sw49_stab__m or !$sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		$pad_legacy = 0
		$pad_status = ""
		return
	if $dock_selection_ready and !@pad_legacy_guidance()
		@pad_legacy_abort()

function @pad_capable($pc_packet : text, $pc_main : text) : number
	return (@fleet_num($pc_packet, "reservationversion") == 1) and (@fleet_get($pc_packet, "baseid") != "") and (size(@fleet_get($pc_packet, "baseid")) <= 64) and (@fleet_num($pc_packet, "padepoch") > 0) and (@fleet_get($pc_packet, "frequency") == $pc_main) and @fleet_text_valid(@fleet_get($pc_packet, "fleetinbox"), 0) and @fleet_text_valid(@fleet_get($pc_packet, "landingfrequency"), 0) and (@fleet_get($pc_packet, "landingfrequency") != "0000") and (@fleet_num($pc_packet, "dockvalid") == 1)

function @pad_request($pc_packet : text, $pc_main : text) : number
	$pad_legacy = 0
	var $pc_requires = @pad_requires_reservation($pc_packet, $pc_main)
	if !@pad_capable($pc_packet, $pc_main)
		$pad_status = "PAD RESERVATION REQUIRED"
		return 0
	if ($fleet_auth_code__m == "") or !@fleet_text_valid($fleet_auth_code__m, 0) or (@fleet_get($pc_packet, "fleetinbox") != $fleet_inbox__m) or (device_type("comms") != "Beacon") or !$sqx_bc14_tx_on__m
		$pad_status = "SET FLEET AUTH / CHANNEL"
		return 0
	if !$pad_active or ($pad_id != @fleet_get($pc_packet, "baseid")) or ($pad_epoch != @fleet_num($pc_packet, "padepoch")) or ($pad_main != $pc_main) or ($pad_land != @fleet_get($pc_packet, "landingfrequency"))
		$pad_id = @fleet_get($pc_packet, "baseid")
		$pad_epoch = @fleet_num($pc_packet, "padepoch")
		$pad_main = $pc_main
		$pad_land = @fleet_get($pc_packet, "landingfrequency")
		$pad_inbox = @fleet_get($pc_packet, "fleetinbox")
		$pad_auth_at_request = $fleet_auth_code__m
		$pad_fleet_inbox_at_request = $fleet_inbox__m
		$pad_session = random(1, 999999999)
		$pad_sequence = 0
		$pad_reply_sequence = 0
		$pad_request_sequences.clear()
		$pad_request_times.clear()
		$pad_request_transmitted.clear()
		$pad_valid_until = 0
		$pad_active = 1
		$sec_expected_reply_from = $pad_id
		$pad_releasing = 0
		$pad_status = "REQUESTING PAD"
		$fleet_join_next = time
	if (@fleet_num($pc_packet, "dockoccupied") != 0) or ((@fleet_get($pc_packet, "dockowner") != "") and (@fleet_get($pc_packet, "dockowner") != $fleet_id))
		$pad_valid_until = 0
		$pad_status = "PAD BUSY"
		return 0
	return @pad_grant_valid()

function @pad_message() : text
	var $pc_message = ""
	if !$pad_active and (!$pad_releasing or (time >= $pad_release_until))
		$pad_releasing = 0
		return $pc_message
	$pad_sequence += 1
	$pad_sent_at = time
	if $pad_request_sequences.size >= 8
		$pad_request_sequences.erase(0)
		$pad_request_times.erase(0)
		$pad_request_transmitted.erase(0)
	$pad_request_sequences.append($pad_sequence)
	$pad_request_times.append($pad_sent_at)
	$pad_request_transmitted.append(0)
	if $pad_active and !@pad_grant_valid() and ($pad_status != "PAD BUSY")
		$pad_status = "WAITING FOR RESPONSE"
	$pc_message.baseid = $pad_id
	$pc_message.epoch = $pad_epoch
	$pc_message.main = $pad_main
	$pc_message.land = $pad_land
	$pc_message.session = $pad_session
	$pc_message.sequence = $pad_sequence
	$pc_message.action = "reserve"
	if !$pad_active
		$pc_message.action = "release"
	return $pc_message

function @pad_note_transmission()
	if !$pad_active or ($sec_last_sent_at < 0)
		return
	var $pt_air = @fleet_get($sec_last_sent_plain,"pad")
	if (@fleet_get($pt_air,"baseid") != $pad_id) or (@fleet_num($pt_air,"session") != $pad_session) or (@fleet_num($pt_air,"epoch") != $pad_epoch) or (@fleet_get($pt_air,"action") != "reserve")
		return
	var $pt_air_sequence = @fleet_num($pt_air,"sequence")
	foreach $pad_request_sequences ($pt_i,$pt_pending)
		if ($pt_pending == $pt_air_sequence) and !$pad_request_transmitted.$pt_i
			; Set exactly once from the physical TX event. Receiving/replaying
			; this grant never moves that deadline forward.
			$pad_request_times.$pt_i = $sec_last_sent_at
			$pad_request_transmitted.$pt_i = 1

function @pad_reply($pc_answer : text)
	@pad_note_transmission()
	if !$pad_active or (size($pc_answer) > 768)
		return
	if (@fleet_get($pc_answer, "baseid") != $pad_id) or (@fleet_num($pc_answer, "epoch") != $pad_epoch) or (@fleet_get($pc_answer, "main") != $pad_main) or (@fleet_get($pc_answer, "land") != $pad_land) or (@fleet_num($pc_answer, "session") != $pad_session)
		return
	; A later renewal must not invalidate an authentic reply still in flight.
	; Preserve the ORIGINAL request deadline; never extend it at receipt.
	var $pc_sequence = @fleet_num($pc_answer,"sequence")
	if $pc_sequence <= $pad_reply_sequence
		return
	var $pc_sent = -1000
	foreach $pad_request_sequences ($pc_i,$pc_pending)
		if ($pc_pending == $pc_sequence) and $pad_request_transmitted.$pc_i
			$pc_sent = $pad_request_times.$pc_i
	if time >= $pc_sent + 20
		return
	$pad_reply_sequence = $pc_sequence
	$pad_status = substring(@fleet_get($pc_answer, "status"), 0, 32)
	if @fleet_num($pc_answer, "granted") == 1
		$pad_valid_until = $pc_sent + 20
	else
		$pad_valid_until = 0

function @pad_client_guard()
	@pad_note_transmission()
	@pad_legacy_guard()
	if !$pad_active
		return
	if ($pad_auth_at_request != $fleet_auth_code__m) or ($pad_fleet_inbox_at_request != $fleet_inbox__m)
		$pad_valid_until = 0
	; An explicit DOCK request can negotiate while the aircraft is stopped.
	; Flight guidance still requires MASTER/STAB/ROTORS in docking_update.
	; Cancelling DOCK releases unless active NAV still owns this exact pad.
	if input_number("ship-dock", 0) or !$sqx_sw49_power__m or ((!$sqx_sw49_dock__m) and ((!$sqx_sw49_ap__m) or (!$sqx_sw49_stab__m) or (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) or (!$sqx_ui46_nav__m) or ($beacon_nav_signal != $pad_main)))
		@pad_release()
		return
	if $sqx_sw49_dock__m and $dock_selection_ready and !@pad_grant_valid()
		; Permission expiry stops approach, not the user's DOCK request/AP.
		; Phase 7 reuses the exact selected pad and existing acquisition hold.
		$dock_selection_ready = 0
		$dock_selection_busy = 1
		$dock_selection_start = 0
		$dock_selection_phase = 7
		$fleet_join_next = min($fleet_join_next,time)
		$pad_status = "CLEARANCE EXPIRED / RETRY"
		$beacon_notice = $pad_status
		$switches_notice = $pad_status

function @pad_selection_guard()
	@pad_client_guard()
	if $sqx_sw49_dock__m and !input_number("ship-dock", 0)
		$beacon_notice = $pad_status
		if !@pad_grant_valid() and !$pad_legacy
			$dock_selection_ready = 0

xc_files.name: boot-branding.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Display-only startup. No flight requests, radio output, actuator or storage writes.
var $brand_logo = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $brand_frame = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $brand_seeded = 0
var $brand_row = 0
var $brand_column = 0
var $brand_cursor = 0
var $brand_ready = 0
var $brand_building = 0
var $brand_started = -1
var $brand_wait_at = 0
var $brand_phase = 0
var $brand_luma = 0
var $brand_frame_key = ""
var $brand_firmware = "v4.0T6aW"
var $brand_sleep_requested = 0
var $brand_sleep_tint : number
var $brand_dim : number
var $brand_steel : number

var $brand_bypass_reason = ""

function @brand_safe_to_show() : number
	$brand_bypass_reason = ""
	; Conservative: never hide instruments during a running-rotor restart/takeoff.
	if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m or $sqx_sw49_ap__m or $sqx_ui46_nav__m or $docking_active
		$brand_bypass_reason = "ACTIVE FLIGHT CONTROLS"
		return 0
	; Propeller channel 0 is signed native speed; cockpit RPM uses abs(value)*30.
	if (abs(input_number("front-left-prop", 0)) > 1.666667) or (abs(input_number("front-right-prop", 0)) > 1.666667) or (abs(input_number("rear-left-prop", 0)) > 1.666667) or (abs(input_number("rear-right-prop", 0)) > 1.666667)
		$brand_bypass_reason = "ROTORS SPINNING"
		return 0
	if (abs(@standby_nav(10)) > 1) or (abs(@standby_nav(1)) > 0.5)
		$brand_bypass_reason = "CRAFT MOVING"
		return 0
	if input_number("ship-dock", 0) or input_number("left-anchor", 0)
		return 1
	; Unknown navigation is not proof that a reboot happened on the ground.
	if (device_type("nav") == "") or (@standby_nav_text(13) == "")
		$brand_bypass_reason = "NAV DATA UNAVAILABLE"
		return 0
	if @standby_nav(3) > 3
		$brand_bypass_reason = "ABOVE GROUND START"
		return 0
	return 1

function @brand_seed()
	if $brand_seeded
		return
	@brand_asset_seed()
	$brand_logo.blank(black)
	$brand_frame.blank(black)
	$brand_dim = color(90, 110, 126)
	$brand_steel = color(8, 14, 22)
	$brand_sleep_tint = color(100,100,100)
	$brand_seeded = 1

function @brand_restart()
	$brand_started = -1
	$brand_wait_at = time
	$brand_phase = 0
	$brand_luma = 0
	$brand_building = 0
	$brand_frame_key = ""

function @brand_work()
	; Called at the END of update, after the original control/update bodies.
	; The asset is decoded once per computer boot, never once per rendered frame.
	if !$brand_building or $brand_ready or !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	; Only an explicit Sleep request permits background cache work in flight.
	; The same small IPC budget and end-of-update ordering remain unchanged.
	if !$brand_sleep_requested
		if !@brand_safe_to_show()
			$brand_building = 0
			return
	@brand_seed()
	var $br_begin = ipc
	var $br_budget = min(24000, system_ipc * 0.12)
	if system_ipc <= 0
		$br_budget = 24000
	repeat 600 ($br_n)
		if (ipc - $br_begin > $br_budget) or ((system_ipc > 0) and (ipc > system_ipc * 0.8))
			return
		if $brand_row >= $brand_asset_size
			$brand_ready = 1
			$brand_building = 0
			return
		var $br_line = $brand_rows.$brand_row
		var $br_length = find($brand_alphabet, substring($br_line, $brand_cursor, 1)) + 1
		var $br_index = find($brand_alphabet, substring($br_line, $brand_cursor + 1, 1))
		var $br_color = $brand_palette.$br_index
		$brand_logo.draw_rect($brand_column, $brand_row, $brand_column + $br_length, $brand_row + 1, $br_color, $br_color)
		$brand_column += $br_length
		$brand_cursor += 2
		if $brand_cursor >= size($br_line)
			$brand_row += 1
			$brand_column = 0
			$brand_cursor = 0

function @brand_tick() : number
	if !@brand_safe_to_show()
		$brand_building = 0
		$brand_phase = 5
		print("Badger startup skipped: " & $brand_bypass_reason)
		return 1
	@brand_seed()
	if !$brand_ready and ($brand_started < 0)
		$brand_building = 1
		; A constrained CPU must not trap the pilot behind a loading screen.
		if time - $brand_wait_at < 3
			$brand_phase = 0
			return 0
		$brand_building = 0
		; Stay beyond the fade boundary despite floating-point time subtraction.
		$brand_started = time - 2.31
	if $brand_started < 0
		$brand_started = time
	var $br_elapsed = time - $brand_started
	$brand_luma = 1
	$brand_phase = 1
	if $br_elapsed < 0.8
		$brand_luma = clamp($br_elapsed / 0.8, 0, 1)
	elseif $br_elapsed < 1.65
		$brand_phase = 2
	elseif $br_elapsed < 2.3
		$brand_phase = 3
		$brand_luma = clamp((2.3 - $br_elapsed) / 0.65, 0, 1)
	elseif $br_elapsed < 4.3
		$brand_phase = 4
	else
		$brand_phase = 5
	return $brand_phase == 5

function @brand_bios_row($br_y : number, $br_label : text, $br_value : text, $br_ink : number)
	$brand_frame.text_size(1)
	$brand_frame.text_align(left)
	$brand_frame.write(15, $br_y, $brand_dim, $br_label)
	$brand_frame.text_align(right)
	$brand_frame.write(285, $br_y, $br_ink, $br_value)

function @brand_render()
	var $br_key = text("{},{0},{}", $brand_phase, $brand_luma * 255, $brand_ready)
	if $brand_phase == 4
		; Status refreshes only while this page is visible. No secrets on the BIOS.
		$br_key &= text(",{0},{},{},{}", floor(time * 5), $sec_ready, $fleet_tx_ready, $fleet_last_ack)
	if $br_key == $brand_frame_key
		return
	$brand_frame_key = $br_key
	$brand_frame.blank(black)
	if ($brand_phase >= 1) and ($brand_phase <= 3)
		var $br_light = floor($brand_luma * 255)
		screen_copy($brand_logo, $brand_frame, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300, color($br_light, $br_light, $br_light))
		return
	if $brand_phase == 0
		@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 128, 1.8, orange, "BADGER")
		@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 157, 0.9, $brand_dim, "PREPARING DISPLAY CACHE")
		@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 280, 0.65, $brand_dim, "FLIGHT CONTROLS RUN IN BACKGROUND")
		return
	$brand_frame.blank($brand_steel)
	@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 24, 1.5, orange, "BADGER FLIGHT SYSTEMS")
	@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 44, 0.85, cyan, $brand_firmware & "  /  BY CHIP PATTON")
	$brand_frame.draw_line(15, 61, 285, 61, $brand_dim)
	@brand_bios_row(84, "DISPLAY ROUTER", "ONLINE", green)
	var $br_nav = "NOT DETECTED"
	var $br_ink = yellow
	if (device_type("nav") != "") and (@standby_nav_text(13) != "")
		$br_nav = "DATA PRESENT"
		$br_ink = green
	@brand_bios_row(108, "NAV INSTRUMENT", $br_nav, $br_ink)
	var $br_rotors = 0
	if device_type("front-left-prop") != ""
		$br_rotors += 1
	if device_type("front-right-prop") != ""
		$br_rotors += 1
	if device_type("rear-left-prop") != ""
		$br_rotors += 1
	if device_type("rear-right-prop") != ""
		$br_rotors += 1
	$br_ink = yellow
	if $br_rotors == 4

	@brand_bios_row(132, "ROTOR DEVICES", text("{0}/4 FOUND", $br_rotors), $br_ink)
	var $br_radio = "NO COMMS DEVICE"
	$br_ink = yellow
	if device_type("comms") != ""
		$br_radio = "CLAIMING CHANNEL"

	@brand_bios_row(156, "FLEET RADIO", $br_radio, $br_ink)
	var $br_secure = "PREPARING KEY"
	$br_ink = yellow
	if $fleet_auth_code__m == ""
		$br_secure = "DISABLED"
		$br_ink = $brand_dim
	elseif $sec_ready
		$br_secure = "KEY READY"
		$br_ink = green
	@brand_bios_row(180, "PRIVATE LINK", $br_secure, $br_ink)
	var $br_base = "WAITING / OPTIONAL"
	$br_ink = $brand_dim
	if $sec_ready and (time - $fleet_last_ack < 60)
		$br_base = "AUTHENTICATED"
		$br_ink = green
	@brand_bios_row(204, "BASE SESSION", $br_base, $br_ink)
	$brand_frame.draw_line(15, 229, 285, 229, $brand_dim)
	@access_text($brand_frame, 150, 247, 0.9, white, "STARTING COCKPIT")
