xc_files.name: crypto-sha.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; SHA-256 key derivation: domain-separated hash of the game-only pairing code.
; This is not a slow password-hardening scheme; use a strong, unique game key.
array $cr_sha_k : number
array $cr_sha_h : number
array $cr_sha_w : number

function @cr_ror($cs_v : number, $cs_n : number) : number
	var $cs_p = pow(2,$cs_n)
	return floor($cs_v / $cs_p) + mod($cs_v,$cs_p) * pow(2,32 - $cs_n)

function @cr_and($cs_a : number, $cs_b : number) : number
	return ($cs_a + $cs_b - @cr_xor($cs_a,$cs_b)) / 2

function @cr_sha_boot()
	if $cr_sha_k.size > 0
		return
	$cr_sha_k.append(1116352408,1899447441,3049323471,3921009573,961987163,1508970993,2453635748,2870763221,3624381080,310598401,607225278,1426881987,1925078388,2162078206,2614888103,3248222580,3835390401,4022224774,264347078,604807628,770255983,1249150122,1555081692,1996064986,2554220882,2821834349,2952996808,3210313671,3336571891,3584528711,113926993,338241895,666307205,773529912,1294757372,1396182291,1695183700,1986661051,2177026350,2456956037,2730485921,2820302411,3259730800,3345764771,3516065817,3600352804,4094571909,275423344,430227734,506948616,659060556,883997877,958139571,1322822218,1537002063,1747873779,1955562222,2024104815,2227730452,2361852424,2428436474,2756734187,3204031479,3329325298)

function @cr_sha256_hex($cs_hex : text) : text
	@cr_sha_boot()
	var $cs_length = size($cs_hex) * 4
	var $cs_message = $cs_hex & "80"
	while mod(size($cs_message),128) != 112
		$cs_message &= "00"
	$cs_message &= "00000000"
	var $cs_length_hex = @cr_word_hex($cs_length)
	for 3,0 ($cs_j)
		$cs_message &= substring($cs_length_hex,$cs_j * 2,2)
	$cr_sha_h.clear()
	$cr_sha_h.append(1779033703,3144134277,1013904242,2773480762,1359893119,2600822924,528734635,1541459225)
	var $cs_blocks = size($cs_message) / 128
	repeat $cs_blocks ($cs_block)
		$cr_sha_w.clear()
		repeat 16 ($cs_i)
			$cr_sha_w.append(@cr_hex_number(substring($cs_message,$cs_block * 128 + $cs_i * 8,8)))
		for 16,63 ($cs_i)
			var $cs_i15 = $cs_i - 15
			var $cs_i2 = $cs_i - 2
			var $cs_i16 = $cs_i - 16
			var $cs_i7 = $cs_i - 7
			var $cs_s0 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$cs_i15,7),@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$cs_i15,18)),floor($cr_sha_w.$cs_i15 / 8))
			var $cs_s1 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$cs_i2,17),@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$cs_i2,19)),floor($cr_sha_w.$cs_i2 / 1024))
			$cr_sha_w.append(mod($cr_sha_w.$cs_i16 + $cs_s0 + $cr_sha_w.$cs_i7 + $cs_s1,4294967296))
		var $cs_a = $cr_sha_h.0
		var $cs_b = $cr_sha_h.1
		var $cs_c = $cr_sha_h.2
		var $cs_d = $cr_sha_h.3
		var $cs_e = $cr_sha_h.4
		var $cs_f = $cr_sha_h.5
		var $cs_g = $cr_sha_h.6
		var $cs_h = $cr_sha_h.7
		repeat 64 ($cs_i)
			var $cs_s1 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cs_e,6),@cr_ror($cs_e,11)),@cr_ror($cs_e,25))
			var $cs_ch = @cr_xor($cs_g,@cr_and($cs_e,@cr_xor($cs_f,$cs_g)))
			var $cs_t1 = mod($cs_h + $cs_s1 + $cs_ch + $cr_sha_k.$cs_i + $cr_sha_w.$cs_i,4294967296)
			var $cs_s0 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cs_a,2),@cr_ror($cs_a,13)),@cr_ror($cs_a,22))
			var $cs_maj = @cr_xor(@cr_and($cs_a,$cs_b),@cr_and($cs_c,@cr_xor($cs_a,$cs_b)))
			var $cs_t2 = mod($cs_s0 + $cs_maj,4294967296)
			$cs_h = $cs_g
			$cs_g = $cs_f
			$cs_f = $cs_e
			$cs_e = mod($cs_d + $cs_t1,4294967296)
			$cs_d = $cs_c
			$cs_c = $cs_b
			$cs_b = $cs_a
			$cs_a = mod($cs_t1 + $cs_t2,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.0 = mod($cr_sha_h.0 + $cs_a,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.1 = mod($cr_sha_h.1 + $cs_b,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.2 = mod($cr_sha_h.2 + $cs_c,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.3 = mod($cr_sha_h.3 + $cs_d,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.4 = mod($cr_sha_h.4 + $cs_e,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.5 = mod($cr_sha_h.5 + $cs_f,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.6 = mod($cr_sha_h.6 + $cs_g,4294967296)
		$cr_sha_h.7 = mod($cr_sha_h.7 + $cs_h,4294967296)
	var $cs_result = ""
	foreach $cr_sha_h ($cs_i,$cs_v)
		var $cs_word = @cr_word_hex($cs_v)
		for 3,0 ($cs_j)
			$cs_result &= substring($cs_word,$cs_j * 2,2)
	return $cs_result

xc_files.name: geology.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Geology.

; GEO is a survey/display subsystem, NEVER a flight controller.
; Exclusive use of the existing ore pivot/scanners while its tab is selected.
; 72 stationary, settled rays x 64 fixed distances; all detections are candidates.
; No water mask/biome/volcano ID exists in the scanner API. Do not claim one.
var $geology_selected = 0
var $geology_running = 0
var $geology_owned = 0
; Match cockpit miles: nautical miles (1852 m). Scan all supported kinds.
var $geology_range = 3704
var $geology_length = 1000
var $geology_row = 0
var $geology_class_row = 0
var $geology_stage = 0
var $geology_stable_at = -1
var $geology_packets = 0
var $geology_requests_live = 0
var $geology_revision = 0
var $geology_origin_valid = 0
var $geology_lat = 0
var $geology_lon = 0
var $geology_radius = 0
var $geology_body = ""
var $geology_status = "PRESS START TO SURVEY"
array $geology_heights : number
array $geology_fluorite : number
array $geology_bearings : number
array $geology_valid : number
; Additive persistent database; NEVER the AP's beacon/target database.
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_lat : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_lon : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_kind : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_length : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_variation : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_body : text
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_radius : number
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_name : text
storage array $sqx_geo18_find_notes : text
storage array $sqx_geo20_elevation : number
storage array $sqx_geo20_elevation_known : number
storage array $sqx_geo20_annotation_ready : number
var $geology_full = 0
var $geology_filter = 0
var $geology_focus = -1
var $geology_clear_pending = 0
var $geology_delete_pending = -1

function @geology_label($geo_kind : number) : text
	if $geo_kind==8
		return "ORE"
	if $geo_kind == 1
		return "FLAT?"
	elseif $geo_kind == 2
		return "PLAT?"
	elseif $geo_kind == 5
		return "PEAK?"
	elseif $geo_kind == 6
		return "BASIN?"
	elseif $geo_kind == 7
		return "VOLC?"
	return "ALL"

function @geology_delta($geo_a : number) : number
	return mod($geo_a + 540, 360) - 180

function @geology_north($geo_lat : number, $geo_base : number, $geo_r : number) : number
	return ($geo_lat - $geo_base) * pi / 180 * $geo_r

function @geology_east($geo_lon : number, $geo_base : number, $geo_lat : number, $geo_r : number) : number
	return @geology_delta($geo_lon - $geo_base) * pi / 180 * $geo_r * cos($geo_lat * pi / 180)

function @geology_clear_finds()
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_lat ($nt_i, $nt_latitude)
		if @nav_target_record_locked($nt_latitude, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$nt_i, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$nt_i)
			$geology_status = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
			return
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_lat ($nt_i, $nt_latitude)
		if @nav_target_same($nt_latitude, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$nt_i, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$nt_i)
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
	; Storage repair or explicitly confirmed CLEAR only, never normal controls.
	$sqx_geo18_find_lat.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_lon.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_kind.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_length.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_variation.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_body.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_radius.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_name.clear()
	$sqx_geo18_find_notes.clear()
	$sqx_geo20_elevation.clear()
	$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.clear()
	$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.clear()
	$geology_full = 0
	$geology_focus = -1
	$geology_delete_pending = -1
	$geology_revision += 1

function @geology_delete($geo_index : number) : number
	if ($geo_index < 0) or ($geo_index >= $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size) or ($geo_index != floor($geo_index))
		return 0
	if @nav_target_record_locked($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_index, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_index, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_index)
		$geology_status = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
		return 0
	if @nav_target_same($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_index, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_index, $sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_index)
		var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
	; Delete one complete record; unrelated GEO entries and beacons stay intact.
	$sqx_geo18_find_lat.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_lon.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_kind.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_length.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_variation.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_body.erase($geo_index)
	$sqx_geo18_find_radius.erase($geo_index)
	if $geo_index < $sqx_geo18_find_name.size
		$sqx_geo18_find_name.erase($geo_index)
	if $geo_index < $sqx_geo18_find_notes.size
		$sqx_geo18_find_notes.erase($geo_index)
	if $geo_index < $sqx_geo20_elevation.size
		$sqx_geo20_elevation.erase($geo_index)
	if $geo_index < $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.size
		$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.erase($geo_index)
	if $geo_index < $sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.size
		$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.erase($geo_index)
	$geology_full = 0
	$geology_focus = -1
	$geology_delete_pending = -1
	$geology_revision += 1
	return 1

function @geology_boot()
	; Rebuild complete, valid records; bounded RAM and persistent storage.
	array $geo_lat : number
	array $geo_lon : number
	array $geo_kind : number
	array $geo_len : number
	array $geo_dz : number
	array $geo_body : text
	array $geo_radius : number
	array $geo_name : text
	array $geo_notes : text
	array $geo_elevation : number
	array $geo_known : number
	array $geo_annotation_ready : number
	$geo_lat.clear()
	$geo_lon.clear()
	$geo_kind.clear()
	$geo_len.clear()
	$geo_dz.clear()
	$geo_body.clear()
	$geo_radius.clear()
	$geo_name.clear()
	$geo_notes.clear()
	$geo_elevation.clear()
	$geo_known.clear()
	$geo_annotation_ready.clear()
	var $geo_count = min(256, min($sqx_geo18_find_lat.size, min($sqx_geo18_find_lon.size, min($sqx_geo18_find_kind.size, min($sqx_geo18_find_length.size, min($sqx_geo18_find_variation.size, min($sqx_geo18_find_body.size, $sqx_geo18_find_radius.size)))))))
	repeat $geo_count ($geo_i)
		var $geo_k = $sqx_geo18_find_kind.$geo_i
		if ($geo_k != 1) and ($geo_k != 2) and ($geo_k != 5) and ($geo_k != 6) and ($geo_k != 7) and ($geo_k != 8)
			continue
		if (abs($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_i) > 89) or (abs($sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_i) > 180) or ($sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_i == "") or (size($sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_i) > 32) or ($sqx_geo18_find_radius.$geo_i <= 1000)
			continue
		$geo_lat.append($sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_i)
		$geo_lon.append($sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_i)
		$geo_kind.append($geo_k)
		$geo_len.append(clamp($sqx_geo18_find_length.$geo_i, 0, 20000))
		$geo_dz.append(clamp($sqx_geo18_find_variation.$geo_i, 0, 100000))
		$geo_body.append($sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_i)
		$geo_radius.append($sqx_geo18_find_radius.$geo_i)
		var $name = ""
		var $notes = ""
		if $geo_i < $sqx_geo18_find_name.size
			$name = substring($sqx_geo18_find_name.$geo_i, 0, 32)
		if $geo_i < $sqx_geo18_find_notes.size
			$notes = substring($sqx_geo18_find_notes.$geo_i, 0, 160)
		$geo_name.append($name)
		$geo_notes.append($notes)
		var $geo_height = 0
		var $geo_has_height = 0
		if ($geo_i < $sqx_geo20_elevation.size) and ($geo_i < $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.size)
			$geo_height = $sqx_geo20_elevation.$geo_i
			$geo_has_height = $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.$geo_i and (abs($geo_height) < 100000)
		$geo_elevation.append($geo_height)
		$geo_known.append($geo_has_height)
		var $geo_annotation_done = 0
		if $geo_i < $sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.size
			$geo_annotation_done = $sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.$geo_i
		$geo_annotation_ready.append($geo_annotation_done)
	@geology_clear_finds()
	foreach $geo_kind ($geo_i, $geo_k)
		$sqx_geo18_find_lat.append($geo_lat.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_lon.append($geo_lon.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_kind.append($geo_k)
		$sqx_geo18_find_length.append($geo_len.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_variation.append($geo_dz.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_body.append($geo_body.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_radius.append($geo_radius.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_name.append($geo_name.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo18_find_notes.append($geo_notes.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo20_elevation.append($geo_elevation.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.append($geo_known.$geo_i)
		$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.append($geo_annotation_ready.$geo_i)
	$geology_full = ($sqx_geo18_find_kind.size >= 256)

function @geology_reset()
	$geology_heights.clear()
	$geology_fluorite.clear()
	$geology_bearings.clear()
	$geology_valid.clear()
	repeat 4608 ($geo_cell)
		$geology_heights.append(0)
		$geology_fluorite.append(0)
	repeat 72 ($geo_ray)
		$geology_bearings.append(0)
		$geology_valid.append(0)
	$geology_row = 0
	$geology_class_row = 0
	$geology_stage = 0
	$geology_origin_valid = 0
	$geology_stable_at = -1
	$geology_packets = 0
	$geology_status = "HOLD STILL / LEVEL"
	$geology_revision += 1

function @geology_quiet()
	@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
	; A zero distance deactivates a scanner channel; no old far requests linger.
	if $geology_requests_live
		repeat 100 ($geo_channel)
			output_number("terrain_scanner", $geo_channel, 0)
			output_number("ore_scanner", $geo_channel, 0)
	$geology_requests_live = 0
	$geology_packets = 0
	$geology_stable_at = -1

function @geology_add($geo_kind : number, $geo_row : number, $geo_distance : number, $geo_len : number, $geo_dz : number)
	if (!$geology_origin_valid) or ($geo_row < 0) or ($geo_row >= 72) or ($geology_radius <= 1000) or ($geology_body == "")
		return
	if ($geo_kind != 1) and ($geo_kind != 2) and ($geo_kind != 5) and ($geo_kind != 6) and ($geo_kind != 7) and ($geo_kind != 8)
		return
	var $geo_angle = $geology_bearings.$geo_row * pi / 180
	var $geo_n = cos($geo_angle) * $geo_distance
	var $geo_e = sin($geo_angle) * $geo_distance
	var $geo_cos = cos($geology_lat * pi / 180)
	if abs($geo_cos) < 0.01
		return
	var $geo_f_lat = $geology_lat + $geo_n / $geology_radius * 180 / pi
	var $geo_f_lon = @geology_delta($geology_lon + $geo_e / ($geology_radius * $geo_cos) * 180 / pi)
	; TerrainScanner returns sea-level elevation, including legitimate zero.
	var $geo_sample_height = 0
	var $geo_sample_known = 0
	var $geo_sample_slot = $geo_row * 64 + clamp(round($geo_distance / max($geology_range, 1) * 64) - 1, 0, 63)
	if ($geo_row < $geology_valid.size) and ($geo_sample_slot < $geology_heights.size)
		$geo_sample_height = $geology_heights.$geo_sample_slot
		$geo_sample_known = $geology_valid.$geo_row and (abs($geo_sample_height) < 100000)
	; Bounded, same-kind spatial clustering. No thousands of nearly identical flags.
	foreach $sqx_geo18_find_kind ($geo_fi, $geo_fk)
		if ($geo_fk == $geo_kind) and ($sqx_geo18_find_body.$geo_fi == $geology_body)
			var $geo_dn = @geology_north($geo_f_lat, $sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_fi, $geology_radius)
			var $geo_de = @geology_east($geo_f_lon, $sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_fi, $geo_f_lat, $geology_radius)
			if ($geo_dn * $geo_dn + $geo_de * $geo_de) < 250000
				if $geo_sample_known and ($geo_fi < $sqx_geo20_elevation_known.size) and (!$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.$geo_fi)
					; Re-observed old cluster now refers to this verified sampled point.
					$sqx_geo18_find_lat.$geo_fi = $geo_f_lat
					$sqx_geo18_find_lon.$geo_fi = $geo_f_lon
					$sqx_geo20_elevation.$geo_fi = $geo_sample_height
					$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.$geo_fi = 1
					$geology_revision += 1
				return
	if $sqx_geo18_find_kind.size >= 256
		if !$geology_full
			print("GEO: saved waypoint limit (256) reached; existing discoveries retained.")
		$geology_full = 1
		return
	$sqx_geo18_find_lat.append($geo_f_lat)
	$sqx_geo18_find_lon.append($geo_f_lon)
	$sqx_geo18_find_kind.append($geo_kind)
	$sqx_geo18_find_length.append($geo_len)
	$sqx_geo18_find_variation.append($geo_dz)
	$sqx_geo18_find_body.append($geology_body)
	$sqx_geo18_find_radius.append($geology_radius)
	$sqx_geo18_find_name.append(@geology_label($geo_kind))
	$sqx_geo18_find_notes.append("INFERRED FROM ELEVATIONS / CHECK SITE")
	$sqx_geo20_elevation.append($geo_sample_height)
	$sqx_geo20_elevation_known.append($geo_sample_known)
	$sqx_geo20_annotation_ready.append(1)
	$geology_revision += 1

function @geology_height($geo_row : number, $geo_col : number) : number
	var $geo_index = mod($geo_row + 72, 72) * 64 + clamp($geo_col, 0, 63)
	return $geology_heights.$geo_index

function @geology_classify($geo_row : number)
	var $geo_left = mod($geo_row + 71, 72)
	var $geo_right = mod($geo_row + 1, 72)
	if (!$geology_valid.$geo_row) or (!$geology_valid.$geo_left) or (!$geology_valid.$geo_right)
		return
	var $geo_step = $geology_range / 64
	var $geo_start = -1
	var $geo_min = 0
	var $geo_max = 0
	; Include an extra terminal pass to finish a run at the outer scan boundary.
	repeat 65 ($geo_col)
		var $geo_low = -1
		var $geo_high = -1
		if $geo_col < 64
			$geo_low = min(@geology_height($geo_left, $geo_col), min(@geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col), @geology_height($geo_right, $geo_col)))
			$geo_high = max(@geology_height($geo_left, $geo_col), max(@geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col), @geology_height($geo_right, $geo_col)))
			if (2 * ($geo_col + 1) * $geo_step * sin(5 * pi / 180)) < 30
				$geo_low = -1
		var $geo_break = ($geo_col == 64) or ($geo_low <= 0.1) or (($geo_high - $geo_low) >= 1)
		if $geo_start >= 0
			$geo_break = $geo_break or ((max($geo_max, $geo_high) - min($geo_min, $geo_low)) >= 1)
			if $geo_break
				var $geo_len = ($geo_col - 1 - $geo_start) * $geo_step
				var $geo_width = 2 * ($geo_start + 1) * $geo_step * sin(5 * pi / 180)
				if ($geo_len >= $geology_length) and ($geo_width >= 30)
					; This is a SAMPLED candidate, not certification between samples.
					@geology_add(1, $geo_row, ($geo_start + $geo_col + 1) / 2 * $geo_step, min($geo_len, 2000), $geo_max - $geo_min)
					; Elevated flat top with drops at both radial ends: plateau candidate.
					if ($geo_start > 0) and ($geo_col < 64)
						if (@geology_height($geo_row, $geo_start - 1) < ($geo_min - 20)) and (@geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col) < ($geo_min - 20))
							@geology_add(2, $geo_row, ($geo_start + $geo_col + 1) / 2 * $geo_step, min($geo_len, 2000), $geo_max - $geo_min)
				$geo_start = -1
		if ($geo_col < 64) and ($geo_low > 0.1) and (($geo_high - $geo_low) < 1)
			if $geo_start < 0
				$geo_start = $geo_col
				$geo_min = $geo_low
				$geo_max = $geo_high
			else
				$geo_min = min($geo_min, $geo_low)
				$geo_max = max($geo_max, $geo_high)
		if ($geo_col > 0) and ($geo_col < 63)
			var $geo_h = @geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col)
			var $geo_prev = @geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col - 1)
			var $geo_next = @geology_height($geo_row, $geo_col + 1)
			var $geo_idx = $geo_row * 64 + $geo_col
			var $geo_earth = ($geology_body == "earth") or ($geology_body == "Earth")
			; No water/coast flags; suppress underwater extrema on Earth too.
			if $geo_earth and ($geo_h <= 0.1)
				continue
			; Local extrema require all eight neighboring samples, not just a line.
			var $geo_neighbor_min = min($geo_prev, $geo_next)
			var $geo_neighbor_max = max($geo_prev, $geo_next)
			var $geo_f_max = $geology_fluorite.$geo_idx
			var $geo_f_before = $geo_idx - 1
			var $geo_f_after = $geo_idx + 1
			$geo_f_max = max($geo_f_max, max($geology_fluorite.$geo_f_before, $geology_fluorite.$geo_f_after))
			repeat 3 ($geo_offset)
				var $geo_l = @geology_height($geo_left, $geo_col + $geo_offset - 1)
				var $geo_r = @geology_height($geo_right, $geo_col + $geo_offset - 1)
				$geo_neighbor_min = min($geo_neighbor_min, min($geo_l, $geo_r))
				$geo_neighbor_max = max($geo_neighbor_max, max($geo_l, $geo_r))
				var $geo_fl = $geo_left * 64 + $geo_col + $geo_offset - 1
				var $geo_fr = $geo_right * 64 + $geo_col + $geo_offset - 1
				$geo_f_max = max($geo_f_max, max($geology_fluorite.$geo_fl, $geology_fluorite.$geo_fr))
			if $geo_h > ($geo_neighbor_max + 20)
				@geology_add(5, $geo_row, ($geo_col + 1) * $geo_step, 0, 0)
			if $geo_h < ($geo_neighbor_min - 20)
				@geology_add(6, $geo_row, ($geo_col + 1) * $geo_step, 0, 0)
			; Legacy Earth documents fluorite near volcanoes ONLY. This is NOT
			; proof of a volcano center or a verified rule for the new Earth.
			var $geo_volcanic_shape = ($geo_h > ($geo_neighbor_max + 20)) or ($geo_h < ($geo_neighbor_min - 20))
			if $geo_earth and ($geo_h > 0.1) and ($geo_f_max > 0.000001) and $geo_volcanic_shape
				@geology_add(7, $geo_row, ($geo_col + 1) * $geo_step, 0, 0)

function @geology_tick()
	if !$geology_owned
		$geology_requests_live = 1
		@geology_quiet()
		$geology_owned = 1
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or $display_sleep or (!$geology_running)
		if $geology_requests_live or ($geology_stable_at >= 0)
			@geology_quiet()
		else
			@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
		return
	if (device_type("terrain_scanner") != "TerrainScanner") or (device_type("ore_pivot") != "SmallPivot") or (@standby_nav(14) <= 1000)
		@geology_quiet()
		$geology_status = "SCANNER / NAV UNAVAILABLE"
		return
	var $geo_body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	var $geo_lat_now = @standby_nav(8)
	var $geo_lon_now = @standby_nav(9)
	if (abs($geo_lat_now) > 89) or (abs($geo_lon_now) > 180) or ($geo_body == "")
		@geology_quiet()
		$geology_status = "POSITION UNAVAILABLE"
		return
	if ($geology_body != "") and ($geology_body != $geo_body)
		@geology_reset()
	$geology_body = $geo_body
	if (@standby_nav(10) > 0.5) or (abs(@standby_nav(4) * 180) > 3) or (abs(@standby_nav(5) * 180) > 3)
		@geology_quiet()
		$geology_status = "HOLD STILL / LEVEL"
		return
	if !$geology_origin_valid
		$geology_lat = $geo_lat_now
		$geology_lon = $geo_lon_now
		$geology_radius = @standby_nav(14)
		$geology_origin_valid = 1
	else
		var $geo_dn = @geology_north($geo_lat_now, $geology_lat, $geology_radius)
		var $geo_de = @geology_east($geo_lon_now, $geology_lon, $geo_lat_now, $geology_radius)
		if ($geo_dn * $geo_dn + $geo_de * $geo_de) > 4
			@geology_quiet()
			@geology_reset()
			return
	if $geology_stage == 1
		; At most ONE radial row is classified per control tick. Fixed upper bound.
		@geology_classify($geology_class_row)
		$geology_class_row += 1
		$geology_revision += 1
		$geology_status = "INTERPRETING HEIGHTMAP"
		if $geology_class_row >= 72
			$geology_running = 0
			$geology_stage = 2
			$geology_status = "SURVEY COMPLETE - CANDIDATES"
			if $geology_full
				$geology_status = "SAVED DATABASE FULL (256)"
		return
	; Installed pivot's angle is opposite the existing ORE map's screen azimuth.
	; Target world bearings instead of body bearings, so a small heading drift
	; cannot rotate a previously collected heightmap row.
	var $geo_pivot = input_number("ore_pivot", 0) * 360
	var $geo_bearing = mod(@standby_nav(6) - $geo_pivot + 720, 360)
	var $geo_error = @geology_delta($geo_bearing - $geology_row * 5)
	if (abs($geo_error) > 0.3) or (abs(input_number("ore_pivot", 1)) > 0.002)
		$geology_stable_at = -1
		$geology_packets = 0
		@mech_scanner_pivot(clamp($geo_error * 0.01, -0.05, 0.05))
		$geology_status = "POSITIONING SCANNER"
		return
	@mech_scanner_pivot(0)
	if $geology_stable_at < 0
		$geology_stable_at = time
	if (time - $geology_stable_at) < 0.2
		return
	; Stable pose AND fixed distances for at least two prior packets. Discard
	; stale ORE-mode replies and replies collected before the pivot settled.
	repeat 64 ($geo_request)
		var $geo_distance = ($geo_request + 1) * $geology_range / 64
		output_number("terrain_scanner", $geo_request, $geo_distance)
		output_number("ore_scanner", $geo_request, $geo_distance)
	$geology_requests_live = 1
	$geology_packets += 1
	if $geology_packets < 3
		return
	var $geo_abs_max = 0
	repeat 64 ($geo_reply)
		var $geo_value = input_number("terrain_scanner", $geo_reply)
		$geo_abs_max = max($geo_abs_max, abs($geo_value))
		var $geo_slot = $geology_row * 64 + $geo_reply
		$geology_heights.$geo_slot = $geo_value
		var $geo_ore_packet = input_text("ore_scanner", $geo_reply)
		$geology_fluorite.$geo_slot = $geo_ore_packet.F
	; Unpowered/absent scanners often return all zero. Do not call that runway.
	$geology_valid.$geology_row = ($geo_abs_max > 0.1)
	$geology_bearings.$geology_row = $geo_bearing
	$geology_row += 1
	$geology_packets = 0
	$geology_stable_at = -1
	$geology_revision += 1
	$geology_status = "COLLECTING HEIGHTMAP"
	; Do not keep 128 active sample requests drawing power while repositioning.
	@geology_quiet()
	if $geology_row >= 72
		$geology_stage = 1

function @geology_leave()
	if $geology_owned
		@geology_quiet()
		$geology_owned = 0
		$geology_running = 0
		$geology_status = "SURVEY PAUSED"
		$geology_revision += 1

xc_files.name: rotor-pair-sync.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Personal pair-sync flight test. Native propeller speed is signed rev/s.
; Keep the existing targets and all four RPM governors. Only add a bounded
; differential motor-power trim within FL/RR and FR/RL, never between pairs.
; T4o: trim is in propeller speed-request units (1.0 = 100 rev/s). Same RPM
; authority as before (~45 RPM) at a stable gain.
const $rotor_pair_sync_gain = 0.0000375
const $rotor_pair_sync_max_trim = 0.0075
const $rotor_pair_sync_deadband_rpm = 1
const $rotor_pair_sync_warning_rpm = 15
const $rotor_pair_sync_clear_rpm = 10
const $rotor_pair_sync_warning_delay = 0.5
const $rotor_pair_sync_startup_grace = 3
var $rotor_pair_sync_fl : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_fr : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_rl : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_rr : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_error_a : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_error_b : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_trim_a : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_trim_b : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_running : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_pending_a : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_pending_b : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a : number
var $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b : number

function @rotor_pair_sync_reset()
	$rotor_pair_sync_trim_a = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_trim_b = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_running = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_pending_a = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_pending_b = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a = 0
	$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b = 0

function @rotor_pair_sync_trim($pair_error : number) : number
	var $pair_amount = max(abs($pair_error) - $rotor_pair_sync_deadband_rpm, 0) * $rotor_pair_sync_gain
	if $pair_error < 0
		$pair_amount = -$pair_amount
	return clamp($pair_amount, -$rotor_pair_sync_max_trim, $rotor_pair_sync_max_trim)

function @rotor_pair_sync_observe($pair_enabled : number, $pair_fl : number, $pair_fr : number, $pair_rl : number, $pair_rr : number, $pair_dt : number)
	; A single same-cycle sample is reused by the unchanged governor calls.
	$rotor_pair_sync_fl = $pair_fl
	$rotor_pair_sync_fr = $pair_fr
	$rotor_pair_sync_rl = $pair_rl
	$rotor_pair_sync_rr = $pair_rr
	$rotor_pair_sync_error_a = (abs($pair_fl) - abs($pair_rr)) * 60
	$rotor_pair_sync_error_b = (abs($pair_fr) - abs($pair_rl)) * 60
	if !$pair_enabled
		@rotor_pair_sync_reset()
		return
	; Do not accumulate elapsed time across a suspended/resumed saved VM.
	var $pair_step = clamp($pair_dt, 0, 0.1)
	$rotor_pair_sync_running = min($rotor_pair_sync_running + $pair_step, $rotor_pair_sync_startup_grace)
	var $pair_blend = clamp($pair_step / 0.12, 0, 1)
	if min(abs($pair_fl), abs($pair_rr)) * 60 > 150
		$rotor_pair_sync_trim_a = lerp($rotor_pair_sync_trim_a, @rotor_pair_sync_trim($rotor_pair_sync_error_a), $pair_blend)
	else
		$rotor_pair_sync_trim_a = 0
	if min(abs($pair_fr), abs($pair_rl)) * 60 > 150
		$rotor_pair_sync_trim_b = lerp($rotor_pair_sync_trim_b, @rotor_pair_sync_trim($rotor_pair_sync_error_b), $pair_blend)
	else
		$rotor_pair_sync_trim_b = 0
	if $rotor_pair_sync_running < $rotor_pair_sync_startup_grace
		return
	; Independent debounce per pair: an intentional yaw split is not a fault.
	if abs($rotor_pair_sync_error_a) >= $rotor_pair_sync_warning_rpm
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_a = min($rotor_pair_sync_pending_a + $pair_step, $rotor_pair_sync_warning_delay)
		if $rotor_pair_sync_pending_a >= $rotor_pair_sync_warning_delay
			$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a = 1
	elseif abs($rotor_pair_sync_error_a) < $rotor_pair_sync_clear_rpm
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_a = 0
		$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a = 0
	elseif !$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_a = 0
	if abs($rotor_pair_sync_error_b) >= $rotor_pair_sync_warning_rpm
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_b = min($rotor_pair_sync_pending_b + $pair_step, $rotor_pair_sync_warning_delay)
		if $rotor_pair_sync_pending_b >= $rotor_pair_sync_warning_delay
			$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b = 1
	elseif abs($rotor_pair_sync_error_b) < $rotor_pair_sync_clear_rpm
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_b = 0
		$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b = 0
	elseif !$rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b
		$rotor_pair_sync_pending_b = 0

function @rotor_pair_sync_sample($pair_powered : number)
	@rotor_pair_sync_observe($pair_powered, input_number("front-left-prop", 0), input_number("front-right-prop", 0), input_number("rear-left-prop", 0), input_number("rear-right-prop", 0), delta_time)

; T5f: highest motor command of the four this tick (1 = motor at its limit).
var $rotor_motor_peak = 0
function @rotor_pair_sync_motor($pair_base_motor : number, $pair_motor_trim : number, $pair_direction : number, $pair_motor_enabled : number) : number
	if !$pair_motor_enabled
		return 0
	$rotor_motor_peak = max($rotor_motor_peak, abs($pair_base_motor))
	; Clamp the old governor output first. A trim must not unlock a saturated
	; governor's hidden excess or reverse a rotor. Maximum change is 5% power.
	return $pair_direction * clamp(clamp($pair_base_motor * $pair_direction, 0, 1) + $pair_motor_trim, 0, 1)

function @rotor_pair_sync_message() : text
	if $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a and $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b
		return "RPM PAIRS"
	if $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_a
		return "RPM FL/RR"
	if $rotor_pair_sync_alarm_b
		return "RPM FR/RL"
	return "1"

xc_files.plain_code:
; Craft state.

; Load observer/interlock only. No PID, trim, throttle or in-flight motor outputs.
; No fixed airframe mass. A fresh craft learns its first valid unladen reading.
storage var $sqx_wt14_profile_revision : number
var $sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt14_live_seen : number
var $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m : number
; Total physical mass: aircraft + every item + seated occupants.
const $craft_weight_green_limit = 16000 / 2.20462262185
const $craft_weight_yellow_limit = 19000 / 2.20462262185
const $craft_weight_load_limit = 20000 / 2.20462262185
storage var $sqx_wt39_initialized : number
var $sqx_wt39_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_empty_mass : number
var $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_valid : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_x : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_x__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_y : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_y__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_z : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_z__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_heading : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_heading__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch__m : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_roll : number
var $sqx_wt39_ref_roll__m : number
var $craft_weight_mass = 0
var $craft_weight_load = 0
var $craft_weight_rocks = 0
var $craft_weight_valid = 0
var $craft_weight_overload = 0
var $craft_weight_next = 0
var $craft_weight_x = 0
var $craft_weight_y = 0
var $craft_weight_z = 0
var $craft_weight_candidate_since = 0
var $craft_weight_candidate_x = 0
var $craft_weight_candidate_y = 0
var $craft_weight_candidate_z = 0
var $craft_weight_blocked_until = 0
var $craft_weight_blocked_reason = ""
var $craft_weight_warning_red = 0
var $craft_weight_monitor = 0
var $craft_weight_page = 0

function @craft_weight_boot()
	; Never tare upward on reboot: cargo aboard must remain cargo.
	if !$sqx_wt39_initialized__m
		if $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m != 0
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = 0
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m = $sqx_wt39_empty_mass
		if $sqx_wt39_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_wt39_initialized = 1
			$sqx_wt39_initialized__m = $sqx_wt39_initialized
		if $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m != 0
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen = 0
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m = $sqx_wt14_live_seen
		if $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m != 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_valid
	elseif $sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m != 2
		; Preserve an existing installation's known baseline during migration.
		if $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m != 1
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen = 1
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m = $sqx_wt14_live_seen
	if $sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m != 2
		$sqx_wt14_profile_revision = 2
		$sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m = $sqx_wt14_profile_revision
	; Reject corrupt/nonfinite storage without using an inverted clamp.
	if !($sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m > 0 and $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m < 10000000)
		if $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m != 0
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = 0
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m = $sqx_wt39_empty_mass
		if $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m != 0
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen = 0
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m = $sqx_wt14_live_seen
		if $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m != 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_valid

function @craft_weight_sample($craft_weight_force : number)
	; Do not replace a valid reading with zeros from our own parked power gate.
	if !$craft_weight_force
		if !$standby_work_enabled
			return
	@craft_weight_boot()
	if (!$craft_weight_force) and (time < $craft_weight_next)
		return
	$craft_weight_next = time + 0.2
	$craft_weight_mass = input_number("physics", 1)
	var $craft_weight_cargo = input_text("cargo-container", 0)
	$craft_weight_rocks = max($craft_weight_cargo.Rock, 0)
	; Channel 0 is active physics, NOT ground contact. Anchored/docked readings
	; remain usable; zero/default readings and implausible mass are not capacity.
	$craft_weight_valid = ($craft_weight_mass > 0) and ($craft_weight_mass < 10000000) and (input_number("physics", 2) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 3) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 4) > 0)
	if $craft_weight_valid and ((!$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m) or ($craft_weight_mass < $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m))
		if $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m != $craft_weight_mass
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = $craft_weight_mass
			$sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m = $sqx_wt39_empty_mass
		if $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m != 1
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen = 1
			$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m = $sqx_wt14_live_seen
		if $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m != 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 0
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_valid
		$craft_weight_candidate_since = 0
	$craft_weight_load = 0
	if $craft_weight_valid
		$craft_weight_load = max($craft_weight_mass - $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m, 0)
	; Raw TOTAL mass decides the boundary; rounding cannot allow 20000.1 lb.
	$craft_weight_overload = $craft_weight_valid and ($craft_weight_mass > $craft_weight_load_limit)
	if !$craft_weight_valid
		$craft_weight_candidate_since = 0
		return
	if $craft_weight_page or (!$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m)
		$craft_weight_x = input_number("physics", 5)
		$craft_weight_y = input_number("physics", 6)
		$craft_weight_z = input_number("physics", 7)
	; Never learn a loaded/occupied vehicle as empty. Reference requires known
	; dry mass, zero rocks, stationary craft and stopped measured rotors.
	if !$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m
		var $craft_weight_empty = (abs($craft_weight_mass - $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m) < 0.5) and ($craft_weight_rocks == 0) and (abs(@standby_nav(1)) < 0.1) and (abs(@standby_nav(10)) < 0.1) and (abs(input_number("front-left-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("front-right-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-left-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-right-prop", 0)) < 0.5)
		if !$craft_weight_empty
			$craft_weight_candidate_since = 0
		elseif ($craft_weight_candidate_since == 0) or (abs($craft_weight_x - $craft_weight_candidate_x) > 0.005) or (abs($craft_weight_y - $craft_weight_candidate_y) > 0.005) or (abs($craft_weight_z - $craft_weight_candidate_z) > 0.005)
			$craft_weight_candidate_since = time
			$craft_weight_candidate_x = $craft_weight_x
			$craft_weight_candidate_y = $craft_weight_y
			$craft_weight_candidate_z = $craft_weight_z
		elseif time >= $craft_weight_candidate_since + 2
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_x__m != $craft_weight_x
				$sqx_wt39_ref_x = $craft_weight_x
				$sqx_wt39_ref_x__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_x
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_y__m != $craft_weight_y
				$sqx_wt39_ref_y = $craft_weight_y
				$sqx_wt39_ref_y__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_y
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_z__m != $craft_weight_z
				$sqx_wt39_ref_z = $craft_weight_z
				$sqx_wt39_ref_z__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_z
			var $persist_next_75 : number
			$persist_next_75 = @standby_nav(6)
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_heading__m != $persist_next_75
				$sqx_wt39_ref_heading = $persist_next_75
				$sqx_wt39_ref_heading__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_heading
			var $persist_next_76 : number
			$persist_next_76 = @standby_nav(4)
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch__m != $persist_next_76
				$sqx_wt39_ref_pitch = $persist_next_76
				$sqx_wt39_ref_pitch__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch
			var $persist_next_77 : number
			$persist_next_77 = @standby_nav(5)
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_roll__m != $persist_next_77
				$sqx_wt39_ref_roll = $persist_next_77
				$sqx_wt39_ref_roll__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_roll
			if $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m != 1
				$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 1
				$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_valid

function @craft_weight_can_start() : number
	; Fresh synchronous read for EVERY OFF->ON request, never a cached green.
	@craft_weight_sample(1)
	if $craft_weight_overload
		$craft_weight_blocked_reason = "OVERWEIGHT"
	elseif !$craft_weight_valid
		$craft_weight_blocked_reason = "MASS SENSOR"
	else
		$craft_weight_blocked_until = 0
		$craft_weight_blocked_reason = ""
		return 1
	$craft_weight_blocked_until = time + 5
	return 0

function @craft_weight_warning($craft_weight_power : number) : text
	$craft_weight_warning_red = 0
	$craft_weight_monitor = $craft_weight_power
	if !$craft_weight_power
		return ""
	@craft_weight_sample(0)
	if $craft_weight_overload
		$craft_weight_warning_red = 1
		return "OVERWEIGHT"
	if !$craft_weight_valid
		return "MASS SENSOR"
	if time < $craft_weight_blocked_until
		$craft_weight_warning_red = $craft_weight_blocked_reason == "OVERWEIGHT"
		return $craft_weight_blocked_reason
	return ""

function @craft_weight_same_pose() : number
	; COM axes are only documented as relative to the sensor position. Until
	; the native coordinate frame is verified, compare at the reference attitude.
	var $craft_weight_heading_error = mod(@standby_nav(6) - $sqx_wt39_ref_heading__m + 540, 360) - 180
	return $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m and (abs($craft_weight_heading_error) < 1) and (abs(@standby_nav(4) - $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch__m) < (1 / 180)) and (abs(@standby_nav(5) - $sqx_wt39_ref_roll__m) < (1 / 180))

; Event body dispatched after all module helpers.
storage var $sqx_ml18_initialized : number
var $sqx_ml18_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_ml18_limit : number
var $sqx_ml18_limit__m : number
var $mining_limit_edit = ""
const $mining_limit_lb = 2.20462262185
; Total aircraft mass at 75% of the existing green gauge, not new cargo.
const $mining_green_stop = $craft_weight_green_limit * 0.75

function @mining_limit_ceiling() : number
	; T5l: the pilot's setting is the limit (0 to 20,000 lb). The default is
	; the old fixed stop, 75% of the green gauge (12,000 lb).
	return $sqx_ml18_limit__m

; Load colour for a mass, same thresholds as the craft weight gauge.
function @mining_limit_colour($ml_mass : number) : number
	if $ml_mass <= $craft_weight_green_limit
		return green
	if $ml_mass <= $craft_weight_yellow_limit
		return yellow
	return red

function @mining_limit_boot()
	if !$sqx_ml18_initialized__m
		if $sqx_ml18_limit__m != $mining_green_stop
			$sqx_ml18_limit = $mining_green_stop
			$sqx_ml18_limit__m = $sqx_ml18_limit
		if $sqx_ml18_initialized__m != 2
			$sqx_ml18_initialized = 2
			$sqx_ml18_initialized__m = $sqx_ml18_initialized
	elseif $sqx_ml18_initialized__m == 1
		; One-time migration: keep the limit that was actually in force, the
		; smaller of the stored value and the old fixed 12,000 lb stop.
		var $ml_kept = min($sqx_ml18_limit__m, $mining_green_stop)
		if $sqx_ml18_limit__m != $ml_kept
			$sqx_ml18_limit = $ml_kept
			$sqx_ml18_limit__m = $sqx_ml18_limit
		$sqx_ml18_initialized = 2
		$sqx_ml18_initialized__m = $sqx_ml18_initialized
	if !(($sqx_ml18_limit__m >= 0) and ($sqx_ml18_limit__m <= $craft_weight_load_limit + 0.001))
		if $sqx_ml18_limit__m != $mining_green_stop
			$sqx_ml18_limit = $mining_green_stop
			$sqx_ml18_limit__m = $sqx_ml18_limit

function @mining_limit_mass() : number
	var $mass = input_number("physics", 1)
	if ($mass > 0) and ($mass < 10000000) and (input_number("physics", 2) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 3) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 4) > 0)
		return $mass
	return 0

function @mining_limit_weight_ok() : number
	@mining_limit_boot()
	var $mass = @mining_limit_mass()
	; Leave at least 0.25 seconds at the drill's 100 rock/s HV maximum, plus
	; one rock, for the stop command/in-flight items. One rock weighs one kg.
	; A slow control tick expands that reserve rather than crossing into red.
	var $reserve = 100 * max(0.25, delta_time * 3) + 1
	; Unknown mass is not empty. Raw kg, not rounded display pounds, sets cutoff.
	return ($mass > 0) and (($mass + $reserve) < @mining_limit_ceiling())

; Touch-panel access control only; never changes flight, AP or PID state.
storage var $sqx_lock14_initialized : number
var $sqx_lock14_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_lock14_locked : number
var $sqx_lock14_locked__m : number
storage var $sqx_lock14_pin : text
var $sqx_lock14_pin__m : text
var $access_edit = "0000"
array $access_buffers : text
array $access_messages : text
var $access_failures = 0
var $access_until = 0

function @access_digits($pin : text) : number
	if (size($pin) < 1) or (size($pin) > 8)
		return 0
	var $length = size($pin)
	repeat $length ($i)
		var $c = substring($pin, $i, 1)
		if ($c != "0") and ($c != "1") and ($c != "2") and ($c != "3") and ($c != "4") and ($c != "5") and ($c != "6") and ($c != "7") and ($c != "8") and ($c != "9")
			return 0
	return 1

function @access_mask($pin : text) : text
	var $mask = ""
	var $length = min(size($pin), 8)
	repeat $length ($i)
		$mask = text("{}*", $mask)
	return $mask

function @access_boot()
	if !$sqx_lock14_initialized__m
		if $sqx_lock14_pin__m != "0000"
			$sqx_lock14_pin = "0000"
			$sqx_lock14_pin__m = $sqx_lock14_pin
		if $sqx_lock14_locked__m != 0
			$sqx_lock14_locked = 0
			$sqx_lock14_locked__m = $sqx_lock14_locked
		if $sqx_lock14_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_lock14_initialized = 1
			$sqx_lock14_initialized__m = $sqx_lock14_initialized
	if !@access_digits($sqx_lock14_pin__m)
		if $sqx_lock14_pin__m != "0000"
			$sqx_lock14_pin = "0000"
			$sqx_lock14_pin__m = $sqx_lock14_pin
	$access_edit = $sqx_lock14_pin__m
	$access_buffers.clear()
	$access_buffers.append("", "")
	$access_messages.clear()
	$access_messages.append("ENTER PIN", "ENTER PIN")
	$access_failures = 0
	$access_until = 0

function @access_edit_key($key : text)
	if $key == "CLR"
		$access_edit = ""
	elseif $key == "DEL"
		if size($access_edit) > 0
			$access_edit = substring($access_edit, 0, size($access_edit) - 1)
	elseif @access_digits($key) and (size($key) == 1) and (size($access_edit) < 8)
		$access_edit = text("{}{}", $access_edit, $key)

function @access_save() : number
	if !@access_digits($access_edit)
		return 0
	if $sqx_lock14_pin__m != $access_edit
		$sqx_lock14_pin = $access_edit
		$sqx_lock14_pin__m = $sqx_lock14_pin
	$access_buffers.0 = ""
	$access_buffers.1 = ""
	return 1

; Logical replacements for removed dashboard switches. Declare before consumers.
; AP navigation flags must precede the shared switch functions that clear them.
; T4v: switches_boot result cache. Cleared by every write to a switch it
; enforces (generated hooks) and by every forced contact resample; valid one tick.
var $switches_boot_valid = 0
var $switches_boot_time = -1
storage var $sqx_ui46_tar : number
var $sqx_ui46_tar__m : number
storage var $sqx_ui46_nav : number
var $sqx_ui46_nav__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_initialized : number
var $sqx_sw49_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_power : number
var $sqx_sw49_power__m : number
; Solar receiver observes cockpit-power edges even between its 1 Hz samples.
var $flight_sol_power_epoch = 0
storage var $sqx_sw49_rotors : number
var $sqx_sw49_rotors__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_park : number
var $sqx_sw49_park__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_dock : number
var $sqx_sw49_dock__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_stab : number
var $sqx_sw49_stab__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_ap : number
var $sqx_sw49_ap__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_land : number
var $sqx_sw49_land__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_mine : number
var $sqx_sw49_mine__m : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_mode : number
var $sqx_sw49_mode__m : number
var $switches_link_until = 0
var $switches_notice = ""
var $switches_off_context = ""
var $autopilot_alert_disengaged_until = 0
; Water LAND is a session contact latch, not an anchor or saved pilot request.
var $water_landing_over_water = 0
var $water_landing_settled_seconds = 0
var $water_landing_complete = 0
storage var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off : text
var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off__m : text
storage var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off_time : number
var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off_time__m : number

; Rear cargo hatches only. Boot CLOSED; no stored open latch on a new drive.
var $maintenance_pilot_override=0
var $door_panel_was_rotors=-1
var $door_panel_pending=1
var $maintenance_open = 0
const $maintenance_left_open = 0.25
const $maintenance_right_open = -0.25

; Explicit unladen-weight edits only; never an automatic upward tare.
function @weight_editor_editable() : number
	return (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) and (abs(input_number("front-left-prop", 0)) <= 0.5) and (abs(input_number("front-right-prop", 0)) <= 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-left-prop", 0)) <= 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-right-prop", 0)) <= 0.5)

function @weight_editor_current() : number
	var $mass = input_number("physics", 1)
	if ($mass > 0) and ($mass < 10000000) and (input_number("physics", 2) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 3) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 4) > 0)
		return $mass
	return 0

function @weight_editor_set($mass : number) : number
	if (!@weight_editor_editable()) or (!($mass > 0 and $mass < 10000000))
		return 0
	if $sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m != $mass
		$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = $mass
		$sqx_wt39_empty_mass__m = $sqx_wt39_empty_mass
	if $sqx_wt39_initialized__m != 1
		$sqx_wt39_initialized = 1
		$sqx_wt39_initialized__m = $sqx_wt39_initialized
	if $sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m != 2
		$sqx_wt14_profile_revision = 2
		$sqx_wt14_profile_revision__m = $sqx_wt14_profile_revision
	if $sqx_wt14_live_seen__m != 1
		$sqx_wt14_live_seen = 1
		$sqx_wt14_live_seen__m = $sqx_wt14_live_seen
	if $sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m != 0
		$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 0
		$sqx_wt39_ref_valid__m = $sqx_wt39_ref_valid
	$craft_weight_candidate_since = 0
	$craft_weight_next = 0
	@craft_weight_sample(1)
	return 1

var $ui_rotor_at=-1
var $ui_rotor_moving=0
function @du_doors_moving() : number
	if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
		return 1
	if $ui_rotor_at==time
		return $ui_rotor_moving
	$ui_rotor_at=time
	$ui_rotor_moving=(abs(input_number("front-left-prop",0))>0.5) or (abs(input_number("front-right-prop",0))>0.5) or (abs(input_number("rear-left-prop",0))>0.5) or (abs(input_number("rear-right-prop",0))>0.5)
	return $ui_rotor_moving

function @maintenance_locked() : number
	if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
		return 1
	return @du_doors_moving()

; All program writers share these RAM caches; no rounding or control-rate change.
var $mech_cargo_left=999
var $mech_cargo_right=999
var $mech_scanner_last=999
function @mech_cargo($side:number,$target:number)
	if $side==0
		if $target!=$mech_cargo_left
			output_number("left-cargo",0,$target)
			$mech_cargo_left=$target
	else
		if $target!=$mech_cargo_right
			output_number("right-cargo",0,$target)
			$mech_cargo_right=$target

function @mech_scanner_pivot($target:number)
	if $target!=$mech_scanner_last
		output_number("ore_pivot",0,$target)
		$mech_scanner_last=$target

function @maintenance_close()
	$maintenance_pilot_override=0
	$maintenance_open = 0
	@mech_cargo(0,0)
	@mech_cargo(1,0)

function @maintenance_shutdown_shutdown_open()
	; Access to the computer's physical power switch must survive shutdown.
	; Deliberate shutdown-only override; normal lock/rotor interlocks stay intact.
	$maintenance_open = 1
	@mech_cargo(0,$maintenance_left_open)
	@mech_cargo(1,$maintenance_right_open)

function @maintenance_apply()
	if $maintenance_open
		if (!$maintenance_pilot_override) and @maintenance_locked()
			$maintenance_open = 0
	@mech_cargo(0,$maintenance_left_open * $maintenance_open)
	@mech_cargo(1,$maintenance_right_open * $maintenance_open)

function @maintenance_toggle()
	if @maintenance_locked()
		return
	$maintenance_open = !$maintenance_open
	@maintenance_apply()

var $switch_contact_at = -1

function @switches_output($switches_out_alias : text, $switches_out_channel : number, $switches_value : number)
	; Record the first actual AP-off transition; subsequent shutdown writes do not overwrite it.
	if ($switches_out_alias == "main-dash") and (($switches_out_channel == 18) or ($switches_out_channel == 19)) and (!$switches_value) and $sqx_sw49_ap__m
		if $switches_off_context == ""
			$switches_off_context = "CONTROL SHUTDOWN / LANDING"
		@switches_record_ap_off($switches_off_context)
	$switches_off_context = ""
	; Automatic shutdown/undock writes change the SAME stored button state.
	if $switches_out_alias == "main-dash"
		if $switches_out_channel == 2
			if $sqx_sw49_power__m != ($switches_value != 0)
				$flight_sol_power_epoch += 1
			if $sqx_sw49_power__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_power = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_power__m = $sqx_sw49_power
		elseif $switches_out_channel == 3
			if $switches_value and (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m) and (!@craft_weight_can_start())
				$switches_notice = $craft_weight_blocked_reason
				return
			if $switches_value
				@maintenance_close()
			if $switches_value and (!$sqx_sw49_rotors__m)
				@standby_depart()
			if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_rotors = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_rotors__m = $sqx_sw49_rotors
		elseif $switches_out_channel == 10
			if $sqx_sw49_park__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_park = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_park__m = $sqx_sw49_park
		elseif $switches_out_channel == 11
			if $sqx_sw49_dock__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_dock = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_dock__m = $sqx_sw49_dock
				$switches_boot_valid = 0
		elseif $switches_out_channel == 18
			if $sqx_sw49_stab__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_stab = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_stab__m = $sqx_sw49_stab
				$switches_boot_valid = 0
			if !$switches_value
				if $sqx_sw49_ap__m != 0
					$sqx_sw49_ap = 0
					$sqx_sw49_ap__m = $sqx_sw49_ap
					$switches_boot_valid = 0
		elseif $switches_out_channel == 19
			if $sqx_sw49_ap__m != $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_ap = $switches_value
				$sqx_sw49_ap__m = $sqx_sw49_ap
				$switches_boot_valid = 0
			if $switches_value
				if $sqx_sw49_stab__m != 1
					$sqx_sw49_stab = 1
					$sqx_sw49_stab__m = $sqx_sw49_stab
					$switches_boot_valid = 0
		else
			return
		@switches_boot()
		return
	output_number($switches_out_alias, $switches_out_channel, $switches_value)

function @cruise_limit_limit($speed : number) : number
	; T5r: one stateless rule (see main.xc, climb speed limit).
	if $climb_speed_limit_on
		return min($speed, $sqx_cs14_speed__m)
	return $speed

function @autopilot_ui_input($autopilot_ui_channel : number) : number
	; Old physical selectors no longer control the AP.
	; AP memory commits are driven by touchscreen APPLY instead of LIVE switches.
	if ($autopilot_ui_channel == 5) or ($autopilot_ui_channel == 11) or ($autopilot_ui_channel == 17)
		return 1
	if $autopilot_ui_channel == 16
		return $sqx_ui46_tar__m
	if $autopilot_ui_channel == 26
		return $sqx_ui46_nav__m
	if $autopilot_ui_channel == 27
		return time < $autopilot_ui_rev_until
	return 0
; Display/annunciation only: never used as a flight-control request.
var $power_forecast_alarm = 0
var $power_forecast_eta = -1
var $power_forecast_range = -1
var $power_forecast_eta_text = "--:--:--"


; Display permutation only: physical slots 0/left, 1/centre, 2/right.
; Contents 0/attitude, 1/navigation, 2/rotors/AP/settings. No control outputs.
storage array $sqx_dp14_order : number
var $display_ready = 0
var $display_legacy_seen = 0
var $display_sleep = 0
var $display_epoch = 0
var $display_pfd_revision = 0
var $display_nd_revision = 0
var $display_rx_revision = 0
var $display_chime_pulse = 0
var $display_chime_until = 0
var $display_chime_active = 0

function @display_position($content : number) : number
	foreach $sqx_dp14_order ($i, $value)
		if $value == $content
			return $i
	return 0

function @display_boot()
	var $valid = $sqx_dp14_order.size == 3
	if $valid
		repeat 3 ($i)
			var $v = $sqx_dp14_order.$i
			$valid = $valid and ($v >= 0) and ($v <= 2) and ($v == floor($v))
		var $a = 0
		var $b = 1
		var $c = 2
		$valid = $valid and ($sqx_dp14_order.$a != $sqx_dp14_order.$b) and ($sqx_dp14_order.$a != $sqx_dp14_order.$c) and ($sqx_dp14_order.$b != $sqx_dp14_order.$c)
	if !$valid
		$sqx_dp14_order.clear()
		if $sqx_ui48_center__m
			$sqx_dp14_order.append(1, 0, 2)
		else
			$sqx_dp14_order.append(0, 1, 2)
		$display_epoch += 1
	if !$display_ready
		$display_legacy_seen = $sqx_ui48_center__m
		$display_ready = 1
	; Honour old-layout writes without losing the third panel's permutation.
	if $display_legacy_seen != $sqx_ui48_center__m
		var $from = @display_position(0)
		var $to = $sqx_ui48_center__m != 0
		var $other = $sqx_dp14_order.$to
		$sqx_dp14_order.$to = 0
		$sqx_dp14_order.$from = $other
		$display_legacy_seen = $sqx_ui48_center__m
		$display_epoch += 1

function @display_swap($a : number, $b : number)
	@display_boot()
	if ($a < 0) or ($a > 2) or ($b < 0) or ($b > 2) or ($a != floor($a)) or ($b != floor($b))
		return
	var $old = $sqx_dp14_order.$a
	$sqx_dp14_order.$a = $sqx_dp14_order.$b
	$sqx_dp14_order.$b = $old
	var $persist_next_139 : number
	$persist_next_139 = @display_position(0) == 1
	if $sqx_ui48_center__m != $persist_next_139
		$sqx_ui48_center = $persist_next_139
		$sqx_ui48_center__m = $sqx_ui48_center
	$display_legacy_seen = $sqx_ui48_center__m
	$display_epoch += 1

function @display_move($content : number, $slot : number)
	@display_boot()
	if ($content >= 0) and ($content <= 2) and ($content == floor($content))
		@display_swap(@display_position($content), $slot)

function @display_position_name($position : number) : text
	if $position == 0
		return "LEFT"
	if $position == 1
		return "CENTER"
	return "RIGHT"

; Per-base current-boot challenge cache. No keys are placed in packets.
array $fp_ids : text
array $fp_epochs : number
array $fp_boots : text

function @fleet_proof_update($fp_id : text, $fp_epoch : number, $fp_boot : text)
	if (size($fp_id) < 1) or (size($fp_id) > 64) or contains($fp_id,"|") or !($fp_epoch > 0)
		return
	if (size($fp_boot) != 16) or !@cr_hex_valid($fp_boot)
		return
	foreach $fp_ids ($fp_i,$fp_existing)
		if $fp_existing == $fp_id
			$fp_epochs.$fp_i = $fp_epoch
			$fp_boots.$fp_i = $fp_boot
			return
	if $fp_ids.size >= 8
		$fp_ids.erase(0)
		$fp_epochs.erase(0)
		$fp_boots.erase(0)
	$fp_ids.append($fp_id)
	$fp_epochs.append($fp_epoch)
	$fp_boots.append($fp_boot)

function @fleet_proof_packet() : text
	var $fp_result = ""
	foreach $fp_ids ($fp_i,$fp_id)
		$fp_result &= "|" & $fp_id & ":" & text("{0}",$fp_epochs.$fp_i) & ":" & $fp_boots.$fp_i & "|"
	return $fp_result

; 0 = live, 1 = cockpit OFF, 2 = own terrain anchor locked.

var $standby_ui_until = 0

var $standby_work_enabled = 0
var $standby_visual_enabled = 1
var $standby_diagnostics = 0
array $standby_nav_cache : number
var $standby_planet = ""

function @standby_flight() : number
	return ($standby_mode == 0) and (time >= $standby_warm_until) and (!$visibility_parked_sleep)

function @standby_io() : number
	return ($standby_mode == 0) or (($standby_mode == 2) and ((time < $standby_io_until) or (time < $standby_job_until) or (($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==1)) or (($mission_mode==2) and ($mission_phase==4))))

function @standby_visual() : number
	return ($standby_mode == 0) or (time < $standby_ui_until) or (($standby_mode == 2) and ((time < $standby_job_until) or (time < $standby_io_until) or (time < $standby_boot_until)))

function @standby_touch()
	$standby_ui_until = time + 0.6
	$standby_visual_enabled = 1
	; Touching instruments is an explicit request for a brief avionics session.
	if $standby_mode == 2
		if !@standby_io()
			$standby_io_ready_at = time + 0.3
		$standby_io_until = time + 10
		output_number("lvbreaker2", 0, 1)
		output_number("hvbreaker", 0, 1)
		$standby_service_last = 1
		$standby_hv_last = 1

function @standby_work() : number
	return @standby_io() and (time >= $standby_io_ready_at)

function @standby_depart()
	$standby_departure = 1
	@standby_touch()

function @standby_nav($channel : number) : number
	if ($standby_live_enabled or $visibility_parked_sleep) and (time >= $standby_warm_until)
		return input_number("nav", $channel)
	; Even during a scan, anchored attitude/position are immutable. The locator
	; output (23..25) is allowed to change when a different target is requested.
	if ($channel >= 23) and $standby_work_enabled
		$standby_nav_cache.$channel = input_number("nav", $channel)
	return $standby_nav_cache.$channel

function @standby_nav_text($channel : number) : text
	if ($standby_live_enabled or $visibility_parked_sleep) and (time >= $standby_warm_until)
		return input_text("nav", $channel)
	return $standby_planet

function @standby_doors() : number
	if @standby_visual()
		return 1
	if time < $standby_doors_at
		return 0
	$standby_doors_at = time + 0.25
	return 1

; Units.

; Presentation preference ONLY. Native flight/storage units and limits stay fixed.
storage var $sqx_u20_initialized : number
var $sqx_u20_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_u20_metric : number
var $sqx_u20_metric__m : number
var $units_edit = 0
var $units_revision = 0

function @units_boot()
	if !$sqx_u20_initialized__m
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m != 0
			$sqx_u20_metric = 0
			$sqx_u20_metric__m = $sqx_u20_metric
		if $sqx_u20_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_u20_initialized = 1
			$sqx_u20_initialized__m = $sqx_u20_initialized
	var $persist_next_261 : number
	$persist_next_261 = $sqx_u20_metric__m == 1
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m != $persist_next_261
		$sqx_u20_metric = $persist_next_261
		$sqx_u20_metric__m = $sqx_u20_metric
	$units_edit = $sqx_u20_metric__m

function @units_choice($us : text, $si : text) : text
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		return $si
	return $us

function @units_name($mode : number) : text
	if $mode
		return "METRIC"
	return "IMPERIAL (US)"

function @units_mass_factor($us_factor : number) : number
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		return 1
	return $us_factor

function @units_distance($meters : number) : text
	if abs($meters) >= 1000
		return text("{0.00} km", $meters / 1000)
	if abs($meters) < 10
		return text("{0.0} m", round($meters * 10) / 10)
	return text("{0} m", $meters)

; Close scales use metres; longer scales use clean km labels.
function @units_scale($meters : number, $legacy : text) : text
	if !$sqx_u20_metric__m
		return $legacy
	if abs($meters) < 1000
		return @units_distance($meters)
	var $scale_km = $meters / 1000
	if abs($scale_km - round($scale_km)) < 0.000001
		return text("{0} km", $scale_km)
	if abs($scale_km * 10 - round($scale_km * 10)) < 0.000001
		return text("{0.0} km", $scale_km)
	return text("{0.00} km", $scale_km)

; Range selections are native metric presets, not relabelled Imperial presets.
; The NAV zoom index remains shared with the unchanged close DOCK zoom.
function @units_nav_meters($zoom_index : number) : number
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		return $zoom_index * 1000
	return $zoom_index * 1852

function @units_ore_preset($preset_index : number, $preset_metric : number) : number
	if $preset_metric
		if $preset_index == 0
			return 500
		if $preset_index == 1
			return 2500
		if $preset_index == 2
			return 5000
		return 10000
	if $preset_index == 0
		return 457.2
	if $preset_index == 1
		return 1852
	if $preset_index == 2
		return 5556
	return 9260

function @units_geo_preset($preset_index : number, $preset_metric : number) : number
	if $preset_metric
		if $preset_index == 0
			return 2000
		if $preset_index == 1
			return 5000
		return 10000
	if $preset_index == 0
		return 3704
	if $preset_index == 1
		return 9260
	return 18520

function @units_ore_index($preset_meters : number, $preset_metric : number) : number
	var $preset_best = 0
	var $preset_error = abs($preset_meters - @units_ore_preset(0, $preset_metric))
	repeat 4 ($preset_i)
		var $preset_delta = abs($preset_meters - @units_ore_preset($preset_i, $preset_metric))
		if $preset_delta < $preset_error
			$preset_best = $preset_i
			$preset_error = $preset_delta
	return $preset_best

function @units_geo_index($preset_meters : number, $preset_metric : number) : number
	var $preset_best = 0
	var $preset_error = abs($preset_meters - @units_geo_preset(0, $preset_metric))
	repeat 3 ($preset_i)
		var $preset_delta = abs($preset_meters - @units_geo_preset($preset_i, $preset_metric))
		if $preset_delta < $preset_error
			$preset_best = $preset_i
			$preset_error = $preset_delta
	return $preset_best

; Legacy AP edit drafts stay in ft/KT/FPM, even in Metric. Convert only labels.
function @units_ap_value($row : number, $legacy : number, $unit : text) : text
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m and ($row != 2)
		if $row == 0
			return text("{0}m", $legacy / 3.280839895)
		if $row == 1
			return text("{0.0}m/s", $legacy / 1.94384449)
		return text("{0.0}m/s", $legacy / 196.8503937)
	return text("{0}{}", $legacy, $unit)
