; Warnings.

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;															     ;;
;;				ALARMS DASHBOARD BY CHIP PATTON                  ;;
;;	       Please don't copy without credit.  Thanks!		     ;;			
;;															     ;;
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

var $warnings_icon = virtualscreen(24, 24)
var $warnings_ready = 0
var $msg = "0"
var $dashboard = virtualscreen(250, 30)
var $txtwidth = 1
var $blankcolor = color(0,0,0,0)
var $flight_status_last_drawn = "__INIT__"
; Session acknowledgement owner is declared earlier, before the audio helpers.
var $warnings_current_bit = 0
var $vertical_control_ascent_advisory : number
var $vertical_control_speed_advisory : number
var $autopilot_alert_advisory : number
var $ore_notices_notice_ink : number
var $craft_weight_message : text

; T5q: MINIMUMS call-out and automatic LAND/DOCK height readout.
; The NAV instrument sits about 3 ft above the skids; heights subtract it.
const $nav_sensor_height = 0.9144
var $minimums_until = 0
var $minimums_armed = 1
var $approach_readout = ""

function @minimums_update()
	var $mu_agl = @standby_nav(3) - $nav_sensor_height
	var $mu_ap = $sqx_sw49_power__m and $sqx_sw49_ap__m
	var $mu_floor = $sqx_ui46_floor__m
	var $mu_secured = input_number("left-anchor", 0) or input_number("ship-dock", 0)
	; One call-out per descent to the floor; re-arms 100 ft above it.
	if $mu_agl > $mu_floor + 30.48
		$minimums_armed = 1
	if $mu_ap and $minimums_armed and (!$sqx_sw49_land__m) and (!$docking_active) and (!$mu_secured) and ($mu_agl <= $mu_floor + 3) and (@standby_nav(1) < -0.3)
		$minimums_armed = 0
		$minimums_until = time + 5
	$approach_readout = ""
	; T5w: only once below minimums (the AP floor), not from cruise height.
	if $mu_ap and (!$mu_secured) and ($mu_agl <= $mu_floor)
		if $docking_active
			var $mu_dock = max($docking_height, 0)
			$approach_readout = @units_choice(text("DOCK {0} FT", $mu_dock * 3.280839895), text("DOCK {0.0} M", $mu_dock))
		elseif $sqx_sw49_land__m
			var $mu_ground = max($mu_agl, 0)
			$approach_readout = @units_choice(text("GROUND {0} FT", $mu_ground * 3.280839895), text("GROUND {0.0} M", $mu_ground))

function @rotor_warning_status($rw_on:number,$rw_min_rpm:number,$rw_requested_rpm:number) : text
	if $rw_on and ($rw_min_rpm<max($rw_requested_rpm-200,0))
		return "ROTORS"
	return "1"

function @warnings_prepare()
	$warnings_icon.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$warnings_icon.draw_triangle(12, 2, 2, 22, 22, 22, red)
	$warnings_icon.text_align(top_left)
	$warnings_icon.text_size(1)
	$warnings_icon.write(9, 10, red, "!")
	$warnings_ready = 1

function @warnings_message($warning_bit : number) : text
	if $warning_bit == 1
		return "STALL"
	if $warning_bit == 2
		if $power_forecast_alarm
			return "BATTERY RESERVE"
		return "BATTERIES LOW"
	if $warning_bit == 4
		return "PULL UP"
	if $warning_bit == 8
		return $craft_weight_message
	if $warning_bit == 16
		if $rott != 1
			return $rott
		return "ROTORS"
	if $warning_bit == 32
		return "DOOR AJAR"
	if $warning_bit == 64
		return "AP DISENGAGED"
	if $warning_bit == 128
		return "LAND AVAILABLE"
	if $warning_bit == 256
		return "ASC LIMIT"
	if $warning_bit == 512
		return "SPEED"
	if $warning_bit==1024
		if $seal_cockpit==0
			return "COCKPIT SEAL UNKNOWN"
		return "COCKPIT SEAL BROKEN"
	if $warning_bit==2048
		if $seal_fuselage==0
			return "FUSELAGE SEAL UNKNOWN"
		return "FUSELAGE SEAL BROKEN"
	return "0"

function @warnings_recall($warning_bit : number) : number
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m or !@warnings_active($warning_bit)
		return 0
	; Only an active red tile can recall/rearm its own alarm, never another one.
	$warnings_dismissed -= $warning_bit * mod(floor($warnings_dismissed / $warning_bit), 2)
	$warnings_recall_bit = $warning_bit
	$warnings_recall_until = time + 5
	$flight_status_last_drawn = "__RECALL__"
	return 1

var $notice_recall_text=""
var $notice_recall_ink=orange
var $notice_recall_active=0
var $ui_secure_last=-1
var $ui_secure_until=0
var $ui_secure_pending=0

function @ui_secure_sample($contact:number)
	; Existing supervisor already owns the physical contact samples.
	if $contact and ($ui_secure_last!=1)
		$ui_secure_pending=1
		$ui_secure_until=0
		$standby_ui_until=max($standby_ui_until,time+4.25)
	if !$contact
		if $notice_recall_text=="AIRCRAFT SECURED"
			$notice_recall_active=0
		$ui_secure_pending=0
		$ui_secure_until=0
	$ui_secure_last=$contact

function @ui_secure_presented()
	; Retain the drawn banner; no recurring repaint or expiry timer is needed.
	return

function @warnings_pick($respect_ack : number) : text
	$warnings_current_bit = 0
	$ore_notices_notice_ink = red
	$isalm = 1
	if $respect_ack and ($warnings_recall_bit > 0) and (time < $warnings_recall_until)
		if @warnings_active($warnings_recall_bit) and @warnings_allowed($warnings_recall_bit, 1)
			$warnings_current_bit = $warnings_recall_bit
			return @warnings_message($warnings_recall_bit)
	; T4v: every branch returns, so the chain is written as guarded ifs; the
	; acknowledgement test is evaluated only when its condition holds (this
	; runtime does not short-circuit 'and'). Same order, same results.
	if ($ui_secure_last!=1) and ($stallt != 1)
		if @warnings_allowed(1, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 1
			return $stallt
	if ($battt != 1) or $power_forecast_alarm
		if @warnings_allowed(2, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 2
			if $power_forecast_alarm
				return "BATTERY RESERVE"
			return $battt
	if ($ui_secure_last!=1) and ($altt != 1)
		if @warnings_allowed(4, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 4
			return $altt
	if $craft_weight_message!=""
		if $craft_weight_warning_red
			if @warnings_allowed(8,$respect_ack)
				$warnings_current_bit=8
				return $craft_weight_message
		else
			$ore_notices_notice_ink=orange
			$isalm=0
			return $craft_weight_message
	if $rott != 1
		if @warnings_allowed(16, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 16
			return $rott
	if $doors_ajar
		if @warnings_allowed(32, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 32
			return "DOOR AJAR"
	if mod(floor($warnings_active_bits / 1024), 4) != 0
		if (@warnings_active(1024) and @warnings_allowed(1024,$respect_ack)) or (@warnings_active(2048) and @warnings_allowed(2048,$respect_ack))
			$warnings_current_bit=1024
			if (!@warnings_active(1024)) or (!@warnings_allowed(1024,$respect_ack)) or (@warnings_active(2048) and @warnings_allowed(2048,$respect_ack) and (mod(floor(time/2),2)==1))
				$warnings_current_bit=2048
			return @warnings_message($warnings_current_bit)
	if time < $minimums_until
		$ore_notices_notice_ink = red
		$isalm = 0
		if mod(floor(time * 2.5), 2) == 0
			return "MINIMUMS"
		return ""
	if $approach_readout != ""
		$ore_notices_notice_ink = red
		$isalm = 0
		return $approach_readout
	if $autopilot_alert_advisory
		if @warnings_allowed(64, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 64
			return "AP DISENGAGED"
	if $vertical_control_ascent_advisory
		if @warnings_allowed(256, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 256
			if round(time / 1.5) % 2 == 0
				return "ASC LIMIT"
			return "SPEED"
	if $vertical_control_speed_advisory
		if @warnings_allowed(512, $respect_ack)
			$warnings_current_bit = 512
			if round(time / 0.75) % 2 == 0
				return "SPEED"
			return ""
	$isalm = 0
	if $ui_secure_pending and ($ui_secure_last==1)
		$ore_notices_notice_ink=green
		return "AIRCRAFT SECURED"
	if $notice_recall_active
		$ore_notices_notice_ink=$notice_recall_ink
		return $notice_recall_text
	return "0"

function @warnings_acknowledge() : number
	if ($flight_status_last_drawn=="AIRCRAFT SECURED") or ($notice_recall_active and ($flight_status_last_drawn==$notice_recall_text))
		if $flight_status_last_drawn=="AIRCRAFT SECURED"
			$ui_secure_pending=0
		$notice_recall_active=0
		$dashboard.blank($blankcolor)
		$flight_status_last_drawn="0"
		$warnings_current_bit=0
		return 1
	if ($warnings_current_bit <= 0) or ($flight_status_last_drawn == "0") or ($flight_status_last_drawn == "") or ($ore_notices_notice_ink != red)
		return 0
	if @warnings_allowed($warnings_current_bit, 1)
		$warnings_dismissed += $warnings_current_bit
	$warnings_recall_bit = 0
	$warnings_recall_until = 0
	; Stop this alarm immediately, without muting other/future warning conditions.
	output_number("speaker-1", 0, 0)
	output_number("speaker-2", 0, 0)
	$sound_alarm_until = 0
	$isalm = 0
	; Blank immediately; the normal display key will refresh on its next update.
	$dashboard.blank($blankcolor)
	$flight_status_last_drawn = "0"
	$warnings_current_bit = 0
	return 1

; Event body dispatched after all module helpers.

xc_files.name: cockpit-controls.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Cockpit controls.

; Single owner for the existing lamps. No rotor/flight outputs.
; HEAD 0/OFF 1/NORMAL 2/BRIGHT; CABIN 0/OFF 1/ON 2/AUTO.
; Shared navigation lamps: 0/OFF 1/NAV strobes 2/FLOOD white (exclusive).
storage var $sqx_ls47_defaults : number
var $sqx_ls47_defaults__m : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_head : number
var $sqx_ls47_head__m : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_cabin : number
var $sqx_ls47_cabin__m : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_nav : number
var $sqx_ls47_nav__m : number
storage var $sqx_ls18_migrated : number
var $sqx_ls18_migrated__m : number
var $light_controls_was_ap = 0
var $light_controls_was_completed = 0
var $light_controls_lights = screen("main-dash", 1)
var $light_controls_systems = screen("pilot-screen", 3)
var $light_controls_frame = virtualscreen(150, 120)
var $lights_lcd = screen("pilot-screen", 3)
var $sound_icons = virtualscreen(400, 36)
var $light_icons_icons = virtualscreen(210, 36)
var $light_buttons_frame = virtualscreen(300, 120)
var $sound_ready = 0
var $lights_bg = color(8, 14, 22)
var $lights_last_frame = ""
var $lights_last_lamps = ""
var $lights_power = -1
var $lights_pressed = -1
var $lights_pressed_until = 0
var $lights_head_start = 0
var $lights_head_seen = 0
var $lights_head_before = 0
var $lights_head_armed = 0
var $lights_head_long = 0

function @lights_boot()
	if !$sqx_ls47_defaults__m
		if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 0
			$sqx_ls47_head = 0
			$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
		if $sqx_ls47_cabin__m != 2
			$sqx_ls47_cabin = 2
			$sqx_ls47_cabin__m = $sqx_ls47_cabin
		if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != 1
			$sqx_ls47_nav = 1
			$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
		if $sqx_ls47_defaults__m != 1
			$sqx_ls47_defaults = 1
			$sqx_ls47_defaults__m = $sqx_ls47_defaults
	if !$sqx_ls18_migrated__m
		; Preserve every explicit OFF/NAV/FLOOD selection; retire old AUTO once.
		if ($sqx_ls47_nav__m < 0) or ($sqx_ls47_nav__m > 2)
			if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != 0
				$sqx_ls47_nav = 0
				$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
		if $sqx_ls18_migrated__m != 1
			$sqx_ls18_migrated = 1
			$sqx_ls18_migrated__m = $sqx_ls18_migrated

; Eleven lamps, four latched output channels each. NAV timing is unchanged.
array $lt_lamp_values : number
var $lt_last_head=-1
var $lt_last_cabin=-1
var $lt_last_nav=-1
var $lt_env_at=-1
var $lt_env_night=0
var $lt_env_seated=0

function @lt_environment()
	if $lt_env_at==time
		return
	$lt_env_at=time
	$lt_env_night=0
	if contains(device_type("solar"),"SolarSensor")
		$lt_env_night=input_number("solar",1)<=0
	; Seat state comes from the shared 2Hz observer, not per-frame lighting reads.

function @lt_channel($alias:text,$slot:number,$channel:number,$value:number)
	var $index=$slot*4+$channel
	if $lt_lamp_values.$index!=$value
		$lt_lamp_values.$index=$value
		output_number($alias,$channel,$value)

function @lights_lamp($alias:text,$slot:number,$on:number,$r:number,$g:number,$b:number)
	if $lt_lamp_values.size!=44
		$lt_lamp_values.fill(44,-9999)
	@lt_channel($alias,$slot,0,$on)
	var $index=$slot*4
	; Light::Update consumes RGB channels together and clears their input values.
	; Cache the complete colour tuple, never individual components of that tuple.
	if ($lt_lamp_values.($index+1)!=$r) or ($lt_lamp_values.($index+2)!=$g) or ($lt_lamp_values.($index+3)!=$b)
		$lt_lamp_values.($index+1)=$r
		$lt_lamp_values.($index+2)=$g
		$lt_lamp_values.($index+3)=$b
		output_number($alias,1,$r)
		output_number($alias,2,$g)
		output_number($alias,3,$b)


; DOME AUTO: daylight is always lit. At night an open door comes first (people
; boarding can see while the pilot is already seated), then an empty pilot seat.
; Only a seated pilot with both doors shut darkens the cabin.
function @lt_cabin_auto() : number
	if !$lt_env_night
		return 1
	if @access_door_open(0)
		return 1
	if @access_door_open(1)
		return 1
	return !$lt_env_seated

; Cabin lighting is an actuator, not a screen-rendering task.
function @lt_cabin_apply()
	@lights_boot()
	var $cabin_on=$sqx_sw49_power__m and ($sqx_ls47_cabin__m==1)
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m and ($sqx_ls47_cabin__m==2)
		$cabin_on=@lt_cabin_auto()
	if $lt_last_cabin!=$cabin_on
		$lt_last_cabin=$cabin_on
		@lights_lamp("pilot-light",2,$cabin_on,255,255,255)

function @lt_seat_observe($seat_token:number)
	if !$sqx_sw49_power__m
		return
	$lt_env_seated=$seat_token!=0
	if $sqx_ls47_cabin__m==2
		@lt_environment()
		@lt_cabin_apply()


; T5j: high-altitude headlamp hold. With AP on, lamps go dark above
; 10,000 ft ASL AND 4,000 ft above the terrain (so over mountains they stay on
; until 4,000 ft clear of the ground). Back on below 9,500 ft ASL or 3,500 ft
; AGL. The pilot's lamp setting is never changed; only the output is held off.
var $lights_head_high = 0
function @lights_head_high_update()
	if !@sw_in_19()
		$lights_head_high = 0
		return
	; T6a: read the NAV instrument directly, as flight control does; the
	; display cache can hold an old (low) altitude while screens are idle.
	var $lh_asl = input_number("nav", 2)
	var $lh_agl = input_number("nav", 3)
	if $lh_agl <= 0
		; No ground return at very high clearance: treat as clear of terrain.
		$lh_agl = $lh_asl
	if $lights_head_high
		if ($lh_asl < 2895.6) or ($lh_agl < 1066.8)
			$lights_head_high = 0
	elseif ($lh_asl > 3048) and ($lh_agl > 1219.2)
		$lights_head_high = 1

function @light_controls_ap_lights()
	var $power = @sw_in_2()
	var $ap = @sw_in_19()
	; Missing sensor cannot declare night; continue observing during AP flight.
	@lt_environment()
	var $night=$lt_env_night
	if $power and $ap and $night and ($sqx_ls47_head__m == 0)
		if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 1
			$sqx_ls47_head = 1
			$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
	if $power and $ap and (!$light_controls_was_ap)
		if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != 1
			$sqx_ls47_nav = 1
			$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
	; Read-only observer of completed automatic contact, not a LAND request
	; or a manual AP disconnect. No controller state or actuator is changed.
	var $lc_anchor=input_number("left-anchor",0)
	var $lc_dock=input_number("ship-dock",0)
	var $landed = $sqx_sw49_land__m and $flight_landing_controls_released and ($lc_anchor or $water_landing_complete)
	var $docked = $sqx_sw49_dock__m and $lc_dock and (!@sw_in_3())
	var $completed = $power and (!$ap) and ($landed or $docked)
	if $completed and ($light_controls_was_ap or (!$light_controls_was_completed))
		if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 0
			$sqx_ls47_head = 0
			$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
		; An unfinished lamp tap cannot relight it after automatic shutdown.
		$lights_head_armed = 0
	; AP cancellation while still secured is also a return to ground lighting.
	; Do not require rotor shutdown or a LAND latch that launch deliberately cleared.
	if $power and $light_controls_was_ap and (!$ap) and ($lc_anchor or $lc_dock or $water_landing_complete or ($departure_snapshot and $takeoff_grounded))
		if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != 0
			$sqx_ls47_nav = 0
			$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
		; SolarSensor channel 1 is W/m². Missing sensor is not "night".
		if $night
			if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != 2
				$sqx_ls47_nav = 2
				$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
	$light_controls_was_ap = $power and $ap
	$light_controls_was_completed = $completed


function @lights_update_lamps()
	@lights_boot()
	@light_controls_ap_lights()
	@lights_head_high_update()
	var $lights_pwr = @sw_in_2()
	; Commit a short tap only after release, so a long hold never flashes OFF
	; on its way to BRIGHT. A completed long hold cannot toggle again on release.
	if $lights_head_armed and ((time - $lights_head_seen) > 0.2)
		if (!$lights_head_long) and $lights_pwr
			if $lights_head_before == 0
				if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 1
					$sqx_ls47_head = 1
					$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
			elseif $lights_head_before == 1
				if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 0
					$sqx_ls47_head = 0
					$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
			else
				if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 1
					$sqx_ls47_head = 1
					$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
		$lights_head_armed = 0
	; AUTO: see @lt_cabin_auto (daylight, then open doors, then an empty seat).
	; As with the headlamps, a missing solar sensor cannot declare night.
	@lt_environment()
	var $lights_night=$lt_env_night
	var $lights_seated=$lt_env_seated
	var $lights_cabin_on = $lights_pwr and ($sqx_ls47_cabin__m == 1)
	if $lights_pwr and ($sqx_ls47_cabin__m == 2)
		$lights_cabin_on = @lt_cabin_auto()
	var $sound_mode = $sqx_ls47_nav__m
	var $lights_strobe = mod(time, 1) < 0.2
	var $lights_nav_on = $lights_pwr and (($sound_mode == 2) or (($sound_mode == 1) and $lights_strobe))
	; Include resolved mode so a lit NAV pulse -> lit EXT transition updates RGB.
	var $lights_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $lights_head_high, $lights_pwr, $sqx_ls47_head__m, $lights_cabin_on, $sqx_ls47_nav__m, $sound_mode, $lights_nav_on)
	if $lights_key == $lights_last_lamps
		return
	$lights_last_lamps = $lights_key
	var $head_key=$lights_pwr*4+$sqx_ls47_head__m+$lights_head_high*8
	var $head_lit=$lights_pwr and ($sqx_ls47_head__m > 0) and (!$lights_head_high)
	if $lt_last_head!=$head_key
		$lt_last_head=$head_key
		var $lights_brightness = 75
		if $sqx_ls47_head__m == 2
			; Preserve the old normal + bright amplification, not a flight setting.
			$lights_brightness = 330
		@lights_lamp("headlight-1", 0, $head_lit, $lights_brightness, $lights_brightness, $lights_brightness)
		@lights_lamp("headlight-2", 1, $head_lit, $lights_brightness, $lights_brightness, $lights_brightness)
	@lt_cabin_apply()
	var $lights_front_gb = 0
	var $lights_rear_rb = 0
	if $sound_mode == 2
		$lights_front_gb = 255
		$lights_rear_rb = 255
	@lights_lamp("front-left-left-light", 3, $lights_nav_on, 255, $lights_front_gb, $lights_front_gb)
	@lights_lamp("front-left-head-light", 4, $lights_nav_on, 255, $lights_front_gb, $lights_front_gb)
	@lights_lamp("front-right-head-light", 5, $lights_nav_on, 255, $lights_front_gb, $lights_front_gb)
	@lights_lamp("front-right-right-light", 6, $lights_nav_on, 255, $lights_front_gb, $lights_front_gb)
	@lights_lamp("rear-left-rear-light", 7, $lights_nav_on, $lights_rear_rb, 255, $lights_rear_rb)
	@lights_lamp("rear-left-left-light", 8, $lights_nav_on, $lights_rear_rb, 255, $lights_rear_rb)
	@lights_lamp("rear-right-right-light", 9, $lights_nav_on, $lights_rear_rb, 255, $lights_rear_rb)
	@lights_lamp("rear-right-rear-light", 10, $lights_nav_on, $lights_rear_rb, 255, $lights_rear_rb)

function @lights_text($lights_x : number, $lights_y : number, $lights_t : text, $lights_c : number, $lights_size : number)
	$lights_lcd.text_size($lights_size)
	$lights_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$lights_lcd.write($lights_x - size($lights_t) * $lights_lcd.char_w / 2, $lights_y - $lights_lcd.char_h / 2, $lights_c, $lights_t)

function @light_icons_prepare()
	$light_icons_icons.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 2 ($state)
		var $x = $state * 30
		; Recognizable headlamp housing, retaining the original beam sprites.
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 10.25, 6.75, $x + 10.25, 20.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 10.25, 6.75, $x + 20, 8.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 20, 8.25, $x + 23, 13.5, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 23, 13.5, $x + 20, 18.75, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 20, 18.75, $x + 10.25, 20.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 5.75, 7.5, $x + 8.75, 7.5, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 5, 13.5, $x + 8.75, 13.5, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 5.75, 19.5, $x + 8.75, 19.5, white)
		if $state
			$light_icons_icons.draw_triangle($x + 10.25, 6.75, $x + 20, 8.25, $x + 23, 13.5, white, white)
			$light_icons_icons.draw_triangle($x + 10.25, 6.75, $x + 23, 13.5, $x + 10.25, 20.25, white, white)
			$light_icons_icons.draw_triangle($x + 10.25, 20.25, $x + 23, 13.5, $x + 20, 18.75, white, white)
		$x = 60 + $state * 30
		var $dome = color(0, 0, 0, 0)
		if $state
			$dome = yellow
		$light_icons_icons.draw_circle($x + 15, 12, 7, white, $dome)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 10, 21, $x + 20, 21, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 11, 24, $x + 19, 24, white)
		if $state
			$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15, 0, $x + 15, 3, yellow)
			$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 3, 12, $x + 6, 12, yellow)
			$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 24, 12, $x + 27, 12, yellow)
		$x = 120 + $state * 30
		; Exact NAV silhouette and rays: white-filled FLOOD, hollow OFF.
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15, 0, $x + 15, 2.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15, 21.75, $x + 15, 24.75, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 2.25, 12, $x + 6.75, 12, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 23.25, 12, $x + 27.75, 12, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 4.5, 3.75, $x + 7.5, 6.75, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 22.5, 6.75, $x + 25.5, 3.75, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 4.5, 20.25, $x + 7.5, 17.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 22.5, 17.25, $x + 25.5, 20.25, white)
		var $previous_half = 3
		repeat 23 ($row)
			var $half = 5.25
			var $edge = min($row, 22 - $row)
			if $edge == 0
				$half = 3
			elseif $edge == 1
				$half = 3.75
			elseif $edge <= 3
				$half = 4.5
			var $y = 3.75 + $row * 0.75
			if $state
				$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15 - $half, $y, $x + 14.25, $y, white)
				$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15, $y, $x + 15 + $half, $y, white)
			else
				if ($row == 0) or ($row == 22)
					$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15 - $half, $y, $x + 15 + $half, $y, white)
				if $row > 0
					$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15 - $previous_half, $y - 0.75, $x + 15 - $half, $y, white)
					$light_icons_icons.draw_line($x + 15 + $previous_half, $y - 0.75, $x + 15 + $half, $y, white)
			$previous_half = $half
	; Original parking-brake circle and brake shoes, with a central P.
	$light_icons_icons.draw_circle(195, 14.25, 6.75, white)
	repeat 2 ($side)
		var $sign = $side * 2 - 1
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 6.267, 6.7808, 195 + $sign * 7.4693, 7.983, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 7.4693, 7.983, 195 + $sign * 8.4435, 9.375, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 8.4435, 9.375, 195 + $sign * 9.162, 10.9155, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 9.162, 10.9155, 195 + $sign * 9.6022, 12.5572, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 9.6022, 12.5572, 195 + $sign * 9.75, 14.25, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 9.75, 14.25, 195 + $sign * 9.6022, 15.9428, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 9.6022, 15.9428, 195 + $sign * 9.162, 17.5845, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 9.162, 17.5845, 195 + $sign * 8.4435, 19.125, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 8.4435, 19.125, 195 + $sign * 7.4693, 20.517, white)
		$light_icons_icons.draw_line(195 + $sign * 7.4693, 20.517, 195 + $sign * 6.267, 21.7192, white)
	$light_icons_icons.text_align(top_left)
	$light_icons_icons.text_size(1)
	$light_icons_icons.write(192, 10.25, white, "P")

function @sound_prepare()
	@light_icons_prepare()
	@panel_layout_prepare()
	$light_controls_frame.blank($shared_background)
	@draw_rounded_box($light_controls_frame, 4, 4, 146, 118, 12, color(76, 93, 108))
	$sound_icons.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sound_icons.draw_line(5.25, 6.75, 5.25, 20.25, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(5.25, 6.75, 15.0, 8.25, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(15.0, 8.25, 18.0, 13.5, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(18.0, 13.5, 15.0, 18.75, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(15.0, 18.75, 5.25, 20.25, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(0.75, 7.5, 3.75, 7.5, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(0.0, 13.5, 3.75, 13.5, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(0.75, 19.5, 3.75, 19.5, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(50.5, 18.75, 59.5, 18.75, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(52.0, 21.75, 58.0, 21.75, white)
	$sound_icons.draw_line(53.5, 24.0, 56.5, 24.0, white)

function @light_controls_systems_hit($x : number, $y : number) : number
	if ($x < 24.5) or ($x >= 275.5) or ($y < 42) or ($y >= 86) or (mod($x - 24.5, 69) >= 44)
		return -1
	var $col = floor(($x - 24.5) / 69)
	if $col == 0
		return 9
	if $col == 1
		return 3
	if $col == 2
		return 6
	return 7

function @lights_button($lights_slot : number, $lights_label : text, $lights_on : number, $lights_auto : number)

	if ($lights_slot == 2) or ($lights_slot == 8)
		$lights_x = 18.5
		$lights_y = 70
		if $lights_slot == 8
			$lights_x = 87.5
	if ($lights_slot == 3) or ($lights_slot == 6) or ($lights_slot == 7) or ($lights_slot == 9)
		$lights_y = 42

			$lights_x = 93.5
		elseif $lights_slot == 6

		elseif $lights_slot == 7

function @lights_hit($x:number,$y:number) : number
	if ($x<12) or ($x>=141) or (mod($x-12,69)>=60)
		return -1
	var $col=floor(($x-12)/69)
	if ($y>=20) and ($y<64)
		return $col
	if ($y>=70) and ($y<114)
		if $col==0
			return 2
		return 8
	return -1


function @light_controls_click($lights_slot : number)
	if !@sw_in_2()
		return
	if $lights_slot < 0
		return
	; Passenger/cargo controls now live on the independent DOORS LCD.
	if ($lights_slot == 4) or ($lights_slot == 5)
		return
	@lights_boot()
	$lights_pressed = $lights_slot
	$lights_pressed_until = time + 0.18
	$lights_head_armed = 0
	if $lights_pressed == 0
		$lights_head_before = $sqx_ls47_head__m
		$lights_head_start = time
		$lights_head_seen = time
		$lights_head_armed = 1
		$lights_head_long = 0
	elseif $lights_pressed == 1
		var $persist_next_54 : number
		$persist_next_54 = mod($sqx_ls47_cabin__m + 1, 3)
		if $sqx_ls47_cabin__m != $persist_next_54
			$sqx_ls47_cabin = $persist_next_54
			$sqx_ls47_cabin__m = $sqx_ls47_cabin
	elseif $lights_pressed == 2
		var $persist_next_55 : number
		$persist_next_55 = 1 - ($sqx_ls47_nav__m == 1)
		if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != $persist_next_55
			$sqx_ls47_nav = $persist_next_55
			$sqx_ls47_nav__m = $sqx_ls47_nav
	elseif $lights_pressed == 8
		var $persist_next_56 : number
		$persist_next_56 = 2 * ($sqx_ls47_nav__m != 2)
		if $sqx_ls47_nav__m != $persist_next_56

function @lights_click($x : number, $y : number)

function @lights_hold($lights_x : number, $lights_y : number)
	if !@sw_in_2()
		return
	if @lights_hit($lights_x, $lights_y) != 0
		$lights_head_armed = 0
		return
	if !$lights_head_armed
		return
	if (time - $lights_head_seen) > 0.2
		$lights_head_armed = 0
		return
	$lights_head_seen = time
	$lights_pressed = 0
	$lights_pressed_until = time + 0.18
	if ((time - $lights_head_start) >= 1) and (!$lights_head_long)
		; Holding from OFF/NORMAL selects BRIGHT once; holding from BRIGHT
		; returns to NORMAL. The next short tap then turns NORMAL off.
		if $lights_head_before == 2
			if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 1
				$sqx_ls47_head = 1
				$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
		else
			if $sqx_ls47_head__m != 2
				$sqx_ls47_head = 2
				$sqx_ls47_head__m = $sqx_ls47_head
		$lights_head_long = 1

; Status is an observer: no AP, flight, dock or anchor writes here.
; 0 idle, 1 LAND? confirmation, 2 waiting, 3 active AP, 4 confirmed, 5 auto-docked.
function @course_buttons_status($course_buttons_id : number) : number
	if $course_buttons_id == 7
		if $sqx_ui46_nav__m and (!$docking_active) and (!@switches_navigation_blocked()) and @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling()
			return 3
	elseif $course_buttons_id == 9
		if input_number("ship-dock", 0)
			if $course_buttons_dock_auto_seen
				return 5
			return 4
		if $sqx_sw49_dock__m
			if $docking_active and @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling()
				return 3
			return 2
		if $vertical_control_land_prompt_active and input_number("docking-beacon", 5) and (input_number("docking-beacon", 1) < 100)
			return 1
	elseif $course_buttons_id == 8
		if input_number("left-anchor", 0) or $water_landing_complete
			if $sqx_sw49_rotors__m
				return 6
			return 4
		if $sqx_sw49_land__m
			return 2
		if $vertical_control_land_prompt_active or $nav_arrival_land_prompt
			return 1
	return 0

; RAM-only transaction: records change only after all five fields validate.
array $wpc_fields : text
var $wpc_field = 0
var $wpc_metric = 0

function @wpc_title($wc_field : number) : text
	if $wc_field == 0
		return "NAME"
	if $wc_field == 1
		return "NOTES"
	if $wc_field == 2
		return "LATITUDE (DEG)"
	if $wc_field == 3
		return "LONGITUDE (DEG)"
	if $wpc_metric
		return "GROUND ELEVATION ASL (M)"
	return "GROUND ELEVATION ASL (FT)"

function @wpc_begin($wc_capture : number) : number
	if $sqx_way18_lat.size >= 128
		$waypoint_notice = "WAYPOINT STORAGE FULL (128)"
		return 0
	if $wc_capture
		if !@waypoint_capture()
			return 0
	else
		$waypoint_draft_body = @standby_nav_text(13)
		$waypoint_draft_radius = @standby_nav(14)
		if ($waypoint_draft_body == "") or (size($waypoint_draft_body) > 32) or ($waypoint_draft_radius <= 1000)
			$waypoint_notice = "CURRENT PLANET UNAVAILABLE"
			return 0
	$wpc_metric = $sqx_u20_metric__m
	$wpc_fields.clear()
	$wpc_fields.append("", "", "", "", "")
	if $wc_capture
		$wpc_fields.2 = text("{0.000000}", $waypoint_draft_lat)
		$wpc_fields.3 = text("{0.000000}", $waypoint_draft_lon)
		var $wc_factor = 1
		if !$wpc_metric
			$wc_factor = 1 / 0.3048
		$wpc_fields.4 = text("{0.00}", $waypoint_records_draft_elevation * $wc_factor)
	$waypoint_editor = 5
	$waypoint_notice = ""
	$waypoint_focus = -1
	$geology_focus = -1
	$waypoint_revision += 1
	return 1

function @wpc_save() : number
	if $wpc_fields.size != 5
		return 0
	if !@waypoint_has_name($wpc_fields.0)
		$waypoint_notice = "ENTER A NAME"
		return 0
	if !isnumeric($wpc_fields.2) or !isnumeric($wpc_fields.3) or !isnumeric($wpc_fields.4)
		$waypoint_notice = "ENTER LAT / LON / ELEVATION"
		return 0
	var $wc_lat = $wpc_fields.2:number
	var $wc_lon = $wpc_fields.3:number
	var $wc_elev = $wpc_fields.4:number
	if !$wpc_metric
		$wc_elev *= 0.3048
	if !(($wc_lat >= -90) and ($wc_lat <= 90) and ($wc_lon >= -180) and ($wc_lon <= 180) and ($wc_elev >= 0) and ($wc_elev < 100000))
		$waypoint_notice = "COORDINATE / ELEVATION RANGE"
		return 0
	$waypoint_draft_lat = $wc_lat
	$waypoint_draft_lon = $wc_lon
	$waypoint_records_draft_elevation = $wc_elev
	$waypoint_buffer = $wpc_fields.0
	$waypoint_editor = 1
	if !@waypoint_save()
		$waypoint_editor = 5
		return 0
	$sqx_way18_notes.$waypoint_focus = substring($wpc_fields.1, 0, 160)
	$waypoint_revision += 1
	return 1

; Only sensitive values are encrypted. Public values are authenticated as AAD.
var $sf_public = ""
var $sf_private = ""

function @sf_quad_private($sf_key : text) : number
	return ($sf_key == "latitude") or ($sf_key == "longitude") or ($sf_key == "altitude") or ($sf_key == "planet") or ($sf_key == "navvalid") or ($sf_key == "pilotname")

function @sf_split_quad($sf_packet : text)
	$sf_public = ""
	$sf_private = ""
	foreach $sf_packet ($sf_key,$sf_value)
		if @sf_quad_private($sf_key)
			$sf_private.$sf_key = $sf_value
		elseif $sf_key != "authcode"
			$sf_public.$sf_key = $sf_value

function @sf_split($sf_packet : text, $sf_kind : text)
	if $sf_kind == "telemetry"
		@sf_split_quad($sf_packet)
		return
	var $sf_out_public = ""
	var $sf_out_private = ""
	foreach $sf_packet ($sf_key,$sf_value)
		if $sf_key == "snapshot"
			@sf_split_quad($sf_value)
			$sf_out_public.snapshot = $sf_public
			$sf_out_private.snapshot = $sf_private
		elseif ($sf_key == "nonce") or ($sf_key == "reply") or ($sf_key == "targetbase") or ($sf_key == "pad") or ($sf_key == "proof") or ($sf_key == "challengeid") or ($sf_key == "challengeepoch") or ($sf_key == "challengeboot") or ($sf_key == "clientepoch") or @sf_quad_private($sf_key)
			$sf_out_private.$sf_key = $sf_value
		elseif $sf_key != "authcode"
			$sf_out_public.$sf_key = $sf_value
	$sf_public = $sf_out_public
	$sf_private = $sf_out_private

function @sf_merge_quad($sf_open : text, $sf_secret : text) : text
	foreach $sf_secret ($sf_key,$sf_value)
		$sf_open.$sf_key = $sf_value
	return $sf_open

function @sf_merge($sf_open : text, $sf_secret : text) : text
	foreach $sf_secret ($sf_key,$sf_value)
		if $sf_key == "snapshot"
			$sf_open.snapshot = @sf_merge_quad(@fleet_get($sf_open,"snapshot"),$sf_value)
		else
			$sf_open.$sf_key = $sf_value
	return $sf_open

function @sf_aad_field($sf_value : text) : text
	return text("{0}:{}",size($sf_value),$sf_value)

xc_files.plain_code:
; Beacons.

; Persistent truck-style target slots. Main and landing receivers remain separate.
; Fleet registration is separate from flight; saved command permissions remain non-actuating.
storage array $sqx_tg47_names : text
storage array $sqx_tg47_main : text
storage array $sqx_tg47_land : text
storage array $sqx_tg47_commands : number
storage var $sqx_tg47_initialized : number
var $sqx_tg47_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_tg47_selected : number
var $sqx_tg47_selected__m : number
var $dock : text
var $beacon_focus = 0
var $beacon_delete = 0
var $beacon_wait_name = 0
var $beacon_receive_after = 0
var $beacon_last_main = "!"
var $beacon_last_land = "!"
var $beacon_last_label = "!"
var $beacon_keyboard_last = 0
var $beacon_prev_last = 0
var $beacon_next_last = 0
; Manual edits are transactional. Live modern metadata has its own read-only owner.
var $beacon_editing = 0
var $beacon_new = 0
var $beacon_draft_name = ""
var $beacon_draft_main = ""
var $beacon_draft_land = ""
var $beacon_draft_commands = 0
var $beacon_packet = ""
var $beacon_structured = 0
var $beacon_info = 0
var $beacon_edit_array = 0
var $beacon_next_packet = 0
var $beacon_land_after = 0
; Session-only format latch. Reboot starts detection anew; telemetry stays live.
array $beacon_modern_signals : text
; Session-only NAV ownership: immutable receiver identity until NAV disengages.
var $beacon_nav_index = -1
; Browsing never retunes the guidance receiver while AP owns a target.
var $beacon_browser_last_view = "!"
var $beacon_browser_nav_packet = ""
var $beacon_browser_nav_modern = 0
var $beacon_browser_nav_land = ""
var $beacon_browser_nav_after = 0

; Native text key/value enumeration distinguishes missing fields from zero.
function @beacon_has($packet : text, $field : text) : number
	foreach $packet ($key, $value)
		if $key == $field
			return 1
	return 0

function @beacon_get($packet : text, $field : text) : text
	foreach $packet ($key, $value)
		if $key == $field
			return $value
	return ""

function @beacon_array($packet : text) : number
	foreach $packet ($key, $value)
		return 1
	return 0

function @beacon_number($packet : text, $field : text) : number
	var $value = @beacon_get($packet, $field)
	if isnumeric($value)
		return $value:number
	return 0

function @beacon_available($packet : text, $field : text, $validfield : text) : number
	var $value = @beacon_get($packet, $field)
	if !@beacon_has($packet, $field) or !isnumeric($value)
		return 0
	if ($validfield != "") and @beacon_has($packet, $validfield)
		return @beacon_number($packet, $validfield) == 1
	return 1

function @beacon_received_name($packet : text) : text
	if @beacon_array($packet)
		return substring(@beacon_get($packet, "name"), 0, 44)
	return substring($packet, 0, 44)

; Display-only decoding: never feed packet syntax to a name label.
; Plain legacy broadcasts pass through unchanged (including a landing heading).
var $br_name_packet = ""
var $br_name_label = ""
var $br_name_structured = 0
var $br_name_ready = 0
function @beacon_display_name($packet : text) : text
	var $br_structured = 0
	var $label = ""
	if $br_name_ready and ($br_name_packet == $packet)
		$br_structured = $br_name_structured
		$label = $br_name_label
	else
		$br_structured = @beacon_array($packet)
		if $br_structured
			$label = @beacon_get($packet,"name")
		if size($packet) <= 2048
			$br_name_packet = $packet
			$br_name_label = $label
			$br_name_structured = $br_structured
			$br_name_ready = 1
	if !$br_structured
		return $packet
	if $label != ""
		return $label
	var $index = $sqx_tg47_selected__m
	if $beacon_nav_index >= 0
		$index = $beacon_nav_index
	if ($index >= 0) and ($index < $sqx_tg47_names.size)
		return $sqx_tg47_names.$index
	return "BASE"


storage var $sqx_bc31_initialized : number
var $sqx_bc31_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_bc31_frequency : text
var $sqx_bc31_frequency__m : text
; Independent migration flag preserves the previously saved frequency.
storage var $sqx_bc31_name_initialized : number
var $sqx_bc31_name_initialized__m : number
storage var $sqx_bc31_name : text
var $sqx_bc31_name__m : text
var $beacon_settings_last_tx = ""
var $beacon_settings_last_name = ""
storage var $sqx_bc14_tx_initialized : number
var $sqx_bc14_tx_initialized__m : number
var $beacon_transmitter_tx_applied = -1

function @beacon_settings_boot()
	if !$sqx_bc14_tx_initialized__m
		if $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m != 1
			$sqx_bc14_tx_on = 1
			$sqx_bc14_tx_on__m = $sqx_bc14_tx_on
		if $sqx_bc14_tx_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_bc14_tx_initialized = 1
			$sqx_bc14_tx_initialized__m = $sqx_bc14_tx_initialized
	if !$sqx_bc31_initialized__m
		if $sqx_bc31_frequency__m != "4545"
			$sqx_bc31_frequency = "4545"
			$sqx_bc31_frequency__m = $sqx_bc31_frequency
		if $sqx_bc31_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_bc31_initialized = 1
			$sqx_bc31_initialized__m = $sqx_bc31_initialized
	if !$sqx_bc31_name_initialized__m
		if $sqx_bc31_name__m != "BADGER SMART QUAD 4.0"
			$sqx_bc31_name = "BADGER SMART QUAD 4.0"
			$sqx_bc31_name__m = $sqx_bc31_name
		if $sqx_bc31_name_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_bc31_name_initialized = 1
			$sqx_bc31_name_initialized__m = $sqx_bc31_name_initialized

function @beacon_transmitter_transmit()
	@beacon_settings_boot()
	var $data = ""
	var $frequency = ""
	if $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m and $fleet_tx_ready
		$data = $fleet_broadcast_packet
		$frequency = $sqx_bc31_frequency__m
	if ($beacon_settings_last_name != $data) or ($beacon_transmitter_tx_applied != $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m)
		output_text("beacon", 0, $data)
		$beacon_settings_last_name = $data
	if ($beacon_settings_last_tx != $frequency) or ($beacon_transmitter_tx_applied != $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m)
		output_text("beacon", 1, $frequency)
		$beacon_settings_last_tx = $frequency
	$beacon_transmitter_tx_applied = $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m

function @beacon_transmitter_toggle()
	@beacon_settings_boot()
	var $persist_next_6 : number
	$persist_next_6 = !$sqx_bc14_tx_on__m
	if $sqx_bc14_tx_on__m != $persist_next_6
		$sqx_bc14_tx_on = $persist_next_6
		$sqx_bc14_tx_on__m = $sqx_bc14_tx_on
	$fleet_phase = -1
	$fleet_due = time + 0.2
	$fleet_probe = $sqx_bc31_frequency__m
	$fleet_attempt = 0
	@beacon_transmitter_transmit()

function @beacon_settings_set($bc_value : text) : number
	@beacon_settings_boot()
	if (size($bc_value) == 0) or (size($bc_value) > 32)
		return 0
	if $sqx_bc31_frequency__m != $bc_value
		$sqx_bc31_frequency = $bc_value
		$sqx_bc31_frequency__m = $sqx_bc31_frequency
	$fleet_phase = -1
	$fleet_tx_ready = 0
	$fleet_attempt = 0
	$fleet_start_frequency = $bc_value
	$fleet_probe = $bc_value
	$fleet_due = time + 0.2
	return 1

function @beacon_settings_set_name($bc_value : text) : number
	@beacon_settings_boot()
	if (size($bc_value) == 0) or (size($bc_value) > 32)
		return 0
	if $sqx_bc31_name__m != $bc_value
		$sqx_bc31_name = $bc_value
		$sqx_bc31_name__m = $sqx_bc31_name
	return 1
; BROADCAST31 END configuration

function @beacon_boot()
	@beacon_settings_boot()
	if !$sqx_tg47_initialized__m
		; Public installations begin with an empty target database.
		$sqx_tg47_names.clear()
		$sqx_tg47_main.clear()
		$sqx_tg47_land.clear()
		$sqx_tg47_commands.clear()
		if $sqx_tg47_selected__m != 0
			$sqx_tg47_selected = 0
			$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $sqx_tg47_selected
		if $sqx_tg47_initialized__m != 1
			$sqx_tg47_initialized = 1
			$sqx_tg47_initialized__m = $sqx_tg47_initialized

function @beacon_nav_locked() : number
	@switches_boot()
	return $sqx_ui46_nav__m and $sqx_sw49_ap__m and $sqx_sw49_power__m and (!$waypoint_navigation_active)

function @beacon_browser_owned() : number
	; DOCK owns a separate acquired identity, never the displayed NAV record.
	return @beacon_nav_locked()

function @beacon_browser_navigation_index() : number
	if @beacon_browser_owned() and ($beacon_nav_index >= 0)
		return $beacon_nav_index
	return $sqx_tg47_selected__m

function @beacon_locked() : number
	; Freeze record edits during acquisition; keep the acquired pad immutable.
	; Completed contact is not an active scan/approach record lock. NAV's
	; independent target guard below still applies until NAV/AP releases it.
	var $connected = input_number("ship-dock", 0)
	if $dock_selection_busy and (!$connected)
		return 1
	if (!$connected) and $dock_selection_ready and @sw_in_11() and ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0)
		if $sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m == $dock_selection_target
			return 1
	return @beacon_browser_owned() and (($beacon_nav_index < 0) or ($sqx_tg47_selected__m == $beacon_nav_index))

function @beacon_records_nav_record_locked() : number
	return @beacon_nav_locked() and ($sqx_tg47_selected__m == $beacon_nav_index)

function @beacon_records_ap_record_locked() : number
	if @beacon_records_nav_record_locked()
		return 1
	if $docking_active and $dock_selection_ready and ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0)
		return $sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m == $dock_selection_target
	return 0

function @beacon_valid() : number
	return ($sqx_tg47_names.size == $sqx_tg47_main.size) and ($sqx_tg47_land.size == $sqx_tg47_main.size) and ($sqx_tg47_commands.size == $sqx_tg47_main.size)

function @beacon_nav_latch()
	if !$sqx_ui46_nav__m
		$waypoint_navigation_active = 0
		$waypoint_navigation_valid = 0
		$waypoint_navigation_name = ""
		$waypoint_navigation_body = ""
		$waypoint_navigation_distance = 0
	if !@beacon_browser_owned()
		$beacon_nav_index = -1
		$beacon_nav_signal = ""
		if $beacon_notice == "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
			$beacon_notice = ""
		return
	if (!@beacon_valid()) or ($sqx_tg47_main.size == 0)
		return
	if $nav_target_beacon_pending
		$beacon_nav_index = -1
		foreach $sqx_tg47_main ($nt_i, $nt_frequency)
			if $nt_frequency == $nav_target_signal
				$beacon_nav_index = $nt_i
				break
		$nav_target_beacon_pending = 0
		if $beacon_nav_index < 0
			$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
			$sqx_ui46_nav__m = $sqx_ui46_nav
			$switches_boot_valid = 0
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
			$beacon_notice = "TARGET NO LONGER EXISTS"
			return
		$beacon_nav_signal = $sqx_tg47_main.$beacon_nav_index
		$beacon_editing = 0
		$beacon_edit_array = 0
		$beacon_new = 0
		$beacon_delete = 0
		$beacon_focus = 0
		$beacon_wait_name = 0
		$beacon_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"
	if $beacon_nav_index < 0
		$beacon_nav_index = clamp($sqx_tg47_selected__m, 0, $sqx_tg47_main.size - 1)
		$beacon_nav_signal = $sqx_tg47_main.$beacon_nav_index
		; Entering NAV closes an uncommitted editor/deletion, never saves it.
		$beacon_editing = 0
		$beacon_edit_array = 0
		$beacon_new = 0
		$beacon_delete = 0
		$beacon_focus = 0
		$beacon_wait_name = 0
		$beacon_notice = "NAV TARGET LOCKED"

; Observation-only coordinate snapshots. No receiver/locator/actuator writes.
; Frequency identity survives paging and deletion without shifting coordinates.
; T5h: destination elevation memory (frequency -> metres ASL), max 32 rows.
storage array $sqx_be19_frequency : text
storage array $sqx_be19_elevation : number
var $dest_elev_next = 0
var $dest_elev_key = ""
var $dest_elev_reported = -1

function @dest_elev_find($de_frequency : text) : number
	if $sqx_be19_frequency.size != $sqx_be19_elevation.size
		$sqx_be19_frequency.clear()
		$sqx_be19_elevation.clear()
	foreach $sqx_be19_frequency ($de_i, $de_f)
		if $de_f == $de_frequency
			return $de_i
	return -1

function @dest_elev_update()
	; Once per second; NAV to a beacon only (waypoints carry their own elevation).
	if (time < $dest_elev_next) or $waypoint_navigation_active or (!$sqx_ui46_nav__m) or ($beacon_nav_signal == "")
		if (!$sqx_ui46_nav__m) or $waypoint_navigation_active
			$nav_arrival_known_elevation = -1
			$dest_elev_key = ""
		return
	$dest_elev_next = time + 1
	if $dest_elev_key != $beacon_nav_signal
		$dest_elev_key = $beacon_nav_signal
		$dest_elev_reported = -1
		$nav_arrival_known_elevation = -1
		var $de_row = @dest_elev_find($beacon_nav_signal)
		if $de_row >= 0
			$nav_arrival_known_elevation = $sqx_be19_elevation.$de_row
	var $de_live = ($beacon_last_main == $beacon_nav_signal) and input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $nav_arrival_receive_after)
	if !$de_live
		return
	; A beacon that reports its own altitude (with valid GPS) is authoritative.
	var $de_packet = input_text("beacon", 0)
	if @beacon_available($de_packet, "altitude", "navvalid")
		if (@beacon_get($de_packet, "planet") == "") or (@beacon_get($de_packet, "planet") == @standby_nav_text(13))
			$dest_elev_reported = max(@beacon_number($de_packet, "altitude"), 0)
			$nav_arrival_known_elevation = $dest_elev_reported
	; Learn from a close, low approach, where the radio-angle estimate is good.
	if $nav_beacon_ready and ($nav_beacon_horizontal < 300) and (@standby_nav(3) < 120) and (abs(@standby_nav(4)) < 2 / 180) and ($dest_elev_reported < 0)
		var $de_elev = round(max($nav_beacon_elevation, 0))
		var $de_index = @dest_elev_find($beacon_nav_signal)
		if $de_index < 0
			if $sqx_be19_frequency.size >= 32
				$sqx_be19_frequency.erase(0)
				$sqx_be19_elevation.erase(0)
			$sqx_be19_frequency.append($beacon_nav_signal)
			$sqx_be19_elevation.append($de_elev)
		elseif abs($sqx_be19_elevation.$de_index - $de_elev) > 5
			$sqx_be19_elevation.$de_index = $de_elev
		$nav_arrival_known_elevation = $de_elev

storage array $sqx_bc18_frequency : text
storage array $sqx_bc18_name : text
storage array $sqx_bc18_lat : number
storage array $sqx_bc18_lon : number
storage array $sqx_bc18_body : text
storage array $sqx_bc18_radius : number
var $saved_beacons_revision = 0
var $saved_beacons_after = 0
var $saved_beacons_ink : number

function @saved_beacons_valid() : number
	var $count = $sqx_bc18_frequency.size
	return ($sqx_bc18_name.size == $count) and ($sqx_bc18_lat.size == $count) and ($sqx_bc18_lon.size == $count) and ($sqx_bc18_body.size == $count) and ($sqx_bc18_radius.size == $count)

function @saved_beacons_boot()
	$saved_beacons_ink = color(70, 103, 130)
	; Only this new cache is repaired; existing beacons/settings are untouched.
	if !@saved_beacons_valid()
		$sqx_bc18_frequency.clear()
		$sqx_bc18_name.clear()
		$sqx_bc18_lat.clear()
		$sqx_bc18_lon.clear()
		$sqx_bc18_body.clear()
		$sqx_bc18_radius.clear()
	$saved_beacons_revision += 1

function @saved_beacons_record($frequency : text) : number
	foreach $sqx_tg47_main ($index, $value)
		if $value == $frequency
			return $index
	return -1

function @saved_beacons_find($frequency : text) : number
	foreach $sqx_bc18_frequency ($index, $value)
		if $value == $frequency
			return $index
	return -1

; Display-only per-frequency marker preference; no receiver/control writes.
storage array $bp_nav_hidden : text

function @bp_nav_shown($bp_frequency : text) : number
	foreach $bp_nav_hidden ($bp_i, $bp_f)
		if $bp_f == $bp_frequency
			return 0
	return 1

function @bp_nav_toggle($bp_frequency : text)
	if $bp_frequency == ""
		return

function @bp_nav_prune()

function @saved_beacons_prune()
	@bp_nav_prune()
	; Cache cardinality is bounded by the saved record list, not visit history.
	; Editing a frequency/deleting a record cannot resurrect its previous marker.
	var $count = $sqx_bc18_frequency.size
	repeat $count ($step)
		var $index = $count - $step - 1
		if @saved_beacons_record($sqx_bc18_frequency.$index) < 0
			$sqx_bc18_frequency.erase($index)
			$sqx_bc18_name.erase($index)
			$sqx_bc18_lat.erase($index)
			$sqx_bc18_lon.erase($index)
			$sqx_bc18_body.erase($index)
			$sqx_bc18_radius.erase($index)
	$saved_beacons_revision += 1

function @saved_beacons_store($frequency : text, $lat : number, $lon : number, $body : text, $radius : number)
	var $record = @saved_beacons_record($frequency)
	if ($record < 0) or ($frequency == "") or (size($body) == 0) or (size($body) > 32) or ($radius <= 1000) or (abs($lat) > 90) or (abs($lon) > 180)
		return
	var $label = substring($sqx_tg47_names.$record, 0, 44)
	var $index = @saved_beacons_find($frequency)
	if $index < 0
		$sqx_bc18_frequency.append($frequency)
		$sqx_bc18_name.append($label)
		$sqx_bc18_lat.append($lat)
		$sqx_bc18_lon.append($lon)
		$sqx_bc18_body.append($body)
		$sqx_bc18_radius.append($radius)
		$saved_beacons_revision += 1
		return
	; Do not rewrite stationary coordinates every computer tick. About one metre
	; of angular movement (or a metadata change) updates the persistent snapshot.
	var $delta_lon = mod($lon - $sqx_bc18_lon.$index + 540, 360) - 180
	var $delta_lat = $lat - $sqx_bc18_lat.$index
	var $motion = sqrt($delta_lat * $delta_lat + $delta_lon * $delta_lon * cos($lat * pi / 180) * cos($lat * pi / 180)) * pi / 180 * $radius
	if ($motion < 1) and ($sqx_bc18_name.$index == $label) and ($sqx_bc18_body.$index == $body) and ($sqx_bc18_radius.$index == $radius)
		return
	$sqx_bc18_name.$index = $label
	$sqx_bc18_lat.$index = $lat
	$sqx_bc18_lon.$index = $lon
	$sqx_bc18_body.$index = $body
	$sqx_bc18_radius.$index = $radius
	$saved_beacons_revision += 1

function @saved_beacons_observe($receiver : text, $frequency : text, $settled : number)
	if (($receiver == "comms") and (time - $service_browser_seen > 0.12)) or (time < $settled) or (!input_number($receiver, 5)) or (@saved_beacons_record($frequency) < 0)
		return
	var $radius = @standby_nav(14)
	var $body = @standby_nav_text(13)
	if ($radius <= 1000) or ($body == "")
		return
	var $packet = input_text($receiver, 0)
	; An explicit invalid GPS flag never becomes a zero/zero position or fallback.
	if @beacon_has($packet, "navvalid") and (@beacon_number($packet, "navvalid") != 1)
		return
	if @beacon_has($packet, "latitude") or @beacon_has($packet, "longitude")
		if !@beacon_available($packet, "latitude", "navvalid") or !@beacon_available($packet, "longitude", "navvalid")
			return
		if @beacon_get($packet, "planet") != $body
			return
		@saved_beacons_store($frequency, @beacon_number($packet, "latitude"), @beacon_number($packet, "longitude"), $body, $radius)
		return
	; Legacy name-only broadcasts: the two main receivers share the verified
	; NAV-arrival mount (X right, Y up, Z backward). Read-only levelling, never
	; retune NAV to locate the browsing receiver. Dock's different mount is unused.
	var $distance = input_number($receiver, 1)
	var $x = input_number($receiver, 2)
	var $y = input_number($receiver, 3)
	var $z = input_number($receiver, 4)
	var $norm = sqrt($x * $x + $y * $y + $z * $z)
	var $lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $lon = @standby_nav(9)
	if ($distance <= 0) or ($distance > $radius * 4) or (abs($norm - 1) > 0.05) or (abs($lat) > 90) or (abs($lon) > 180)
		return
	var $bank = @standby_nav(5) * pi
	var $pitch = @standby_nav(4) * pi
	var $right = ($x * cos($bank) - $y * sin($bank)) * $distance
	var $up = ($x * sin($bank) + $y * cos($bank)) * $distance
	var $forward = -$z * $distance
	var $level_forward = $forward * cos($pitch) + $up * sin($pitch)
	var $level_up = $up * cos($pitch) - $forward * sin($pitch)
	var $bc_heading = @standby_nav(6) * pi / 180
	var $north = $level_forward * cos($bc_heading) - $right * sin($bc_heading)
	var $east = $level_forward * sin($bc_heading) + $right * cos($bc_heading)
	; Full spherical ENU displacement: no flat-earth longitude approximation.
	var $phi = $lat * pi / 180
	var $radial = $radius + @standby_nav(2) + $level_up
	var $polar = $radial * sin($phi) + $north * cos($phi)
	var $equatorial = $radial * cos($phi) - $north * sin($phi)
	var $new_lat = atan($polar, sqrt($equatorial * $equatorial + $east * $east)) * 180 / pi
	var $new_lon = mod($lon + atan($east, $equatorial) * 180 / pi + 540, 360) - 180
	@saved_beacons_store($frequency, $new_lat, $new_lon, $body, $radius)

function @saved_beacons_update()

function @saved_beacons_hidden($frequency : text) : number

		$dock_selection_phase = 0

		; Keep the acquired frequency/identity for the connected dock display.

		$dock_selection_busy = 0

		var $packet = input_text("docking-beacon", 0)

			if !input_number("docking-beacon", 5) or !@nav_auto_dock_empty($packet)
				@dock_selection_next()
				return
		if !input_number("docking-beacon", 5) or (@pad_requires_reservation($packet, $dock_selection_candidate) and !@pad_capable($packet, $dock_selection_candidate))
			@dock_selection_next()
			return
		$pad_candidate_packet = $packet
		var $landing = ""

		$dock_selection_after = time + 0.35

			$dock_selection_ready = 1
			$dock_selection_busy = 0
			$dock_selection_phase = 4

		var $pad_packet = input_text("docking-beacon", 0)
		var $pl_accept = 0

		if input_number("docking-beacon", 5) and $pl_accept
			$pad_selected_packet = $pad_packet
			output_text("docking-beacon", 2, $dock_selection_frequency)
			$dock_selection_after = time + 0.35
			$dock_selection_phase = 6
		else

			$dock_selection_busy = 0

function @nav_auto_dock_update()
	if $mission_mode and (($mission_mode!=1) or ($mission_phase!=3))
		return
	; Automatic arrival never uses the manual nearest-saved-dock scanner.
	$nav_auto_dock_probe = 0
	if $sqx_sw49_dock__m
		return
	$nav_auto_dock_owned = 0
	var $eligible = $sqx_sw49_power__m and $sqx_sw49_ap__m and $sqx_sw49_stab__m and $sqx_sw49_rotors__m and $sqx_ui46_nav__m and $nav_arrival_active and $nav_arrival_valid and (!$takeoff_active) and (!$docking_active) and (!$sqx_sw49_land__m) and (!$water_landing_complete) and (!input_number("ship-dock", 0)) and (!input_number("left-anchor", 0))
	if $eligible
		$eligible = ($nav_arrival_arrived or ($nav_arrival_horizontal <= 121.92)) and (abs(input_number("flight-seat", 1)) + abs(input_number("flight-seat", 2)) + abs(input_number("flight-seat", 5)) <= 0.01)
	if !$eligible
		return
	var $destination_live = (!$waypoint_navigation_active) and ($beacon_nav_signal != "") and ($beacon_last_main == $beacon_nav_signal) and input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $nav_arrival_receive_after) and (time >= $beacon_browser_nav_after)
	if $destination_live
		var $packet = input_text("beacon", 0)
		var $landing = @beacon_get($packet, "landingfrequency")
		var $pl_reservation = @pad_requires_reservation($packet, $beacon_nav_signal)
		if !@beacon_array($packet) and !@beacon_modern($beacon_nav_signal)
			; Old plain-name beacons use only THIS target's explicitly saved slave.
			var $pl_index = @beacon_browser_navigation_index()
			if ($pl_index >= 0) and ($pl_index < $sqx_tg47_land.size)
				$landing = $sqx_tg47_land.$pl_index
		if ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase==3) and $sqx_home_assume__m and ($beacon_nav_signal==$sqx_home_main__m) and ($landing=="") and !$pl_reservation
			$landing=$sqx_home_main__m
		var $pl_usable = 0
		if $pl_reservation
			; Advertised dock selects the MODE; clearance gates only approach.
			$pl_usable = @fleet_text_valid($landing,0) and ($landing != "0000") and (@beacon_number($packet,"dockvalid") == 1)
		else
			$pl_usable = @pad_legacy_ok($packet, $beacon_nav_signal, $landing)
		if $pl_usable
			; The ordinary NAV tuner follows this live advertised slave. Give its
			; retune a full settling interval; never accept the old receiver sample.
			if ($beacon_last_land != $landing) or (time < $beacon_land_after)
				return
			if $pl_reservation or @dock_selection_heading_valid()
				if !$pl_reservation
					@pad_legacy_begin($beacon_nav_signal, $landing)
				$dock_selection_nav_only = 1
				$dock_selection_start = 0
				$dock_selection_busy = 0
				$dock_selection_ready = 1
				$dock_selection_phase = 4
				$dock_selection_frequency = $landing
				$dock_selection_target = $beacon_nav_signal
				$dock_selection_best_distance = input_number("docking-beacon", 1)
				if $pl_reservation
					$pad_selected_packet = $packet
					var $pl_requested = @pad_request($packet,$beacon_nav_signal)
					$dock_selection_ready = 0
					$dock_selection_busy = 1
					$dock_selection_phase = 7
				$nav_auto_dock_owned = 1

		return

		output_text("screen", 3, $beacon_frequency)
		output_text("hud", 0, $beacon_frequency)
		$beacon_last_main = $beacon_frequency
	if input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $beacon_browser_nav_after) and ($sqx_tg47_main.size > 0)
		var $nav_packet = input_text("beacon", 0)
		if ($nav_packet != "") and ($nav_packet != $beacon_browser_nav_packet)
			$beacon_browser_nav_packet = $nav_packet
			if !$beacon_browser_nav_modern
				$beacon_browser_nav_modern = @beacon_array($nav_packet)
				if $beacon_browser_nav_modern and !@beacon_modern($beacon_frequency)
					$beacon_modern_signals.append($beacon_frequency)
			$beacon_browser_nav_land = ""
			if $beacon_browser_nav_modern
				var $slave = @beacon_get($nav_packet, "landingfrequency")
				if (size($slave) > 0) and (size($slave) <= 32)
					$beacon_browser_nav_land = $slave
				var $name = substring(@beacon_get($nav_packet, "name"), 0, 44)
				if $name != ""
					var $index = @beacon_browser_navigation_index()
					if $sqx_tg47_names.$index != $name
						$sqx_tg47_names.$index = $name
					$beacon_label = $name
	; Structured records ALWAYS use landingfrequency from the broadcast.
	; Missing/empty/oversized fields do not fall back to a saved legacy slave.
	if $beacon_browser_nav_modern
		$beacon_landing = $beacon_browser_nav_land
	if ($mission_mode==1) and ($mission_phase<=3) and $sqx_home_assume__m and ($beacon_frequency==$sqx_home_main__m) and ($beacon_landing=="")
		$beacon_landing=$sqx_home_main__m
	var $beacon_effective_land = $beacon_landing
	if ($beacon_landing == "") and !$beacon_browser_nav_modern
		$beacon_landing = $beacon_frequency
	$dock = ""
	if (@sw_in_11() or $nav_auto_dock_probe) and @sw_in_2()
		; Acquisition has sole receiver ownership until DOCK is released.
		if $dock_selection_ready and (!$dock_selection_busy)
			$dock = $dock_selection_frequency
	else
		if $beacon_landing != $beacon_last_land
			output_text("docking-beacon", 2, $beacon_landing)
			$beacon_last_land = $beacon_landing
			$beacon_land_after = time + 0.25
		; Do not interpret the old receiver sample at a new frequency.
		if time >= $beacon_land_after
			$dock = $beacon_effective_land
	if $beacon_label != $beacon_last_label
		output_text("screen", 4, $beacon_label)
		$beacon_last_label = $beacon_label
	@beacon_transmitter_transmit()
	@saved_beacons_update()

function @beacon_move($beacon_direction : number)
	@beacon_boot()
	if $beacon_editing or $beacon_delete or ($sqx_tg47_main.size == 0)
		return
	; Cycle in both directions; normalize negative remainders for first-to-last PREV.
	var $persist_next_12 : number
	$persist_next_12 = mod(mod($sqx_tg47_selected__m + $beacon_direction, $sqx_tg47_main.size) + $sqx_tg47_main.size, $sqx_tg47_main.size)
	if $sqx_tg47_selected__m != $persist_next_12
		$sqx_tg47_selected = $persist_next_12
		$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $sqx_tg47_selected
	$beacon_focus = 0
	$beacon_wait_name = 0
	@beacon_tune()

	$beacon_focus = 0

	$beacon_draft_main = ""
	$beacon_draft_land = ""

function @beacon_edit()
	if @mission_locked()
		return
	if @beacon_locked() or $beacon_delete or $beacon_editing or !@beacon_valid() or ($sqx_tg47_main.size == 0)
		return
	$beacon_draft_name = $sqx_tg47_names.$sqx_tg47_selected__m
	$beacon_draft_main = $sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m
	$beacon_draft_land = $sqx_tg47_land.$sqx_tg47_selected__m
	$beacon_draft_commands = $sqx_tg47_commands.$sqx_tg47_selected__m
	; Retain legacy storage, but only the main signal is editable for modern records.
	$beacon_edit_array = $beacon_structured
	$beacon_editing = 1
	$beacon_new = 0
	$beacon_focus = 0
	$beacon_notice = "ENTER UPDATES FIELD / SAVE COMMITS"

function @beacon_add()
	@beacon_boot()
	if ($dock_selection_busy and (!input_number("ship-dock", 0))) or $beacon_delete or $beacon_editing or (!@beacon_valid())
		return
	@beacon_back()
	$beacon_editing = 1
	$beacon_new = 1
	$beacon_focus = 1
	$beacon_wait_name = 0
	$beacon_notice = "ENTER SIGNAL ON KEYBOARD"

function @beacon_save()
	if @mission_locked()
		return
	if ($dock_selection_busy and (!input_number("ship-dock", 0))) or !$beacon_editing or (@beacon_locked() and !$beacon_new) or !@beacon_valid()
		return
	if size($beacon_draft_main) == 0
		$beacon_notice = "SIGNAL REQUIRED"
		return
	$beacon_wait_name = ($beacon_draft_name == "")
	if $beacon_wait_name
		$beacon_draft_name = $beacon_draft_main
	if $beacon_new
		$sqx_tg47_names.append($beacon_draft_name)
		$sqx_tg47_main.append($beacon_draft_main)
		$sqx_tg47_land.append($beacon_draft_land)
		$sqx_tg47_commands.append($beacon_draft_commands)
		var $persist_next_13 : number
		$persist_next_13 = $sqx_tg47_main.size - 1
		if $sqx_tg47_selected__m != $persist_next_13
			$sqx_tg47_selected = $persist_next_13
			$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $sqx_tg47_selected
	else
		if ($nav_target_kind == 1) and ($nav_target_signal == $sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m)
			var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
		$sqx_tg47_main.$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $beacon_draft_main
		if !$beacon_edit_array
			$sqx_tg47_names.$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $beacon_draft_name
			$sqx_tg47_land.$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $beacon_draft_land
			$sqx_tg47_commands.$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $beacon_draft_commands
	@beacon_back()
	@saved_beacons_prune()
	@beacon_tune()

function @beacon_remove_last()
	if @mission_locked()
		return
	if @beacon_locked() or (!$beacon_delete) or ($sqx_tg47_main.size == 0) or (!@beacon_valid())
		return
	var $beacon_last = $sqx_tg47_selected__m
	if ($nav_target_kind == 1) and ($nav_target_signal == $sqx_tg47_main.$beacon_last)
		var $nt_cleared = @nav_target_clear()
	; All associated slot data is erased, never only its visible label.
	$sqx_tg47_names.erase($beacon_last)
	$sqx_tg47_main.erase($beacon_last)
	$sqx_tg47_land.erase($beacon_last)
	$sqx_tg47_commands.erase($beacon_last)
	if $beacon_last < $beacon_nav_index
		$beacon_nav_index -= 1
	var $persist_next_14 : number
	$persist_next_14 = max(min($sqx_tg47_selected__m, $sqx_tg47_main.size - 1), 0)
	if $sqx_tg47_selected__m != $persist_next_14
		$sqx_tg47_selected = $persist_next_14
		$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $sqx_tg47_selected
	$beacon_focus = 0
	$beacon_delete = 0
	$beacon_wait_name = 0
	$beacon_notice = "RECORD DELETED"
	@saved_beacons_prune()
	@beacon_tune()

function @beacon_keyboard()
	var $beacon_enter = input_number("keyboard", 1)
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m and $beacon_editing and $beacon_enter and (!$beacon_keyboard_last) and ($beacon_focus>0)
		if ((!@beacon_locked()) or $beacon_new) and @beacon_valid()
			var $beacon_text = input_text("keyboard", 0)
			if $beacon_focus == 1
				$beacon_draft_main = substring($beacon_text, 0, 32)
				$beacon_focus = 2
				if $beacon_edit_array
					$beacon_focus = 0
			elseif ($beacon_focus == 2) and !$beacon_edit_array
				$beacon_draft_name = substring($beacon_text, 0, 44)
				$beacon_focus = 3
			elseif !$beacon_edit_array
				$beacon_draft_land = substring($beacon_text, 0, 32)
				$beacon_focus = 0
			$beacon_notice = "DRAFT ONLY / PRESS SAVE"
	$beacon_keyboard_last = $beacon_enter
	if $sqx_sw49_power__m and (!$beacon_editing) and $beacon_wait_name and (time>=$beacon_receive_after) and ($sqx_tg47_main.size>0)
		if (!@beacon_locked()) and (@service_number("comms",5)==1) and @beacon_valid()
			var $beacon_received = @beacon_received_name(@service_text("comms", 0))
			if $beacon_received != ""
				$sqx_tg47_names.$sqx_tg47_selected__m = $beacon_received
				$beacon_wait_name = 0
				$beacon_notice = ""
				@beacon_tune()

; Power display.

; Display-only measured nautical miles per MAIN-bank percentage point consumed.
; 20-second minimum and 0.2 percentage-point minimum reject tiny/noisy deltas.
storage var $sqx_ef13_best : number
var $sqx_ef13_best__m : number
var $efficiency_ready = 0
var $efficiency_valid = 0
var $efficiency_previous = 0
var $efficiency_start = 0
var $efficiency_capacity = 0
var $efficiency_seconds = 0
var $efficiency_distance = 0
var $efficiency_value = 0
var $efficiency_label = "EFF -- NM/%"
var $efficiency_pixels = 0

function @efficiency_reset()
	$efficiency_ready = 0
	$efficiency_valid = 0
	$efficiency_seconds = 0
	$efficiency_distance = 0
	$efficiency_label = "EFF -- NM/%"
	$efficiency_pixels = 0

function @efficiency_sample($ef_dt : number, $ef_capacity : number, $ef_energy : number, $ef_speed : number, $ef_enabled : number)
	if (!$ef_enabled) or ($ef_capacity <= 0) or ($ef_speed < 0.5) or ($ef_dt <= 0) or ($ef_dt > 2.5)
		@efficiency_reset()
		return
	var $ef_level = clamp($ef_energy / $ef_capacity, 0, 1)
	if (!$efficiency_ready) or (abs($ef_capacity - $efficiency_capacity) > 0.01) or ($ef_level > ($efficiency_previous + 0.000001))
		; First sample, changed bank or charging starts a new window.
		@efficiency_reset()
		$efficiency_capacity = $ef_capacity
		$efficiency_previous = $ef_level
		$efficiency_start = $ef_level
		$efficiency_ready = 1
		return
	$efficiency_seconds += $ef_dt
	$efficiency_distance += $ef_speed * $ef_dt
	$efficiency_previous = $ef_level
	var $ef_used = $efficiency_start - $ef_level
	if ($efficiency_seconds >= 20) and ($ef_used >= 0.002)
		var $ef_measured = ($efficiency_distance / 1852) / ($ef_used * 100)
		if !$efficiency_valid
			$efficiency_value = $ef_measured
		else
			$efficiency_value += ($ef_measured - $efficiency_value) * 0.25
		$efficiency_valid = 1
		; Only completed, genuinely discharging flight windows update storage.
		var $persist_next_225 : number
		$persist_next_225 = max($sqx_ef13_best__m, $ef_measured)
		if $sqx_ef13_best__m != $persist_next_225
			$sqx_ef13_best = $persist_next_225
			$sqx_ef13_best__m = $sqx_ef13_best
		$efficiency_label = text("EFF {0.00} NM/%", $efficiency_value)
		$efficiency_pixels = floor(clamp($efficiency_value / max($sqx_ef13_best__m, 0.000001), 0, 1) * 146)
		$efficiency_start = $ef_level
		$efficiency_seconds = 0
		$efficiency_distance = 0
	elseif $efficiency_seconds >= 300
		; Indefinite flat charge is not an infinite-efficiency record.
		@efficiency_reset()

function @pw_history_window_reset()
	$pw_hist_end.clear()
	$pw_hist_dt.clear()
	$pw_hist_main.clear()
	$pw_hist_cpu.clear()
	$pw_hist_distance.clear()
	$pw_hist_head = 0
	$pw_hist_count = 0
	$pw_hist_seconds = 0
	$pw_hist_main_wh = 0
	$pw_hist_cpu_wh = 0
	$pw_hist_meters = 0
	$power_estimates_rate_ready = 0
	$power_estimates_seconds = -1
	$pw_range_meters = -1
	@efficiency_reset()

function @pw_history_reset()
	@pw_history_window_reset()
	$pw_fast_ready=0
	$pw_fast_main=0
	$pw_fast_cpu=0
	$pw_epoch_rotors=-1
	$pw_epoch_flow=0
	$pw_epoch_candidate=0
	$pw_epoch_seconds=0

function @pw_history_epoch($pe_rotors:number,$pe_watts:number,$pe_dt:number)
	if ($pw_epoch_rotors>=0) and ($pw_epoch_rotors!=$pe_rotors)
		@pw_history_window_reset()
	$pw_epoch_rotors=$pe_rotors
	var $pe_flow=0
	if abs($pe_watts)>10
		$pe_flow=sign($pe_watts)
	if ($pe_flow==0) or ($pe_flow==$pw_epoch_flow)
		$pw_epoch_candidate=0
		$pw_epoch_seconds=0
		return
	if $pe_flow!=$pw_epoch_candidate
		$pw_epoch_candidate=$pe_flow
		$pw_epoch_seconds=0
	$pw_epoch_seconds+=clamp($pe_dt,0,2.5)
	if $pw_epoch_seconds>=3
		; Never average dockside charging against flight discharge, even if
		; the rotors remained on during the charge/discharge transition.
		if $pw_epoch_flow!=0
			@pw_history_window_reset()
		$pw_epoch_flow=$pe_flow
		$pw_epoch_candidate=0
		$pw_epoch_seconds=0

function @pw_fast_rate_sample($pw_fast_dt : number, $pw_fast_main_w : number, $pw_fast_cpu_w : number)
	if !$pw_fast_ready
		$pw_fast_main = $pw_fast_main_w
		$pw_fast_cpu = $pw_fast_cpu_w
		$pw_fast_ready = 1
	else
		; Preserve the previous five-second alarm smoothing separately from
		; the new five-minute display history and charging-icon hysteresis.
		var $pw_fast_blend = clamp($pw_fast_dt / (5 + $pw_fast_dt), 0, 1)
		$pw_fast_main += ($pw_fast_main_w - $pw_fast_main) * $pw_fast_blend
		$pw_fast_cpu += ($pw_fast_cpu_w - $pw_fast_cpu) * $pw_fast_blend

function @pw_history_pop()
	$pw_hist_seconds -= $pw_hist_dt.$pw_hist_head
	$pw_hist_main_wh -= $pw_hist_main.$pw_hist_head
	$pw_hist_cpu_wh -= $pw_hist_cpu.$pw_hist_head
	$pw_hist_meters -= $pw_hist_distance.$pw_hist_head
	$pw_hist_head = mod($pw_hist_head + 1, 302)
	$pw_hist_count -= 1

function @pw_history_add($pw_dt : number, $pw_main_w : number, $pw_cpu_w : number, $pw_ground_speed : number)
	if ($pw_dt <= 0) or ($pw_dt > 2.5)
		@pw_history_reset()
		return
	var $pw_cutoff = time - 300
	while $pw_hist_count > 0
		if $pw_hist_end.$pw_hist_head <= $pw_cutoff
			@pw_history_pop()
		else
			var $pw_old_start = $pw_hist_end.$pw_hist_head - $pw_hist_dt.$pw_hist_head
			if $pw_old_start < $pw_cutoff
				var $pw_trim = $pw_cutoff - $pw_old_start
				var $pw_fraction = $pw_trim / $pw_hist_dt.$pw_hist_head
				$pw_hist_seconds -= $pw_trim
				$pw_hist_main_wh -= $pw_hist_main.$pw_hist_head * $pw_fraction
				$pw_hist_cpu_wh -= $pw_hist_cpu.$pw_hist_head * $pw_fraction
				$pw_hist_meters -= $pw_hist_distance.$pw_hist_head * $pw_fraction
				$pw_hist_dt.$pw_hist_head -= $pw_trim
				$pw_hist_main.$pw_hist_head *= 1 - $pw_fraction
				$pw_hist_cpu.$pw_hist_head *= 1 - $pw_fraction
				$pw_hist_distance.$pw_hist_head *= 1 - $pw_fraction
			break
	if $pw_hist_count >= 302
		@pw_history_pop()
	var $pw_hslot = mod($pw_hist_head + $pw_hist_count, 302)
	var $pw_main_delta = $pw_main_w * $pw_dt / 3600
	var $pw_cpu_delta = $pw_cpu_w * $pw_dt / 3600
	var $pw_moved = max($pw_ground_speed, 0) * $pw_dt
	if $pw_hslot == $pw_hist_end.size
		$pw_hist_end.append(time)
		$pw_hist_dt.append($pw_dt)
		$pw_hist_main.append($pw_main_delta)
		$pw_hist_cpu.append($pw_cpu_delta)
		$pw_hist_distance.append($pw_moved)
	else
		$pw_hist_end.$pw_hslot = time
		$pw_hist_dt.$pw_hslot = $pw_dt
		$pw_hist_main.$pw_hslot = $pw_main_delta
		$pw_hist_cpu.$pw_hslot = $pw_cpu_delta
		$pw_hist_distance.$pw_hslot = $pw_moved
	$pw_hist_count += 1
	$pw_hist_seconds += $pw_dt
	$pw_hist_main_wh += $pw_main_delta
	$pw_hist_cpu_wh += $pw_cpu_delta
	$pw_hist_meters += $pw_moved

function @pw_charge_reset()
	$pw_charge_run.clear()
	$pw_charge_latch.clear()
	$pw_charge_bits.clear()
	$pw_charge_end.clear()
	$pw_charge_dt.clear()
	repeat 14 ($pw_i)
		$pw_charge_run.append(0)
		$pw_charge_latch.append(0)
	repeat 112 ($pw_i)
		$pw_charge_bits.append(0)
	repeat 8 ($pw_i)
		$pw_charge_end.append(-100)
		$pw_charge_dt.append(0)
	$pw_charge_index = 0
	$pw_charge_ready = 1

function @pw_charge_step($pw_charge_seconds : number)
	if !$pw_charge_ready
		@pw_charge_reset()
	if ($pw_charge_seconds <= 0) or ($pw_charge_seconds > 2.5)
		@pw_charge_reset()
		return
	$pw_charge_end.$pw_charge_index = time
	$pw_charge_dt.$pw_charge_index = $pw_charge_seconds
	repeat 14 ($pw_bank)
		var $pw_charging = $pw_watts.$pw_bank < -10
		var $pw_bit = $pw_charge_index * 14 + $pw_bank
		$pw_charge_bits.$pw_bit = $pw_charging
		if $pw_charging
			$pw_charge_run.$pw_bank += $pw_charge_seconds
		else
			$pw_charge_run.$pw_bank = 0
		if $pw_charge_run.$pw_bank > 5
			$pw_charge_latch.$pw_bank = 1
		if $pw_charge_latch.$pw_bank
			var $pw_recent_charge = 0
			repeat 8 ($pw_window)
				var $pw_window_seconds = max(0, min($pw_charge_end.$pw_window, time) - max($pw_charge_end.$pw_window - $pw_charge_dt.$pw_window, time - 5))
				var $pw_window_bit = $pw_window * 14 + $pw_bank
				$pw_recent_charge += $pw_window_seconds * $pw_charge_bits.$pw_window_bit
			if $pw_recent_charge < 1
				$pw_charge_latch.$pw_bank = 0
	$pw_charge_index = mod($pw_charge_index + 1, 8)

function @pw_estimates_calculate()
	$power_estimates_seconds = -1
	$pw_range_meters = -1
	$efficiency_valid = 0
	$pw_eff_pixels = 0
	if ($pw_main_capacity <= 0) or ($pw_cpu_capacity <= 0)
		return
	if ($pw_main_energy <= 0) or ($pw_cpu_energy <= 0)
		$power_estimates_seconds = 0
		$pw_range_meters = 0
		return
	if $pw_hist_seconds < 20
		return
	$power_estimates_rate_ready = 2
	$power_estimates_main_rate = $pw_hist_main_wh * 3600 / $pw_hist_seconds
	$power_estimates_cpu_rate = $pw_hist_cpu_wh * 3600 / $pw_hist_seconds
	var $pw_cpu_seconds = -1
	if $power_estimates_main_rate > 1
		$power_estimates_seconds = $pw_main_energy * 3600 / $power_estimates_main_rate
	if $power_estimates_cpu_rate > 1
		$pw_cpu_seconds = $pw_cpu_energy * 3600 / $power_estimates_cpu_rate
		if $power_estimates_seconds < 0
			$power_estimates_seconds = $pw_cpu_seconds
		else
			$power_estimates_seconds = min($power_estimates_seconds, $pw_cpu_seconds)
	; Measured distance per NET Wh, not instantaneous speed times endurance.
	if ($pw_hist_main_wh > max($pw_main_capacity * 0.00001, 0.001)) and ($pw_hist_meters > 10)
		$pw_range_meters = $pw_hist_meters * $pw_main_energy / $pw_hist_main_wh
		if $pw_cpu_seconds >= 0
			$pw_range_meters = min($pw_range_meters, $pw_hist_meters / $pw_hist_seconds * $pw_cpu_seconds)
		$efficiency_valid = 1
		$efficiency_value = ($pw_hist_meters / 1852) / ($pw_hist_main_wh / $pw_main_capacity * 100)
		$pw_eff_pixels = floor(clamp($efficiency_value / max($sqx_ef13_best__m, $efficiency_value, 0.000001), 0, 1) * 146)
		; Retain records, but never persist a new record on every sample.
		if ($pw_hist_seconds >= 299) and (time >= $pw_record_at)
			$pw_record_at = time + 60
			if $efficiency_value > $sqx_ef13_best__m
				$sqx_ef13_best = $efficiency_value
				$sqx_ef13_best__m = $sqx_ef13_best

function @power_estimates_range($power_estimates_dt : number)
	var $power_estimates_main_capacity = 0
	var $power_estimates_main_energy = 0
	var $power_estimates_cpu_capacity = $power_display_c10 + $power_display_c11
	var $power_estimates_cpu_energy = $power_display_c10 * $power_display_l10 + $power_display_c11 * $power_display_l11
	; Ten main batteries: retain their individual capacities in the estimate.
	$power_estimates_main_capacity = $power_display_c0 + $power_display_c1 + $power_display_c2 + $power_display_c3 + $power_display_c4 + $power_display_c5 + $power_display_c6 + $power_display_c7 + $power_display_c8 + $power_display_c9
	$power_estimates_main_energy = $power_display_c0 * $power_display_l0 + $power_display_c1 * $power_display_l1 + $power_display_c2 * $power_display_l2 + $power_display_c3 * $power_display_l3 + $power_display_c4 * $power_display_l4 + $power_display_c5 * $power_display_l5 + $power_display_c6 * $power_display_l6 + $power_display_c7 * $power_display_l7 + $power_display_c8 * $power_display_l8 + $power_display_c9 * $power_display_l9
	$pw_main_capacity = $power_estimates_main_capacity
	$pw_cpu_capacity = $power_estimates_cpu_capacity
	$pw_main_energy = $power_estimates_main_energy
	$pw_cpu_energy = $power_estimates_cpu_energy
	$pw_levels.clear()
	$pw_levels.append($power_display_l0, $power_display_l1, $power_display_l2, $power_display_l3, $power_display_l4, $power_display_l5, $power_display_l6, $power_display_l7, $power_display_l8, $power_display_l9, $power_display_l10, $power_display_l11, $power_display_main_level, $power_display_cpu_level)
	$pw_watts.clear()
	$pw_watts.append($power_display_w0, $power_display_w1, $power_display_w2, $power_display_w3, $power_display_w4, $power_display_w5, $power_display_w6, $power_display_w7, $power_display_w8, $power_display_w9, $power_display_w10, $power_display_w11, $power_display_main_watts, $power_display_cpu_watts)
	$pw_capacities.clear()
	$pw_capacities.append($power_display_c0, $power_display_c1, $power_display_c2, $power_display_c3, $power_display_c4, $power_display_c5, $power_display_c6, $power_display_c7, $power_display_c8, $power_display_c9, $power_display_c10, $power_display_c11, $pw_main_capacity, $pw_cpu_capacity)
	$pw_loads.clear()
	$pw_loads.append($battery_load_load0, $battery_load_load1, $battery_load_load2, $battery_load_load3, $battery_load_load4, $battery_load_load5, $battery_load_load6, $battery_load_load7, $battery_load_load8, $battery_load_load9, $battery_load_load10, $battery_load_load11, $battery_load_main_load, $battery_load_cpu_load)
	if ($pw_hist_last_main_capacity != $pw_main_capacity) or ($pw_hist_last_cpu_capacity != $pw_cpu_capacity)
		@pw_history_reset()
		@pw_charge_reset()
		$pw_hist_last_main_capacity = $pw_main_capacity
		$pw_hist_last_cpu_capacity = $pw_cpu_capacity
	if $power_display_previous_time > 0
		@pw_charge_step($power_estimates_dt)
		@pw_history_epoch($sqx_sw49_rotors__m,$power_display_main_watts,$power_estimates_dt)
		var $pw_history_forward = @standby_nav(11)
		var $pw_history_right = @standby_nav(12)
		@pw_history_add($power_estimates_dt, $power_display_main_watts, $power_display_cpu_watts, sqrt($pw_history_forward * $pw_history_forward + $pw_history_right * $pw_history_right))
		@pw_fast_rate_sample($power_estimates_dt, $power_display_main_watts, $power_display_cpu_watts)
	else
		@pw_charge_reset()
	@pw_estimates_calculate()

		$pw_meter_keys.append("")

	$pw_tte_key = ""

	$pw_eff_key = ""
