function @pw_render_button()
	; PWR is owned solely by SYSTEMS in 4.0.
	return


function @pw_signed_load($pw_signed_watts : number, $pw_signed_capacity : number) : number
	if $pw_signed_capacity <= 0
		return 0
	var $pw_budget = 10
	if $sqx_ui46_budget__m > 0
		$pw_budget = clamp($sqx_ui46_budget__m, 5, 120)
	; Existing watts: +discharge / -charge. UI: red down / green up.
	return clamp(-$pw_signed_watts * $pw_budget / ($pw_signed_capacity * 60), -1, 1)

function @pw_cell($pw_slot : number, $pw_cx : number, $pw_width : number, $pw_name : text)
	var $pw_soc = $pw_levels.$pw_slot
	var $pw_w = $pw_watts.$pw_slot
	var $pw_load = $pw_loads.$pw_slot
	var $pw_half = 9
	var $pw_top = 35
	var $pw_bottom = 102
	var $pw_track_top = 42
	var $pw_track_bottom = 86
	var $pw_track_width = 3
	var $pw_icon_y = 58
	if $pw_width > 25
		$pw_half = 19
		$pw_top = 28
		$pw_bottom = 110
		; Five pixels clear of the percent glyph and bottom bank-name glyph.
		$pw_track_top = 43
		$pw_track_bottom = 96
		$pw_track_width = 5
		$pw_icon_y = 61
	var $pw_mid = floor(($pw_track_top + $pw_track_bottom) / 2)
	var $pw_signed = @pw_signed_load($pw_w, $pw_capacities.$pw_slot)
	var $pw_bar_pixels = 0
	if $pw_signed > 0
		$pw_bar_pixels = floor($pw_signed * ($pw_mid - $pw_track_top - 1))
	else
		$pw_bar_pixels = -floor(-$pw_signed * ($pw_track_bottom - $pw_mid - 2))
	var $pw_icon = 1
	if $pw_load >= 1
		$pw_icon = -1
		if $power_display_phase
			$pw_icon = 2
	elseif $pw_load >= 0.8
		$pw_icon = 2
	elseif $pw_charge_latch.$pw_slot
		$pw_icon = -1
		if $power_display_phase
			$pw_icon = 1
	var $pw_fill = floor(clamp($pw_soc, 0, 1) * ($pw_bottom - $pw_top - 4))
	var $pw_empty = ($pw_soc <= 0.02) and $power_display_phase
	var $pw_cell_key = text("{0},{0},{0},{},{},{},{}", $pw_soc * 100, $pw_fill, $pw_bar_pixels, $pw_icon, $pw_empty, $pw_soc <= 0.25, $pw_soc <= 0.10)
	if $pw_cell_key == $pw_meter_keys.$pw_slot
		return
	$pw_meter_keys.$pw_slot = $pw_cell_key
	$pw_meter_builds += 1
	; Restore only this cell, never the neighbouring meters or estimates.
	screen_copy($power_display_bg, $power_display_lcd, $pw_cx - $pw_half, 21, $pw_cx - $pw_half, 21, $pw_half * 2 + 1, 91)
	var $pw_fill_ink = color(0, 80, 36)
	if $pw_soc <= 0.25
		$pw_fill_ink = color(110, 65, 0)
	if $pw_soc <= 0.10
		$pw_fill_ink = color(100, 15, 15)
	$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_cx - $pw_half, $pw_top, $pw_cx + $pw_half, $pw_bottom, white, color(26, 32, 38))
	$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_cx - $pw_half / 3, $pw_top - 6, $pw_cx + $pw_half / 3, $pw_top, gray, gray)
	if $pw_fill > 0
		; SOC fill spans the full interior width BEFORE the black load overlay.
		$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_cx - $pw_half + 2, $pw_bottom - 2 - $pw_fill, $pw_cx + $pw_half - 2, $pw_bottom - 2, $pw_fill_ink, $pw_fill_ink)
	if $pw_width > 25
		@power_display_text($pw_cx, $pw_top + 8, 0.5, white, text("{0}%", $pw_soc * 100))
		if $pw_empty
			@power_display_text($pw_cx, $pw_bottom - 7, 0.7, red, "E")
		else
			@power_display_text($pw_cx, $pw_bottom - 7, 0.42, white, $pw_name)
	else
		@power_display_text($pw_cx, 95, 0.35, white, $pw_name)
	if $pw_icon >= 0
		if $pw_width > 25
			screen_copy($power_display_icons, $power_display_lcd, $pw_icon * 16, 40, $pw_cx - 8, $pw_icon_y, 16, 20)
		else
			screen_copy($power_display_icons, $power_display_lcd, $pw_icon * 12, 64, $pw_cx - 8, $pw_icon_y, 12, 15)
	var $pw_track_right = $pw_cx + $pw_half - 2
	var $pw_track_left = $pw_track_right - $pw_track_width
	$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_track_left, $pw_track_top, $pw_track_right, $pw_track_bottom, gray, black)
	if $pw_bar_pixels > 0
		$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_track_left + 1, $pw_mid - $pw_bar_pixels, $pw_track_right - 1, $pw_mid, green, green)
	elseif $pw_bar_pixels < 0
		$power_display_lcd.draw_rect($pw_track_left + 1, $pw_mid + 1, $pw_track_right - 1, $pw_mid + 1 - $pw_bar_pixels, red, red)
	$power_display_lcd.draw_line($pw_track_left, $pw_mid, $pw_track_right, $pw_mid, white)

function @pw_forecast_background()

	var $pw_original_screen=$power_display_lcd
	$power_display_lcd=$pw_forecast_bg

	$power_display_lcd.draw_line(100,24,100,110,gray)

	$power_display_lcd=$pw_original_screen
	$pw_forecast_bg_ready=1

		screen_copy($pw_forecast_bg,$power_display_lcd,101,20,101,20,195,44)

			var $pw_eff_ink=orange

			$power_display_lcd.draw_rect(106,45,106+$efficiency_pixels*186/146,55,$pw_eff_ink,$pw_eff_ink)
		$pw_eff_key=$pw_field_key
		$pw_forecast_builds+=1


function @power_forecast_estimates()
	$pw_forecast_updates += 1
	$power_estimates_time_text = "--:--"
	$power_estimates_distance_text = "--"
	$power_forecast_eta = -1
	$power_forecast_eta_text = "--:--:--"

		var $pw_visible_minutes = floor(mod($power_estimates_seconds, 3600) / 60)
		$power_estimates_time_text = text("{00}:{00}", $pw_visible_hours, $pw_visible_minutes)
	elseif $pw_hist_seconds >= 20
		if ($power_estimates_main_rate <= 1) and ($power_estimates_cpu_rate <= 1)
			$power_estimates_time_text = "CHG/IDLE"
	if $pw_range_meters >= 0
		$power_estimates_distance_text = text("{0} mi", round($pw_range_meters / 1852))
		if $pw_range_meters < 1852
			$power_estimates_distance_text = text("{0} ft", round($pw_range_meters * 3.280839895))
		if $sqx_u20_metric__m
			$power_estimates_distance_text = @units_distance($pw_range_meters)
	$efficiency_label = "EFF -- NM/%"
	if $efficiency_valid
		$efficiency_label = text("EFF {0.00} NM/%", $efficiency_value)
	if $sqx_u20_metric__m
		$efficiency_label = "EFF -- km/%"
		if $efficiency_valid
			$efficiency_label = text("EFF {0.00} km/%", $efficiency_value * 1.852)
	$efficiency_pixels = $pw_eff_pixels
	var $pw_eta_valid = input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $nav_arrival_receive_after)
	var $pw_eta_distance = max(input_number("beacon", 1), 0)
	if $waypoint_navigation_active
		$pw_eta_valid = $waypoint_navigation_valid
		$pw_eta_distance = $waypoint_navigation_distance
	if !$pw_eta_valid
		return
	var $pw_eta_f = @standby_nav(11)
	var $pw_eta_r = @standby_nav(12)
	var $pw_eta_speed = sqrt($pw_eta_f * $pw_eta_f + $pw_eta_r * $pw_eta_r)
	if $pw_eta_speed <= 0.5
		$pw_eta_speed = abs($sqx_mynumber21__m)
	if $pw_eta_speed > 0.5
		$power_forecast_eta = $pw_eta_distance / $pw_eta_speed
		var $pw_eta_s = min(ceil($power_forecast_eta), 359999)
		$power_forecast_eta_text = text("{00}:{00}:{00}", floor($pw_eta_s / 3600), floor(mod($pw_eta_s, 3600) / 60), mod($pw_eta_s, 60))

; Safety observer stays 1 Hz, including Sleep. Long averages cannot hide a
; sudden sustained drain: compare averaged endurance with the original
; five-second-smoothed drain observer, not noisy instantaneous CPU cycling.
; T5s: the reserve forecast is only meaningful in steady cruise. It is not
; evaluated until the craft has held cruise altitude (within 100 ft, under
; 300 ft/min) and cruise speed (within 5 kt of the AP speed) for 2 minutes.
; After that it keeps evaluating for the rest of the trip, until AP is off or
; the NAV target changes.
var $pw_cruise_since = -1
var $pw_cruise_ready = 0
var $pw_cruise_epoch = -1
function @pw_cruise_update()
	var $pc_ap = $sqx_sw49_power__m and $sqx_sw49_ap__m
	if (!$pc_ap) or ($pw_cruise_epoch != $nav_arrival_receive_after)
		$pw_cruise_ready = 0
		$pw_cruise_since = -1
		$pw_cruise_epoch = $nav_arrival_receive_after
	if !$pc_ap
		return
	var $pc_alt_ok = abs($vertical_control_effective_altitude_target - @standby_nav(2)) < 30.48
	var $pc_vs_ok = abs(@standby_nav(1)) < 1.524
	var $pc_spd_ok = ($flight_speed_final > 10) and (abs(abs(@standby_nav(0)) - $flight_speed_final) < 5 / 1.94384449)
	if $pc_alt_ok and $pc_vs_ok and $pc_spd_ok
		if $pw_cruise_since < 0
			$pw_cruise_since = time
		elseif time - $pw_cruise_since >= 120
			$pw_cruise_ready = 1
	else
		$pw_cruise_since = -1

function @pw_alarm_guard()
	$power_forecast_alarm = 0
	@pw_cruise_update()
	if !$pw_cruise_ready
		return
	if abs(@standby_nav(0)) * 1.94384449 < 100
		return
	var $pw_alarm_valid = input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $nav_arrival_receive_after)
	var $pw_alarm_distance = max(input_number("beacon", 1), 0)
	if $waypoint_navigation_active
		$pw_alarm_valid = $waypoint_navigation_valid
		$pw_alarm_distance = $waypoint_navigation_distance
	if !$pw_alarm_valid
		return
	var $pw_alarm_seconds = $power_estimates_seconds
	if ($pw_main_capacity > 0) and ($pw_cpu_capacity > 0)
		if $pw_fast_main > 1
			var $pw_current_main_tte = $pw_main_energy * 3600 / $pw_fast_main
			if $pw_alarm_seconds < 0
				$pw_alarm_seconds = $pw_current_main_tte
			else
				$pw_alarm_seconds = min($pw_alarm_seconds, $pw_current_main_tte)
		if $pw_fast_cpu > 1
			var $pw_current_cpu_tte = $pw_cpu_energy * 3600 / $pw_fast_cpu
			if $pw_alarm_seconds < 0
				$pw_alarm_seconds = $pw_current_cpu_tte
			else
				$pw_alarm_seconds = min($pw_alarm_seconds, $pw_current_cpu_tte)
	var $pw_alarm_f = @standby_nav(11)
	var $pw_alarm_r = @standby_nav(12)
	var $pw_alarm_speed = sqrt($pw_alarm_f * $pw_alarm_f + $pw_alarm_r * $pw_alarm_r)
	if ($pw_alarm_seconds >= 0) and ($pw_alarm_speed > 0.5)
		$power_forecast_alarm = $pw_alarm_seconds < ($pw_alarm_distance / $pw_alarm_speed + 300)
	if ($pw_range_meters >= 0) and ($pw_alarm_distance > $pw_range_meters)
		$power_forecast_alarm = 1

			@power_display_prepare()

	$power_display_power = 0
	$power_display_key = ""
	$pw_scene = "OFF"
	@pw_render_button()

		$power_forecast_alarm = 0

	if time >= $power_display_next
		@power_display_sample()
		@pw_alarm_guard()
	var $pw_new_scene = text("{},{}", $power_display_mode, $display_sleep)
	var $pw_rebuild = ($power_display_power != 1) or ($pw_scene != $pw_new_scene) or ($power_display_key == "")
	if $pw_rebuild
		screen_copy($power_display_bg, $power_display_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 120)
		$power_display_lcd.draw_rect(129, 0, 171, 13, $power_display_ink, $power_display_ink)
		@power_display_text(150, 8, 0.9, orange, "POWER")
		@pw_render_invalidate()
		$pw_scene = $pw_new_scene
		$pw_draw_at = 0
		$pw_forecast_at = 0
		if $display_sleep
			@power_display_text(140, 58, 1, gray, "SLEEP")
		else
			@power_display_text(280, 16, 1, cyan, "...")
	$power_display_power = 1
	$power_display_key = $pw_scene
	; The PWR touch handler is NEVER gated by Sleep or by forecast cadence.
	@pw_render_button()
	if $display_sleep
		return
	if (time >= $pw_forecast_at) or ($units_power_seen != $units_revision)
		@power_forecast_estimates()
		$pw_forecast_at = time + 3
		$units_power_seen = $units_revision
	if time < $pw_draw_at
		return
	$pw_draw_at = time + 0.5
	$power_display_phase = mod(floor(time * 2), 2)
	if $power_display_mode == 0
		@pw_cell(12, 27, 38, "MAIN")
		@pw_cell(13, 73, 38, "CPU")
		@pw_forecast_render()
	else
		repeat 12 ($pw_visible_cell)
			var $pw_cell_name = text("H{0}", $pw_visible_cell + 1)
			if $pw_visible_cell >= 10
				$pw_cell_name = text("L{0}", $pw_visible_cell - 9)
			@pw_cell($pw_visible_cell, 14 + $pw_visible_cell * 19.5, 25, $pw_cell_name)

function @power_display_choose($power_display_x : number, $power_display_y : number)
	; Header toggles battery detail; no latent PWR hit region.
	if $display_sleep and $sqx_sw49_power__m and ($power_display_x >= 0) and ($power_display_x < 300) and ($power_display_y >= 0) and ($power_display_y < 120)
		$display_sleep = 0
		$power_display_key = ""
		return
	if @sw_in_2() and ($power_display_x >= 0) and ($power_display_x < 300) and ($power_display_y >= 0) and (($power_display_y < 16) or (($power_display_x >= 268) and ($power_display_y < 28)))
		$power_display_mode = 1 - $power_display_mode
		$power_display_key = ""

xc_files.plain_code:
; SHA-256 in bounded slices for key changes and radio-identity hashing.
var $ch_busy = 0
var $ch_result = ""
var $ch_message = ""
var $ch_block = 0
var $ch_round = -1
array $ch_work : number

function @ch_begin($ch_input : text) : number
	if $ch_busy or (size($ch_input) > 256) or !@cr_hex_valid($ch_input)
		return 0
	@cr_sha_boot()
	$ch_message = $ch_input & "80"
	while mod(size($ch_message),128) != 112
		$ch_message &= "00"
	$ch_message &= "00000000"
	var $ch_len = @cr_word_hex(size($ch_input) * 4)
	for 3,0 ($ch_i)
		$ch_message &= substring($ch_len,$ch_i * 2,2)
	$cr_sha_h.clear()
	$cr_sha_h.append(1779033703,3144134277,1013904242,2773480762,1359893119,2600822924,528734635,1541459225)
	$ch_block = 0
	$ch_round = -1
	$ch_busy = 1
	$ch_result = ""
	return 1

function @ch_step()
	if !$ch_busy
		return
	if $ch_round < 0
		$cr_sha_w.clear()
		repeat 16 ($ch_i)
			$cr_sha_w.append(@cr_hex_number(substring($ch_message,$ch_block * 128 + $ch_i * 8,8)))
		$ch_work.from($cr_sha_h)
		$ch_round = 0
		return
	repeat 8 ($ch_slice)
		var $ch_i = $ch_round
		if $ch_i >= 16
			var $ch_i15 = $ch_i - 15
			var $ch_i2 = $ch_i - 2
			var $ch_i16 = $ch_i - 16
			var $ch_i7 = $ch_i - 7
			var $ch_s0 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$ch_i15,7),@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$ch_i15,18)),floor($cr_sha_w.$ch_i15 / 8))
			var $ch_s1 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$ch_i2,17),@cr_ror($cr_sha_w.$ch_i2,19)),floor($cr_sha_w.$ch_i2 / 1024))
			$cr_sha_w.append(mod($cr_sha_w.$ch_i16 + $ch_s0 + $cr_sha_w.$ch_i7 + $ch_s1,4294967296))
		var $ch_a = $ch_work.0
		var $ch_b = $ch_work.1
		var $ch_c = $ch_work.2
		var $ch_d = $ch_work.3
		var $ch_e = $ch_work.4
		var $ch_f = $ch_work.5
		var $ch_g = $ch_work.6
		var $ch_h = $ch_work.7
		var $ch_s1 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($ch_e,6),@cr_ror($ch_e,11)),@cr_ror($ch_e,25))
		var $ch_ch = @cr_xor($ch_g,@cr_and($ch_e,@cr_xor($ch_f,$ch_g)))
		var $ch_t1 = mod($ch_h + $ch_s1 + $ch_ch + $cr_sha_k.$ch_i + $cr_sha_w.$ch_i,4294967296)
		var $ch_s0 = @cr_xor(@cr_xor(@cr_ror($ch_a,2),@cr_ror($ch_a,13)),@cr_ror($ch_a,22))
		var $ch_maj = @cr_xor(@cr_and($ch_a,$ch_b),@cr_and($ch_c,@cr_xor($ch_a,$ch_b)))
		var $ch_t2 = mod($ch_s0 + $ch_maj,4294967296)
		$ch_work.7 = $ch_g
		$ch_work.6 = $ch_f
		$ch_work.5 = $ch_e
		$ch_work.4 = mod($ch_d + $ch_t1,4294967296)
		$ch_work.3 = $ch_c
		$ch_work.2 = $ch_b
		$ch_work.1 = $ch_a
		$ch_work.0 = mod($ch_t1 + $ch_t2,4294967296)
		$ch_round += 1
	if $ch_round < 64
		return
	repeat 8 ($ch_i)
		$cr_sha_h.$ch_i = mod($cr_sha_h.$ch_i + $ch_work.$ch_i,4294967296)
	$ch_block += 1
	if $ch_block < size($ch_message) / 128
		$ch_round = -1
		return
	foreach $cr_sha_h ($ch_i,$ch_v)
		var $ch_word = @cr_word_hex($ch_v)
		for 3,0 ($ch_j)
			$ch_result &= substring($ch_word,$ch_j * 2,2)
	$ch_busy = 0

xc_files.name: fleet-link.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Background radio state machine. No actuator or flight-request writes.
function @fleet_tune($fl_frequency : text)
	if $fleet_rx_frequency != $fl_frequency
		output_text("comms", 2, $fl_frequency)
		$fleet_rx_frequency = $fl_frequency
	$fleet_due = time + 0.35

function @fleet_restart()
	$fleet_phase = -1
	$fleet_tx_ready = 0
	$fleet_last_ack = -1000
	$fleet_join_off = 0
	$fleet_join_next = time + random(1, 30) / 10
	$fleet_attempt = 0
	$fleet_start_frequency = $sqx_bc31_frequency__m
	$fleet_probe = $fleet_start_frequency
	$fleet_due = time + 0.2
	$fleet_rx_frequency = "!"
	@sec_stop()
	@beacon_transmitter_transmit()

function @fleet_boot()
	if !$fleet_options__m
		if $fleet_auth_code__m != ""
			$fleet_auth_code = ""
			$fleet_auth_code__m = $fleet_auth_code
		if $fleet_inbox__m != "BADGER-FLEET"
			$fleet_inbox = "BADGER-FLEET"
			$fleet_inbox__m = $fleet_inbox
		if $fleet_options__m != 1
			$fleet_options = 1
			$fleet_options__m = $fleet_options
	$fleet_auth_edit = $fleet_auth_code__m
	$fleet_inbox_edit = $fleet_inbox__m
	var $fl_device = device("beacon")
	$fleet_id = substring($fl_device.id, 0, 64)
	$fleet_reply_frequency = "BGR-" & substring($fleet_id, max(size($fleet_id) - 24, 0), 24)
	@fleet_restart()
	@sec_config($fleet_auth_code__m,$fleet_id,"quad")

function @fleet_next_channel()
	$fleet_tx_ready = 0
	@beacon_transmitter_transmit()
	$fleet_attempt += 1
	if $fleet_attempt >= 1024
		$fleet_notice = "NO FREE CHANNEL / RETRY"
		$fleet_phase = -1
		$fleet_attempt = 0
		$fleet_due = time + 10
		return
	if isnumeric($fleet_start_frequency)
		$fleet_probe = text("{0}", $fleet_start_frequency:number + $fleet_attempt)
	else
		$fleet_probe = substring($fleet_start_frequency, 0, 26) & "-" & text("{0}", $fleet_attempt)
	$fleet_phase = 0
	@fleet_tune($fleet_probe)
	$fleet_due += random(0, 10) / 10

function @fleet_publish()
	var $fl_packet = ""
	$fl_packet.schema = "badger.quad"
	$fl_packet.version = 1
	$fl_packet.id = $fleet_id
	$fl_packet.stamp = time
	$fl_packet.name = $sqx_bc31_name__m
	$fl_packet.frequency = $sqx_bc31_frequency__m
	$fl_packet.batteries = $batts
	$fl_packet.cpubattery = clamp((input_number("battery-small-1", 2) + input_number("battery-small-2", 2)) / 2, 0, 1)
	var $fl_battery_type = device_type("battery-1")
	$fl_packet.batteryvalid = ($fl_battery_type == "HighVoltageBattery") or ($fl_battery_type == "Battery")
	$fl_packet.cpuvalid = device_type("battery-small-1") != ""
	var $fl_planet = @standby_nav_text(13)
	$fl_packet.planet = substring($fl_planet, 0, 32)
	var $fl_lat = @standby_nav(8)
	var $fl_lon = @standby_nav(9)
	$fl_packet.latitude = $fl_lat
	$fl_packet.longitude = $fl_lon
	$fl_packet.altitude = @standby_nav(2)
	$fl_packet.navvalid = ($fl_planet != "") and (abs($fl_lat) <= 90) and (abs($fl_lon) <= 180)
	$fl_packet.speed = @standby_nav(0)
	$fl_packet.heading = @standby_nav(6)
	$fl_packet.ap = $sqx_sw49_ap__m
	$fl_packet.nav = $sqx_ui46_nav__m
	$fl_packet.docking = $sqx_sw49_dock__m
	var $fl_seat = input_number("flight-seat", 0)
	$fl_packet.pilotoccupied = $fl_seat != 0
	if $fl_seat != $fleet_pilot_token
		$fleet_pilot_name = ""
		$fleet_pilot_token = $fl_seat
	$fl_packet.pilotname = $fleet_pilot_name
	$fleet_public_packet = $fl_packet
	$sec_public_plain = $fl_packet
	if $sec_ready and ($sec_public_wire != "")
		$fleet_broadcast_packet = $sec_public_wire
	else
		@sf_split_quad($fl_packet)
		$fleet_broadcast_packet = $sf_public
	$fleet_last_publish = time
	@beacon_transmitter_transmit()

; Called only from a real LCD click. Never publish the user's seat token.
function @fleet_pilot_identify($fl_user : text, $fl_name : text)
	if !isnumeric($fl_user)
		return
	var $fl_seat = input_number("flight-seat", 0)
	if ($fl_seat > 1) and ($fl_user:number == $fl_seat)
		$fleet_pilot_token = $fl_seat
		$fleet_pilot_name = substring($fl_name, 0, 32)
		if @cr_to_hex($fleet_pilot_name) == ""
			$fleet_pilot_name = ""

function @fleet_request_reset()
	$fleet_request_nonces.clear()
	$fleet_request_times.clear()
	$fleet_request_epoch = $sec_prefix
	$fleet_request_key = $fleet_auth_code__m

function @fleet_request_record($fl_nonce : number)
	if $fleet_request_nonces.size >= 16
		$fleet_request_nonces.erase(0)
		$fleet_request_times.erase(0)
	$fleet_request_nonces.append($fl_nonce)
	$fleet_request_times.append(time)

function @fleet_request_valid($fl_nonce : number) : number
	if ($fleet_request_epoch != $sec_prefix) or ($fleet_request_key != $fleet_auth_code__m)
		return 0
	foreach $fleet_request_nonces ($fl_i,$fl_pending)
		if ($fl_pending == $fl_nonce) and (time < $fleet_request_times.$fl_i + 45)
			return 1
	return 0

function @fleet_reply()
	var $fl_reply = @sec_take("reply")
	if $fl_reply == ""
		return
	if (size($fl_reply) > 2048) or (@fleet_get($fl_reply, "schema") != "badger.fleet.reply") or (@fleet_num($fl_reply, "version") != 1)
		return
	if (@fleet_get($fl_reply, "id") != $fleet_id) or !@fleet_request_valid(@fleet_num($fl_reply, "nonce")) or (@fleet_get($fl_reply,"clientepoch") != $sec_prefix)
		return
	@fleet_proof_update(@fleet_get($fl_reply,"challengeid"),@fleet_num($fl_reply,"challengeepoch"),@fleet_get($fl_reply,"challengeboot"))
	if @fleet_num($fl_reply,"accepted") != 1
		$fleet_join_next = min($fleet_join_next, time + random(0,20) / 10)
		return
	if $pad_active and (@fleet_get($fl_reply,"challengeid") != $pad_id)
		return
	@pad_reply(@fleet_get($fl_reply, "pad"))
	$fleet_last_ack = time
	$fleet_base_packet = @fleet_get($fl_reply, "base")

function @fleet_step()
	@sec_config($fleet_auth_code__m,$fleet_id,"quad")
	if ($fleet_request_epoch != $sec_prefix) or ($fleet_request_key != $fleet_auth_code__m)
		@fleet_request_reset()
	@fleet_reply()
	@pad_client_guard()
	if device_type("comms") != "Beacon"
		$fleet_notice = "CHECK COMMS / BEACON"
		return
	if $fleet_id == ""
		@fleet_boot()
		if $fleet_id == ""
			$fleet_notice = "CHECK MAIN BEACON"
			return
	if time - $fleet_last_publish >= 1
		@fleet_publish()
	if !$sqx_bc14_tx_on__m
		$fleet_tx_ready = 0
		@sec_stop()
		$fleet_notice = "BROADCAST OFF"
		return
	if $fleet_phase < 0
		if time < $fleet_due
			return
		$fleet_phase = 0
		@fleet_tune($fleet_probe)
		$fleet_due += random(0, 15) / 10
		$fleet_notice = "CHECKING CHANNEL"
		return
	if $fleet_phase == 0
		if time < $fleet_due
			return
		if input_number("comms", 5) or ($fleet_probe == $fleet_inbox__m) or ($fleet_probe == $fleet_reply_frequency)
			@fleet_next_channel()
			return
		if $sqx_bc31_frequency__m != $fleet_probe
			$sqx_bc31_frequency = $fleet_probe
			$sqx_bc31_frequency__m = $sqx_bc31_frequency
		$fleet_tx_ready = 1
		$fleet_phase = 1
		$fleet_next_probe = time + 10 + random(0, 40) / 10
		@beacon_transmitter_transmit()
		@fleet_tune($service_browser_frequency)
		return
	; Keyed, challenge-bound registration. The pairing key never leaves RAM.
	if $sec_ready and ! $sec_tx_pending and (time >= $sec_tx_off) and @fleet_text_valid($fleet_inbox__m,0) and (time >= $fleet_join_next) and ($fleet_phase != 4)
		$fleet_nonce = @sec_take_request()
		var $fl_join = ""
		$fl_join.schema = "badger.fleet.join"
		$fl_join.version = 1
		$fl_join.id = $fleet_id
		$fl_join.nonce = $fleet_nonce
		$fl_join.clientepoch = $sec_prefix
		$fl_join.reply = $fleet_reply_frequency
		$fl_join.snapshot = $fleet_public_packet
		$fl_join.pad = @pad_message()
		if ($fl_join.pad != "")
			$fl_join.targetbase = $pad_id
		$fl_join.proof = @fleet_proof_packet()
		var $fl_submitted = @sec_submit($fl_join,"join","FLEET",$fleet_inbox__m)
		if $fl_submitted
			@fleet_request_record($fleet_nonce)
		$fleet_join_next = time + 20 + random(0,100) / 10
		if $pad_active or $pad_releasing
			$fleet_join_next = time + 6 + random(0,20) / 10
	if $fleet_auth_code__m == ""
		$fleet_notice = "FLEET AUTH DISABLED"
	elseif time - $fleet_last_ack < 60
		$fleet_notice = "AUTH / " & substring(@fleet_get($fleet_base_packet, "name"), 0, 24)
	elseif !$sec_ready
		$fleet_notice = $sec_notice
	else
		$fleet_notice = "WAITING FOR BASE AUTH"
	if contains($sec_notice,"NEEDS") or contains($sec_notice,"LIMIT") or contains($sec_notice,"FULL")
		$fleet_notice = $sec_notice
	if time < $fleet_due
		return
	if $fleet_phase == 4
		; Silence OUR transmitter before looking for someone else on its channel.
		; A second receiver otherwise hears our own nearest antenna forever.
		if input_number("comms", 5)
			@fleet_next_channel()
			return
		$fleet_tx_ready = 1
		@beacon_transmitter_transmit()
		$fleet_phase = 1
		$fleet_next_probe = time + 10 + random(0, 40) / 10
		@fleet_tune($service_browser_frequency)
		return
	if time >= $fleet_next_probe and !$sec_tx_pending and (time >= $sec_tx_off)
		$fleet_tx_ready = 0
		@beacon_transmitter_transmit()
		$fleet_phase = 4
		@fleet_tune($sqx_bc31_frequency__m)
		$fleet_due += random(0, 5) / 10
		return
	if $pad_active or ($pad_releasing and (time < $pad_release_until))
		; Do not starve public base telemetry while waiting for a pad grant.
		; Each .35s settled browser visit is followed by >=2s on reply RX.
		; Neither NAV nor numeric landing guidance is ever retuned here.
		if ($fleet_rx_frequency == $service_browser_frequency) and ($service_browser_frequency != $fleet_reply_frequency)
			@service_capture()
			$fleet_pad_browser_next = time + 2
		elseif $fleet_rx_frequency == $fleet_reply_frequency
			if input_number("comms",5)
				@sec_capture(input_text("comms",0))
			if (time >= $fleet_pad_browser_next) and ($service_browser_frequency != "") and ($service_browser_frequency != $fleet_reply_frequency)
				@fleet_tune($service_browser_frequency)
				return
		@fleet_tune($fleet_reply_frequency)
		return
	@service_capture()
	if ($fleet_phase == 2) and input_number("comms",5)
		@sec_capture(input_text("comms",0))
	$fleet_phase += 1
	if $fleet_phase > 3
		$fleet_phase = 1
	if $fleet_phase == 1
		@fleet_tune($service_browser_frequency)
	elseif $fleet_phase == 2
		@fleet_tune($fleet_reply_frequency)
	else
		var $fl_count = $sqx_tg47_main.size
		if $fl_count > 0
			$service_scan_index = mod($service_scan_index, $fl_count)
			@fleet_tune($sqx_tg47_main.$service_scan_index)
			$service_scan_index += 1
		else
			@fleet_tune($service_browser_frequency)

function @fleet_shutdown()
	@sec_stop()
	output_text("beacon", 1, "")

xc_files.name: seal-alarms.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Volume channel 2 is State text. Pressure is NOT a seal test.
; RAM only; sampled by one 2 Hz powered callback, not by drawing code.
var $seal_cockpit=0
var $seal_fuselage=0
var $seal_cockpit_alarm=0
var $seal_fuselage_alarm=0
var $seal_cockpit_grace=0
var $seal_fuselage_grace=0

function @seal_flight($height:number,$dock:number,$anchor:number,$land:number,$water_complete:number) : number
	if $dock or $anchor or $water_complete
		return 0
	; LAND retains the check below the usual 3 m airborne threshold.
	return ($height>3) or $land

; 0 unknown/unavailable, 1 airtight, 2 leak, 3 intentionally open/closing.
function @seal_decode($state:text) : number
	var $s=lower($state)
	if $s=="airtight"
		return 1
	if $s=="leak"
		return 2
	return 0

function @seal_clear()
	$seal_cockpit=0
	$seal_fuselage=0
	$seal_cockpit_alarm=0
	$seal_fuselage_alarm=0
	@warnings_track(1024,0)
	@warnings_track(2048,0)

function @seal_sample($enabled:number)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or (!$enabled)
		@seal_clear()
		return
	if $_doors_pulse1__m or $_doors_pulse2__m
		$seal_cockpit_grace=time+2
	if $maintenance_open
		$seal_fuselage_grace=time+2
	if $_doors_pulse1__m or $_doors_pulse2__m or (time<$seal_cockpit_grace)
		$seal_cockpit=3
	else
		$seal_cockpit=@seal_decode(input_text("cockpit-pressure",2))
		; Read hinge feedback only when an unsealed result needs explaining.
		if $seal_cockpit!=1
			if (abs(input_number("left-door",0))>0.003) or (abs(input_number("left-door-top",0))>0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-door",0))>0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top",0))>0.003)
				$seal_cockpit=3
	if $maintenance_open or (time<$seal_fuselage_grace)
		$seal_fuselage=3
	else
		$seal_fuselage=@seal_decode(input_text("fuselage-pressure",2))
		if $seal_fuselage!=1
			if (abs(input_number("left-cargo",0))>0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-cargo",0))>0.003)
				$seal_fuselage=3
	$seal_cockpit_alarm=($seal_cockpit==0) or ($seal_cockpit==2)
	$seal_fuselage_alarm=($seal_fuselage==0) or ($seal_fuselage==2)
	@warnings_track(1024,$seal_cockpit_alarm)
	@warnings_track(2048,$seal_fuselage_alarm)

function @seal_audible() : number
	return ($seal_cockpit_alarm and @warnings_allowed(1024,1)) or ($seal_fuselage_alarm and @warnings_allowed(2048,1))

function @seal_sound($priority:number)
	if (!$sqx_sw49_power__m) or $priority or (!@seal_audible())
		return
	$sound_alarm_until=time+0.75
	var $phase=mod(time,2)
	var $beep=($phase<0.15) or (($phase>=0.3) and ($phase<0.45))
	output_number("speaker-1",1,1000)
	output_number("speaker-2",1,1000)
	output_number("speaker-1",0,0.35*$beep*(!$sqx_ls48_mute__m))
	output_number("speaker-2",0,0.35*$beep*(!$sqx_ls48_mute__m))

xc_files.name: attitude-display.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; Attitude display.

; DISPLAY ONLY. No control outputs; reads passive command telemetry and armed AP memory.
; 50cm HD panel, pilot-screen channel 0: 300 x 300 pixels.
; Native text alignment is reset to TOP_LEFT; centring uses actual font metrics.
var $attitude_display_lcd = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $attitude_command_tape_cache = virtualscreen(48, 11)
var $attitude_panels_heading_cache = virtualscreen(44, 14)
; Short display-only filter plus hysteresis; raw control/sensor values are untouched.
var $attitude_axes_ready = 0
var $attitude_axes_at = 0
var $attitude_axes_pitch = 0
var $attitude_axes_roll = 0
var $attitude_axes_held_pitch = 0
var $attitude_axes_held_roll = 0
; T5k: one-pixel deadband for the flight-path marker and director cue.
var $ad_fx_held = 0
var $ad_fy_held = 0
var $ad_fd_x_held = 150
var $ad_fd_y_held = 150
function @ad_px_hold($ad_prev : number, $ad_new : number) : number
	if abs($ad_new - $ad_prev) <= 1
		return $ad_prev
	return $ad_new

function @attitude_axes_axes($pitch : number, $roll : number)
	var $dt = time - $attitude_axes_at
	var $pose_reset=(!$attitude_axes_ready) or ($dt>0.5) or ($dt<=0)
	if $pose_reset
		$attitude_axes_pitch = $pitch
		$attitude_axes_roll = $roll
	else
		; Preserve smoothing, but do not hold a changing pose behind a deadband.
		var $blend = clamp($dt / (0.18 + $dt), 0, 1)
		$attitude_axes_pitch += ($pitch - $attitude_axes_pitch) * $blend
		$attitude_axes_roll += (mod($roll - $attitude_axes_roll + 540, 360) - 180) * $blend
	; Sub-pixel-sized buckets retain static-pose cache reuse without the old
	; 0.35-degree hold that made gentle motion appear to update at 1-2 Hz.
	; T5k: redraw only for a change that moves a real pixel. Pitch snaps to
	; whole pixels (3.7 px per degree) and moves once it is 0.9 px away. Bank
	; reads level inside +-0.3 degrees and otherwise moves in steps that shift
	; the horizon end at the window edge by about a pixel, so micro-motion no
	; longer re-renders the whole horizon with shimmering rounding changes.
	if $pose_reset or (abs($attitude_axes_pitch - $attitude_axes_held_pitch) * 3.7 >= 0.9)
		$attitude_axes_held_pitch = round($attitude_axes_pitch * 3.7) / 3.7
	var $axes_roll_now = mod($attitude_axes_roll + 540, 360) - 180
	if abs($axes_roll_now) < 0.3
		$axes_roll_now = 0
	if $pose_reset or (abs(mod($axes_roll_now-$attitude_axes_held_roll+540,360)-180) >= 0.5) or (($axes_roll_now == 0) and ($attitude_axes_held_roll != 0))
		$attitude_axes_held_roll = round($axes_roll_now * 4) / 4
	$attitude_axes_ready = 1
	$attitude_axes_at = time


var $attitude_guidance_speed_pips = virtualscreen(4, 2400)
var $attitude_guidance_alt_pips = virtualscreen(8, 600)
const $attitude_display_ppd = 3.7
var $attitude_display_atlas = virtualscreen(288, 32)
var $attitude_display_bezel = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $attitude_graphics_terrain_cache = virtualscreen(51, 300)
var $attitude_display_sky = color(20, 101, 164)
var $attitude_display_ground = color(127, 77, 44)
var $attitude_display_ink = color(8, 14, 22)
var $attitude_display_tape = color(38, 47, 57)
var $attitude_display_ready = 0
var $attitude_display_power = -1
var $attitude_display_last_frame = ""
; T4v: 1 once a frame exists since the last power-off (the layers are then the image).
var $ar_composed = 0
var $attitude_display_mode = 0
var $attitude_display_speed_source = 0
var $attitude_display_path_edge = 0
var $attitude_frames_magenta = color(255, 0, 220)

; Centre a label in pixel coordinates WITHOUT text_align(center)'s screen offset.
; Target 0=physical LCD, 1=cached horizon, 2=cached bezel.

function @attitude_display_text($attitude_display_destination : number, $attitude_display_tx : number, $attitude_display_ty : number, $attitude_display_scale : number, $attitude_display_colour : number, $attitude_display_label : text)
	if $attitude_display_destination == 0
		$attitude_display_lcd.text_size($attitude_display_scale)
		$attitude_display_lcd.text_align(top_left)
		$attitude_display_lcd.write($attitude_display_tx - size($attitude_display_label) * $attitude_display_lcd.char_w / 2, $attitude_display_ty - $attitude_display_lcd.char_h / 2, $attitude_display_colour, $attitude_display_label)
	elseif $attitude_display_destination == 1
		$attitude_display_atlas.text_size($attitude_display_scale)
		$attitude_display_atlas.text_align(top_left)
		$attitude_display_atlas.write($attitude_display_tx - size($attitude_display_label) * $attitude_display_atlas.char_w / 2, $attitude_display_ty - $attitude_display_atlas.char_h / 2, $attitude_display_colour, $attitude_display_label)
	else
		$attitude_display_bezel.text_size($attitude_display_scale)
		$attitude_display_bezel.text_align(top_left)
		$attitude_display_bezel.write($attitude_display_tx - size($attitude_display_label) * $attitude_display_bezel.char_w / 2, $attitude_display_ty - $attitude_display_bezel.char_h / 2, $attitude_display_colour, $attitude_display_label)

; Transform the horizon only when the existing filtered display pitch/roll changes.
; Heading, tapes, locators and command bugs are NOT part of this layer's key.
var $ad_base_image = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $ar_horizon_view = virtualscreen(184,232)
var $ar_observe_ready = 0
var $ar_observed_speed = 150
var $ar_observed_alt = 150
var $ar_observed_head = 150
var $ar_observed_fd_x = 150
var $ar_observed_fd_y = 150
var $ad_base_key = ""
var $ad_base_builds = 0
var $ad_heading_number_image = virtualscreen(44, 18)
var $ad_compass_pip = virtualscreen(16, 9)
var $ad_number_value = -10000
var $ad_number_builds = 0

var $yr_ad_base_draw_ready = 0
var $yr_ad_base_draw_key = ""
var $yr_ad_base_draw_0 = 0
var $yr_ad_base_draw_1 = 0
; Direct horizon geometry, in the existing 184x232 clipped viewport.
; Preserve the old global pivot (150,150), pitch scale, bank sign and cadence.
array $hs_ground_x : number
array $hs_ground_y : number
var $hs_sin = 0
var $hs_cos = 1
var $hs_pitch_pixels = 0

function @hs_ground()
	$ar_horizon_view.blank($attitude_display_sky)
	$hs_ground_x.clear()
	$hs_ground_y.clear()
	var $hs_prev_x = 0
	var $hs_prev_y = 232
	var $hs_prev_d = -97*$hs_sin + 110*$hs_cos - $hs_pitch_pixels
	repeat 4 ($hs_corner)
		var $hs_x = 0
		var $hs_y = 0
		if ($hs_corner == 1) or ($hs_corner == 2)
			$hs_x = 184
		if $hs_corner >= 2
			$hs_y = 232
		var $hs_d = ($hs_x-97)*$hs_sin + ($hs_y-122)*$hs_cos - $hs_pitch_pixels
		if ($hs_d >= 0) != ($hs_prev_d >= 0)
			; Opposite signs guarantee a nonzero denominator.
			var $hs_t = $hs_prev_d / ($hs_prev_d-$hs_d)
			$hs_ground_x.append($hs_prev_x+($hs_x-$hs_prev_x)*$hs_t)
			$hs_ground_y.append($hs_prev_y+($hs_y-$hs_prev_y)*$hs_t)
		if $hs_d >= 0
			$hs_ground_x.append($hs_x)
			$hs_ground_y.append($hs_y)
		$hs_prev_x = $hs_x
		$hs_prev_y = $hs_y
		$hs_prev_d = $hs_d
	var $hs_triangles = max($hs_ground_x.size-2,0)
	repeat $hs_triangles ($hs_tri)
		var $hs_b = $hs_tri+1
		var $hs_c = $hs_tri+2
		$ar_horizon_view.draw_triangle($hs_ground_x.0,$hs_ground_y.0,$hs_ground_x.$hs_b,$hs_ground_y.$hs_b,$hs_ground_x.$hs_c,$hs_ground_y.$hs_c,$attitude_display_ground,$attitude_display_ground)

var $hs_segments = virtualscreen(40, 64)

function @hs_line($hs_left : number,$hs_right : number,$hs_height : number,$hs_line_roll : number)
	; Square padded tiles preserve the entire line at every bank angle.
	var $hs_length = 36
	var $hs_size = 40
	var $hs_src_y = 0
	if $hs_right-$hs_left == 20
		$hs_length = 20
		$hs_size = 24
		$hs_src_y = 40
	var $hs_count = round(($hs_right-$hs_left)/$hs_length)
	var $hs_x = 97+$hs_cos*($hs_left+$hs_length/2)+$hs_sin*$hs_height
	var $hs_y = 122-$hs_sin*($hs_left+$hs_length/2)+$hs_cos*$hs_height
	var $hs_dx = $hs_cos*$hs_length
	var $hs_dy = -$hs_sin*$hs_length
	repeat $hs_count ($hs_piece)
		if ($hs_x > -$hs_size/2) and ($hs_x < 184+$hs_size/2) and ($hs_y > -$hs_size/2) and ($hs_y < 232+$hs_size/2)
			screen_copy($hs_segments,$ar_horizon_view,0,$hs_src_y,$hs_x-$hs_size/2,$hs_y-$hs_size/2,$hs_size,$hs_size,-1,-$hs_line_roll,1)
		$hs_x += $hs_dx
		$hs_y += $hs_dy


function @hs_label($hs_local_x : number,$hs_height : number,$hs_slot : number,$hs_roll : number)
	var $hs_px = 97+$hs_cos*$hs_local_x+$hs_sin*$hs_height
	var $hs_py = 122-$hs_sin*$hs_local_x+$hs_cos*$hs_height
	if ($hs_px < -20) or ($hs_px > 204) or ($hs_py < -20) or ($hs_py > 252)
		return
	; A square label tile has enough padding for any bank, with soft edges.
	screen_copy($attitude_display_atlas,$ar_horizon_view,$hs_slot*32,0,$hs_px-16,$hs_py-16,32,32,-1,-$hs_roll,1)

function @hs_draw($hs_pitch : number,$hs_roll : number)
	$hs_sin = sin($hs_roll*pi/180)
	$hs_cos = cos($hs_roll*pi/180)
	$hs_pitch_pixels = $hs_pitch*$attitude_display_ppd
	@hs_ground()
	@hs_line(-180,180,$hs_pitch_pixels,$hs_roll)
	; T4v: only rungs within +/-180 px can pass the visibility test below, so
	; the loop starts/ends a little outside that band (same rungs, same order).
	; Each rung half is a single tile; the tile and label placement is inlined
	; with the exact expressions of @hs_line / @hs_label.
	var $hs_first = max(0, floor(($hs_pitch - 60) / 5) + 18)
	var $hs_last = min(36, ceil(($hs_pitch + 60) / 5) + 18)
	if $hs_first > $hs_last
		return
	var $hs_neg_roll = -$hs_roll
	for $hs_first, $hs_last ($hs_tick)
		var $hs_degrees = ($hs_tick-18)*5
		var $hs_height = ($hs_pitch-$hs_degrees)*$attitude_display_ppd
		; This conservative radius includes partially clipped text at every roll.
		if ($hs_degrees != 0) and (abs($hs_height) <= 180)
			if mod(abs($hs_degrees),10) == 0
				var $hs_slot = abs($hs_degrees)/10-1
				var $hs_px = 97+$hs_cos*-58+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				var $hs_py = 122-$hs_sin*-58+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if !(($hs_px < -20) or ($hs_px > 204) or ($hs_py < -20) or ($hs_py > 252))
					screen_copy($attitude_display_atlas,$ar_horizon_view,$hs_slot*32,0,$hs_px-16,$hs_py-16,32,32,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)
				$hs_px = 97+$hs_cos*58+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				$hs_py = 122-$hs_sin*58+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if !(($hs_px < -20) or ($hs_px > 204) or ($hs_py < -20) or ($hs_py > 252))
					screen_copy($attitude_display_atlas,$ar_horizon_view,$hs_slot*32,0,$hs_px-16,$hs_py-16,32,32,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)
				var $hs_x = 97+$hs_cos*-22+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				var $hs_y = 122-$hs_sin*-22+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if ($hs_x > -20) and ($hs_x < 204) and ($hs_y > -20) and ($hs_y < 252)
					screen_copy($hs_segments,$ar_horizon_view,0,0,$hs_x-20,$hs_y-20,40,40,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)
				$hs_x = 97+$hs_cos*22+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				$hs_y = 122-$hs_sin*22+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if ($hs_x > -20) and ($hs_x < 204) and ($hs_y > -20) and ($hs_y < 252)
					screen_copy($hs_segments,$ar_horizon_view,0,0,$hs_x-20,$hs_y-20,40,40,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)
			else
				var $hs_x = 97+$hs_cos*-14+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				var $hs_y = 122-$hs_sin*-14+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if ($hs_x > -12) and ($hs_x < 196) and ($hs_y > -12) and ($hs_y < 244)
					screen_copy($hs_segments,$ar_horizon_view,0,40,$hs_x-12,$hs_y-12,24,24,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)
				$hs_x = 97+$hs_cos*14+$hs_sin*$hs_height
				$hs_y = 122-$hs_sin*14+$hs_cos*$hs_height
				if ($hs_x > -12) and ($hs_x < 196) and ($hs_y > -12) and ($hs_y < 244)
					screen_copy($hs_segments,$ar_horizon_view,0,40,$hs_x-12,$hs_y-12,24,24,-1,$hs_neg_roll,1)


; T4v: padded rectangles holding every opaque bezel pixel inside the
; 184x232 horizon window (53,28). Built with the bezel in attitude_display_prepare.
array $ad_bz_x : number
array $ad_bz_y : number
array $ad_bz_w : number
array $ad_bz_h : number
function @ad_bz_add($bx1 : number, $by1 : number, $bx2 : number, $by2 : number)
	var $bx = max(53, floor($bx1))
	var $by = max(28, floor($by1))
	var $bw = min(237, ceil($bx2)) - $bx
	var $bh = min(260, ceil($by2)) - $by
	if ($bw > 0) and ($bh > 0)
		$ad_bz_x.append($bx)
		$ad_bz_y.append($by)
		$ad_bz_w.append($bw)
		$ad_bz_h.append($bh)

var $ad_bank_x = 150
var $ad_bank_y = 57.333333
var $ad_window_stale = 0
var $ad_in_x1 = 0
var $ad_in_y1 = 0
var $ad_in_x2 = 300
var $ad_in_y2 = 300
; T4v: horizon window of the base image, drawn onto $ad_window_dst in the
; original order: opaque horizon, bezel pixels inside the window, bank pointer.
function @ad_window_draw($ad_window_dst : screen)
	screen_copy($ar_horizon_view,$ad_window_dst,0,0,53,28,184,232)
	; Inside the horizon window the bezel is transparent except its edges,
	; the wings/centre box and the bank ticks (padded rectangles).
	var $ad_bz_n = $ad_bz_x.size
	repeat $ad_bz_n ($ad_bz_i)
		screen_copy($attitude_display_bezel,$ad_window_dst,$ad_bz_x.$ad_bz_i,$ad_bz_y.$ad_bz_i,$ad_bz_x.$ad_bz_i,$ad_bz_y.$ad_bz_i,$ad_bz_w.$ad_bz_i,$ad_bz_h.$ad_bz_i)
	$ad_window_dst.draw_triangle($ad_bank_x,$ad_bank_y-3,$ad_bank_x-3,$ad_bank_y+3,$ad_bank_x+3,$ad_bank_y+3,white,white)

; T4v: 1 unless the bank pointer straddles the edge of the window part of
; patch rectangle (px,py,pw,ph) (then that part cannot be drawn on its own).
function @ad_part_safe($ad_px : number, $ad_py : number, $ad_pw : number, $ad_ph : number) : number
	var $ad_x1 = max($ad_px, 53)
	var $ad_y1 = max($ad_py, 28)
	var $ad_x2 = min($ad_px + $ad_pw, 237)
	var $ad_y2 = min($ad_py + $ad_ph, 260)
	if ($ad_bank_x + 5 <= $ad_x1) or ($ad_bank_x - 5 >= $ad_x2) or ($ad_bank_y + 5 <= $ad_y1) or ($ad_bank_y - 5 >= $ad_y2)
		return 1
	return ($ad_bank_x - 5 >= $ad_x1) and ($ad_bank_x + 5 <= $ad_x2) and ($ad_bank_y - 5 >= $ad_y1) and ($ad_bank_y + 5 <= $ad_y2)

; T4v: the part of the base window inside patch rectangle (px,py,pw,ph),
; drawn onto $ad_part_dst with the same per-pixel operations in the same order
; (opaque horizon, clipped bezel rectangles, bank pointer when fully inside).
function @ad_window_part($ad_part_dst : screen, $ad_px : number, $ad_py : number, $ad_pw : number, $ad_ph : number)
	var $ad_x1 = max($ad_px, 53)
	var $ad_y1 = max($ad_py, 28)
	var $ad_x2 = min($ad_px + $ad_pw, 237)
	var $ad_y2 = min($ad_py + $ad_ph, 260)
	if ($ad_x2 <= $ad_x1) or ($ad_y2 <= $ad_y1)
		return
	screen_copy($ar_horizon_view,$ad_part_dst,$ad_x1 - 53,$ad_y1 - 28,$ad_x1,$ad_y1,$ad_x2 - $ad_x1,$ad_y2 - $ad_y1)
	var $ad_bz_n = $ad_bz_x.size
	if ($ad_x2 <= $ad_in_x1) or ($ad_x1 >= $ad_in_x2) or ($ad_y2 <= $ad_in_y1) or ($ad_y1 >= $ad_in_y2)
		$ad_bz_n = min($ad_bz_n, 4)
	repeat $ad_bz_n ($ad_bz_i)
		var $ad_bx1 = max($ad_bz_x.$ad_bz_i, $ad_x1)
		var $ad_by1 = max($ad_bz_y.$ad_bz_i, $ad_y1)
		var $ad_bx2 = min($ad_bz_x.$ad_bz_i + $ad_bz_w.$ad_bz_i, $ad_x2)
		var $ad_by2 = min($ad_bz_y.$ad_bz_i + $ad_bz_h.$ad_bz_i, $ad_y2)
		if ($ad_bx2 > $ad_bx1) and ($ad_by2 > $ad_by1)
			screen_copy($attitude_display_bezel,$ad_part_dst,$ad_bx1,$ad_by1,$ad_bx1,$ad_by1,$ad_bx2 - $ad_bx1,$ad_by2 - $ad_by1)
	if ($ad_bank_x - 5 >= $ad_x1) and ($ad_bank_x + 5 <= $ad_x2) and ($ad_bank_y - 5 >= $ad_y1) and ($ad_bank_y + 5 <= $ad_y2)
		$ad_part_dst.draw_triangle($ad_bank_x,$ad_bank_y-3,$ad_bank_x-3,$ad_bank_y+3,$ad_bank_x+3,$ad_bank_y+3,white,white)

function @ad_base_draw($ad_pitch : number, $ad_roll : number)
	var $ad_key = $yr_ad_base_draw_key
	if !$yr_ad_base_draw_ready or $ad_pitch != $yr_ad_base_draw_0 or $ad_roll != $yr_ad_base_draw_1
		$ad_key = text("{},{}",$ad_pitch,$ad_roll)
		$yr_ad_base_draw_key = $ad_key
		$yr_ad_base_draw_ready = 1
		$yr_ad_base_draw_0 = $ad_pitch
		$yr_ad_base_draw_1 = $ad_roll
	if $ad_key != $ad_base_key
		@hs_draw($ad_pitch,$ad_roll)
		if $ad_base_key == ""
			$ad_base_image.blank($attitude_display_ink)
			screen_copy($attitude_display_bezel,$ad_base_image,0,0,0,0,300,300)
		; T4v: the window part of the base (horizon + bezel + bank pointer) is
		; composed straight onto the LCD by the horizon patch; the base copy
		; is refreshed only when another patch needs the window region.
		var $ad_bank = $ad_roll*pi/180
		$ad_bank_x = 150+sin($ad_bank)*66
		$ad_bank_y = 123.333333-cos($ad_bank)*66
		$ad_window_stale = 1
		$ad_base_key = $ad_key
		$ad_base_builds += 1


function @ad_heading_number($ad_bearing : number)
	; Match the original integer formatter, including its pre-wrap 360 reading.
	var $ad_number = round($ad_bearing)
	if $ad_number != $ad_number_value
		$ad_heading_number_image.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
		$ad_heading_number_image.draw_rect(0, 0, 42, 18, cyan, $attitude_display_ink)
		$ad_heading_number_image.text_size(1.65)
		$ad_heading_number_image.text_align(top_left)
		var $ad_text = text("{000}", $ad_bearing)
		$ad_heading_number_image.write(21 - size($ad_text) * $ad_heading_number_image.char_w / 2, 9 - $ad_heading_number_image.char_h / 2, cyan, $ad_text)
		$ad_number_value = $ad_number
		$ad_number_builds += 1
	screen_copy($ad_heading_number_image, $attitude_display_lcd, 0, 0, 129, 282, 44, 18)

function @attitude_display_prepare()
	; Full-size cached numbers and stronger soft-edged line sprites; built once.
	$hs_segments.blank(color(0,0,0,0))
	; Stronger coverage, same centreline and same rotated tiles/copy workload.
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,19,38,19,color(255,255,255,160))
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,20,38,20,white)
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,21,38,21,color(255,255,255,160))
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,51,22,51,color(255,255,255,160))
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,52,22,52,white)
	$hs_segments.draw_line(2,53,22,53,color(255,255,255,160))
	$attitude_display_atlas.blank(color(0,0,0,0))
	repeat 9 ($hs_label_index)
		@attitude_display_text(1,$hs_label_index*32+16,16,1,white,text("{0}",($hs_label_index+1)*10))
	; No circular mask: the horizon fills the whole central viewport.
	; Fixed 45-degree, nine-pixel terrain stripes. Clip BOTH axes at cache edges.
	$attitude_graphics_terrain_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 40 ($terrain_stripe)
		var $terrain_intercept = $terrain_stripe * 9 - 54
		var $terrain_x0 = max(0, -$terrain_intercept)
		var $terrain_y0 = max(0, $terrain_intercept)
		var $terrain_x1 = min(50, 299 - $terrain_intercept)
		var $terrain_y1 = $terrain_x1 + $terrain_intercept
		if ($terrain_x1 >= $terrain_x0) and ($terrain_y0 <= 299)
			$attitude_graphics_terrain_cache.draw_line($terrain_x0, $terrain_y0, $terrain_x1, $terrain_y1, $attitude_display_ground)
	$attitude_display_bezel.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$attitude_display_bezel.draw_rect(0, 0, 53.333333, 300, $attitude_display_tape, $attitude_display_tape)

function @attitude_frames_hatch($attitude_frames_x1 : number, $attitude_frames_y1 : number, $attitude_frames_x2 : number, $attitude_frames_y2 : number)
	if $attitude_frames_y2 > $attitude_frames_y1
		repeat 18 ($attitude_frames_hi)
			var $attitude_frames_hx = $attitude_frames_x1 - 42 + $attitude_frames_hi * 6
			var $attitude_frames_sx = max($attitude_frames_x1, $attitude_frames_hx)
			var $attitude_frames_sy = $attitude_frames_y1 + max(0, $attitude_frames_x1 - $attitude_frames_hx)
			var $attitude_frames_ex = min($attitude_frames_x2, $attitude_frames_hx + $attitude_frames_y2 - $attitude_frames_y1)
			var $attitude_frames_ey = $attitude_frames_y2 - max(0, $attitude_frames_hx + $attitude_frames_y2 - $attitude_frames_y1 - $attitude_frames_x2)
			if ($attitude_frames_ex > $attitude_frames_sx) and ($attitude_frames_ey > $attitude_frames_sy)
				$attitude_display_lcd.draw_line($attitude_frames_sx, $attitude_frames_sy, $attitude_frames_ex, $attitude_frames_ey, yellow)

function @attitude_frames_tape_bug($attitude_frames_edge : number, $attitude_frames_y : number, $attitude_frames_side : number, $attitude_frames_active : number)
	var $attitude_frames_by = clamp(round($attitude_frames_y), 31, 253)
	if $attitude_frames_active
		var $attitude_command_source_x = 12 * @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling()
		var $attitude_command_destination_x = $attitude_frames_edge
		if $attitude_frames_side < 0
			$attitude_command_source_x += 24
			$attitude_command_destination_x -= 11
		screen_copy($attitude_command_tape_cache, $attitude_display_lcd, $attitude_command_source_x, 0, $attitude_command_destination_x, $attitude_frames_by - 5, 12, 11)

function @attitude_frames_heading_bug($attitude_frames_target : number, $attitude_frames_current : number, $attitude_frames_active : number)
	var $attitude_frames_delta = mod($attitude_frames_target - $attitude_frames_current + 540, 360) - 180
	; Quantize the final pixel, not the heading: equal headings centre on the pip.
	var $attitude_frames_hx = clamp(round(150 + $attitude_frames_delta * 2.222222), 73, 217)
	if $attitude_frames_active
		screen_copy($attitude_panels_heading_cache, $attitude_display_lcd, 22 * @autopilot_ownership_ap_controlling(), 0, $attitude_frames_hx - 11, 258, 22, 14)

function @rc_prepare_speed_strip()
	if $rc_speed_strip_units == $units_revision
		return
	$rc_speed_strip.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	var $rc_speed_destination = $attitude_display_lcd
	$attitude_display_lcd = $rc_speed_strip
	; The 0-10 knot caution hatch is part of the moving strip, not the frame.
	@attitude_frames_hatch(0, 2150, 53.333333, 2200)
	repeat 401 ($rc_speed_minor)
		var $rc_speed_ink = white
		if $rc_speed_minor >= 200
			$rc_speed_ink = red
		elseif $rc_speed_minor >= 150
			$rc_speed_ink = orange
		elseif $rc_speed_minor >= 120
			$rc_speed_ink = yellow
		var $rc_speed_y = 2200 - $rc_speed_minor * 5
		$attitude_display_lcd.draw_line(49.333333, $rc_speed_y, 52.333333, $rc_speed_y, $rc_speed_ink)
		if mod($rc_speed_minor, 5) == 0
			$attitude_display_lcd.draw_line(46.666667, $rc_speed_y, 53.333333, $rc_speed_y, $rc_speed_ink)
			@attitude_display_text(0, 25.555556, $rc_speed_y, 1, $rc_speed_ink, @units_choice(text("{0}", $rc_speed_minor), text("{0}", $rc_speed_minor / 1.94384449)))
	$attitude_display_lcd.draw_rect(50, 1450, 53.333333, 1600, yellow, yellow)
	$attitude_display_lcd.draw_rect(50, 1200, 53.333333, 1450, orange, orange)
	$attitude_display_lcd.draw_rect(50, 0, 53.333333, 1200, red, red)
	$attitude_display_lcd = $rc_speed_destination
	$rc_speed_strip_units = $units_revision
	$rc_speed_strip_builds += 1

function @rc_prepare_alt_strip($rc_alt_feet : number)
	var $rc_alt_base = floor($rc_alt_feet / 1000) * 1000
	if $rc_alt_strip_ready and (abs($rc_alt_feet - $rc_alt_strip_base) <= 1500) and ($rc_alt_strip_units == $units_revision)
		return
	$rc_alt_strip.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 177 ($rc_alt_minor)
		var $rc_alt_delta = ($rc_alt_minor - 88) * 25
		var $rc_alt_y = 600 - $rc_alt_delta * 0.266667
		var $rc_alt_mark = $rc_alt_base + $rc_alt_delta
		if mod($rc_alt_delta + 2200, 100) == 0
			$rc_alt_strip.draw_line(6.222222, $rc_alt_y, 17.777778, $rc_alt_y, white)
			$rc_alt_strip.text_size(0.8)
			$rc_alt_strip.text_align(top_left)
			var $rc_alt_label = @units_choice(text("{0}", $rc_alt_mark), text("{0}", $rc_alt_mark / 3.280839895))
			$rc_alt_strip.write(32.555556 - size($rc_alt_label) * $rc_alt_strip.char_w / 2, $rc_alt_y - $rc_alt_strip.char_h / 2, white, $rc_alt_label)
		else
			var $rc_alt_width = 3
			if mod($rc_alt_delta + 2200, 50) == 0
				$rc_alt_width = 6
			$rc_alt_strip.draw_line(6.222222, $rc_alt_y, 6.222222 + $rc_alt_width, $rc_alt_y, white)
	$rc_alt_strip_base = $rc_alt_base
	$rc_alt_strip_units = $units_revision
	$rc_alt_strip_ready = 1
	$rc_alt_strip_builds += 1

function @rc_prepare_compass_strip()
	if $rc_compass_strip_ready
		return
	$rc_compass_strip.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	; Extra repeated bearings on either side cover the 359->000 wrap seam.
	repeat 49 ($rc_compass_tick)
		var $rc_compass_mark = ($rc_compass_tick - 6) * 10
		var $rc_compass_x = 140 + $rc_compass_mark * 2.222222
		var $rc_compass_num = mod($rc_compass_mark + 720, 360)
		var $rc_compass_label = text("{00}", $rc_compass_num / 10)
		var $rc_compass_size = 1.1
		if $rc_compass_num == 0
			$rc_compass_label = "N"
		elseif $rc_compass_num == 90
			$rc_compass_label = "E"
		elseif $rc_compass_num == 180
			$rc_compass_label = "S"
		elseif $rc_compass_num == 270
			$rc_compass_label = "W"
		if mod($rc_compass_num, 90) == 0
			$rc_compass_size = 1.7
		$rc_compass_strip.draw_line($rc_compass_x, 3, $rc_compass_x, 9, white)
		$rc_compass_strip.text_size($rc_compass_size)
		$rc_compass_strip.text_align(top_left)
		$rc_compass_strip.write($rc_compass_x - size($rc_compass_label) * $rc_compass_strip.char_w / 2, 17 - $rc_compass_strip.char_h / 2, white, $rc_compass_label)
	$rc_compass_strip_ready = 1
	$rc_compass_strip_builds += 1

	if $attitude_display_knots >= 200

	$attitude_display_lcd.draw_rect(0, 136.666667, 52.222222, 158.888889, $attitude_display_current_speed_colour, $attitude_display_ink)
	$attitude_display_lcd.draw_triangle(52.222222, 136.666667, 58.888889, 147.777778, 52.222222, 158.888889, $attitude_display_current_speed_colour, $attitude_display_ink)

	if ($ar_x == 53) and ($ar_y == 28) and ($ar_w == 184) and ($ar_h == 232)
		; T4v: the horizon patch is exactly the base window; compose it directly.
		@ad_window_draw($attitude_display_lcd)
	else
		; T4v: outside the window the base is static. Its window region is
		; refreshed only when the bank pointer would be cut by this rectangle;
		; otherwise the window part is rebuilt from the layers after the copy.
		if $ad_window_stale
			if !@ad_part_safe($ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)
				@ad_window_draw($ad_base_image)
				$ad_window_stale = 0
		screen_copy($ad_base_image,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)
		if $ad_window_stale
			@ad_window_part($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)
	if $ar_x < 66
		screen_copy($rc_attitude_display_speed_tape_image,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_x,$ar_y,min($ar_w,66-$ar_x),$ar_h)
	if $ar_x + $ar_w > 225
		var $ar_ax = max($ar_x,225)
		var $ar_aw = min($ar_x+$ar_w,287)-$ar_ax
		if $ar_aw > 0
			screen_copy($rc_attitude_display_alt_tape_image,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_ax,$ar_y,$ar_ax,$ar_y,$ar_aw,$ar_h)
	if ($ar_y+$ar_h > 258) and ($ar_x < 229) and ($ar_x+$ar_w > 62)
		var $ar_cx = max($ar_x,62)
		var $ar_cy = max($ar_y,258)
		screen_copy($rc_attitude_display_compass_image,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_cx,$ar_cy,$ar_cx,$ar_cy,min($ar_x+$ar_w,229)-$ar_cx,$ar_y+$ar_h-$ar_cy)
	if $ar_x+$ar_w > 286
		var $ar_vx = max($ar_x,286)
		screen_copy($ar_vs,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_vx,$ar_y,$ar_vx,$ar_y,$ar_x+$ar_w-$ar_vx,$ar_h)
	if $ar_y < 28
		screen_copy($ar_header,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,min($ar_h,28-$ar_y))
	var $ar_ox = max(max($ar_x,53),$ar_ov_x1)
	var $ar_oy = max(max($ar_y,28),$ar_ov_y1)
	var $ar_ow = min(min($ar_x+$ar_w,237),$ar_ov_x2)-$ar_ox
	var $ar_oh = min(min($ar_y+$ar_h,260),$ar_ov_y2)-$ar_oy
	if ($ar_ow > 0) and ($ar_oh > 0)
		screen_copy($ar_overlay,$attitude_display_lcd,$ar_ox,$ar_oy,$ar_ox,$ar_oy,$ar_ow,$ar_oh)
	@ar_bug_crop($attitude_command_tape_cache,12*$ar_command_fill,53.333333,$ar_speed_command-5,12,11,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)
	@ar_bug_crop($attitude_command_tape_cache,24+12*$ar_command_fill,225.222222,$ar_alt_command-5,12,11,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)
	@ar_bug_crop($attitude_panels_heading_cache,22*$ar_command_fill,$ar_head_command-11,258,22,14,$ar_x,$ar_y,$ar_w,$ar_h)

	if $ar_composed
		var $ar_keep = $attitude_display_lcd
		$attitude_display_lcd = $ar_destination
		if $ar_full
			@ar_patch(0,0,300,300)
		else
			if $ar_horizon_dirty
				@ar_patch(53,28,184,232)
			if $ar_speed_dirty
				@ar_patch(0,0,66,300)
			if $ar_alt_dirty
				@ar_patch(225,0,63,300)
			if $ar_compass_dirty
				@ar_patch(62,258,167,42)
			if $ar_vs_dirty
				@ar_patch(286,0,14,300)
			if $ar_header_dirty
				@ar_patch(0,0,242,28)
		$attitude_display_lcd = $ar_keep
	elseif $ar_full
		screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_destination,0,0,0,0,300,300)
	else
		if $ar_horizon_dirty
			screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_destination,53,28,53,28,184,232)
		if $ar_speed_dirty
			screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_destination,0,0,0,0,66,300)
		if $ar_alt_dirty

		if $ar_compass_dirty

		if $ar_vs_dirty
			screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_destination,286,0,286,0,14,300)
		if $ar_header_dirty
			screen_copy($attitude_display_lcd,$ar_destination,0,0,0,0,242,28)

	$ar_speed_dirty = 0
	$ar_alt_dirty = 0
	$ar_compass_dirty = 0

function @ad_locator_sample()

	$ad_locator_signal=0
	$ad_locator_range=0
	$ad_locator_right=0

		return

		$ad_locator_source=2
		$ad_receiver="docking-beacon"

		if $ad_docking
			if (!$dock_selection_ready) or $dock_selection_busy
				return

		var $attitude_display_sensor_heading = @standby_nav(6)
		var $attitude_display_sensor_forward = @standby_nav(11)
		var $attitude_display_sensor_right = @standby_nav(12)

		var $attitude_display_fx = 0
		var $attitude_display_fy = 0
		var $attitude_display_visible = 0
		$attitude_display_path_edge = 0

				$attitude_display_fy = round(150 - atan($attitude_display_body_u, $attitude_display_body_f) * 180 / pi * $attitude_display_ppd)

				if $attitude_display_fx < 66
					$attitude_display_path_edge += 1
				elseif $attitude_display_fx > 224
					$attitude_display_path_edge += 2
				if $attitude_display_fy < 40

			elseif ($ad_fx_held > 0) and ($attitude_display_path_edge == 0)

const $doormax = 0.1500000

var $_doors_pulse2__m : number

var $lights_was_rotors = 0

var $sqx_do32_initialized__m : number

function @access_set($locked : number)
	var $persist_next_141 : number
	$persist_next_141 = $locked != 0
	if $sqx_lock14_locked__m != $persist_next_141
		$sqx_lock14_locked = $persist_next_141
		$sqx_lock14_locked__m = $sqx_lock14_locked

	$access_buffers.1 = ""
	if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
		if $_doors_pulse1__m != 0
			$_doors_pulse1 = 0
			$_doors_pulse1__m = $_doors_pulse1
		if $_doors_pulse2__m != 0
			$_doors_pulse2 = 0
			$_doors_pulse2__m = $_doors_pulse2
		@maintenance_close()

function @pilot_maintenance_toggle()
	if $sqx_lock14_locked__m
		@access_set(0)
	$maintenance_open=!$maintenance_open
	$maintenance_pilot_override=$maintenance_open
	@maintenance_apply()

function @access_enter($side : number)
	if ($side < 0) or ($side > 1) or (time < $access_until)
		return
	if $access_buffers.$side == $sqx_lock14_pin__m
		$access_failures = 0
		@access_set(0)
	else
		$access_buffers.$side = ""
		$access_messages.$side = "WRONG PIN"
		$access_failures += 1
		if $access_failures >= 3
			$access_until = time + 10
			$access_failures = 0

function @doors_boot()
	if $sqx_do32_initialized__m
		return
	; Preserve the physical position on first installation; later boots use storage.
	var $persist_next_144 : number
	$persist_next_144 = (abs(input_number("left-door", 0)) > 0.001) or (abs(input_number("left-door-top", 0)) > 0.001)

	var $persist_next_145 : number
	$persist_next_145 = (abs(input_number("right-door", 0)) > 0.001) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top", 0)) > 0.001)
	if $_doors_pulse2__m != $persist_next_145
		$_doors_pulse2 = $persist_next_145

function @doors_toggle($side : number)

		return

	if $side == 0
		var $persist_next_147 : number
		$persist_next_147 = !$_doors_pulse1__m

		return

	output_number("speaker-2", 1, 1000)
	output_number("speaker-1", 0, 0.35 * $beep * (!$sqx_ls48_mute__m))
	output_number("speaker-2", 0, 0.35 * $beep * (!$sqx_ls48_mute__m))
